jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer, LLM Systems
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

You will own a multi-agent research system as production infrastructure: make it faster, cheaper, measurably better and efficient.

hermeneutic Research Labs is the firm’s applied research and engineering unit. Its first product is a research intelligence platform for both traditional and digital-asset markets, built with our researchers and traders and used by them every day. The platform turns market, on-chain, macro and news data into event-driven research that trading decisions rely on. The platform is held to the standard we apply to our own trading: rigorous, falsifiable and measured on outcomes.

The Labs is making a multi-year investment to turn the platform into production infrastructure that a growing set of internal users can depend on. As part of that investment, it is hiring a Lead AI Engineer.

The LLM layer is yours for years. A research query runs through multiple agent stages across several model providers and our own self-hosted models. You start with your hands on the system, writing code and running experiments. As the function grows, you will hire and lead its engineers. The role is built to grow into Head of AI Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Keep the LLM layer reliable: latency budgets, concurrency and queueing, declared degradation modes, structured-output validation and provider failover.
  • Build evaluation tied to research outcomes: offline sets from real queries with outcome labels, online experiments, regression gates on every change, and model-generated confidence calibrated with quantitative research before it reaches a decision.
  • Control cost and routing: per-workload cost attribution, difficulty-based routing between small and frontier models, caching and batching, and the economics of self-hosted serving and GPU capacity.
  • Run model strategy and lifecycle: pinned model versions, replayable test batteries before any change, one-step rollback, provider diversification, and fine-tuning or adapters where they pay.
  • Shape the agent architecture with evidence: ablate and retire components that do not earn their keep, and improve tool use, memory and retrieval only where they move research outcomes.
  • Ground and trace outputs: citation, hallucination controls, audit trails, and the boundary between what a model may assert and what it may only suggest.
  • Build the team: review and mentor engineers now, and hire and lead an AI engineering group as the function grows.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of software or ML engineering, including 3+ years shipping LLM-backed systems to real users in production, where you owned latency, cost and quality, and 2+ years leading other engineers while still shipping.
  • A track record of building a function from nothing.
  • Command of inference economics: tokens, caching, routing, structured outputs, tool use and quantisation, with cost-per-request figures for the systems you ran.
  • Measurement discipline: you instrument before changing anything, evaluate against outcomes rather than model judges, have built an eval that caught what a vibe check missed, and have retired a component with data.
  • Strong Python, including async concurrency.
  • Experience with self-hosted serving (vLLM or similar), adapters and GPU capacity planning, or an end-to-end provider migration.
  • Depth in vector and graph retrieval, built and measured, with an informed view on when retrieval is the wrong fix.

Technologies named here are what we run today, not a filter. We hire for depth and judgement.

Desired Attributes

  • Directness: you tell the author when their component does not earn its keep.
  • Sound judgement working alongside AI coding agents on a largely AI-written codebase, keeping ownership of what ships.
  • Initiative: you take on the hard, unowned problem first, and bring the profiling data and a first fix.
  • Bonus: fine-tuning and preference optimisation in production, and an informed view on when multi-agent frameworks are over-built.
  • Bonus: finance or trading exposure, and experience hiring engineers.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Hiring Manager Screen – A conversation about the LLM systems you have run in production.
  3. Systems Deep-Dive – A whiteboard session on LLM systems design.
  4. Hands-On Round – A take-home on a synthetic trace set with a review, or a live debugging session.
  5. Reliability and Measurement Scenarios – A scenario discussion with peers from research or risk.
  6. Collaboration and AI-Assisted Work – A conversation on how you work with teammates and AI coding agents.
  7. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to assess your capabilities, strategic thinking, and cultural fit.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

The Channel Company values differences because they enhance dynamic teams. We know that the confidence gap can get in the way of connecting with the best candidates. Please do not hesitate to apply – we would be honored to connect with you.

About the role

The Partner Marketing Specialist works on behalf of a large global IT vendor in the cloud computing space, supporting the enablement of its partner network at scale. The role focuses on increasing awareness and driving adoption of the vendor's existing marketing tools, platforms and resources, empowering partners to independently leverage the support available to them.

Our Partner Marketing Specialists engage with both partners and internal teams across a range of activities, including promoting marketing platforms and partner-ready resources, supporting the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF), and providing guidance on marketing processes, best practices and vendor guidelines. They deliver one-to-one partner support and onboarding, while also driving enablement at scale through webinars, workshops and bootcamps, delivered both virtually and in person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner and Internal Enablement: Drive awareness and understanding of the vendor's marketing tools, platforms, resources and processes across the partner network and internal teams.
  • Marketing Platform Adoption: Promote the use of the vendor's marketing platform, ensuring partners are aware of and able to access available partner-ready campaigns, templates, marketing assets and other resources to support their marketing activities.
  • Marketing Funding Enablement: Support partner awareness and adoption of marketing funding programmes. Ensure partners understand their eligibility, available opportunities, funding guidelines and the processes required to access and use funding.
  • Marketing Process and Guidelines: Educate partners and internal stakeholders on the vendor's marketing guidelines, best practices and operational processes, including lead tagging requirements and other key marketing mechanisms.
  • Partner Onboarding and Engagement: Manage one-to-one partner conversations and onboarding sessions, helping partners navigate available resources and understand how to leverage the vendor's marketing ecosystem.
  • Enablement Activities: Collaborate with internal teams to develop and deliver enablement initiatives at scale, including webinars, workshops and bootcamps, both virtually and in person.
  • Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to ensure they are familiar with available marketing resources, platforms and processes, enabling them to effectively guide and support partners.
  • Reporting and Insights: Maintain reporting on enablement activities, platform adoption and partner engagement, providing visibility into progress and identifying opportunities to improve awareness and adoption.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Additional European language is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging presentations and training sessions to large audiences, both in person and virtually. Ability to communicate information clearly, simplify complex topics and adapt messaging to different audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish trust with partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities and proactively identify opportunities to improve enablement and adoption.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Word.
  • Curious about AI and emerging technologies, with an interest in exploring and creating AI agents to simplify ways of working, improve efficiency and maximise impact.

Benefits:

  • 35 hours of work per week
  • Generous Holiday package + National bank holidays
  • Opportunity to join a growing business with lots of opportunities to influence.
  • 100% Remote working. We have the best of both worlds with a historical remote working setup and an office in London or Madrid.

About the Role

The Coding Specialist is responsible for independently reviewing, analyzing, and resolving all assigned front-end scrubs and denied claims to ensure accurate and timely claim payment. This position focuses on identifying and correcting coding-related issues prior to claim submission, resubmitting corrected claims or appealing denied claims, applying established coding guidelines, payer requirements, and organizational policies. The Coding Specialist works closely with revenue cycle partners to prevent claim rejections, support clean claim rates, and promote efficient reimbursement processes. This role requires strong attention to detail, foundational coding knowledge, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

A Day in the Life

  • Averages 10 front-end holds/denials per hour
  • Reviews coding and resubmits corrected claims to insurance
  • Creates appeal letters/forms with medical documentation
  • Maintains a minimum of 92% coding accuracy.
  • Assigns ICD-10-CM and CPT codes with appropriate modifiers for services provided in the professional fee environment.
  • Reviews medical records and all applicable documentation to determine appropriate codes for documented services and diagnoses.
  • Ensures all diagnosis codes meet local and national medical necessity guidelines.
  • Utilizes internal coding resources, payer guidelines, and other reference materials to ensure accurate and compliant coding for all assigned services.
  • Follows all HIPAA regulations and upholds the highest standards of privacy and confidentiality.
  • Maintains current knowledge of laws, regulations, payer policies, and industry guidance impacting compliant coding practices.
  • Independently reviews and resolves all assigned front-end claim holds.
  • Actively participates in department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and mentorship meetings with the assigned Coding Team Lead.
  • Escalates identified client trends to the assigned Coding Manager.
  • Escalates all coding-related questions to the assigned Coding manager for guidance and clarification.
  • Maintains and completes all CEU requirements.
  • Performs other duties or tasks as assigned

What You Need

  • Must hold a current AAPC or AHIMA Coding Certification for a minimum of 3 years.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of professional coding experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, and state and federal Medicare reimbursement guidelines.
  • Prior experience in reviewing front end coding errors before submitting to insurance
  • Prior experience in reviewing and correcting coding from insurance denials.
  • Prior experience in submitting corrected claims and appeals.
  • Prior experience with insurance guidelines and EOBs.
  • Familiarity with proper English grammar, usage, and professional documentation standards.
  • Ability to research and analyze data, draw logical conclusions, and resolve coding or documentation issues.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply policies, procedures, laws, and regulations.
  • Ability to accurately read and interpret medical documentation, clinical terminology, and documented procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in coding and claim resolution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, clarify documentation needs, and maintain collaborative working relationships with physicians and staff.
  • Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding protected health information.
  • Prior experience working in a medical billing environment with strict adherence to HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).

Please review the job details below.

Intuitive Machines - West (formerly Lanteris Space Systems) is currently seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Simulations team in San Jose, CA, or a US remote location. In this role, you will provide technical leadership in designing and implementing software for spacecraft simulators used by internal and external customers, while shaping the technical direction of our simulation architecture and mentoring engineering staff across the organization.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for spacecraft simulation systems across multiple programs and projects
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of new simulation technologies, frameworks, and methodologies to advance organizational capabilities
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on simulation architecture, distributed systems, and real-time modeling for the organization
  • Identify and resolve complex technical issues that span multiple subsystems and require evaluation of intangible factors and trade-offs
  • Create and maintain formal networks with key technical decision-makers across engineering disciplines, program management, and customer organizations

Technical Execution

  • Design and implement sophisticated models of spacecraft components and/or subsystems for all-software spacecraft simulators, addressing significant and unique technical challenges
  • Read, interpret, and provide authoritative guidance on spacecraft hardware specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical documentation
  • Architect and enhance complex simulation codebases, making critical decisions on system architecture, design patterns, and long-term maintainability
  • Champion satellite and software industry best practices and drive their adoption across simulation projects
  • Establish standards and best practices for CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality

Leadership & Influence

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers at all levels, from entry-level through senior staff
  • Lead technical design reviews and serve as the authoritative voice on simulation architecture decisions
  • Coordinate activities across multiple engineering teams to ensure coherent system designs and successful integration
  • Represent the organization externally as a technical spokesperson at customer meetings, industry conferences, and technical forums
  • Contribute to business development by providing technical expertise for proposals and customer engagements
  • Drive innovation in simulation methodologies and contribute to the company's technical roadmap

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate cross-functionally with software, systems, hardware, and program management to ensure alignment on technical objectives
  • Lead customer-facing design reviews and technical discussions with senior stakeholders
  • Exercise independent judgment in determining methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for solving complex simulation challenges
  • Build and maintain formal networks involving coordination among multiple engineering groups

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • Requires a minimum of 15 years of related professional software development experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace Engineering, or related disciplines
    • OR 10 years with a Master's degree
    • OR 8 years with a PhD
    • OR equivalent experience (four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree)
  • 10+ years of demonstrated expertise in simulation of spacecraft or other complex physical systems
  • Proven track record of technical leadership on multiple significant programs or projects

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level proficiency in reading, interpreting, and providing guidance on technical documentation (hardware specifications, ICDs, datasheets, system architecture documents)
  • Deep expertise in software architecture for complex, real-time simulation systems
  • Expert proficiency with Linux development environments
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality practices at organizational scale
  • Authoritative knowledge in the following:
    • Developing large-scale software systems in C++ and Python (expert-level C++ required)
    • Architecting and debugging complex distributed systems
    • Software development life cycle best practices and process improvement
    • Agile methodologies and technical leadership within Agile teams
    • Modern software engineering tools and practices

Leadership & Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams or disciplines
  • Proven mentorship and technical coaching of engineers at various experience levels
  • Strong executive communication skills with ability to present complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Track record of influencing technical direction at the organizational level

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in applied mathematics with proven ability to architect and implement sophisticated mathematical algorithms (numerical methods, linear algebra, differential equations, computational physics, control theory)
  • Expert knowledge of simulation standards and frameworks such as HLA (High Level Architecture), DIS, or TENA
  • Extensive experience with distributed simulation architectures, real-time synchronization, and middleware (DDS, ZeroMQ, RTI)
  • Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP network programming, including low-latency and real-time communication protocols
  • Expert understanding of spacecraft hardware interfaces and protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553)
  • Deep knowledge of spacecraft command and telemetry protocols (CCSDS, Space Packet Protocol)
  • Mastery of software design patterns, object-oriented design, and software architecture principles
  • Experience architecting containerized and cloud-native simulation systems (Docker, Kubernetes)

Domain Expertise

  • Significant experience in spacecraft operations, design, testing, or mission support

  • Industry recognition or leadership roles in professional organizations related to simulation or aerospace
  • Active U.S. citizenship and current or past security clearance (or ability to obtain TS/SCI for classified programs)

Leadership & Strategic Impact

  • Track record of defining technical roadmaps for simulation systems or similar complex software

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and champion adoption of emerging technologies that create competitive advantage
  • History of building and leading technical communities of practice or centers of excellence
  • Cross-organizational influence with demonstrated ability to drive technical standards and best practices company-wide

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term technical vision with near-term execution needs
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability for issues involving evaluation of intangible factors and complex trade-offs
  • Passion for space exploration and commitment to mission success
  • Executive presence and credibility with senior technical and business leadership

jobs.description:
About SeedTrust Group

SeedTrust Group is a family of companies working in the assisted-reproduction space. Our businesses provide escrow and financial management for surrogacy, egg donation and fertility journeys, medical records collection, case-management software and payment management.

We handle client funds, payment data and sensitive personal information for families going through some of the most important moments of their lives. We operate in a regulated environment, and we're building the functions that keep us trustworthy as we grow.

Our business and executive leadership is based in the United States, and our team is distributed across the US and Latin America, working on Eastern Time.

The Role

This is a new seat in a newly established Internal Audit function. You'll work directly with the Internal Audit Manager and take on audits across several companies in our group, from planning to final report.

You'll bring the judgment of someone who has done this before: you can scope an audit, test controls, write findings that stand up to scrutiny, and sit across from a department head who disagrees with you. You'll also help shape how the function works, including methodology, templates and the risk-based audit plan.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and run risk-based audits across financial, operational and compliance areas, from scoping through fieldwork, reporting and remediation follow-up.
  • Test controls for design and operating effectiveness, and document your work so anyone can follow your logic.
  • Write clear findings and agree on realistic remediation plans with process owners.
  • Interview department heads and process owners to understand how work really gets done and where the risks are.
  • Contribute to the annual risk assessment and the audit plan that follows from it.
  • Help build the function: workpaper templates, risk and control matrices, testing standards and reporting formats.
  • Review the work of others and give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Partner with Compliance on risk and control topics, while keeping Internal Audit's independence.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of internal audit or equivalent assurance experience, including controls testing and audit reporting.
  • Experience reviewing other auditors' workpapers, or leading parts of an audit.
  • A background in internal audit consulting or advisory (Big 4, a mid-tier firm or a risk advisory practice) or in-house internal audit.
  • Experience working with US companies or US frameworks (e.g., SOX, US GAAP, US regulatory requirements) on audits that included US stakeholders.
  • Advanced professional English, spoken and written. Most of your conversations will be in English with business leaders.
  • Experience with risk assessments and risk and control matrices (RCMs).
  • Comfort working independently and asynchronously in a remote team.
  • CPA, CIA, CISA or an equivalent certification preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, payments, escrow, insurance or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with SOX, SOC 2 or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with audit tools (e.g., AuditBoard, TeamMate) and data analysis.

Who Thrives Here

  • You're curious, ask good questions and learn new areas fast.
  • You challenge your own work and welcome challenge from others.
  • You take pride in the craft and in the team, not in your title.
  • You're honest about what you don't know yet.
  • You work well with all kinds of personalities, including people who aren't thrilled to be audited.

If you've read this far, enter the word Saffron in the "Reference word" question of the application.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, with the flexibility that comes with independent contracting.
  • Monthly payment in USD against your invoice.
  • Close day-to-day collaboration with a US-based team, not an arm's-length engagement.
  • A professional development roadmap built with your manager, with room to grow your craft.
  • The chance to help build a function from the ground up.

Eligibility

This is an independent-contractor engagement. Candidates must be based in a Latin American country, be able to work as an independent contractor and invoice in their country of residence, and be available for substantial daily overlap with US Eastern Time (roughly 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET at minimum). The role involves regulated and confidential data and requires accepting confidentiality terms. We do not work with staffing agencies for this role. Interviews are conducted on video with camera on.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Application and short questionnaire. Please answer in your own words. Specific, honest answers matter more than polished ones.
  2. 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team.
  3. In-depth interview with the Internal Audit Manager.
  4. Conversations with our Compliance and business leaders.
  5. Final conversation with executive leadership.

SeedTrust Group is an equal opportunity organization. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
Why this role exists

We've just moved our CRM to HubSpot and we're modernising . We want one connected system, from the first website visit to a closed deal, that Marketing and Sales both trust and that runs without manual effort. Today too much of our reporting is still done by hand, and our measurement has grown faster than its foundations.

We need one engineer to own the systems behind our growth. You'll architect HubSpot across marketing and sales, ship front-end code on , own the tracking layer and automate the rest. You won't be a product engineer, a designer, a copywriter or a Sales help desk. You'll build the engine that Marketing and Sales run on.

This is a remote-first position. We're looking for a person to be based in the UK, Poland or Switzerland, with occassional trips to our head office in Zurich.

What you'll own

HubSpot and RevOps systems (about 35% of your time)

  • Architecture of our HubSpot portal across Marketing and Sales: data model, custom objects, properties and governance
  • Pipeline and deal-stage configuration, lifecycle stages and lead routing, built with Sales leadership, who own the sales process
  • Attribution from first touch to closed deal, so we know which channels create revenue, not just leads
  • Lead scoring and intent signals that help Sales prioritise
  • Integrations and data quality: syncing HubSpot with our platform data in Databricks, ad platforms and enrichment, with deduplication and property hygiene
  • Self-serve pipeline and marketing dashboards, so teams get answers without filing requests
  • Using CRM data on the website (smart forms, personalisation), making practical use of HubSpot's AI features, and keeping a roadmap of what to build next
  • Deliverability, plus a modular email template system for HubSpot and Intercom

Website and front-end (about 25%)

  • Front-end development of coople.com: page templates, reusable components, Prismic CMS integration and landing pages
  • Performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG) and code quality
  • Technical SEO and AI-search discoverability: structured data, crawlability, multilingual setup (DE/FR/IT/EN, hreflang)
  • Marketing's technical lead on the website modernisation programme, including evaluating CMS options. You'll use AI-assisted development to ship at pace, working with our Engineering team, who own infrastructure and deployment standards

Measurement (about 20%)

  • The tracking layer end to end: tag management, event schemas, conversion tracking, and consent under GDPR and Swiss nFADP
  • Monitoring and alerting, so broken tracking is found in hours, not at month-end
  • Connecting web and product analytics to CRM outcomes, with the analytics and data teams owning KPI definitions and warehouse models

Automation and experimentation (about 20%)

  • Internal tools and AI-built automations that remove manual reporting and data-shuffling
  • Keeping the stack lean: tool audits, UTM and naming governance, documented schemas
  • Designing, building and reading out tests across the website and the funnel, starting from a clear hypothesis
  • Bringing your own growth ideas to the team, not just building other people's

Where the line sits: you build and run the systems; marketers decide what goes through them. Campaigns, content and copy stay with Marketing. The sales process, forecasting and enablement stay with Sales leadership. Batch changes and large admin updates are handled with our HubSpot partner, and dashboards are self-serve.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: a HubSpot health check across Marketing and Sales with a prioritised roadmap, a documented tracking plan, the first ad-hoc reports replaced by self-serve dashboards, and your first components shipped to coople.com
  • First 12 months: one trusted view from first visit to closed deal, lead scoring and routing that Sales actually use, clean CRM data synced with our platform, a faster site delivered through the modernisation programme, and a measurably smaller manual-reporting load

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Experience owning a CRM's data model and configuration. HubSpot is preferred, but Salesforce or Marketo experience counts if you're ready to get HubSpot-certified within your first three months
  • Depth in analytics and tag management: GA4, Google Tag Manager (including server-side), consent mode, event design
  • Comfort with data: you can write SQL, work with APIs and shape data in Python or JavaScript
  • A track record of automating recurring work, including with AI tools, that you can show us
  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development (for example Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot), with the judgement to review what it produces
  • Proven front-end skills: you have shipped production pages or components with semantic HTML, modern CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, ideally in a component-based framework (React/Next.js, TBC) with a headless CMS
  • Around 4+ years in web development, marketing technology, RevOps or growth engineering.
  • Fluent English, and the ability to say no to stakeholders constructively
  • The right to work in the country you're based in (UK, PL or CH)

Nice to have

  • RevOps remit like: pipeline design, lead routing, sales-marketing handover
  • Previous experience as a Data Engineer or a CRM Manager could relevant
  • HubSpot development (HubL, custom objects, Operations Hub, APIs)
  • Experimentation tooling (PostHog, Optimizely, VWO) and basic statistics for test readouts
  • Databricks or another data warehouse
  • Responsive email development, multilingual sites, or B2B marketplace experience

Our stack

HubSpot, Prismic, front-end framework (TBC), GA4, Google Tag Manager, PostHog, Intercom, Databricks, Supermetrics, Notion, plus whatever AI tooling helps you work faster. You'll help shape what we keep.

How we hire

  1. Screening call with our inhouse recruiter (20 min)
  2. Intro call with the Head of Growth Marketing (30 min, video)
  3. Technical conversation with Engineering about front-end and tracking (45 min)
  4. A short practical task based on a real HubSpot or automation problem, followed by a walkthrough (60 min)
  5. Conversation with Sales leadership and/or other relevant future team mates (in person or video)

Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Issued for Construction (IFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.

Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

  • Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

  • P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

  • Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

  • Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

  • Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

  • Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

  • Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

  • Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

  • Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

  • Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

  • Proven experience delivering complete substation design packages from conceptual to IFC, covering both physical and P&C design, at voltages from 34.5 kV to 345 kV or higher.

  • Experience with both greenfield substations and brownfield modifications to existing, energized facilities.

  • Working knowledge of NESC, NFPA, IEEE and utility/transmission owner design standards, and of how NERC requirements apply to substation design.

  • Solid understanding of protection philosophy and protective relays (SEL, GE, Siemens or similar), plus substation communications, SCADA/RTU and revenue metering.

  • Experience with AutoCAD and grounding analysis software (CDEGS, WinIGS or similar).

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with clients and contractors.
  • Occasional travel to project sites for walkdowns, filed verification and construction support.

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Reporting to the VP, Mid-Revenue Cycle, the Director, Clinical Documentation Integrity is responsible for developing a unified, multidisciplinary, outcome-focused clinical documentation integrity program. This position evaluates the adequacy and effectiveness of internal and operational controls designed to ensure that CDI processes and practices lead to appropriate execution of regulatory requirements and guidelines related to facility coding and CDI practices, including federal and state compliance standards. This position plays a key role in leading the initiative for reporting quality of care outcomes and in obtaining complete, accurate and compliant documentation for appropriate reimbursement of services provided and capture of clinical outcome measures. Serve as a subject matter expert and authoritative resource on interpretation and application of CDI practices, coding rules and regulations and conducts risk assessments of potential and detected compliance deficiencies, as well as documentation improvement opportunities. The position works closely with key stakeholders in Coding, Quality, Physician Champions, and others to ensure overall clinical documentation represents an accurate picture of the patient's hospital stay therefore confirming both internal and external reporting of information is accurate and complete. The CDI Director will collaborate extensively and in a collegial manner with the CDI Physician Advisors, Chief Medical Officers (CMO), Chief Quality Officers (CQO's) and other leaders in the review of complex patients. Actively participates on committees and presents the results of studies, trends, and activities as necessary to demonstrate improvement in the quality of clinical documentation. This position will create performance measures to assess the impact of clinical documentation targeted at the capture of the severity of illness of hospitalized patients. This position leads the collaborative efforts of cross-functional teams to minimize variation in clinical practice documentation.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Provides CDI strategic direction for the program and collaborates with internal resources, consultants, auditors, electronic systems, and physician champions.
  • Works collaboratively with the service lines, Physician Leaders/Liaisons and other resources to clarify and/or otherwise improve documentation in order to accurately support diagnosis and quality indicators for care rendered to patients.
  • Develop CDI tools and queries, leads initiatives, and is a subject-matter expert in CDI, managing the hospital CDI team and leading efforts in educating medical staff and other clinicians in clinical documentation requirements.
  • Co leads the CDI Steering Committee
  • Creates, tracks, trends and reports on performance measures to assess the impact of clinical documentation improvement program. Routinely provide the medical staff with Key Performance Indicators related to their documentation and query response rates.
  • Develops and delivering training and education to clinical, CDI and coding professionals regarding CDI practices, coding and documentation requirements.
  • Leads multidisciplinary and cross departmental documentation initiatives to achieve strategic goals and objectives.
  • Coordinates and ensures the overall quality and completeness of medical record clinical documentation.
  • Connects and integrates internal and external resources to streamline systems and to effectively monitor and report outcomes.
  • Interacts with treating physicians and partners with Coding and Quality leadership for issue resolution and to ensure complete and compliant physician documentation supporting MS-DRG, APR-DGR, severity of illness, risk of mortality, and HAC clarifications with appropriate clinical groups.
  • Develops a meaningful scorecard, dashboard metrics, peer group comparisons, and service specific data that are actionable.
  • Designs and delivers service specific education for clinicians and directs CDI staff to deliver point of care education which focuses on accurate documentation of severity of illness and risk of mortality.
  • Develops processes and systems to identify projects that can demonstrate a return on efforts.
  • Implements tracking tools to benchmark against best practices, to maintain forward momentum and to establish timelines for actions.
  • Oversees the data analysis and reporting essential for project management and identification of improvement opportunities and action plans to achieve results.
  • Oversees the monitoring and evaluation of patient care in relationship to best practices while reviewing aggregate data and makes any relevant recommendations to modify/improve patient care and/or clinical documentation.
  • Maintains a system to monitor efforts and to analyze if desired goals are being achieved.
  • Designs concurrent clinical documentation review of CDI team members and ensures that there is appropriate physician interaction when ambiguous or conflicting information is in the medical record, providing guidance to Case Management, physicians, and hospital staff regarding documentation for correct coding and compliance necessary for increased Case Mix Index (CMI), decreased Length of Stay (LOS), and optimal resource utilization.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Health Information Management, or similarly related field of study. Master’s degree preferred.

Experience Qualifications

  • Seven (7) years of management experience required including five (5) years of CDI experience in an acute care setting.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced clinical expertise and extensive knowledge of complex disease processes with broad based clinical experience in an inpatient setting.
  • Demonstrated business communication skills with demonstrated leadership and influencing abilities and the ability to work and communicate effectively with physicians and other clinical professional staff.
  • Knowledge of care delivery documentation systems and related medical record documentation.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementing process improvements and achieving high-performance goals.
  • Displays skill in organizational savvy by adapting own approach to the audience, anticipating impact of words and actions, preparing for possible resistance, and responding in an appropriate style, using a range of influencing styles.
  • Outstanding relationship management skills – easily builds strong and effective working relationships within a climate of trust, inspires cooperation and confidence and is a true consensus builder.
  • A strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and work at a high level with members of the executive team and physician leadership.
  • Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills and be able to communicate effectively with all levels of management.
  • Must have demonstrated interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills in dealing with multidisciplinary teams and variety of ongoing activities.
  • Ability to work with senior management, physicians, and medical center staff with various levels of education and experience.
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong, collaborative and supportive working relationships with CDI peers, physicians and other clinical professionals.
  • Demonstrated judgment and independent decision making.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and reporting practices pertaining to quality improvement and program evaluation.
  • Ability to lead teams and produce project results within schedule.
  • Knowledgeable and capable to apply/incorporate coding and clinical concepts into all phases of the development, instruction, and communication of the CDI Services.
  • Stays current with requirements of CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment Systems (IPPS), AHA Coding Clinic and ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting.
  • Expertise in MS-DRGs, ICD coding and CDI practices.
  • Expertise in MS-DRGs, ICD coding, CDI practices, and knowledge distribution to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Maintains working knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid rules and regulations regarding CDI, POA (present on admission), basic coding, as well as current trends and developments in the area of Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI).
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Skilled and experienced in data analysis and qualitative reporting of results.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid rules and regulations regarding CDI, POA, PSI, HAC, basic coding, as well as current trends and developments in the area of Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI).
  • Ability to direct data management and report generation activities.
  • Ability to manage, organize, prioritize, multi-task and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated organizational, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with medical staff and to foster effective working relationships and build consensus with others.
  • Ability to provide leadership and influence others, both directly and indirectly.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems and initiatives.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization and vendors.

Licenses and Certifications

  • CA-RN (Registered Nurse) . or
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator . or
  • CCDS - Cert Clinical Document Spec . or
  • CDIP – Clinical Documentation Improvement Practitioner . or
  • MD – Medical Doctor (foreign educated, acceptable; active or non-active license) .

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.

jobs.description:
The Acute Strategic Client Manager - Revenue Cycle will lead executive relationships (as an Individual Contributor) for top enterprise (Acute) clients, with deep expertise in Acute-basedrevenue cycle management services and accountability for value realization across the broader TruBridge portfolio, including the EHR and third-party solutions. The SCM will use revenue cycle leadership experience to improve operational and financial performance while advancing EHR adoption, solution integration, and overall client outcomes.


This role is NOT a leadership position, rather it owns client-specific success and recovery plans, drives measurable improvements across the revenue cycle and broader solution portfolio, coordinates cross-functional execution, manages escalations and risk, supports retention and growth, and ensures clients can demonstrate value from the TruBridge partnership.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop and implement client success plans with defined retention, satisfaction, risk-reduction, and growth objectives.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of each client’s organization and healthcare environment to strengthen strategic relationships and advance documented client outcomes.
  • Measure client satisfaction and engagement through structured feedback, executive conversations, solution adoption, service performance, and relationship indicators.
  • Create and maintain value realization reporting that demonstrates client ROI, supports executive business reviews, identifies satisfaction or adoption gaps, strengthens renewal decisions, and informs responsible growth opportunities.
  • Align qualified clients with the TruBridge reference program.
  • Own executive-level performance reviews with client financial and operational leaders, translating revenue cycle data into prioritized actions that improve cash collections, accounts receivable performance, denial outcomes, billing effectiveness, and overall financial health.
  • Lead cross-functional TruBridge Financial Health teams and subject matter experts in diagnosing client performance challenges, establishing corrective action plans, assigning clear ownership, removing barriers, and holding internal and client stakeholders accountable for timely execution and measurable results.

These goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to work dynamically within a team structure and perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our performance factors specific responsibilities of this role include:


  • Proven ability to build and maintain complex client relationships, including strategic partnerships with C-suite leaders and stakeholders across client organizations.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end healthcare revenue cycle operations, including patient access, charge capture, coding, billing, claims management, denials, accounts receivable, cash collections, underpayments, write-offs, and payer or contractual performance.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in managing operational processes and driving growth strategies.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple client priorities, focusing on common results.
  • Highly organized and efficient in time management.
  • Connected to all life cycles of client relationships, including sales, implementation, and support.
  • Develop and establish best practices for client profitability management, including invoicing, accounts receivable, cash collections, write-off processes, and contractual interactions.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for material RCM service and performance issues, rapidly assess business impact, mobilize the appropriate operational leaders and subject matter experts, establish recovery milestones, and communicate progress through resolution.
  • Own the client relationship and overall execution for assigned clients, with direct accountability for retention, renewal readiness, client satisfaction, risk reduction, and responsible growth.
  • Maintain a disciplined client risk management process using service, financial, operational, relationship, and contractual indicators; identify emerging risks early; quantify retention and financial exposure; establish mitigation plans with accountable owners and deadlines; and escalate unresolved risks through measurable resolution.
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including appropriate upsell or cross-sell options, based on client priorities, adoption, performance, and demonstrated value; partner with sales to reach mutually beneficial agreements that protect trust, retention, and long-term growth.
  • Team-oriented, focusing on constructive feedback, process improvement, and developing best practices.

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Experience/Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field (preferred).
  • Ability to travel up to 30%-40% regionally
  • At least 7 years of Acute healthcare revenue cycle experience, including at least 3 years leading client-facing RCM services, operations, performance improvement, or complex account recovery initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience improving Acute-based revenue cycle performance, with working knowledge of key measures such as cash collections, accounts receivable aging, denial performance, billing quality, and payer or contractual outcomes.
  • Proven success improving client satisfaction, protecting renewals, reducing preventable attrition, and recovering at-risk client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging client issues, establish clear resolution plans, maintain accountability across stakeholders, and follow through until risk is mitigated and the client confirms an acceptable outcome.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively, engaging the appropriate subject matter experts to resolve client needs and achieve shared outcomes.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to listen and connect the dots for client benefit.
  • Experience advising and influencing hospital CFOs, revenue cycle executives, and operational leaders on performance gaps, competing priorities, recovery plans, and financial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze revenue cycle performance trends, identify root causes of underperformance, quantify financial impact, and present clear recommendations and accountable recovery plans to client and internal leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in strategic account management, healthcare technology, or health information systems that complements the required healthcare revenue cycle leadership background.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada or ouroffice in Ottawa, Canada.

About the team

The AI Security Governance Analyst operationalizes approved AI security policies, standards and governance processes within Security Strategy & Compliance. The role performs and coordinates AI cybersecurity assessments, evaluates control evidence, identifies risks and deficiencies, maintains traceable records, and produces decision-ready reporting. The analyst applies approved frameworks and procedures, recommends proportionate treatment, and escalates decisions outside the role’s authority. The role uses approved AI-enabled tools to improve workflow efficiency, evidence management, analysis and reporting. Human review, validation, transparency, confidentiality and accountability remain required.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

AI Security Governance and Lifecycle

  • Apply Kinaxis AI policy, security standards, guardrails and playbooks in Corporate IT and security-managed environments; maintain an implementation register covering owners, requirements, controls, evidence, status, exceptions and review dates.
  • Maintain authoritative AI security governance, assessment and assurance records for in-scope AI systems, generative AI, agents, pilots and material AI features; reconcile records with inventories owned by Corporate IT, Product or other designated owners.
  • Validate intake information, including ownership, purpose, data use, deployment context, architecture, vendor, integrations, human oversight and lifecycle state; identify reassessment triggers and track use cases through intake, assessment, authorization, review, suspension and retirement.
  • Escalate incomplete intake, unclear ownership, unregistered AI, material changes, unsupported exceptions and overdue remediation through established channels.

AI Security Assessment and Action Tracking

  • Perform or coordinate AI cybersecurity assessments using approved methods and criteria, including assessments of generative and agentic AI, non-human identities, privileged access, APIs, integrations, secrets, sensitive data, human oversight and secure-lifecycle controls.
  • Evaluate security inputs, threat models and architecture evidence for trust boundaries, attack paths, data flows, agent capabilities, permissions, autonomy, approval gates, observability, controllability and potential blast radius, using guidance such as MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM and agentic AI security resources.
  • Identify threats, vulnerabilities, misuse scenarios, control gaps and inherent or residual cybersecurity exposure; document findings, required controls, accountable owners, remediation, exceptions, compensating controls and reassessment triggers.
  • Recommend proportionate cybersecurity treatment and track actions to verified closure, approved exception or formal escalation. Risk-treatment and acceptance decisions remain with authorized risk owners and governance bodies.

Control Assurance, Metrics and Reporting

  • Translate approved AI security requirements into control and evidence expectations covering lifecycle gates, identities, privileged access, APIs, credentials, sensitive data, human oversight, logging, monitoring, and generative or agentic AI.
  • Evaluate control design, implementation and relevant testing evidence, including threat modelling, adversarial testing, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and security-relevant TEVV. Document limitations, conclusions, deficiencies and outstanding evidence needs.
  • Assess whether logging, telemetry, monitoring and detection capabilities are proportionate to cybersecurity risk; verify implementation evidence and escalate material or persistent gaps.
  • Maintain dashboards and audit-ready records covering intake, assessments, cybersecurity classification, control coverage, findings, remediation, exceptions and emerging themes. Maintain mappings supporting ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53 and other assigned requirements.
  • Analyze AI-related security incidents and lessons learned from a governance and assurance perspective and incorporate relevant findings into assessments, controls and reassessment criteria.
  • Maintains current knowledge of rapid developments in AI, particularly generative and agentic AI, and their cybersecurity implications.

Third-Party AI and Awareness

  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity Risk and the third-party risk process to support appropriate review of AI vendors and AI-enabled supplier capabilities; provide documented security requirements, findings and evidence-based risk input.
  • Publish practical AI security guidance and support role-based awareness on intake triggers, sensitive-data handling, credential protection, human oversight, approved use and incident escalation.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience in AI security governance, cybersecurity governance, technology risk, security compliance, security audit, Corporate IT governance or security program delivery.
  • Experience operationalizing policies, risk assessments, control requirements, workflows, reporting and assurance evidence, including cross-functional assessment and action tracking.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise AI lifecycles and security risks affecting generative and agentic AI, identities, privileged access, APIs, integrations, secrets, sensitive data, human oversight, logging and monitoring.
  • Ability to evaluate control evidence, identify deficiencies, distinguish inherent from residual exposure, produce defensible findings, and communicate decision-ready summaries without assuming control-operation or risk-acceptance authority.
  • Strong written communication, analytical judgment, organization and stakeholder coordination skills; experience with GRC, workflow, ticketing, inventory, document-management or reporting tools.

Preffered Qualifications

About PatientIQ

PatientIQ is a fast-growing health tech company on a mission to improve patient outcomes. We partner with healthcare providers, medical device companies, and researchers to collect, analyze, and act on patient-reported outcomes data at scale — powering smarter clinical decisions and accelerating the future of value-based care.

Headquartered in Chicago and backed by top-tier venture capital and major health system investors, PatientIQ is building the largest platform for healthcare providers, industry partners, and researchers to collaborate on what matters most: helping patients get better.

The opportunity

PatientIQ partners with health systems, medical device companies, and researchers to turn patient-reported outcomes into better patient care. As our Senior Director, Integrated Marketing, you'll make that customer base our strongest growth engine, driving expansion and upsell pipeline through account-based campaigns, customer advocacy, and a reference program that gives Sales credible proof when it matters most.

You'll also lead our event strategy across third-party and PatientIQ-hosted events, with clear accountability for the pipeline those events source and influence. You'll own customer marketing for our Strategic and Tier 2 customers, working side by side with Customer Success, Sales, and Product to understand what customers need and how we can serve them better.

You'll thrive here if you're comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and the long, relationship-driven sales cycles typical of enterprise healthcare.

What you'll do

Customer Insights and Segmentation:

  • Analyze customer and usage data to identify trends, segment the customer base, and develop customer personas that inform targeted expansion and retention strategies for Strategic and Tier 2 accounts.

Campaign Development and Execution:

  • Lead the design and execution of customer-centric campaigns across email, social media, digital advertising, and events that drive adoption, upsell, and cross-sell, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Customer Lifecycle Management:

  • Create tailored programs that engage customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, partnering with Customer Success and Sales to surface and accelerate expansion pipeline.

Advocacy:

  • Build and scale a customer advocacy and reference program, including case studies, testimonials, customer references, customer speakers, and peer review and analyst relations, that supports sales and strengthens customer loyalty.

Budget Management:

We believe clarity drives performance. Here's what the first 90 days look like in this role:

30 days - Ramped on PatientIQ's products, customers, and messaging; met with Customer Success, Sales, and key customers; audit of current customer marketing, advocacy, and event programs complete; initial segmentation of Strategic and Tier 2 accounts drafted.

60 days - Customer marketing and event strategy aligned with the Head of Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success; first expansion and account-based campaigns in market; reference program framework and first advocacy assets (case studies, references) underway; event calendar, budget, and pipeline targets set.

90 days - Expansion pipeline (sourced and influenced), event, and reference program KPIs defined and reported on a regular cadence; campaigns and events refined based on early results; clear handoff process with Customer Success and AEs for expansion opportunities.

What you bring

Required

  • Proven ability to define strategy, drive alignment, and lead end-to-end execution of customer marketing initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in customer marketing, expansion pipeline growth, account-based marketing, advocacy and reference programs, case studies, and third-party and PatientIQ-hosted events.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer data and apply insights to segmentation, targeting, campaign strategy, and pipeline attribution.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing customer marketing campaigns that drive measurable growth.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills to influence cross-functional teams and convey customer insights.
  • Skilled in marketing automation tools and CRM systems.
  • Experienced leader with a track record of managing and motivating high-performing teams with diverse goals.

Nice to have

  • Experience in US B2B SaaS healthcare technology, ideally marketing to health systems, medical device companies, or research organizations.

Benefits

Why PatientIQ

  • Mission-driven work. We're solving a hard problem that matters — improving patient outcomes through better data. Every person here is working on something real.
  • True idea meritocracy. Great ideas win, regardless of title. We encourage every team member to challenge the status quo.
  • World-class team. You'll work alongside people who are at the top of their fields in health tech, enterprise software, and clinical science.
  • Fast-growing. We're building the largest platform for healthcare providers and industry to collaborate — and we're just getting started.
  • Great benefits. Top-notch health, dental, and vision. 401(k). Flexible PTO — we trust you to take the time you need. Professional development stipends.
  • Real ownership. This is not a role where you maintain someone else's playbook. You'll build, shape strategy, and see your impact directly.

  • Test candidate fixes — prompt and configuration variants, context changes, model alternatives — and verify improvements with structured evaluations, not anecdotes; confirm fixes don't regress other behavior.

Fluency in *using* modern eval tooling matters; the platform exists — extending it thoughtfully is in scope, rebuilding it is not.

  • Support the annual clinical-guidelines update cycle with regression evaluation as guidelines, prompts, and models change; ramp with the team's senior data scientists in Q4 2026.
  • Document the diagnostic playbook: failure taxonomies, experiment templates, variant history — a method others can run, not a private intuition. This is a practicing role — the diagnostic loop is the job, at every level of seniority.
  • Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years of recent, hands-on experience evaluating and improving LLM-based systems: structured error analysis, prompt/configuration iteration, experiment design, metrics interpretation — as a practitioner, not only as a reviewer of others' work.
  • Demonstrated experience with LLM evaluation methods and tools — golden/regression sets, LLM-as-judge with validation, tracing and observability tooling.
  • Strong Python and solid data-analysis skills (SQL a plus); comfort computing and reasoning about metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, and PPV.
  • Hypothesis-driven working style: the instinct to isolate variables and prove a fix, rather than tweak and hope.
  • Strong written communication — findings and go/no-go evidence must be legible to engineers, clinicians, and leadership.

Preferred Requirements

  • Healthcare experience: utilization management, prior authorization, clinical documentation, or clinical/claims data; comfort reading clinical guideline and medical-policy content.
  • Experience mentoring data scientists or leading small technical workstreams; interest in growing into people leadership as a function scales.
  • Experience working with clinical reviewers or other domain experts to convert expert judgment into labeled data and evaluation criteria.
  • Experience with LLM observability/telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry-based tracing, Logfire, Langfuse, or similar).
  • Statistics or experimentation background (A/B testing, statistical significance, sample-size reasoning).

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with strong hands-on experience in deploying, debugging, and optimizing training and inference workloads on large-scale GPU clusters. As we support customers and partners across Europe in training models on ground breaking GPU infrastructure, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of High Performance Computing and AI. Similarly, inference is increasing in its complexity with explosion of MOE models and disaggregated execution making inference truly a HPC workload. You don’t need to have expertise in every skill we mention, but we are especially interested in candidates who bring deep knowledge in at least few key areas to enable large scale AI workloads. If you can demonstrate hands-on experience, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborating with NVIDIA’s training framework developers and product teams to stay ahead of the latest features and help partners to adopt them effectively.

  • Assisting with deployment, debugging, and improving the efficiency of AI workloads on extensive NVIDIA platforms.

  • Benchmarking new framework features, analyzing performance, and sharing actionable insights with both customers and internal teams.

  • Working directly with external customers to solve cluster performance and stability issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement effective solutions.

  • Build expertise and guide customers in scaling workloads efficiently and reliably on the latest generation of NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Contributing to Europe’s Sovereign AI initiative by helping customers implement advanced resiliency features within AI training pipelines.

What We Need To See:

  • BS, MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related engineering field—or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in accelerated computing technologies at cluster scale, ideally including work with NVIDIA platforms.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Python.

  • Practical experience identifying and resolving bottlenecks in large-scale training workloads or parallel applications.

  • Hands-on experienced in profiling and debugging large parallel applications.

  • Solid understanding of CPU and GPU architectures, CUDA, parallel filesystems, and high-speed interconnects.

  • Experienced in working with large compute clusters with an understanding of their internal scheduling and resource management mechanisms (e.g. SLURM or Cloud based clusters).

  • Proficient knowledge of training pipelines and frameworks, encompassing their internal operations and performance attributes.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Experience in debugging training pipelines running on thousands of GPUs in production environment.

  • Hands-on experience with performance profiling and optimizations using tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute and good understanding of NCCL, MPI and low-level communication libraries.

  • Ability to debug stability issues across the entire stack: parallel application, training frameworks, runtime libraries, schedulers, and hardware.

  • Solid understanding of the internal workings of LLM frameworks such as PyTorch, Megatron-LM, or NeMo, and how they affect compute layers like CPUs, GPUs, network and storage or understanding of inference tools such as vLLM, Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, RedHat Inference Server or SGLang.

Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Director of Solutions Architecture to lead the domain-first solutions engine of our sales and delivery motion. You'll own the presales function end to end, from first discovery call through handoff into delivery. You'll manage and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts, and you'll set the vision for how we scope, demonstrate, and win.This role rests first on deep real assets domain expertise, complemented by technical acumen and a strong market-facing presence. You'll be credible discussing property operations and investment strategy with a client's leadership, guiding the solution alongside their data and engineering teams, and representing Cherre in front of a prospect's decision-makers. Domain fluency is the foundation; the ideal candidate pairs it with enough technical depth and executive presence to carry a solution from discovery through the deal.This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic deals, shaping how we translate complex prospect requirements into compelling, credible solutions. Just as important, you'll be expected to modernize how the function operates. We want a leader who builds tools and AI-assisted workflows that make the team faster and sharper, not one who simply runs the existing playbook.

  • Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.
  • Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.
  • Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.
  • Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.
  • Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.
  • Ensure clean handoffs to Delivery. Build and maintain a repeatable bridge from presales scoping into implementation so nothing is lost between the sale and the build.
  • Modernize the function with AI. Design and build skills and agentic workflows, and optimize the agentic fleet to streamline the process from scoping through delivery. Continuously identify ways to use AI to improve the quality and speed of the team’s output.
  • Represent the point of view. Publish, speak, and advocate for Cherre’s perspective on real assets data and semantic infrastructure, shaping how the market thinks about the problem—not just how Cherre solves it.
  • Close the loop into Product. Translate market and client signals from the field into product roadmap input, ensuring the roadmap reflects what the market is actually telling you—not just what has already been scoped.

Qualifications

  • Real assets domain expertise spanning the full stack: up into the capital stack (fund structures, debt and equity vehicles, investment vehicles) and down into the physical, operational asset (property operations, leasing, maintenance, tenant and resident experience). A track record of scoping and designing solutions that hold together across both ends of that stack, not just one.
  • Global and cross-asset-class experience: comfortable moving between multifamily, office, industrial, retail, and alternative asset classes, and across US, European, and APAC market conventions and regulatory contexts.- 10+ years in real estate, proptech, or consulting, with experience leading teams of domain and technical experts.

  • Fluent in the shift from human-readable reporting to typed, governed interfaces built for agent consumption: why a report could tolerate semantic drift that an agent reasoning from the same data cannot, and why that difference is now a product architecture problem, not a documentation problem.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership: a track record of publishing or speaking on real assets, data, or investment strategy, not just executing someone else's narrative.
  • Executive presence to represent Cherre externally, lead the room in strategic deals, and translate technical complexity into business value for institutional buyers.
  • The ability to operate as both a player and a coach: both getting hands-on in deals, and effective at hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing team behind you.
  • An AI-forward mindset, with hands-on experience building tools, automations, or agentic workflows.

  • Building AI agents and agentic workflows
