About Relish

At Relish, we're transforming the way businesses manage their supplier relationships, third-party risk, and procurement processes.

Our AI-powered solutions help organizations simplify supplier data validation, streamline invoicing, and get more value from their enterprise technology investments. Trusted by hundreds of global organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we're helping businesses work smarter, reduce risk, and unlock new opportunities.

We're growing, and we're looking for commercially minded Account Executives who know how to turn strong customer relationships into meaningful business growth.

The Opportunity

We're hiring two Account Executives – Customer Base to join our growing sales organisation.

Unlike traditional new business sales roles, this opportunity is all about growing the relationships we already have. You'll work with an established portfolio of customers, identifying opportunities to expand their use of Relish's solutions, introduce additional products, and drive long-term revenue growth.

You'll be responsible for uncovering opportunities, building relationships with new stakeholders within existing accounts, and leading commercial conversations that deliver value for both our customers and Relish.

We're hiring across two key technology channels:

  • SAP: One Account Executive focused on expanding relationships within our SAP customer base.

  • Workday / Coupa: One Account Executive focused on customers operating within the Workday OR Coupa ecosystems.

Experience within SAP, Workday, or Coupa is certainly an advantage, but it's not essential. What matters most is your ability to grow existing accounts, build trusted relationships, and consistently deliver commercial results.

You'll work closely with our Customer Success team, who focus on customer satisfaction and adoption, while you take ownership of identifying and closing opportunities for additional revenue.

If you're someone who enjoys building relationships, spotting untapped potential, and turning customer conversations into commercial wins, this could be a great fit.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Grow existing accounts: Own and execute account expansion strategies, identifying opportunities to increase revenue through upselling and cross-selling.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Develop strong partnerships with existing customers, engaging stakeholders across Procurement, Accounts Payable, IT, and executive leadership.

  • Uncover new opportunities: Proactively identify additional business units, departments, and decision-makers within existing customer accounts.

  • Drive commercial conversations: Lead discovery, proposals, negotiations, and closing activities for expansion opportunities.

  • Expand product adoption: Identify opportunities to introduce complementary Relish solutions across supplier management, third-party risk, data validation, and invoicing.

  • Partner with Customer Success: Work closely with our CSM team to understand customer needs, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term customer value.

  • Own your pipeline: Build and manage a healthy pipeline of expansion, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities, maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM records.

  • Deliver results: Consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets while contributing to a collaborative, high-performing sales team.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who knows that the best commercial opportunities don't always come from winning new customers - sometimes they're sitting within the relationships you've already built.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of B2B software or SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of growing revenue within an existing customer base.

  • Demonstrated success in account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or strategic account management.

  • A consistent history of achieving or exceeding sales targets.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles and navigating multiple stakeholders.

  • The confidence to engage senior decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and position solutions that deliver measurable value.

  • A proactive, commercially curious mindset — you're not waiting for customers to ask for more; you're identifying opportunities before they do.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Customer Success and other internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience selling multiple products or solutions into enterprise customer accounts.

  • An understanding of supplier management, procurement technology, or Source-to-Pay processes.

Why Join Relish?

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten.

Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

  • Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

  • Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

  • Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

  • Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

  • Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

  • Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

  • Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

  • Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

  • Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

  • Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

  • Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

  • Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

  • Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

  • Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

  • Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

Requirements

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

  • Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

  • Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

  • Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: CGI Automotive Artist (3Ds Max & V-Ray)
jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.title: Senior Director Services Excellence
jobs.excerpt: Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Position Summary

Sprinklr is creating a new Services Excellence organization to serve as the design authority, governance function, and operating system owner for the global Professional Services business.

The Senior Director of Services Excellence will build this organization from the ground up. This leader will define how Services is sold, priced, forecasted, staffed, governed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved across the company.

This is not a traditional operations or PMO role. This leader will establish the systems, standards, governance, metrics, and operating rhythms that enable a $100M+ global services organization to scale profitably while improving quality, customer outcomes, and delivery consistency.

The successful candidate will be both a builder and operator: capable of creating an operating model from first principles while simultaneously driving adoption, accountability, and measurable business results.

Mission: Build and institutionalize the Services operating system that enables predictable growth, scalable delivery, improved margins, and world-class customer outcomes.

What This Leader Will Own

1. Build the Services Excellence Organization

  • Design and stand up the Services Excellence function from inception.

  • Define the organization structure, charter, responsibilities, operating rhythm, governance forums, and success metrics.

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a team spanning portfolio management, commercial governance, demand planning, workforce planning, delivery excellence, and business process excellence.

  • Establish Services Excellence as the long-term owner of standards, guardrails, methodologies, metrics, process governance, QA, and continuous improvement.

2. Services Portfolio Governance

  • Define and manage the global services portfolio architecture, including offerings, packages, SKUs, rate cards, delivery models, and lifecycle ownership.

  • Rationalize the portfolio so Sales can consume it, Delivery can execute it, and Finance can measure it.

  • Establish portfolio governance mechanisms that ensure each offering is commercially viable, scalable, repeatable, and aligned to margin expectations.

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery leadership to improve portfolio adoption, packaging, enablement, and reporting.

3. Commercial Governance and Services Economics

  • Own services deal governance frameworks, including approval rules, pricing controls, margin gates, and exception management.

  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Sales to align cost basis, pricing methodology, discounting controls, and margin reporting.

  • Drive adoption of standardized fully burdened cost models and profitability analytics.

  • Identify and execute opportunities to improve gross margin, realization, utilization, partner spend efficiency, and overall services economics.

4. Demand, Capacity and Workforce Planning

  • Establish integrated demand forecasting that connects pipeline, bookings, revenue timing, staffing, capacity, and delivery needs.

  • Build workforce planning models that determine where to hire, redeploy, cross-train, or use partners.

  • Develop forward-looking capacity views by geography, service line, role, skill, and delivery model.

  • Help leadership move from reactive staffing decisions to proactive capacity planning.

5. Delivery Excellence

  • Define global delivery standards, methodologies, quality frameworks, delivery governance, and operational runbooks.

  • Create repeatable playbooks that convert customer and project learnings into institutional knowledge.

  • Partner with regional delivery leaders to reduce project risk, delivery inconsistency, escalations, poor system hygiene, and margin leakage.

  • Establish operating reviews across project health, customer outcomes, utilization, productivity, and delivery quality.

6. Business Process Excellence and Transformation

  • Redesign and optimize end-to-end Services processes across the customer lifecycle.

  • Establish process ownership, decision rights, RACI models, and escalation paths across Services, Sales, Finance, Partner Operations, and Customer Success.

  • Lead major transformation initiatives across operating model design, organizational structure, systems, reporting, governance, and change adoption.

  • Create accountability through transformation roadmaps, scorecards, milestones, and executive inspection cadences.

7. Systems, Automation and Data Governance

  • Own Services requirements and prioritization for PSA, workflow, reporting, automation, and analytics platforms.

  • Ensure systems support the operating model rather than allowing tools to dictate processes.

  • Build executive reporting standards, data hygiene rules, scorecards, and operating dashboards.

  • Partner with BI, Finance, RevOps, and Operations to ensure trusted data across portfolio, delivery, staffing, financial, and operational reporting.

8. Executive Leadership and Change Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Services leadership team on operating model, economics, governance, and transformation priorities.

  • Influence senior stakeholders across Services, Sales, Finance, Product, Customer Success, and global delivery teams.

  • Translate executive vision into practical operating mechanisms that teams can adopt.

  • Drive change management with direct communication, strong stakeholder engagement, and clear decision-making discipline.

Required Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience across professional services, consulting, customer success operations, business transformation, strategy, operations, or services excellence.

  • Significant experienceoperating in a global software, SaaS, consulting, or technology services organization.

  • Proven track record building teams, operating models, transformation offices, or Centers of Excellence from the ground up.

  • Deep understanding of professionalservices economics, including utilization, realization, gross margin, pricing, discounting, forecasting, capacity planning, revenue timing, and partner management.

  • Experience owning cross-functional transformation initiatives with measurable operational and financial outcomes.

  • Experience developing governance models, decision rights, operating cadences, executive reporting, and performance scorecards.

  • Experience partnering with Sales, Finance, Services Delivery, Product, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and executive leadership.

Requisite Skills and Capabilities

Builder mindset

Creates structure where none exists and can operate through ambiguity without waiting for perfect inputs.

Systems thinking

Sees the connections between portfolio, pricing, staffing, partner usage, delivery quality, systems, reporting, and margin.

Commercial judgment

Understands how services decisions affect bookings, revenue, margin, customer outcomes, and long-term scalability.

Operational rigor

Builds repeatable processes, governance, metrics, and accountability mechanisms that teams can actually follow.

Data fluency

Uses financial, operational, delivery, and pipeline data to diagnose issues and drive decisions.

Executive communication

Can translate complex operating model issues into crisp recommendations, business cases, and decision asks.

Influence without authority

Can align regional leaders, finance partners, sales stakeholders, and delivery teams across competing priorities.

Change leadership

Can move the organization from informal ways of working to disciplined, scalable operating mechanisms.

Talent development

Can recruit, grow, and lead a high-caliber Services Excellence team with clear ownership and accountability.

Success Measures After 12 Months

  • Services Excellence organization stood up with clear charter, team design, governance, and executive sponsorship.

  • Portfolio and commercial governance operating with defined standards, margin thresholds, approval gates, and exception management.

  • Integrated demand-to-capacity planning model established across pipeline, bookings, staffing, partner usage, and delivery capacity.

  • Global delivery standards, runbooks, quality reviews, and project health governance embedded into routine operations.

  • Clear ownership model and decision rights established across Services Excellence, Services Operations, Partner Operations, Regional VPs, Finance, and Sales Operations.

  • Improved margin visibility, forecast accuracy, operating discipline, system hygiene, process adoption, and delivery consistency.

  • Services Excellence recognized as the permanent owner of the Services operating system and transformation roadmap.

Target Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate will likely haveoperated as a Services Transformation leader, Services Operations executive, Professional Services Excellence leader, Consulting COO, Transformation Office leader, or senior strategy and operations leader inside a scaled software, SaaS, consulting, or technology services environment.

This person should not be a pure PMO leader or a pure delivery leader. The role requires someone who can design the operating model, build the organization, influence senior stakeholders, understand the economics, and drive measurable execution across a global services business.

In practical terms, this is a mini-COO role for Services: part strategist, part operator, part transformation leader, and part governance owner.

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

JOB REQ COMPENSATION RANGE

$195,000 - $325,000

The base salary range for this role is shown above. At Sprinklr, base pay depends on multiple individualized factors, including experience, qualifications, job-related knowledge and skills, and geographic location. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package: the successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in Sprinklr’s discretionary bonus plan, commission plan, and/or equity plan, depending on role.

jobs.description:
Reports to: Sr. Director, Global Agentic AI

About SailPoint

SailPoint is the leading, AI-driven identity security platform providing the autonomous governance that solves the complex needs of the modern enterprise. By harnessing the power of AI and machine learning, SailPoint automates and streamlines the complexity of delivering the right access to the right identities and technology resources at the right time—all delivered at the scale our enterprise customers demand.

The Opportunity: A Career-Defining Role

This is not a standard pre-sales position. This is an invitation to be the pioneering technical leader for a new category of technology in the Japanese market.

SailPoint is seeking a high-caliber, deeply technical Principal Agentic Technologist to join our newly formed global Agentic Technologists team. Reporting to the Sr. Director, you will be the primary technical authority responsible for proving the immense value of SailPoint’s Agentic Identity Security products to our most strategic customers and prospects in Japan. You aren’t just selling a solution; you are defining a new market and establishing SailPoint as its undisputed leader.

As the team's representative for the APJ region, you will join a globally distributed, elite group of principal-level technologists. Our mission is to unlock the potential of SailPoint’s global sales engineering scale and existing infrastructure, tapping into the powerful new agentic products SailPoint has released and is continuously innovating.

What You'll Do:

  • Pioneer the "Agentic Story" in Japan: Collaborate with world-class, like-minded individuals to build and iterate on technical assets that showcase how SailPoint gives organizations the confidence to securely build and govern AI agents at scale.

  • Drive Technical Success: As our senior-most technologist in Japan, you will orchestrate the technical strategy for our most critical engagements. You will personally lead these complex opportunities from discovery through to final architectural design, unlocking customer potential by delivering our industry-leading Top-3 Agent Workshops (T3AW).

  • Field Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Act as the premier SME for Agentic AI in the region. You will present at high-profile industry events, lead executive workshops, and enable the broader global sales engineering team on how to articulate and demonstrate our Agentic vision.

  • Strategic Partner Enablement: Work closely with local partners to unlock the reach of our products. You will be responsible for creating and delivering scaled enablement programs, equipping partners with the deep technical knowledge required to bring SailPoint's agentic solutions to the wider Japanese market.

  • Influence the Future: Partner closely with Product Management and executive leadership to provide critical "feet-on-the-ground" feedback from the field. You will directly influence the product roadmap by identifying the real-world identity challenges customers face when deploying Agentic AI.

  • Masterful Solution Design: Function as a trusted advisor to customers, working with them to design secure, forward-thinking identity architectures that meet their strategic business goals in the age of AI.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Business-Level Japanese Fluency: Native or equivalent proficiency in Japanese is a firm requirement to effectively engage with customers, partners, and in-country leadership.

  • Hands-on Agentic AI Proficiency: Deep, practical experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.. You must be comfortable building or configuring sophisticated agents that interact with cloud platforms, other agents, and enterprise data.

  • Cloud AI Platform Expertise: Demonstrable experience working with major cloud AI platforms like AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI.

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) Foundations: A strong, commanding understanding of IGA/IAM principles, including Just-in-Time (JIT) access, least privilege, and lifecycle management.

  • Non-Human Identity Expertise: Familiarity with securing service accounts, API keys, and machine identities (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE, workload identity).

  • Advanced Development/Scripting Skills: High proficiency in Python (highly preferred for AI/ML work) and/or Java/JavaScript, with the ability to build custom demo integrations and automation scripts for POCs.

  • Strategic & Technical Communication: The rare ability to explain "the why" to a CISO and "the value" to a CDO, while also being able to dive deep and explain "the how" to a Lead Architect or developer.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support the SVP of Product Marketing. You will partner closely with Product Marketing, the broader Marketing organization, and cross-functional teams across the company, serving as a critical connector and helping drive alignment, accountability, and execution. Success requires exceptional judgment, discretion, communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple high-priority work streams without losing sight of the bigger picture.


The ideal candidate goes well beyond traditional administrative support. You anticipate needs before they arise, understand business priorities, connect dots across teams, and create the structure and operating rhythm that enables an executive and organization to perform at their best. You are resourceful, calm under pressure, highly adaptable, and comfortable making sound decisions with limited direction.


What You’ll Do:

Executive Partnership & Prioritization

  • Serve as a trusted partner to the SVP of Product Marketing, developing a strong understanding of their priorities, organization, key stakeholders, and business objectives.
  • Proactively anticipate executive and organizational needs, identify potential issues, and take action before they become blockers.
  • Manage and continuously optimize a complex, high-volume calendar across global time zones, making thoughtful prioritization decisions and resolving conflicts as business needs shift.

Organizational Operations & Execution

  • Serve as a communication hub across the Product Marketing organization and with key cross-functional teams, helping information flow quickly and effectively.
  • Partner closely with EA peers across Marketing and the company to coordinate executive priorities, resolve scheduling and prioritization conflicts, and ensure alignment across leadership.

Travel, Events & Logistics

  • Own complex domestic and international travel planning, including multi-leg itineraries, accommodations, ground transportation, documentation requirements, and real-time changes.
  • Proactively brief the SVP on relevant travel considerations and coordinate with internal teams, when appropriate.
  • Plan and execute PMM and leadership meetings, offsites, and team events, managing logistics, budgets, materials, and attendee experience from start to finish.
  • Manage timely and accurate expense reconciliation and reporting and serve as an approval delegate for T&E.

AI & Operational Excellence

  • Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your workflow to increase speed, quality, and efficiency – including drafting communications, summarizing meetings and documents, research and travel planning, preparing briefing materials, project tracking, and operational processes.
  • Embrace new technologies and ways of working, helping raise the bar for how the EA function operates in an AI-driven environment.

What You'll Need:


  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 5+ years Executive Assistant experience, supporting SVP- and VP-level executives in complex, global organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a business partner beyond traditional administrative responsibilities, with strong business judgment and an understanding of executive priorities.
  • Exceptional calendar management skills, including experience managing high-volume schedules across multiple executives, stakeholders, and global time zones.
  • Proven ability to independently own projects, executive meetings, offsites, and events from initial planning through successful execution.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-moving, time-sensitive environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated experience interacting confidently and professionally with executives and senior leaders.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, identify problems, and act without waiting for direction.
  • Strong accountability and follow-through, to respectfully drive commitments and deliverables across stakeholders at all levels.
  • Collaborative, team player who readily jumps in where needed and consistently operates with a company-first mindset.
  • Demonstrated discretion and professionalism when handling confidential, sensitive, and proprietary information.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom, with a high aptitude for quickly learning new systems and technologies.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to support leadership meetings, offsites, conferences, and other key business events.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Haryanvi-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Haryanvi Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Haryanvi Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Haryanviand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

Qualifications

  • Fluency inHaryanvi and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

jobs.excerpt: About Us Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Nupe-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Nupe Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.75 - $0.90 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Nupe Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Nupeand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inNupeand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for OneHundredEighty (180)days from the posting date of May 15, 2026.

jobs.title: SAP Solution Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: SD Worx ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von Payroll- und HR-Dienstleistungen mit globaler Reichweite.
jobs.description:
SD Worx ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von Payroll- und HR-Dienstleistungen mit globaler Reichweite. Wir haben Niederlassungen in Europa und ein Büro auf Mauritius. Unser Ziel? Wir erwecken Personallösungen zum Leben, so können Unternehmen jeder Größe ihre Personalabteilung zu einer Quelle der Wertschöpfung für das Unternehmen und ihre Mitarbeiter machen.

Unsere Personallösungen umfassen den gesamten Weg eines Mitarbeiters, von der Bezahlung über die Gewinnung bis zur Weiterentwicklung von Talenten. Bist du bereit, dich uns anzuschließen?


Was haben wir zu bieten?

  • Eine dynamische Arbeitsumgebung: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und remote working

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sowie Heiligabend und Silvester als zusätzliche freie Tage

  • Stabile Beschäftigungsbedingungen: unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag (nach einer 6-monatigen Probezeit)

  • Kostenlose Sprachkurse (während der Arbeitszeit)

  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen jährlichen Gesundheitsbudget von 600 €

  • Erholungsbeihilfe in Höhe von 156 € netto jährlich

  • Sachbezug in Höhe von 50 € netto monatlich (einzulösen bei verschiedenen Anbietern wie Lieferando, REWE, Aral etc.)

  • Essenszuschuss von bis zu 40 € netto monatlich

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Kostenfreie Unfallversicherung

  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Fahrradleasing über JobRad

  • Corporate Benefits mit Rabatten und Vorteilen bei über 800 Top-Markenanbietern

  • Workation: Möglichkeit, von jedem SD Worx-Standort aus zu arbeiten (4 Wochen pro Jahr, nur EU)

  • Empfehlungsprogramm

  • Lernmöglichkeiten: Durch einen individuellen Entwicklungsplan und professionelle Schulungen

  • Karriereentwicklung: Ob du dich in deinem Fachgebiet weiter spezialisieren oder dein Wissen horizontal erweitern möchtest, bei SD Worx gibt es immer Raum für Wachstum

Die Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne werden den Kandidaten im ersten Kontakt mit dem Talent-Acquisition-Team mitgeteilt, entweder telefonisch oder per E-Mail.

Was hast du zu bieten?

Eine umfassende Leidenschaft für das SAP-Ökosystem und ein starkes Engagement für die Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden. Aber auch:

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Solution Architect im HR-Umfeld, idealerweise im SAP-Ökosystem (SAP SuccessFactors, SAP HCM).

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP-Systemarchitektur, Integrationen sowie Customizing und Entwicklungen in SAP HR.

  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von IT-Projekten im HR-Bereich, einschließlich Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessdesign und Implementierung.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen von Fachabteilungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

  • Eigenständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Engagement.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Welche Aufgaben kannst du erwarten?

  • Analyse und Design von SAP-basierten HR-Lösungen

  • Beratung und Unterstützung der Fachabteilungen bei der Implementierung von SAP HR-Modulen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Architekturkonzepten und -strategien

  • Sicherstellung der Integration von SAP HR-Lösungen in die bestehende IT-Landschaft

  • Durchführung von Schulungen und Workshops für Anwender und Key User

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zur Optimierung der HR-Prozesse

Von vielen Orten aus arbeiten wir als Eins, um gemeinsam vom Besseren zum Besten zu gelangen.

SD Worx lebt Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz. Vielfalt sorgt für Inspiration und Innovation in unserem Unternehmen. Wir freuen uns besonders über Bewerbungen von qualifizierten Talenten, unabhängig von Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, ethnischem und sozialem Hintergrund, Religion, Alter, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung und Lebensphase.

jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Help us protect CrowdStrike and its customers from the most advanced threats by assessing, designing, and implementing security controls and systems associated with all aspects of the software supply chain. CrowdStrike's Product Security team breaks the mold of traditional internal security, and focuses on active threats to CrowdStrike's products.

As a Security Engineer II, you will focus on securing our open-source footprint and upstream dependencies. You will perform technical security assessments of GitHub organizations and open-source integrations, monitor for malicious packages, create tooling for known gaps, and create automations to make operations more efficient. Additionally, you will collaborate on cross-cutting projects to further harden internal and public-facing source code repositories against active and emerging threats.

What You'll Do:

  • Assess risk and provide security guidance to engineers across the company on open-source software usage and repository configurations.

  • Implement and maintain controls and processes to secure public and private GitHub organizations, including repository guardrails and secret scanning.

  • Harden open-source code usage, development, ingestion, and distribution across the enterprise.

  • Investigate open-source dependencies and third-party packages to mitigate supply chain risks (e.g., typosquatting, dependency confusion).

  • Advocate for secure coding and open-source compliance practices to the wider engineering organization.

  • Contribute to the delivery of security initiatives aimed at hardening CrowdStrike’s software supply chain and code-hosting environments.

What You'll Need:

  • Experience working in an engineering role implementing, supporting, and monitoring software security systems.

  • Strong working experience with GitHub, including repository administration, GitHub Actions, branch protection rules, and access management.

  • Familiarity with other source control management tools (e.g., BitBucket, GitLab)

  • Familiarity with artifact storage tools like Artifactory and S3.

  • Experience identifying and mitigating open-source risks (SCA, dependency management, licensing risks).

  • Experience working with and securing configurations of Linux and/or other Unix-like variants.

  • Proficiency in one or more common scripting languages, such as Python, Golang, Shell, or JavaScript, to automate security checks.

  • Domain knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), secure coding practices, code reviews, and source control security.

  • Collaborative mindset with experience contributing to cross-team security projects and initiatives.

  • Experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows, or automate vulnerability triage.

  • Efficient communicator with strong writing skills, comfortable working in a remote environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with common monitoring or log aggregation tools such as LogScale, Splunk, DataDog, Prometheus, etc.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools (Jenkins, Argo CD) from an integration and ingestion perspective.

  • Experience working in and securing configurations of large-scale cloud platforms.

  • Self-motivated to identify security problems and engage with development teams to find pragmatic solutions.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

If you thrive in a fast-paced and exciting environment and want to help build out an extraordinary team and company, then this is the role for you.

As ServiceTitan’s Pro Sales Manager, this role will directly manage a team of Pro Account Executives responsible for the upsell of these products and services to existing customers.   • Manage the Pro Account Executives on objective and performance achievement

  • Monitor the full Pro Product sales cycle from prospecting through close

  • Shape and implement sales strategy and processes

  • Provide accurate weekly forecasts to sales leadership

  • Motivate, incent, and recognize team members to encourage top performance

  • Recruit, interview, and onboard new team members

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with each Pro Account Manager and respective weekly team meetings

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success

  • Partner with product marketing on market feedback and influence product roadmap

  • Foster & build overall relationship with customers, which include: increasing Pro Product adoption, ensuring retention of existing Pro Products, and long-term customer success

  • Be the go-to-lead on new features adoption in an advocate/consultative approach

  • Strong presentation skills and proficiency in Google Slides

jobs.description:
Ministry Brands is looking for a  Manager, Support to join our growing team!

 

Who we are

Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for faith-based, non-profit and for-profit organizations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades. The diverse and real-world experiences of our team members serving their communities makes us stronger together and enhances our ability to advance digital transformation for the greater good.   

  

Ministry Brands is committed to acknowledging and valuing our employee differences and to creating an environment in which every individual’s unique strengths and abilities are developed and valued. Our employees share in the responsibility for creating this environment and demonstrate mutual respect and acceptance in the workplace. We welcome everyone and are dedicated to creating a culture where all our employees have equal opportunity to be heard and reach their full potential.  

What You'll Do:

The Manager, Support, supervises a staff of client support specialists who provide technical product support to clients and/or end users. You will manage the team’s daily workload to ensure required service volume and quality levels are attained. You will assist with critical customer escalations and train/coach your team in standard policies, procedures, and best practices to provide a high level of service to our clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of support specialists, monitor, and review responses and resolutions with clients

  • Provide coaching and feedback in regular one-on-ones with Associates

  • Actively contribute to and foster a positive team culture that is grounded in feedback and focuses on client experience

  • Assess, propose, enhance, implement, and analyze KPIs needed to optimize team performance and client experience

  • Prioritize team's escalation needs and prepares commentary with Support Directors during weekly meeting

  • Responsible for Support QA testing as needed with assigned team and relaying findings/risks in companywide meetings

  • Assist with product documentation and product/system training as SME's (or identifies SME's as needed from within team)

  • Assist in establishing KPIs and evaluating team activities against those KPIs

  • Review and analyze reporting metrics and client sentiment to identify areas for improvement of the client experience

  • Responsible for team's data and summary/commentary for monthly leadership Business Reviews

  • Estimate client needs, team workload, and team capacity, and flex staff resources accordingly

  • Participate in performance management and evaluations of team members

  • Participate in the hiring of new team members

  • Support processes that align with adjacent department process rollouts

  • Participate as a member of Operations management team, collaborating with other managers and leaders to communicate status, solve issues affecting more than one department and implement solutions needing cross-functional involvement to attain joint objectives

  • Champion client experience improvement initiatives

  • Maintain individual knowledge and ensures team knowledge around the products, services, and platforms that we provide to our client base

  • Provide input to (and in some cases champion) Product, Service and Process enhancement initiatives to drive a stellar client experience

  • After hours, weekend, and holiday coverage may be required and assigned as needed

  • Other duties as assigned

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • 3+ years of experience working in a technical support environment

  • Experience working in technology is preferred

  • Proficient in Office 365 - Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and understand complex office software applications

  • Experience with client support ticketing and phone systems preferred (We use Zendesk and Purecloud)

  • Strong leadership, development, and organizational skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks

  • Excellent time management skills

  • Experience in Salesforce, Zendesk, and Azure Dev Ops is a plus

  • Strong attention to detail

Physical Considerations:

  • Ability to work in a general office environment

  • Ability to handle extended periods of computer-based work, including telephone

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or international travel required, estimated up to 5%

Benefit offerings designed to promote a life of balance!  
 

At Ministry Brands, we recognize that your career is just one important piece of your dynamic life. We offer a robust range of benefit offerings designed to cultivate a lifestyle of balance and personal success. 

 

Robust healthcare options – Employees have several healthcare options to choose from in order to find what works best for them. 

Flexible paid time off – There is no perfect, one size fits all balance between work and home. We provide flexible work schedules, PTO for vacation, and up to 80 hours of paid sick/safe leave. We also feature 11.5 days of fully paid holidays!  

Invest in your future – Ministry Brands matches 100% of your 401(k) contributions, dollar-for-dollar, up to 3%. Contribute 3%, and we add another 3%. It's well-earned money working toward your retirement from day one.

Paid parental leave – Adding a new child to the family is a big adjustment! We provide the time and income to allow parents to adjust to their new normal in the healthiest way possible.  

Mental health support –Ministry Brands is a stigma free company with the National Alliance on Mental Illness. Associates are supported through an Employee Assistance Program which provides access to in-person or virtual counseling at no cost.  

Professional development reimbursement –Ministry Brands aims to support your professional development and empower you to drive your career by providing financial assistance to our associates seeking to further their education and career.

Employee Recognition & Rewards - At Ministry Brands, we use Nectar to celebrate achievements and strengthen our culture of recognition. This social platform empowers employees to send meaningful kudos, award points redeemable for rewards, and highlight contributions that exemplify our values. Through Nectar, we foster engagement and appreciation while providing tangible ways to recognize great work.

Ministry Brands is committed to acknowledging and valuing our employee differences and to creating an environment in which every individual’s unique strengths and abilities are developed and valued. Our employees share in the responsibility for creating this environment and demonstrate mutual respect and acceptance in the workplace. We welcome everyone and are dedicated to creating a culture where all our employees have equal opportunity to be heard and reach their full potential.  

Ministry Brands is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release. As an AI SDLC Engineer, you'll help drive that transformation: building the platforms and workflows that let engineers ship faster, offload well-scoped work to AI agents with confidence, and spend more of their time on the hardest problems. You'll partner closely with engineering teams to identify friction points across the dev lifecycle and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities — with an eye toward efficient use of compute and model spend along the way.


What You'll Do:


  • Design and build agentic workflows that let engineers automate more of the SDLC — from code generation and review to testing and release — with confidence in the output.
  • Improve context-grounding systems so agents resolve the right information on the first try, cutting slow, error-prone multi-turn search out of the workflow.
  • Tune model-routing so each task runs on the model best suited to it — matching capability to the job at hand, with cost efficiency as one input among several.
  • Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it.
  • Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities.
  • Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization.

What You'll Need:


  • 5+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, ideally with production Kubernetes systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs.
  • Go and/or Python proficiency.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards.

Bonus Points:


  • Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications.
  • Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines.
  • Prior experience running a benchmark-driven optimization program (A/B testing, Pareto-frontier tracking) for a production system.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at further assistance.

Find out more about your rights as an applicant.

CrowdStrike participates in the E-Verify program.

Notice of E-Verify Participation

Right to Work

CrowdStrike, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Placement within the pay range is dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications, job level, supervisory status, and location. The base salary range for this position for all U.S. candidates is $120,000 - $180,000 per year, with eligibility for bonuses, equity grants and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, 401k and paid time off.
