Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Engineering

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

This is a Staff-level, hands-on engineering role for someone who has built data infrastructure from zero to production and knows how to turn fragmented operational data into reliable, accessible, and actionable systems.

You'll own the architecture and implementation of our data warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformations, and product analytics foundations.

We're building an AI-native organization where both humans and autonomous agents need access to trustworthy, well-structured data. You'll design the systems that make this possible, enabling self-service analytics, automated decision-making, and increasingly intelligent workflows across the company.

What You'll Do

  1. Build our data platform from zero: Architect and implement our internal data warehouse, ingestion infrastructure, ETL/ELT pipelines, and core data models.
  2. Create agent-ready data foundations: Design reliable, well-documented datasets and interfaces that AI agents can safely discover, query, and use.
  3. Turn messy data into trusted systems: Transform fragmented operational and product data into consistent, high-quality sources of truth.
  4. Enable self-service analytics: Build the infrastructure that allows engineering, product, and business teams to answer questions independently without relying on manual data requests.
  5. Own product analytics infrastructure: Establish the event tracking, instrumentation, data models, and reporting foundations needed to understand product usage and performance.
  6. Automate data operations: Leverage AI coding agents and intelligent automation to accelerate pipeline development, data validation, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  7. Build for reliability and scale: Establish data quality standards, observability, governance, and scalable architectural patterns from the beginning.
  8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish strong data engineering practices, and lead architectural decisions through hands-on execution.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with extensive hands-on experience building and operating production data platforms.
  2. Proven greenfield experience: You've personally led the design and implementation of a data platform from scratch, rather than exclusively maintaining or extending existing infrastructure.
  3. Deep understanding of data warehouses, ETL/ELT architectures, data modeling, orchestration, and distributed data processing.
  4. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the software engineering fundamentals needed to build reliable data infrastructure.
  5. Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent tools.
  6. Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, access controls, and production data reliability.
  7. Experience designing analytics infrastructure that supports product insights and operational decision-making.
  8. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow and actively automate repetitive development and data engineering tasks.
  9. Ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions, balancing scalability, simplicity, performance, and engineering velocity.
  10. Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers and establishing engineering standards.

Nice to have

  1. You've been the founding or early Data Engineer responsible for building a company's first real data platform.
  2. You've designed data systems that support both traditional analytics and AI-powered applications or autonomous agents.
  3. You have experience building semantic layers, data discovery systems, or structured interfaces that make enterprise data accessible to AI.
  4. You've automated substantial portions of data pipeline development, validation, or maintenance using AI agents.
  5. You know how to avoid overengineering while building foundations that won't need to be replaced six months later.
  6. You're comfortable moving between data architecture, production pipelines, analytical modeling, and hands-on debugging.

jobs.excerpt: Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI.
jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

As the GRC Lead, you will own Aerospike's compliance program day to day, together with the Head of Security and Compliance. Aerospike holds a SOC 2 Type 2 report and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, and you will lead both programs together with risk management, policy, third-party risk and the security assurance we give customers. You will report to the Head of Security and Compliance, coordinate the Information Security Steering Committee, and work with Engineering, IT, People Operations, Legal, Finance and Sales. You will turn compliance from an annual audit effort into a weekly operating discipline, help shape the GRC function, and give our customers and auditors confidence in how Aerospike protects their data.

Job Responsibilities

  • Certifications and audits: Run the SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 programs day to day, including scope, the Statement of Applicability, the annual audit and surveillance cycles, and the relationship with our external audit firm.
  • Controls and system of record: Run our compliance automation platform as the system of record for controls, policies, people tasks, vendors and risks. Make sure every control has a named, current owner and that integrations and automated tests stay healthy, so evidence collection is continuous rather than an audit-season effort.
  • Governance: Coordinate the Information Security Steering Committee with a fixed calendar, agendas, minutes, decisions and an action log carried from meeting to meeting. Set measurable security objectives and run management review.
  • Risk management: Own the risk management procedure and the information security risk register. Run periodic risk assessments and make sure each risk has a treatment owner, a plan and a recorded decision.
  • Policy lifecycle: Own the security policy set and its annual review and approval. Keep policies, procedures and tool configuration consistent, and make sure everyone in scope accepts the policies that apply to them.
  • People and access controls: Partner with People Operations and IT so onboarding, offboarding, background checks, security training and user access reviews are completed on schedule and evidenced.
  • Third-party risk: Own the vendor risk program with Procurement and Legal, from intake and risk tiering to periodic reassessment and offboarding.
  • Customer trust: Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence reviews and the Trust Center, backed by an approved answer library, so every customer receives accurate, consistent, evidence-backed answers. Support Legal on the security terms of contracts and data processing agreements.
  • Internal audit and improvement: Run the internal audit program, manage nonconformities and corrective actions to closure, and coordinate independent assurance such as the annual penetration test.
  • Shape the function: Help define the GRC operating model, metrics and tooling, and automate repetitive compliance work. The role has no direct reports at first, with room to grow into people leadership as the team grows.

    Qualifications (Required)
  • Minimum of 7 years in information security, GRC or IT audit at a technology or SaaS company.
  • Hands-on ownership of SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 programs through multiple audit cycles, including leading an organization through ISO certification or recertification.
  • Deep working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (clauses 4 to 10 and Annex A) and the AICPA Trust Services Criteria.
  • Experience building and running risk management, third-party risk and policy management programs.
  • Experience implementing and operating a compliance automation platform with continuous control monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience assessing controls within major cloud environments (AWS or GCP), gathering data across systems to measure compliance postures, and actively developing technical capabilities to automate where off-the-shelf GRC tooling ends.
  • Demonstrated ability to run governance forums with executives: setting agendas, driving decisions and holding owners to commitments.
  • Experience answering customer security questionnaires and supporting enterprise sales security reviews.
  • Ability to influence and hold control owners accountable across Engineering, IT, People Operations and Legal without direct authority.
  • Strong communication, analytical, and decision-making skills, with clear, concise writing for both executives and auditors.

💡 Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks and regulations, for example GDPR, CCPA and ISO/IEC 27701.
  • Experience with public cloud environments (AWS, GCP) and with engineering and CI/CD controls.
  • Experience automating compliance evidence and reporting with scripts or APIs.
  • Experience building a GRC program.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Intrahealth, a subsidiary of HEALWELL AI Inc.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Intrahealth, a subsidiary of HEALWELL AI Inc. (TSX: AIDX), is an enterprise class EMR provider supporting approximately 20,000 providers and the care delivery of tens of millions of patients and clients across Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Intrahealth provides a suite of flexible software solutions to a wide variety of customers including health authorities, public health, community health, home care, and primary care professionals. Intrahealth’s solution is highly configurable and is ideal for complex health environments. To learn more about Intrahealth, please visit .

Position Overview

Intrahealth is hiring a full-time Infrastructure and Operations Team Lead. You will lead the team that hosts, runs, and secures our electronic medical record (EMR) software, for health authorities, public health agencies, community and home care organizations, and clinics across Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

Our customers rely on our software to deliver care every day, so availability, performance, and security are essential. You will be accountable for the reliability of our hosted environments, lead a team of DevOps and operations specialists, and set the standards, tooling, and processes that keep production stable as we grow.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction and coach your team, and you will also design, build, and troubleshoot alongside them. You’ll work closely with colleagues in engineering, customer support, security, and compliance, and you’ll help shape our hosting strategy as it evolves.

Our hosted environments run in Microsoft Azure and AWS, using Kubernetes containers, PostgreSQL, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and GitHub for CI/CD. We operate under a quality and information security management system aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 13485, and SOC 2. We use AI tools to work more effectively, but every change to production follows our change control and verification standards.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of infrastructure, DevOps, and operations specialists, including hiring, onboarding, setting priorities, and managing performance.
  • Own the availability, performance, capacity, and cost of our hosted production and non-production environments.
  • Lead the response to infrastructure incidents, run post-incident reviews, and make sure lessons learned become lasting fixes.
  • Define service level objectives, and put monitoring and alerting in place so problems are found before customers notice them.
  • Maintain and improve infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation for Profile and related services.
  • Plan and deliver infrastructure projects, including new customer environments, upgrades, migrations, and changes to our hosting model.
  • Work with security and compliance colleagues to implement and evidence controls for ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and customer contracts, and support internal and external audits.
  • Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and test them regularly.
  • Manage hosting and infrastructure suppliers, review cloud spending, and find opportunities to reduce cost.
  • Partner with engineering on release processes, environment needs, and production readiness for new services.
  • Act as an escalation point for customer support on hosting, performance, and connectivity issues.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Use AI tools to automate routine work and improve how the team operates.

Requirements

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Join One of the Fastest-Growing Professional Services Firms in the Nation

Are you passionate about helping clients embrace technology to elevate their business operations and enhance customer satisfaction?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly US, LLP (BT) as a Sage Intacct BT360 Senior Consultant specializing in the Construction Vertical! At BT your main responsibilities will include working directly with clients to deliver software solutions through implementation projects and ongoing support—driving high customer satisfaction and successful adoption.

As one of the fastest-growing firms in the country, BT offers:

  • A clear path for career advancement
  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Meaningful relationships with clients, teammates, and leaders who genuinely care about your growth and development

What You’ll Do

As a trusted member of the engagement team, you will be expected to:

Interpersonal Functions:

  • Provide prompt, concise, and friendly communications providing high quality service
  • Utilize time management skills with ability to manage priorities independently and successfully multi-task across projects, customers, and internal activities
  • Advocate for clients, team members, and the product
  • Work effectively independently and collaboratively in a team environment
  • Act as project sponsor on resourced projects, managing resources and providing project updates to clients
  • Understand, communicate expectations, and enforce SOWs and scope of BT360 program

Technical Functions:

  • Monitor and respond to customer technical issues, product questions and informational requests
  • Clearly articulate system functionality through written and oral communication methods
  • Coordinate, plan, and lead internal and client project team meetings
  • Be able to: 1) configure and implement the Sage Intacct software, following our prescriptive implementation methodology resulting in in-scope/on-budget/on-time delivery, high customer satisfaction, and successful customer adoption 2) document customer business requirements into configurable software solutions and business management processes utilizing best practices and visual process flowcharts 3) perform gap analysis between system functionality and client requirements including recommendation of alternative applications to achieve similar goals when necessary 4) design and build industry specific key performance indicators, reports, and dashboards 5) conduct training for customer end-users at all levels of the customers organization and relate system functionality to customer business operations
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel (pivot tables, vlookups, macros, etc.) for efficient data mapping, integration, and migration of customer data
  • Utilize and deepen your knowledge of the Sage Intacct software including development of expertise implementing and using Sage Intacct, as well as staying current with the latest product features and enhancements, especially those related to the CRE product at Sage
  • Any additional assignments as requested by management 

Successful candidates will have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Accounting (preferred), Business, or MIS (with a foundational understanding of accounting concepts).
  • Deep knowledge of the construction industry, including micro-verticals, operational/reporting requirements, and terminology.
  • Knowledge of construction-specific payroll requirements, preferred
  • At least 3+ years of experience consulting and implementing Sage Intacct
  • Construction industry experience working in accounting or operations (with general understanding of accounting principles)
  • Public accounting experience
  • Accounting and finance or similar as an end user of Sage Intacct or similar ERP system
  • Sage Intacct Implementation Certification, and/or Sage Intacct Construction Implementation Consultant Certification Package
  • Experience as a client-facing support consultant (preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with full-cycle software delivery or as an end-user during implementation or upgrades (preferred)
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros, etc.) for efficient data mapping, integration, and migration of client data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship


Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing professional services firms in the nation?

Do you enjoy helping customers embrace technology to elevate their business and customer satisfaction?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP (BT) as a Sage HCM Implementation & Support Senior Consultant! At BT your main responsibilities will include leading client implementations and providing ongoing functional and technical support for Sage HCM solutions.

This is a client-facing role responsible for guiding customers through the full implementation lifecycle—from requirements gathering and system configuration through testing, training, go-live, and post-implementation support. You will also work with existing clients to troubleshoot issues, optimize their Sage HCM environments, and help them get greater value from the system.

The ideal candidate has hands-on HCM implementation experience, understands HR and payroll processes, enjoys solving complex system and configuration issues, and can confidently guide clients through both implementation and ongoing support.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for more than someone who knows how to navigate an HCM system. We want a consultant who can listen to a client’s requirements, understand the underlying business process, determine the appropriate system configuration, and guide the client to a successful outcome.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between new implementations, client training, configuration projects, troubleshooting, and ongoing support. They will take ownership of client issues, communicate clearly, and develop the expertise necessary to become a trusted advisor to our Sage HCM clients.

What success looks like:

Success in this role means:

  • Implementations are delivered accurately and clients are prepared for go-live
  • Client issues are investigated thoroughly and resolved efficiently
  • Clients understand how to effectively use and administer Sage HCM
  • Configuration decisions are well documented and aligned with client requirements
  • Clients view the consultant as a knowledgeable and dependable partner
  • Opportunities to improve client processes and Sage HCM utilization are proactively identified

Does this describe you?

  • You want to work for a leading professional services firm whose owners have both their clients’ and employees’ best interests in mind and are transparent in their decisions
  • You want to grow professionally and develop your client service and technical skills to build a career with endless opportunities now, for tomorrow

What you will do:

  • Be a trusted member of the engagement team and responsible for:
  • Sage HCM Implementation
  • Leading or supporting Sage HCM implementations for new clients
  • Conducting client discovery sessions to understand HR, payroll, timekeeping, and business requirements
  • Translating business requirements into effective Sage HCM configurations
  • Configuring employee structures, organizational hierarchies, policies, workflows, security, timekeeping, and other HCM functionalities
  • Assisting with employee data conversion, validation, and migration
  • Configuring and testing workflows, approvals, notifications, and business processes
  • Supporting integrations between Sage HCM and payroll, accounting, benefits, timekeeping, and other third-party applications
  • Following implementation plans and managing assigned implementation tasks and deliverables
  • Coordinating user acceptance testing and assisting clients with identifying and resolving issues before go-live
  • Supporting clients’ go-live activities and transitioning customers into ongoing support
  • Client Support & Optimization
  • Providing ongoing functional and technical support to Sage HCM clients
  • Troubleshooting employee setup, timesheets, workflows, security, reporting, configuration, and system errors
  • Researching issues, identifying root causes, and providing clients with clear resolutions
  • Assisting clients with configuration changes as their organizations and processes evolve
  • Reviewing existing Sage HCM environments and recommending improvements or best practices
  • Managing client support requests and communicating status, next steps, and resolutions
  • Escalating software defects or complex technical issues to Sage or other appropriate resources when necessary
  • Maintaining clear documentation of client configurations, issues, and resolutions
  • Client Training & Consulting
  • Training HR administrators, payroll teams, managers, and other users on Sage HCM functionality
  • Developing client-specific procedures, documentation, and training materials
  • Explaining system functionality in practical terms to both technical and non-technical users
  • Advising clients on Sage HCM process improvements and system best practices
  • Building strong, long-term client relationships and serving as a trusted Sage HCM resource
  • Identifying opportunities for clients to expand or improve their use of Sage HCM
  • Learn and grow from direct on the job coaching and mentoring along with participating in firm wide learning and development programs – seek knowledge
  • Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and with your clients
  • Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals
  • Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience implementing, configuring, or supporting Sage HCM or comparable HCM/HRIS solutions
  • Strong understanding of HRIS/HCM processes and employee lifecycle management
  • Experience gathering client requirements and translating them into system configurations
  • Experience troubleshooting Sage HCM system and configuration issues
  • Strong client-facing consulting and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple client projects and support requests simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Ability to independently research and resolve unfamiliar system issues
  • Comfortable leading client meetings, system demonstrations, and training sessions

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of HCM/HRIS implementation or consulting experience
  • Direct Sage HCM implementation and support experience
  • Experience with time and attendance, timesheets, payroll, benefits, and HR workflows
  • Experience with data conversion and system integrations
  • Experience developing reports and data extracts
  • Knowledge of payroll and accounting processes
  • Experience working for a Sage business partner, HCM consulting firm, or managed services provider
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

The pay range for this position is $97,600 to $158,200. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program, an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AOUSC) in developing a modern, cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Senior Data Engineer will leverage their expertise with AWS Cloud and the Databricks platform to help the CMM Data Modernization and Governance Team deliver integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and AI/ML capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill the AOUSC’s data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM Program.

The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, building, testing, and maintaining scalable data engineering components and platform services that power the CMM Program. This role delivers high-quality, secure, and performant data pipelines, transformations, ETL/ELT delivery, data management solutions, and system integrations aligned with federal standards and CMM objectives for modernization, analytics, and operational excellence. The Senior Data Engineer partners closely with the Data Architecture, Data Governance, and Migration teams to ensure engineering work is consistent, auditable, and aligned with CMM's cloud-based CI/CD standards.

If you're interested in engineering mission-critical data solutions while growing your career with a company that always puts our people at the forefront of everything we do, then we'd love to hear from you!

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Senior Data Engineer, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of the AOUSC. You will play a crucial role in:

Data Platform & Architecture

  • Develop and implement a scalable, secure, cloud-based data platform supporting operational data, reporting, and analytics delivering cloud-based architecture (data lake, lakehouse, or data warehouse).
  • Ensure alignment with federal security requirements, judiciary architecture standards, data governance policies, and application modernization initiatives
  • Engineer multi-tenant, cloud-based environments supporting hybrid/on‑premises systems, enabling SQL, NoSQL, IaaS, PaaS, distributed SQL, multi-modal, and event-driven/streaming databases.
  • Produce and maintain dimensional data models that form the basis for the data marts to satisfy the requirements of the data products
  • Develop and maintain downstream data marts and / or consumable data and their corresponding ETL/ELT processes (on a near real-time basis or overnight batch depending on the individual uses case requirements) and their associated reports and dashboards
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation including the STTMs, data models (logical and physical), design documents, testing documents and other related documents
  • Develop, deploy and maintain the data presentation and data reports for each of the data products using visualization or presentation tool(s) selected by the customer
  • Support development of the Data and Technology Enabler Roadmap across data engineering, reporting/analytics, and AI/ML use cases

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Design and develop data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines for integrating data from multiple enterprise sources, and transformation logic for near-real-time and batch workloads
  • Implement robust, reusable data services supporting analytics, reporting, and downstream data marts and / or gold layers
  • Collaborate with architects to implement logical and physical data models in cloud-based platforms (e.g., Databricks)
  • Develop and maintain high-quality, testable code using secure coding standards and best practices
  • Support the operationalization CMM Data Classification Standards, including workshops, security controls, metadata requirements, and integration into system design, procurement, and training
  • Configure metadata structures, workflows, automation, and security settings; develop ingestion processes and attribute definitions for catalog entries
  • Create training, job aids, and communications to support user adoption
  • Integrate data pipelines with cloud services, messaging, and storage components
  • Implement data quality checks, validations, and error-handling mechanisms
  • Optimize pipeline performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support CI/CD-enabled deployments, including automated testing and promotion across environments
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and sprint ceremonies.
  • Support incident resolution and root cause analysis for data pipeline failures
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and workflows
  • Ensure deliverables meet federal security, governance, and audit requirements
  • Operates within an Agile federal delivery environment across multiple scrum teams
  • Collaborates closely with architects, DBAs, business analysts, and QA personnel
  • Accountable for code quality, performance, and delivery timelines.
  • Expected to maintain audit-ready documentation and technical artifacts

Data Migration & Archiving

  • Partners closely with the Data Architecture, Data Governance, and Migration teams to execute the data migration, archival, and disaster recovery (DR) strategy
  • Deliver migration documentation for scripts, transformations, and validation results
  • Support the Failover Testing and DR drills engineering activities
  • Implement operational databases supporting data migration, archival, DR, document storage, indexing services, schemas, and secure data APIs using IaC for provisioning and configuration

This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Senior Data Engineer must have:

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills

  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team

jobs.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies.

Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it’s porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners’ internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

    • Epic
    • Xbox
    • Meta
    • Obsidian Entertainment
    • Riot
    • Gearbox Software

We're hiring Unreal Engine Programmers (mid-senior): a generalist who can pick up whatever the sprint needs, from gameplay features and AI to UI, tools, performance and bug fixing. You'll work in a large, mature Unreal codebase that you didn't write, alongside the client's engineers, and ship content to live players on a regular cadence.

This isn't a specialist role. We want someone who's comfortable anywhere in the engine, gets up to speed in an unfamiliar codebase quickly, and needs very little hand-holding.

What you’ll do

  • Implement gameplay systems from designer briefs: combat, abilities, movement, AI behaviours, progression, inventory, interaction, camera — scope varies by engagement
  • Build reusable, maintainable, testable gameplay code in C++ (and Blueprint where appropriate) within Unreal Engine 5
  • Implement multiplayer-safe gameplay code on engagements with networking requirements — replication, client-server authority, lag compensation
  • Ship live content updates on the client’s release cadence, following their engineering standards, code reviews and source control workflow
  • Profile and optimise gameplay code to target platform budgets — CPU frame time, tick overhead, replication cost
  • Write code that is reviewable: clean, commented where logic is non-obvious, consistent with project standards
  • Catch and fix gameplay bugs — including edge cases, exploit patterns, and regression from live updates
  • Participate actively in code review: review peers’ PRs with specificity, receive and act on feedback without defensiveness
  • Work directly with gameplay designers to translate design intent into engine behaviour — close the gap between what is specced and what ships
  • Identify implementation risks in design briefs early — before they become rework — and propose alternatives when the spec is not buildable as written
  • Document systems clearly — architecture decisions, integration points, known limitations
  • Support technical handoffs between phases or teams: leave the codebase in a state that the next engineer can understand without a phone call
  • Leverage generative AI models to accelerate your work

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional game programming in C++, with at least 3 of those in Unreal Engine (UE4 and/or UE5)
  • At least one shipped commercial title where you wrote production Unreal C++, not only Blueprint
  • Solid knowledge of Unreal’s gameplay framework: Actors, Components, GameMode/GameState, PlayerController, the UObject and reflection system
  • Hands-on experience with Unreal networking and replication in a multiplayer game
  • Comfort working in a large existing codebase you didn’t build, and the debugging skills to match (Visual Studio or Rider, Unreal Insights, crash dumps)
  • Experience with Perforce or similar source control on a multi-team project
  • Clear written and spoken English (B2 or above) for daily work with a US-based client team

Nice to have

  • Shipped work on a live-service game with regular content drops
  • Co-op PvE, action or shooter experience, including AI and encounter systems
  • Gameplay Ability System (GAS) experience
  • Console development on PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo Switch, including certification
  • UMG or Slate UI work, or building editor tools and plugins
  • Previous co-development or outsourcing experience embedded in a client team

Benefits

This is a full time salaried position with competitive industry benefits.

The Contracts & Credentialing Coordinator is responsible for supporting provider enrollment, credentialing, contracting, and payer-related activities to ensure providers are accurately enrolled, credentialed, and maintained with commercial and government payers. This position works closely with providers, insurance carriers, healthcare facilities, and internal teams to ensure timely completion of all credentialing and contracting processes.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer to help prospective customers understand how Bask Health's platform works and how it can support their business needs.

You'll work closely with Account Executives throughout the sales process, leading technical discovery, delivering product demonstrations, and developing proposed solutions based on customer requirements.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce businesses, healthcare companies, and brands looking to launch or grow their own telehealth offerings.

You'll help them understand how Bask's storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools work together.

This role combines technical problem-solving with customer communication. You'll need to understand customer requirements, explain software capabilities clearly, and work with internal teams when opportunities involve more complex technical questions.

You'll collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to help prospective customers evaluate Bask's platform and prepare clear technical handoffs when deals close.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, is curious about technology, and takes ownership of solving problems.

  • Partner with Account Executives throughout the technical sales process.
  • Participate in discovery calls with prospective customers.
  • Identify customer technical requirements and business needs.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand how prospective customers plan to use Bask.

  • Deliver product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.
  • Explain Bask's storefront, questionnaire, checkout, and operational capabilities.
  • Help prospective merchants understand how different platform components work together.
  • Support technical evaluations during active sales opportunities.
  • Explain available integration options and platform capabilities.
  • Discuss APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations with prospective customers.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to evaluate complex technical questions.

  • Help prospective customers understand technical configuration options.

  • Prepare technical presentations and supporting sales materials.
  • Support presales proof-of-value activities.
  • Help create demonstration environments for customer evaluations.
  • Assist with technical responses to customer questionnaires.
  • Explain technical concepts to founders, executives, developers, and operations teams.
  • Identify potential technical risks or dependencies.
  • Document customer technical requirements and proposed solutions.
  • Coordinate internal technical reviews when needed.
  • Help Account Executives address technical questions during sales cycles.
  • Support technical portions of commercial proposals.
  • Ensure proposed solutions accurately reflect supported platform functionality.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical discovery findings.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Engineering teammates on complex opportunities.
  • Develop reusable demonstration materials and technical documentation.
  • Help improve the quality and consistency of product demonstrations.
  • Share recurring customer requirements with Product and Engineering.
  • Stay informed about new Bask features and platform updates.
  • Support technical discussions involving storefronts, payments, and patient experiences.
  • Help prospective customers understand implementation considerations.
  • Prepare technical handoff documentation for onboarding and implementation teams.
  • Participate in internal sales and technical planning meetings.
  • Support improvements to the overall technical presales process.
  • Take ownership of assigned technical sales activities and customer follow-ups.
  • Communicate clearly about technical capabilities, limitations, and next steps.

This is a technical presales position. Ongoing implementation, production integration development, and post-sale engineering delivery remain with the appropriate implementation and engineering teams.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Presales, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS or technology sales processes.
  • Strong technical discovery and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience delivering product demonstrations or technical presentations.
  • Understanding of modern web applications and SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
  • Ability to understand customer business requirements and explain technical solutions.
  • Experience collaborating with sales teams during customer evaluations.
  • Strong communication skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to explain software capabilities clearly and accurately.
  • Experience documenting customer requirements and technical findings.
  • Ability to identify technical questions that require Product or Engineering input.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms and product features.
  • Experience managing multiple customer requests or technical evaluations.
  • Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Willingness to collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned customer-facing technical activities.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or merchant technology.
  • Experience working with Shopify or online storefronts.
  • Understanding of checkout and payment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or similar payment platforms.
  • Experience with REST APIs and API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or another programming language.
  • Experience working with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Familiarity with patient questionnaires or digital patient experiences.
  • Understanding of white-label software platforms.
  • Experience supporting technical proof-of-concept or proof-of-value activities.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based software systems.

  • AI-enabled workflows or playbook contributions adopted by peers

  • Proven ability to build relationships across complex organizations — from practitioners to VP and C-suite stakeholders — and translate technical risk and product capability into executive-level business impact

About Galvanize Therapeutics

Galvanize is a biomedical platform company operating at the convergence of engineering, biology, and healthcare delivery, aiming to deliver life-changing solutions to patients and their doctors. We design and develop Pulsed Electric Field Systems to achieve meaningful and lasting therapeutic outcomes for patients.

About the role

This is a rare opportunity to launch a novel technology into a massive, underserved market. RheOx is a first-of-its-kind bronchoscopic therapy from Galvanize Therapeutics designed to treat chronic bronchitis at its source: the abnormal airway lining that drives excess mucus, chronic cough, and frequent exacerbations. Chronic bronchitis affects approximately 9 million people in the U.S., representing a $45B+ total addressable market, and today most patients have few options beyond medications that manage symptoms. RheOx has the potential to redefine how this disease is treated, and the Director of Marketing will be the person who brings it to physicians and patients.

As the marketing leader for RheOx, the Director is the single accountable owner of RheOx marketing, from strategy through commercial launch and adoption. This role owns market assessment, segmentation and targeting, the value proposition and claims, brand platform and positioning, pricing strategy, go-to-market and launch strategy, and launch execution, including healthcare professional (HCP) and patient engagement. The Director will also build and lead the RheOx marketing team from the ground up.

The ideal candidate is a highly strategic, hands-on leader who can make the core strategic decisions and drive their execution, with a proven track record in developing successful clinician and direct-to-patient outreach programs that drive awareness, referral, and treatment, and who wants to build a category, not just a brand.

Qualifications

Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field required.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

Skills and Experience

  • 12+ years of medical device or healthcare marketing experience, including at least 5 years in people leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading a commercial launch of a new medical device or pharmaceutical therapy, including a novel procedure or treatment approach requiring physician and patient adoption.
  • Strong, proven background in patient outreach and direct-to-patient marketing, including digital patient acquisition, advocacy partnerships, and primary care referral-pathway development.
  • Experience across both strategic marketing (segmentation, value proposition, pricing, market research) and commercial launch execution.
  • Track record building the value proposition and pricing strategy for a new procedure, including working with market access on coding, coverage, and payment.
  • Experience partnering with R&D, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, and other cross-functional teams to develop and bring a new product to market.
  • Track record of KOL development, physician education, and building HCP advocacy.
  • Experience in pulmonology, interventional pulmonology, or other procedure-based specialties (e.g., interventional cardiology, GI, ENT) strongly preferred.
  • Highly strategic thinker able to translate insight into clear plans and roll up their sleeves to execute in a fast-paced, resource-conscious environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex clinical data into compelling, compliant messaging.
  • Working knowledge of MLR/promotional review, FDA advertising and promotion regulations, and reimbursement fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM and marketing automation platforms, and digital analytics tools.

Other

  • Travel up to 30–40%, including field visits, customer meetings, and national medical congresses.
  • Ability to enter hospital and procedural environments and comply with facility credentialing requirements.
  • Start-up or early commercial-stage company experience preferred.

What you'll do

Launch Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and own the integrated RheOx commercial launch plan, including launch sequencing, readiness milestones, KPIs, and budget.
  • Lead cross-functional launch readiness with Sales, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Market Access/Reimbursement, Regulatory, Training, and Operations.
  • Define success metrics for awareness, referral, adoption, and utilization; track performance and adjust tactics based on data and field insight.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Lead market assessment, segmentation and targeting, and customer journey mapping. Generate customer and patient insights through market research, advisory boards, and field feedback to inform strategy and future indications.
  • Lead pricing strategy and develop robust revenue and supply forecasts.
  • Own competitive intelligence across pharmacologic and interventional options for chronic bronchitis.
  • Partner with R&D and Clinical on voice-of-customer input, evidence-generation priorities, and the RheOx product roadmap.

Messaging, Positioning & Value Proposition

  • Build and own the RheOx brand platform, positioning, and core messaging hierarchy for physicians, referring providers, hospital administrators, and patients.
  • Develop compelling clinical and economic value propositions in partnership with Medical Affairs and Market Access.
  • Translate clinical evidence into clear, compliant, and differentiated claims.

Collateral & Content Development

  • Lead creation of sales tools, clinical and economic collateral, digital content, website, congress materials, and patient-facing education.
  • Manage agencies and vendors; own RheOx content through promotional review (MLR), ensuring all materials are accurate, on-brand, and compliant.

Patient Outreach & Activation

  • Design and lead patient awareness, education, and activation programs that help appropriate patients find RheOx-trained physicians.
  • Build direct-to-patient and digital acquisition channels (search, social, CRM, patient finder/referral pathways) with clear funnel metrics.
  • Develop partnerships with patient advocacy organizations and create patient ambassador and testimonial programs, in line with applicable regulations.

HCP Adoption, KOL Development & Education

  • Develop HCP targeting and engagement strategies across interventional pulmonology, general pulmonology, and referring providers.
  • Identify, cultivate, and manage a network of KOLs and physician advocates; lead speaker programs and advisory boards.
  • Partner with Medical Education and Training on physician training, center-of-excellence, and peer-to-peer education programs.
  • Develop strategy for presence at key medical congresses (e.g., ATS, CHEST, AABIP) and professional society engagement.

Team Building & Management

  • Recruit, build, and develop a high-performing RheOx marketing team (e.g., product managers, patient marketing).
  • Manage the RheOx marketing budget and agency relationships, ensuring efficient resource allocation and measurable return.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, patient-focused culture and serve as the voice of the customer and patient across Galvanize.

Compliance

  • Ensure all activities comply with FDA advertising and promotion requirements, AdvaMed Code, HIPAA, and Galvanize quality and compliance policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

This role pays between $205,000 and $230,000 per year, and your actual base pay will depend on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

People who have run data management programmes inside large regulated organisations and are done with the utilisation treadmill. You've been in the room when a data quality programme stalled, and you know it's almost never the tooling. You want to own the outcome: platform live, teams using it, value the customer can point to, not a project closed and a report filed.

What you'll do

  • Deliver the Soda Quickstart. Our onboarding engagement, roughly eight weeks, from initial access to a production-ready platform with trained teams. Architecture and security review, Soda Cloud org with RBAC and SSO, Runner deployment (self-hosted in the customer's Kubernetes or Soda-hosted), first data source and datasets onboarded, integrations, first data contract or data standard, then persona-based training for admins, data engineers and stewards. Soda is AI-first, so you'll also enable Soda AI, stand up the MCP surface against the customer's AI clients, and use Contract Autopilot to get broad coverage in an afternoon instead of authoring checks by hand.
  • Drive operating model advisory. Map how a customer works today across data onboarding, rule authoring, alert triage, remediation and reporting, then design the target model with them: centrally governed standards, self-serve no-code authoring in the business units, in-pipeline testing for prevention, or a mix. Increasingly that target model includes agents, so you'll also answer the questions that come with it: what Contract Autopilot generates automatically versus what a steward authors, who reviews and approves AI-generated checks before they gate a pipeline, where the assistant replaces a ticket to the central team, and what stays human. The output is an operating model that gets adopted, not a deck that gets filed.
  • Drive implementation engagements. Multi-phase rollouts against an agreed SOW: migrating rules off the customer's legacy data quality tooling, validation and go-live per domain, catalog integration, reporting on the diagnostics warehouse, then scaling from the first domain to the rest of the organisation.
  • Own the programme relationship. Weekly working cadence with the customer team, steering with their chief data architect and sponsors, honest status when a phase slips, and change orders when scope moves. You're the person the customer calls first.
  • Build the reusable stuff. Delivery playbooks, SOW and scoping templates, migration accelerators, training material. If it doesn't exist, you write it.

What's real

  • Priorities move. Expansion phase, a lot of work, not a lot of process.
  • No delivery org behind you. You are the first dedicated services hire. Delivery is handled today by the Customer Engineering team. You'll be writing the playbook you'd normally inherit.
  • This is hands-on. You'll be in Kubernetes, YAML, SQL and the product itself, not just in workshops.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years delivering data management programmes at a consultancy, systems integrator or vendor services team, in enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and a procurement process
  • Data management background is non-negotiable. Data quality, data governance, cataloguing, data modelling. You understand why a rule exists before you migrate it
  • Excellent communication. Fluent English, written and spoken. You can hold a room that contains a chief data architect and a business data steward at the same time, write a scope document that survives legal review, and say "that's out of scope" without damaging the relationship
  • Hands-on technical depth. SQL and Python, a modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow), Git and CI/CD, comfortable around Kubernetes deployments and YAML
  • Hands-on experience with agentic workflows. You use AI coding and agent tooling in your own delivery work (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or similar), you understand MCP, and you can show a customer how to drive bulk onboarding, contract generation and notification rules through agents rather than clicking through a UI. Enterprise customers are asking what AI-first delivery actually looks like, and you should be the proof
  • Scoping and commercial judgement. SOWs, phase planning, change orders, and knowing when an engagement should be fixed scope and when it shouldn't
  • Based in the US, able to travel to customer sites

Nice to have

  • Collibra experience, particularly integration and operating model work. Alation, Atlan, data.world, Microsoft Fabric or Unity Catalog also relevant
  • Regulated industry experience: insurance, banking, pharma, energy
  • Familiarity with BCBS 239, Solvency II, IFRS 17 or DORA driven data programmes
  • Dutch or French

Benefits

  • Base salary: 120-160k EUR
  • Equity - everyone full-time at Soda is a shareholder
  • Location: Remote (US-based), with travel to customer sites

jobs.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration — all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.

The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.

This is a 100% remote role.

Test Automation Development & Strategy

  • Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.
  • Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.
  • Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology — authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.
  • Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.
  • Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.
  • Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

  • Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.
  • Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

  • Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.
  • Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.
  • Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

  • Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.
  • Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.
  • Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

  • Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.
  • Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.
  • Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to production deployment; ensure all IV&V findings are tracked and resolved.

Agile / DevSecOps Participation

  • Actively contribute to and help facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA; provide QA-focused sprint reporting to program leadership.
  • Enforce quality gates across the SDLC pipeline; flag and escalate non-conforming deliverables before stage promotion.
  • Own and submit monthly Quality Status Report (QSR).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, test automation engineering, or related software testing roles with BS/BA, 3 years with MS/MA, 9 years with HS diploma.
  • Must be US Citizen
  • Able to obtain Public Trust clearance
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, Python, Java, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and their application within Agile sprint cycles.
  • Proficiency with JIRA for defect tracking, sprint management, and reporting.
  • Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), UAT plans, and formal testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration within a DevSecOps environment.
  • Experience with Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing and VPAT preparation.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to report QA status and metrics to program leadership and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) Foundation or Advanced Level certification.

jobs.excerpt: Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом.
jobs.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Допомагати клієнтам Райфу у чаті мобільного додатку у розв’язанні різних банківських питань: операції за рахунками, користування мобільним застосунком тощо
  • Пропонувати клієнтам додаткові банківські продукти та послуги
  • Опрацьовувати одночасно запити кількох клієнтів

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла
  • Готовий допомагати клієнтам Райфу
  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
    Перший місяць роботи графік пн -пт з 9:00 до 18:00
    Потім 5\2 з плаваючими вихідними по 8 годин робочий день, в рамках роботи лінії
    Лінія працює з 7:00 до 00:00
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.
  • Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.
  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк? 

Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

    • Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 
    • Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC
    • Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 
    • Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 
    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  
    • Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.
    • Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби
    • Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення! 

Бажаєш дізнатися більше? – Підписуйся на нас у соц.мережах: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn

Job Summary

Prominence is looking for an Epic Prelude / Estimates Analyst with deep experience in patient access build, front-end revenue cycle workflows, and patient estimates to support one of the nation's leading health systems. This role will partner with Patient Access and Revenue Cycle leaders to align registration and scheduling workflows with Professional Billing (PB) requirements, strengthen front-end financial clearance, and improve the accuracy and reach of patient estimates.   • Review the current patient estimate build, analyze estimate accuracy, and recommend opportunities to expand the use of estimates.
  • Prepare the organization for electronic authorizations and help define front-end financial clearance metrics.
  • Document workflows, build decisions, and best practices that can be sustained after the engagement.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and mentoring to client Access IS staff to build the skills needed to sustain and expand on project deliverables.

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Epic Prelude build and support experience in a health system or consulting setting.
  • Active Epic Prelude certification.
  • Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting Epic patient estimates, including analysis of estimate accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of registration and scheduling workflows and how front-end data capture affects Professional Billing claims, denials, and collections.
  • Working knowledge of Real-Time Eligibility (RTE) and payor/plan setup and mapping in Epic.
  • Experience designing, building, and testing Epic build, including unit and integrated testing and change control.
  • Proven ability to lead workflow reviews with operational leaders and translate their requirements into build.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical findings to non-technical audiences.

Desired Qualifications

  • Epic Cadence certification or experience with scheduling build, including automated and patient self-scheduling.
  • Epic Resolute Professional Billing certification or strong PB revenue cycle knowledge.
  • Experience with Epic Referrals and authorization workflows, including electronic prior authorization.
  • Experience defining and reporting front-end financial clearance and patient access metrics, such as registration quality, eligibility verification, estimate accuracy, and point-of-service collections.
  • Familiarity with price transparency and patient estimate regulations, including the No Surprises Act and Good Faith Estimates.
  • Prior operational experience in patient access, financial clearance, or revenue cycle.
  • Consulting experience supporting Epic optimization projects at large or academic health systems.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Professional: Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism by treating others with respect, keeping commitments, building trust within the team, working with integrity, and upholding organizational values (“Do Great Work and Move Mountains”).

This role is part of our active pipeline for upcoming client engagements and is contingent on project availability, with timing aligned to client demand.

Data Protection Program Leadership

Develop and execute data protection roadmaps aligned with business, regulatory, and security objectives. Identify opportunities to improve data protection maturity and reduce organizational risk. Establish metrics and reporting that demonstrate program effectiveness. Partner with leadership to define long-term data governance and protection strategies.

Information Protection & Data Governance

Design and maintain enterprise data classification frameworks. Develop and govern data handling standards and protection requirements. Implement and manage sensitivity labeling, encryption, and information protection controls. Collaborate with Data Governance teams to establish classification taxonomies and data ownership models. Develop automated classification and data discovery capabilities across structured and unstructured repositories.

Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

Develop policies protecting sensitive information across email, collaboration platforms, endpoints, cloud applications, and remote work environments. Insider Risk & Investigations

eDiscovery, Retention & Records Management

Compliance & Regulatory Support

Support security, privacy, and regulatory audits. Map compliance requirements to implemented technical controls. Assist with risk assessments and remediation planning. Partner with Compliance and Legal teams to demonstrate regulatory adherence.

Platform Engineering & Integration

Manage tool upgrades, enhancements, health monitoring, and operational support.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Job Description

As a Verification Engineer on the ASIC & Networking team, you support TeraWave's first in-house silicon program, which comprises a high-throughput modem and a DSP-intensive digital beamformer with first tapeout targeted for 2027. Verification strategy, methodology, and infrastructure are being defined now, and you help define them.

The work spans IP, subsystem, and full SoC verification, including CPU subsystems, performance-critical interconnects, security, high-speed peripherals, modem datapath and PHY layers, DSP and beamforming compute, and mixed-signal interfaces. You own a subset of this scope aligned to your background.

The team treats constrained-random simulation, formal methods, and processor-driven SoC testing as equal first-class tools, and is building an AI-enabled verification platform that includes LLM-assisted stimulus and testbench generation, automated regression triage and failure clustering, and data-driven coverage closure. Because none of this is inherited, the engineers who build these capabilities will own them — and grow with the program as it scales.

Background in wireless communications, modem, baseband, and DSP verification is welcome but not required. Architects and modeling engineers support your ramp, and verification judgment and system-level thinking are weighted above domain background.


Responsibilities:


  • Translate design specifications into verification strategies, measurable coverage goals, and early identification of high-risk scenarios.
  • Assist in verification planning and execution for complex blocks and subsystems, from test plan through sign-off.

  • Background in space-based communications, wireless communications, or modem, baseband, or DSP hardware.
