jobs.description:
About Zumper

Zumper is building a smarter future for multifamily renting and marketing. For more than a decade, we’ve helped millions of renters find their next home, giving us first-hand knowledge of how people search for, discover, and choose where to live.

Today, Zumper serves both sides of the rental market. Millions of renters use our marketplace to find their next home, and the teams behind those properties use our platform to reach renters with tools that simplify marketing across every channel and touchpoint.

Zumper’s investors include Kleiner Perkins, Goodwater Capital, Headline, Dawn Capital, and Blackstone. As we enter our next chapter, we're looking for people who want to challenge how things have always been done and help move renting forward. Come build with us.

About this opportunity

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to be our CEO's right hand. You'll own his calendar, travel, and meeting prep so his time goes to the customers, board members, and teams that need it most, and you'll build the systems that keep the office of the CEO running. You'll also partner with our People Ops team on employee recognition and company events. It's a great fit for an experienced EA who thinks two steps ahead, handles sensitive information with total discretion, and is excited to use AI tools to work smarter.

This role reports to our Director, People Operations.

What you'll do

CEO Support

  • Own the CEO's calendar end to end: act as the gatekeeper, prioritize requests, resolve conflicts before they happen, protect focus time, and keep it accurate across time zones, travel days, and time out of office
  • Plan and book travel for industry conferences, customer meetings, and team gatherings, including flights, hotels, and detailed itineraries
  • Coordinate quarterly board meetings: schedule with board members and their assistants and confirm attendance
  • Keep the company's operating rhythm running smoothly, including weekly All Hands, leadership team meetings, executive sessions, and offsites
  • Prepare the CEO for each day and week with agendas, briefing notes, and background on the people he's meeting, then capture action items and follow up until they're closed
  • Handle expense reports and corporate card reconciliation, manage subscriptions and conference registrations, coordinate company gifting for customers and board members, and take on other administrative tasks and special projects as they come up
  • Use AI tools to automate routine work and give the CEO time back

People Ops Support

  • Support our employee recognition program, including anniversaries, shout-outs, and swag
  • Plan and run company events, from kickoffs and offsites to team celebrations, including agendas, logistics, vendors, and budgets

Who you are

  • 5+ years supporting a C-level executive, ideally a CEO at a startup or growth-stage tech company; experience working with a board is a plus
  • Able to work Eastern Time hours, or flexible enough to overlap with them (Eastern Time preferred, as our CEO is based in New York)
  • Proactive by nature: you spot the conflict, the missing agenda, or the unconfirmed attendee before anyone asks
  • A polished, concise communicator who can speak on the CEO's behalf with executives, customers, and partners
  • Trusted with sensitive information, with sound judgment about what to share, when, and with whom
  • Curious and hands-on with AI: you already use AI tools to work faster, and you're excited to support a CEO who does the same
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, remote environment where priorities shift, and the playbook isn't written yet
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, and fluent in Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom

Compensation

The US base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Where an offer falls within that range depends on your experience, skills, and the cost of labor in your local market — we benchmark against several U.S. geographic tiers and adjust accordingly.

What we offer

  • Fully remote, with a home office stipend to set up your workspace
  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options with up to 100% premium coverage
  • 401k plan + 3% company match
  • Stock options
  • FSAs, HSAs, life insurance, and short & long-term disability insurance
  • Up to 12-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Flexible vacation policy - work hard and take time off when you need it
  • Health & wellness and internet reimbursements
  • Group training and individual professional development programs
  • Team activities, virtual company-wide hosted games, and virtual happy hours
  • Weekly insight into company metrics
  • Employee Resource Group (zERG) that celebrates all communities - Black, LGBTQIA+, Women, Asian & Pacific Islanders, and more! zERG works together to create safe spaces for candid conversations
  • Hackathons (not overnight!)

Life at Zumper

We are proud to be a remote-first company that embraces a distributed workforce. We believe in the power of flexible work environments and encourage our team to work from wherever they are most productive. Join us as we continue to innovate and collaborate across time zones and geographies!

We care deeply about diversity and inclusivity. We are fostering an environment that celebrates individuality and enables you to be your best self. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome all applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, religion, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, or race.

Please note

⚙️ About Azumuta

Manufacturing is entering its biggest transformation in decades.

For years, we’ve helped manufacturers digitize their operations through a platform used by leading manufacturers across Europe and North America. From digital work instructions and quality management to traceability, skills and operational excellence, we’ve helped thousands of operators perform their work better, faster and safer.

But we’re only getting started.

The next generation of manufacturing won’t be driven by software alone. It will be powered by AI that fundamentally changes how work gets done on the factory floor. We’re building a future where work instructions are generated automatically from engineering data, AI agents assist operators in real time, quality documentation is created autonomously, and repetitive administrative work simply disappears.

We’re not digitizing existing processes anymore. We’re redesigning manufacturing execution from the ground up.
Founded in 2016, Azumuta has grown into one of Europe’s leading Manufacturing SaaS scale-ups, working with some of the world’s most innovative manufacturers across industries including aerospace & defense, industrial machinery, automotive, electronics and medical devices.

We’re building what manufacturing will look like over the next decade. If that excites you, you’ll fit right in.

Ready to be part of the next steps?

As our Business Development Representative, you will help build Azumuta's pipeline in France:

  • You focus on 2 ICP sub-segments (chosen from Industrial Electronics/High Tech, Industrial Machinery, Home & Professional Appliances, Aerospace & Defense) and support 2 Account Executives, mapping named accounts, sites, and stakeholders together with them.

  • You report into the French sales organization and work closely with your Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Ops, with regular touchpoints to align territory coverage and handoffs.

🚀 What You’ll Be Doing:

Prospect & map named accounts:

  • Run multi-channel outbound (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on named accounts within your ICP sub-segments.

  • Map every production site within a named account, and identify the relevant stakeholders at each one (industrial engineering, quality, maintenance, plant management).

  • Use trigger-based prospecting: new product launches, hiring signals for continuous improvement/industrial engineering roles, production incidents or quality issues, and other buying signals.

Lead discovery-first conversations:

  • Open with questions about how fast the prospect can react to change, not a platform pitch.

  • Uncover genuine pain points across operational and technical roles on the shop floor.

  • Pitch the right Azumuta 2.0 use case (AI/intelligence layer on top of the platform, covering PLM integration, quality issue analysis and prevention, and VLM-based time studies) so the value lands for that specific role.

Qualify & hand off opportunities:

  • Qualify leads on fit, pain, budget signal, and timing, using SPICED and BANT as your frameworks.

  • Hand off sales-qualified leads to the right Account Executive with a clear discovery summary, feeding MEDDPICC with useful input on Pain, Economic Buyer, and Champion.

Collaborate & improve the playbook:

  • Align outbound with Marketing's ICP campaigns and ABM signals.

  • Keep CRM hygiene sharp in Membrain: log activities, discovery insights, and qualification criteria consistently.

  • Feed patterns and market insights back to Sales and Marketing to continuously sharpen the pitch and playbooks.

Requirements

🎯 You’d Be a Great Fit If You…

  • Are fluent in Dutch (native) or French (native) and professional in English.

  • Have experience in an outbound prospecting role (BDR/SDR), ideally in B2B SaaS industrial or technical sales.

  • Have strong discovery skills: curious, and able to dig for real pain points rather than pitching features.

  • Are comfortable talking to operational and technical profiles on the shop floor.

  • Are structured, activity-driven and resilient: able to sustain a consistently high volume of touches without losing quality.

  • Are organized enough to work multiple sites and stakeholders within the same account in a structured way (CRM discipline), and to connect the dots across sites.

  • Are eager to learn: able to quickly grasp Azumuta 2.0 use cases and talk about them in plain language, no technical background required.

  • Are based in France or have strong knowledge of the French industrial market.

What’s In It for You?

  • Own the first mile of the sales cycle — You'll build pipeline that directly fuels the growth of Azumuta's French sales team, with real ownership over your named accounts and ICP segments.

  • Learn from the ground up — A 2-week hands-on onboarding at our HQ in Ghent gets you fully up to speed on the platform, Azumuta 2.0, and a discovery script built role by role.

  • Grow toward account executive — This role is a launchpad, not a dead end, for those who want to grow into full-cycle sales.

  • Be part of the future of manufacturing tech — Not just another job: you're joining a mission-driven scale-up ready to transform an entire industry.

  • Room to lead, space to grow — We give you autonomy, trust, and the freedom to shape your role, backed by training, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities.

  • Join an ambitious (and fun) team — Work alongside passionate colleagues who are building success together.

Why Patients Need You


Field & Patient Access is an evolving and highly important area for the success of Primary Care. Due to the complexity of the patient journey in many Primary Care therapeutic areas, up to 60% of primary care medications never get dispensed after an HCP writes the prescription. The role of Primary Care Access and Reimbursement is to remove barriers to access through education and streamlined processes that accelerate fulfillment, helping appropriate patients get access to the medication their HCP has prescribed.


What You Will Achieve


The Patient Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director will work across a broad, multi-disciplinary group of internal and external stakeholders to develop, evolve, and lead projects & programs to advance the Patient Access and Reimbursement group’s mission to accelerate fulfillment for appropriate patients. They will develop a process of continuous improvement measured by clearly defined key performance indicators that serve as benchmarks for success across the platform. The Patient Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director brings organizational excellence, project management expertise, and analytical rigor together with a deep understanding of Access and Reimbursement priorities and operations — driving seamless execution of operating plans and supporting their continuous evolution.


This role advances Patient Access and Reimbursement by continuously improving key operational areas: infrastructure, engagement frameworks, project management, documentation, training, the operating model, analytics and reporting, digital and information platforms, third-party license agreements, resourcing, meeting planning, and budget management — the latter in partnership with the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead. The Patient Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director reports to the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead.

  • Analyze data and generate insights to inform strategic decisions at all levels of Primary Care Access & Reimbursement from the territory level to executive directives.

  • Work with Patient Access and Reimbursement Leadership, Legal, Compliance, and other key stakeholders to evolve the role, responsibilities, and remit of the team to better support patients
  • Serve as primary point of contact with vendors, where appropriate, in collaboration with the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead, supporting contracting, procurement, and delivery of key projects.
  • In partnership with the Enablement team lead, contribute to or lead, where appropriate, DSU and PI reporting and overall program requirements.
  • Work across Field & Patient Access Enablement, CMO, and other customer-facing teams to accelerate ways of working programs and key initiatives.
  • Partner with Field Strategy and Enablement Director and Strategy and Innovation Enablement Director to continuously improve ways of working across Patient Access and Reimbursement and Patient Engagement, ensuring alignment with compliance requirements and approved guardrails.
  • Pull through AI strategy in partnership with the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead and other cross-functional partners, helping build, stand up, and drive adoption of the strategy across the team.
  • Contribute to key operational projects and initiatives across the broader Primary Care Field & Patient Access function.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales with extensive external healthcare market and advanced customer / health system knowledge.
  • Previous experience in Access and Reimbursement, leadership, or operations/enablement, with a demonstrated track record of high performance or specialized technical skills gained through cross-functional leadership roles.

  • Ability to influence key stakeholders internally and externally with proven executive communication skills and leadership qualities.
  • Forward looking and results oriented with effective planning, prioritization, and organizational project skills.
  • Strong and proven project management skills demonstrating the ability to deliver multiple time horizon focused projects simultaneously in the short-term and long-term.

  • Strong interpersonal skills are required, as well as excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills to address Leadership and external audiences.
  • Proven experience in working with a compliance first mindset.

ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. jobs.description:
Job title:Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance

Reports to:Chief Information Officer

Division:Central Services

Location:US or Waterloo

Grade:23

About Priority Commerce:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

The Director of QA plays a key role in protecting the reliability and integrity of Priority’s commerce platform by owning the strategy, people, and practices that ensure software is tested thoroughly before it reaches our clients. This leader builds and scales a high-performing quality organization,

modernizes test automation, and embeds quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle, from requirements through production release. The position requires deep expertise in QA leadership, test automation, and CI/CD, along with the ability to drive measurable quality outcomes in a regulated payments environment. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevOps/SRE, Security, Compliance, and Application Support to reduce production defects and customer-impacting incidents, and to accelerate safe, predictable delivery across Priority’s products.

Responsibilities:

  • Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products.

  • Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

  • Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression testing.

  • Partners with Engineering and DevOps to integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling shift-left testing and fast, reliable release cycles.

  • Oversees performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process.

  • Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership.

  • Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage.

  • Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production.

  • Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

  • Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost.

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Customer-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced.

  • Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong.

  • Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline.

  • Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production.

  • QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions.

  • Audits and customer assessments find well-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises.

  • The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members.

Candidate Requirements:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).

  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).

  • Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices.

  • Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray).

  • Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments.

  • Working awareness of PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management.

  • Experience testing cloud-native and distributed architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and high-volume transaction systems.

  • Experience managing offshore, nearshore, or outsourced QA partners.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#) used for test automation.

  • Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$233K-$291K USD, $190K-$257K CAD
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

  • 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Commerce and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

jobs.description:
About Omilia

Omilia is a leader in enterprise Conversational and Agentic AI for customer experience.

We power voice and digital customer service for global enterprises in finance, insurance, healthcare, utilities and beyond. Our unified, self-learning platform spans voice and chat agents, authentication, fraud prevention and agent assist, and completes customer service tasks with human-like understanding.

Our work is recognised by the industry's leading analysts:

  • Gartner Magic Quadrant. Omilia was recognized as a Visionary in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Conversational AI Platforms due to its self-learning agentic customer experience (CX) platform.
  • Forrester Wave. Omilia was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Conversational AI Platforms For Customer Service, Q2 2026, cited for its voice-first approach, tight agent governance, and strong enterprise security and scalability.

The Role

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join the Omilia Cloud Platform (OCP) team - the group that keeps our conversational AI running for enterprise customers in production.

As a Technical Support Engineer you are the first line of defense and a trusted advisor for our global partners and enterprise customers. You will not just be closing tickets: you will diagnose complex issues across speech recognition, natural language understanding, dialogue management and telephony integration, analyse logs across distributed services, and work with internal teams to make the product better.

You will report to the Technical Support Team Leader and work closely with Delivery, Product, Platform Operations and Customer Success.

Important Note: Our Support Teams operate 24/7, including holidays and weekends.

What You'll Do

  • Own the solution. Manage the full lifecycle of support requests for the Omilia Cloud Platform - technical issues, incidents, access requests and queries - from initial triage and diagnosis through to resolution and customer close-out, meeting the response and resolution times our customers are promised.
  • Deep-dive troubleshooting. Investigate issues involving proprietary AI technologies hosted on AWS and Azure. Trace individual conversations across platform monitoring, log search and observability tooling using session identifiers, and isolate whether a fault sits in the customer application, the platform, or the partner contact-centre integration.
  • Reproduce, don't assume. Use lab environments to reproduce reported issues and verify candidate fixes before they reach a customer. When documentation falls short, probe how the platform behaves under non-standard configurations rather than taking the report at face value.
  • Crisis management. Participate in bridge calls during critical production incidents, providing impact analysis and calm, clear communication on a defined cadence. Engage the on-call manager when the situation warrants it.
  • Drive escalations to closure. When a ticket needs a specialist team, hand over a properly evidenced investigation and then keep driving it. Referring the work does not transfer the accountability - you still own the outcome for the customer.
  • OCP operations. Handle resource, access and organisation management requests within the OCP environment.
  • Knowledge sharing. Document how-to guides, troubleshooting steps and root-cause analyses from the cases you resolve, so the team and our customers stop solving the same problem twice.
  • Bridge the gap. Act as the voice of the customer, giving data-driven feedback to Product and Development to prevent the next occurrence.
  • Hit your numbers. Work to individual and team KPIs on response time, resolution time and customer satisfaction, and track every communication and troubleshooting step in the case management platform.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experience. 2+ years in a technical support position, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Analytical rigour. Strong problem-solving skills with a systematic, methodical approach - and the instinct to gather evidence before drawing a conclusion.
  • Communication. Excellent English, verbal and written, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and to stay composed with a customer under pressure.
  • Linux and web smarts. A solid grip on Linux environments and basic experience with web/application server administration (Apache, Tomcat, Nginx).
  • Networking fundamentals. Understanding of TCP/IP, HTTPS, SIP and RTP, and general network troubleshooting.
  • Database knowledge. Fundamental understanding of how databases operate and comfort running basic queries.
  • APIs. Working knowledge of Web/REST APIs and JSON.
  • Case management. Experience with a ticketing or bug-tracking platform such as Jira or Salesforce, and the discipline to document investigations properly.
  • Time management. Ability to prioritise and execute in a high-pressure environment, and readiness to join a live customer troubleshooting session or an internal incident bridge when the situation demands it.
  • Ownership. Willingness to take initiative over a new task, a new assignment or a newly escalated situation - and to work within our 24/7 coverage model.

Nice to Have

  • Observability. Experience with the ELK Stack, DataDog, Prometheus or Grafana - especially constructing queries rather than only reading dashboards.
  • Cloud and DevOps. Exposure to AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes or Ansible.
  • The scripting mindset. Experience in Python or Bash. You are comfortable reading scripts and automating small tasks.
  • Conversational AI. Exposure to ASR, NLU, TTS or voice biometrics technologies.
  • Contact centre. Familiarity with CTI concepts and Genesys, NICE CXone, Talkdesk or RingCentral technologies.
  • Regulated environments. Experience in banking, healthcare or payments, and a working understanding of why compliance controls exist.
  • Follow-the-sun. Exposure to distributed support models and cross-timezone handovers.
  • AI-assisted tooling. Experience using AI assistants in day-to-day triage and troubleshooting.
  • Languages. Spanish, Portuguese, German or French alongside English.

Why Join Omilia?

  • Real onboarding. A structured ramp combining OCP courses and exercises designed by our Academy team, shadowing of our internal channels and knowledge base, and working alongside the team on real tickets from early on.
  • Global impact. Work on a product used by major banks, insurers, healthcare providers and telcos worldwide.
  • A clear path. Defined career progression within Technical Support, with senior and specialist tracks, and structured knowledge-transfer programmes across our Athens, Costa Rica and Manila hubs.
  • Supportive culture. A team that values collaboration, where your voice is heard and your feedback shapes the product.
  • Competitive package. Attractive salary, benefits and long-term employment.
  • Tech-forward gear. The latest Apple equipment.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear.

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT VOYAGEUR GROUP Voyageur Group is a full-service retail strategy and commerce agency helping brands win at the world’s largest retailers.
jobs.description:
ABOUT VOYAGEUR GROUP

Voyageur Group is a full-service retail strategy and commerce agency helping brands win at the world’s largest retailers. We combine best-in-class sales representation, retail media management, and data-driven analytics to grow our clients’ businesses both on-shelf and online. With an established presence at Target and a rapidly growing Walmart Connect advertising practice, we are now launching our full-service Walmart division — and we’re looking for the leader to build it.

This is a ground-floor leadership opportunity for a retail commerce executive who wants to own something. As Voyageur Group’s first Vice President of Walmart, you will establish and lead our Walmart division from Bentonville/Northwest Arkansas — the epicenter of the world’s largest retailer. You will serve as our head of Walmart sales, helping brands launch and scale at Walmart, while also building the operational infrastructure, team, and client base that will define this division’s future.

We already operate Walmart Connect advertising campaigns and analytics work for select clients. This role takes us to the next level: a comprehensive, full-service offering covering omnichannel retail strategy, Walmart Connect retail media, Walmart Luminate/Scintilla data insights, item setup, supply chain coordination, and beyond.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Division Leadership

  • Build and lead Voyageur Group’s Walmart division from the ground up, establishing processes, a team, and a portfolio of brand clients
  • Serve as the senior-most Walmart expert within Voyageur Group, shaping strategy and elevating capabilities across the organization
  • Partner directly with Voyageur Group’s CEO and leadership team to define the Walmart division’s vision, goals, and growth roadmap
  • Recruit, mentor, and manage a growing team of Walmart-focused account managers, analysts, and media specialists

Sales & Client Growth

  • Drive new business development by identifying, pitching, and closing brand clients seeking best-in-class Walmart representation
  • Act as the primary point of contact between Voyageur Group’s clients and their Walmart merchant, modular, and supply chain teams
  • Develop and deliver strategic sales plans, assortment strategies, and item roadmaps to accelerate client growth at Walmart
  • Lead Joint Business Planning (JBP) processes and senior-level meetings with Walmart buyers and category directors on behalf of clients
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships into new categories, channels (1P, 3P, DSV), and services

Walmart Connect & Retail Media

  • Work closely with our existing Retail Media team to connect our best In class Walmart Connect advertising practice to best-in-class retail services and sales representation.
  • Incorporate Voyageur Group’s retail media team into operational practices for our Walmart division that help brand succeed by having a media + sales purview and strategy.

Analytics & Insights

  • Leverage Walmart Luminate (Scintilla) and Data Ventures insights to drive client decision-making around inventory, pricing, promotion, and assortment
  • Build reporting frameworks that translate omnichannel data — in-store and ecommerce — into clear, actionable intelligence for clients
  • Partner with Voyageur Group’s analytics team to deliver supply chain and business management insights that improve clients’ overall performance at Walmart

Operational Excellence

  • Project manage all facets of client business at Walmart, including item setup (Item 360, 1WorldSync), content optimization, modular strategy, and supply chain coordination
  • Navigate the full spectrum of Walmart selling models (1P Supplier/Vendor, 3P Marketplace, Drop Ship Vendor) and advise clients on the optimal structure for their business
  • Ensure flawless execution across the end-to-end retail cycle: ranging, pricing, promotional planning, in-stock, and on-shelf availability

WHO YOU ARE

  • 5–10+ years of experience working directly with Walmart, ideally based in or closely connected to Bentonville/Northwest Arkansas
  • Deep knowledge of Walmart’s buying process, merchant organization, modular and planogram strategy, and omnichannel retail ecosystem
  • Proven track record in a sales leadership role — whether as a national accounts lead, Walmart team lead, or sales agency executive
  • Hands-on experience with Retail Link, Walmart Luminate, and/or SupplierLink
  • Strong existing relationships with Walmart merchants, category directors, or Walmart Leadership teams is a significant plus
  • Entrepreneurial operator who thrives in a build-it-from-scratch environment and is energized by the opportunity to lead
  • Excellent communicator and relationship-builder with the ability to represent Voyageur Group credibly at the senior-most levels of both client and Walmart organizations
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, remote-first environment with a results-over-process mindset

LOCATION

This role is remote, based in Bentonville / Northwest Arkansas. Proximity to Walmart's Home Office is important for the relationships this role depends on — we're looking for a leader with an existing network in the market.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This role offers a competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including:

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus
  • A remote working environment built on trust and autonomy to deliver results
  • Employer-sponsored health, dental, and vision insurance: Voyageur Group covers 80% of plan cost for you and 25% for dependents
  • Health Savings Account option, so you can set aside pre-tax dollars for medical expenses, with unused funds rolling over year to year rather than expiring
  • A one-time $500 home office setup allowance
  • Simple IRA with 3% employer match
  • Company-paid Basic Life and AD&D insurance
  • Flexible paid time off
  • $1,000 annual Life Adventure Bonus, a Voyageur Group benefit that reimburses you for getting outside, traveling, and pursuing life's adventures

WHY VOYAGEUR GROUP

Voyageur Group is not a giant agency. We are a scrappy, ambitious team that punches above our weight — and we are building something real and differentiated. Our Target and Amazon divisions are proof of what happens when we put the right leader in the right seat. We are ready to do the same at Walmart, and we want a true builder — someone who sees the size of the opportunity and is ready to go after it.

If you are a Walmart expert who wants to own a division, shape a company’s trajectory, and help brands win at the world’s largest retailer, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: CloudM is an award-winning SaaS platform headquartered in Manchester, with offices in London and Varna (Bulgaria), and customers in 107 countries.
jobs.description:
CloudM is an award-winning SaaS platform headquartered in Manchester, with offices in London and Varna (Bulgaria), and customers in 107 countries. We help over 50,000 organisations including LinkedIn, Uber, Netflix,, and Spotify, get the most out of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, through three core products: Migrate, Automate, and Continuity.

From IT admin and onboarding to archiving and migrations, CloudM takes the complexity out of SaaS data management so our customers can focus on what matters. Backed by Marlin Equity Partners, we've grown from humble Manchester beginnings into a global business with a team of around 65 brilliant people across the UK and Europe.

If you share our ambition, we'd love you to be part of it!

Role Overview:

You will lead the initial and ongoing adoption of our cloud management software across your customer portfolio. This is a great opportunity for someone who cares about customer outcomes and wants to make a measurable impact.

As a Customer Success Manager you own the relationship from deployment through to renewal and growth: you make sure customers succeed and meet their CloudM goals, prove the value in their own numbers, and spot the next opportunity before they do.

Reporting to the CS Lead, this critical role will build strong and lasting relationships across their customer base with a strategic and commercial focus. You will be a trusted advisor to technical and senior stakeholders, by ensuring that customers understand the full feature set of CloudM so that it becomes a vital part of their IT strategy.

Responsibilities:

Be the trusted advisor

  • Own the relationship with your portfolio, building trust with both day-to-day technical contacts and senior decision makers

  • Know each customer's goals, challenges and roadmap well enough to recommend what they need before they ask

  • Act as the voice of the customer inside CloudM, working with Product to shape the roadmap around real customer needs

  • Ability to have difficult conversations both with customers but also with internal teams

Drive adoption and value

  • Run remote technical adoption sessions and live demos so customers deploy CloudM successfully and use the features that solve their problems

  • Use our adoption framework to build a clear customer journey, and stay proactive with communication rather than waiting for issues to surface

  • Spot risk early (low usage, stalled deployments, champion changes) and act on it with a clear plan

Prove ROI

  • Lead QBRs that show the value CloudM delivers in terms the customer's leadership cares about: goals met, time saved, risk reduced, cost avoided

  • Turn adoption and usage data into stories that justify renewal and investment

Grow revenue

  • Own renewals within your portfolio and forecast them accurately

  • Identify and lead expansion and cross-sell

  • Use your relationships to uncover new use cases, new teams and new budget

Organised and Accurate

  • Keep Salesforce and our CS platform accurate and up to date: notes, health scores, risks and opportunities

  • Work with colleagues to produce regular reporting on adoption, health and renewals, and use the data to prioritise your time

What success looks like

In your first 12 months, we'd expect you to:

  • Be a known, trusted name to the key contacts across your whole portfolio

  • Meet or exceed your retention and net revenue retention targets (portfolio specific)

  • Deliver expansion and cross-sell bookings

  • Have every customer on a clear adoption plan, with a QBR cadence that suits their segment

  • Flag at-risk accounts early and turn them around

  • Feed customer insight into the product roadmap that results in real changes

Skills and Experience:

Essential

  • 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales Engineering or a similar customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS

  • A track record of building credible relationships with technical contacts and senior stakeholders, including international customers

  • Commercial awareness: comfortable talking renewals and pricing, and spotting and pursuing expansion opportunities

  • Experience leading remote sessions, demos and QBRs with clear, organised communication and good CRM discipline

  • Genuine curiosity about cloud technology, and the appetite to learn the CloudM product suite in depth

  • Empathy and a positive attitude, backed by a focus on outcomes and a strong sense of accountability

Desirable

  • Experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365

  • Experience using Salesforce and a customer success platform

  • Experience of upselling, cross-selling or closing deals

  • Experience using AI to improve efficiency

CloudM Culture:

We are a company consisting of old hands and new faces, all with a passion for technology’s power to simplify. We are developers, designers, marketers and innovators. We are constantly trying new things, and sometimes getting it wrong. Which is good, as innovation never came from perfection. We work quickly to keep pace with the industry we’re in. We’re proactive, not reactive, and have been that way since day one.

Our core values are key to everything we do:

🚀 Innovate & Inspire - We move fast; achieving results through focused, proactive problem-solving.

👥 Connect & Collaborate - We recognise the power of synergy, teamwork and inclusivity in reaching our goals.

🫶🏼 Respect & Recognise - We celebrate each individual's contribution, fostering a culture of trust and recognition.

But most importantly we’re a team. Here at CloudM, it’s about balance. As long as you’re driven, ambitious and can get the job done we will respect the outside lives of our employees. That’s why everybody gets their birthday off (plus unlimited leave), cheap gym access, private healthcare, and plenty more.

CloudM is a remote-first organisation. This means we are not limited to one geographical location. We are committed to attracting and developing a diverse workforce, seeing individual differences as opportunities for innovation and growth. Our company is about culture-add, not culture-fit.

What CloudM can offer you:

  • Private healthcare including dental and optical care 🦷

  • Company contributed pension (matched up to 5%) 💷

  • Unlimited paid holiday 🌴

  • Flexible working - we ask that you work during core hours (10-4) to help with collaboration, but outside of that you can work when suits you 😊

  • 10 paid sick days 🤧

  • Death in service, 4 times your annual salary 💔

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 📞

  • Tech scheme (Salary sacrifice, CloudM can loan you up to £1,000.00 for tech equipment) 📱

  • 10 Time to Learn days 🎓

  • Birthdays off 🎁

  • Opportunity to develop within a fast-growing tech business with an ambitious year-on-year growth trajectory 📈

  • Market-leading parental leave policies 👶🏽

  • Various wellbeing initiatives 🧘🏽‍♀️

  • Exclusive access to discounts & rewards💸

  • High-spec equipment (laptops, phones, etc.) 💻

  • Working from home equipment budget 🏠

Location:

Remote-based role. However, within commutable distance to Manchester or London would be desirable for the odd team-building activity / meeting.

Flexible Working:

We value work-life balance and are committed to fostering a supportive and flexible work environment. Our flexible approach aims to empower employees to achieve both personal and professional success.

Environmental & Social Responsibility:

Our business strives to progress our industry as a whole by treating our employees, community, and environment with respect.

We expect that all of our employees play their part in our social progression plans, whether that’s being part of our Culture Innovation Pod, playing a part in our DEI initiatives, participating in a charity support day, or simply following our advice on buying locally and considering the environment when booking a hotel or restaurant. Every bit counts.

Diversity and Inclusion Statement:

At CloudM, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are proud of our people-centred culture; our diversity brings us innovation and our commitment to inclusion drives us forward.

We recognise that neurodivergent candidates bring incredible strengths to our teams, and we are committed to making our hiring process as accessible and supportive as possible. Our goal is to create a space where everyone feels seen, heard, and included. If you require any reasonable adjustments to perform at your best during the application or interview process, please reach out to us

We are here to support you!

Our Commitment to Security

At CloudM, trust and security are at the very core of our platform and our culture. To ensure the continued safety of our team, our business, and our customers, please be aware that a DBS certificate will be requested if you are offered the position. If you have any questions or concerns about this process, please feel free to ask us during your interview - we are always here to help.

jobs.description:
Mission Software Lead

Top Secret clearance

Remote work location with the ability to travel as needed

The Leidos’ Decision Advantage Business Area is seeking an experienced Mission Software Lead to advance software engineering technologies, practices, and architectures across a diverse portfolio of mission-critical software development programs supporting the Department of Defense. This position will serve as a senior technical advisor across direct-funded programs, independent research and development (IRAD) initiatives, and our mission software platform. The Mission Software Lead will identify and drive adoption of innovative technologies, engineering practices, and reusable capabilities that improve software delivery speed, quality, security, resiliency, and long-term maintainability.

The successful candidate will combine technical expertise with the ability to provide technical guidance, help programs overcome complex engineering challenges, and identify opportunities to improve software delivery and reduce technical debt. The role requires the ability to collaborate across programs, influence technical decisions, and translate engineering advancements into measurable value for customers, senior leadership, and business development teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

Innovation

  • Evaluate and champion emerging technologies, tools, and engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, and automated testing and validation, to improve software delivery speed, quality, security, and efficiency.
  • Advise development teams on improvements to engineering workflows, development environments, and delivery pipelines that reduce manual effort, improve productivity, and accelerate software delivery.

Architecture

  • Evaluate and recommend architectural patterns and technologies that improve software resiliency, reliability, recoverability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Conduct technical assessments to identify architectural risks, technical debt, software reliability issues, and delivery bottlenecks; recommend practical corrective actions and modernization strategies.
  • Serve as a senior technical advisor to programs experiencing significant engineering challenges, providing guidance on software performance, reliability, integration, recovery, and long-term technical sustainability.

Reuse

  • Identify opportunities to develop and reuse common software components, services, architectural patterns, and engineering capabilities that accelerate delivery and reduce duplication across programs.
  • Collaborate with platform product leadership and program engineering teams to promote reuse of existing capabilities, identify opportunities for shared development, and recommend platform improvements based on emerging program needs.
  • Provide recommendations to platform product leadership on new capabilities, architectural enhancements, and technical improvements for consideration in the product roadmap, informed by observations, challenges, and emerging requirements across direct-funded programs and captures.

Growth

  • Support solution architecture, capture, and proposal activities by developing technical approaches, architecture descriptions, white papers, and other materials that differentiate Leidos' software engineering capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain validated technical proof points and performance metrics demonstrating software delivery efficiency, quality, resiliency, scalability, and other technical differentiators for use in proposals and customer engagements.
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, demonstrations, and presentations to Government customers, senior leadership, and potential industry partners.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field and a minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in software and systems engineering or a Master’s degree with 13+ years of experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • US Citizen with an active Top Secret clearance
  • Extensive experience designing, developing, integrating, and delivering complex, mission-critical software systems.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple software development teams, programs, or product initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and secure software delivery.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, containerization, microservices, distributed systems, and modern integration patterns.
  • Experience evaluating emerging technologies and advising engineering teams on improvements to software development processes, architectures, and delivery practices.
  • Experience assessing software resiliency, fault tolerance, system recovery, technical debt, and complex software engineering challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing technical documentation, architecture descriptions, proposals, and customer-facing presentations.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance, with the ability to maintain it.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • US Citizen with an active TS/SCI clearance
  • Experience with software deployed in classified, tactical, disconnected, or resource-constrained environments.
  • Experience with reusable software platforms, shared services, and software product development.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity requirements, RMF, STIGs, and secure software deployment practices.
  • Experience supporting technical captures, solution architecture, customer demonstrations, and business development activities.
  • Demonstrated success influencing engineering improvements that measurably increase software delivery efficiency, quality, or operational reliability.

You will partner closely with Google Cloud field sellers, Google Security specialists, and Foresite’s solution architects and delivery teams to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and close business. Revenue Generation & Territory Management

Who You Are:

  • Security Savvy: You have a deep understanding of the threat landscape and experience selling into IT security buyers (CISOs, SOC Directors, Architects).

Why Join the Foresite Team?

At Foresite, we aren’t just another security provider—we are a mission-driven partner helping organizations navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. We’ve built a global leader in SecOps and MDR by leaning into three core pillars that set us apart from the crowd:

As a Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year, we operate at the absolute cutting edge of the industry, offering our team a front-row seat to the future of security operations.

  • Room to Run: We are at that "sweet spot" of growth—large enough to win global contracts, but early enough that every individual’s contribution directly shapes our trajectory.

When you join Foresite, you are part of a "humans-first" culture where radical transparency isn’t just a buzzword—it’s how we lead. We know that while our technology is world-class, our greatest asset is the practitioner behind the keyboard.

How You'll Win Here:

jobs.title: Steuerfachkraft International (w/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: Bei Instagrid bist du Teil der Clean-Tech-Revolution: Du bringst reine Energie in deine Region, unterstützt professionelle Anwender beim Umstieg von Verbrennungsgeneratoren und ermöglichst ihnen eine sichere, effiziente, saubere und leise Energielösung.
jobs.description:
Bei Instagrid bist du Teil der Clean-Tech-Revolution: Du bringst reine Energie in deine Region, unterstützt professionelle Anwender beim Umstieg von Verbrennungsgeneratoren und ermöglichst ihnen eine sichere, effiziente, saubere und leise Energielösung.

Deine Mission

Instagrid ist international: Wir liefern unsere Produkte in zahlreiche Länder, arbeiten mit Lagerpartnern in Ungarn und Polen, haben Tochtergesellschaften in UK, Frankreich und den USA – und all das erzeugt steuerliche Komplexität, die wir intern beherrschen wollen.

Wir suchen eine Person mit fundiertem steuerlichen Fachwissen und echter Lust auf operative Arbeit – ob Steuerfachwirt*in, erfahrene Steuerfachkraft oder jemand aus einer Kanzlei, der den Wechsel ins operative Inhouse-Umfeld sucht. Du machst nicht nur Theorie, sondern kümmerst dich um USt-Meldungen, prüfst Steuerkonten, bewertest Lieferketten und bist der interne Anker für steuerliche Fragen des Tagesgeschäfts.

Dein Impact

Umsatzsteuer & Meldewesen

  • Erstellung und Einreichung der monatlichen Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen (UStVA) für die Instagrid GmbH in Deutschland

  • Bearbeitung von Zusammenfassenden Meldungen (ZM) inkl. innergemeinschaftlicher Lieferungen und Dreiecksgeschäfte

  • Pflege und Überwachung der umsatzsteuerlichen Registrierungen in Deutschland, Ungarn und Polen

  • OSS-Meldungen (One-Stop-Shop) für B2C-Verkäufe in EU-Länder

  • Mitwirkung bei der Jahressteuererklärung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerberater

Steuerkontenpflege & Buchhalterische Umsetzung

  • Laufende Prüfung und Abstimmung von Steuerkonten (Vorsteuer, Umsatzsteuer, Einfuhrumsatzsteuer, Reverse Charge)

  • Korrekte Kodierung von Eingangsrechnungen nach steuerlichen Anforderungen (§14 UStG, §13b UStG, §21 UStG)

  • Erkennung und Korrektur fehlerhafter Steuerschlüssel in NetSuite

  • Buchhalterische Behandlung von steuerlichen Sondertatbeständen

Internationale Warenlieferungen & Steuercodes

  • Steuerliche Beurteilung ausgehender Lieferungen: innergemeinschaftliche Lieferungen, Drittlandsexporte, Dreiecksgeschäfte nach §25b UStG

  • Prüfung eingehender Lieferungen: innergemeinschaftlicher Erwerb, Einfuhrumsatzsteuer, Reverse Charge

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Billing und AP zur Sicherstellung korrekter Steuerschlüssel auf Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen

  • Unterstützung bei der Beurteilung von Warenlieferketten mit Lagerpartnern (Ungarn, Polen)

Zusammenarbeit mit externen Beratern & Steuerrecht

  • Schnittstelle zum deutschen Steuerberater sowie zu externen Partnern (z.B. Rödl & Partner in Ungarn)

  • Zusammenstellung und Plausibilisierung von Unterlagen für Betriebsprüfungen

  • Du hältst dich eigenständig über relevante steuerrechtliche Änderungen auf dem Laufenden und bewertest deren Auswirkungen für Instagrid – das setzt echte Expertise voraus

Requirements

Fachlich

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte*r mit Weiterbildung zum/zur Steuerfachwirt*in, Bilanzbuchhalter*in mit steuerlichem Schwerpunkt, oder vergleichbares Studium (BWL, Steuerrecht, Wirtschaftsrecht)

  • Alternativ: Berufserfahrung aus einer Steuerberatungs- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungskanzlei mit echtem Wunsch nach operativer Inhouse-Tätigkeit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre operative Berufserfahrung im steuerlichen Bereich, davon idealerweise Erfahrung mit Umsatzsteuer auf internationalem Niveau

  • Gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Umsatzsteuerrecht (UStG, UStDV, BMF-Schreiben) sowie Grundkenntnisse der EU-Mehrwertsteuerrichtlinie

  • Erfahrung mit innergemeinschaftlichen Lieferungen, Reverse Charge und idealerweise Dreiecksgeschäften

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise NetSuite) sowie Kenntnisse in DATEV oder vergleichbaren Systemen – ein Wechsel zwischen Systemen ist für dich kein Hindernis

Persönlich

  • Du denkst steuerlich, arbeitest aber buchhalterisch – du magst die Kombination aus rechtlicher Einordnung und operativer Umsetzung

  • Analytische Denkweise und Freude an der Arbeit mit Zahlen, Steuercodes und komplexen Sachverhalten

  • Zuverlässige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Fähigkeit, Fristen einzuhalten

  • Kommunikationsstärke für die Arbeit mit internen Teams und externen Beratern

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind zwingend erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) für die Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld

Deine Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage plus 5 Sonderurlaubstage und 5 Baby-Leave-Tage

  • Rabatte bei nachhaltigen Online-Shops

  • Ein Unternehmen an der Spitze der Clean-Tech-Innovation – und ein Team, in dem du dich von Tag eins wohlfühlst

Das ist Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. Wir entwickeln die weltweit fortschrittlichsten mobilen Energiesysteme und schaffen damit neue Freiheit für die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir gestalten wir eine Zukunft, in der moderne Technologie und ökologische Verantwortung Hand in Hand gehen und nachhaltige Wirkung entfalten. Getrieben von Neugier und dem Anspruch, die Welt von morgen sauberer zu hinterlassen als die von gestern, treiben wir den Wandel von Verbrennungsgeneratoren hin zu einer sauberen Alternative voran – schnell, messbar und mit echtem Impact. Was wir bisher erreicht haben, ist erst der Anfang.

Bei Instagrid stehen wir für echte Chancengleichheit, denn wir glauben an die Stärke vielfältiger Teams. Wir schätzen Diversität nicht nur, wir suchen aktiv nach den besten Talenten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Nationalität. Wir arbeiten als Team, begegnen uns mit Respekt und schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven, um gemeinsam Großes zu erreichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Mortgage - Credit Specialist Manager
jobs.excerpt: Mortgage - Credit Specialist Manager We are Lennar Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career.
jobs.description:
Mortgage - Credit Specialist Manager

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

As a Credit Specialist Manager, you will play a foundational role within Lennar's mortgage operations by supporting the accurate evaluation and processing of borrower credit profiles in alignment with established lending guidelines and regulatory requirements. This position contributes directly to Lennar's mission of delivering an exceptional homebuying experience by helping ensure that credit decisions are thoroughly documented, compliant, and processed with precision. By building expertise in mortgage credit analysis and underwriting support, you will grow your professional capabilities while helping homebuyers take a meaningful step toward owning a Lennar home.

Your Responsibilities on the Team

  • Review and analyze borrower credit reports, including trade line history, derogatory items, and credit score composition, to identify potential eligibility issues and ensure files meet investor and agency credit guidelines prior to submission for underwriting review.
  • Perform data entry and verification of credit-related loan file information within the loan origination system, confirming that all borrower credit documentation is accurate, complete, and consistent with application disclosures and underwriting conditions.
  • Assist in the preparation and organization of credit packages by gathering required supporting documentation such as letters of explanation, credit dispute documentation, and credit supplement requests, following established processing checklists and department procedures.
  • Research and resolve credit report discrepancies by coordinating with credit reporting agencies and third-party vendors to obtain supplements, rapid rescores, or corrected tradeline information under the guidance of senior mortgage staff.
  • Monitor loan files for outstanding credit-related conditions and stale documentation, tracking status updates within the pipeline management system and escalating unresolved items to the appropriate team members within defined service level timeframes.
  • Apply knowledge of applicable mortgage credit guidelines — including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and USDA requirements — to flag potential compliance or eligibility concerns during the file review process and route findings appropriately for resolution.
  • Maintain organized records of credit review activity, condition clearance documentation, and vendor communications in accordance with departmental recordkeeping standards, audit requirements, and applicable federal mortgage regulations such as FCRA and RESPA.
  • Participate in ongoing training, process improvement initiatives, and quality control reviews led by senior mortgage operations staff, applying updated credit policy guidance consistently across assigned loan files to support team accuracy and regulatory compliance.

Your Toolbox

  • Bachelor's degree required; recent college graduates with relevant coursework in finance, business, economics, or a related field are encouraged to apply.
  • One to two years of experience in mortgage lending, consumer credit analysis, loan processing, or a related financial services function preferred; equivalent internship or co-op experience in a mortgage or banking environment will be considered.
  • Working knowledge of mortgage credit guidelines and agency requirements, including familiarity with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, or USDA standards as they relate to credit eligibility and borrower qualification.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and interpret consumer credit reports, including understanding of credit scoring models, tradeline reporting, derogatory history, and dispute resolution processes.
  • Proficiency in data entry and document management within loan origination or mortgage processing systems, with strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in high-volume, deadline-driven environments.
  • Foundational understanding of federal mortgage lending regulations relevant to credit processing, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), and Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA).
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple loan files simultaneously, prioritize competing tasks effectively, and consistently meet processing deadlines under the direction of senior mortgage operations staff.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<> for the latest job opportunities.

Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
