jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Inbound
jobs.excerpt: At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress.
jobs.description:
At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.

Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius, our values guide how we work and grow together:

  • Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.

  • Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.

  • Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at

Job overview

Medius builds AI-powered accounts payable and spend management software for finance teams. We help organizations replace manual invoice processing with automation that captures, matches, approves, and pays, catching errors and fraud along the way. Our customers are finance and accounting leaders at companies between $50M and $1B in revenue, running ERPs including NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft, and Oracle.

The Business Development Representative I – Inbound role is for someone who wants to break into tech sales and is ready to learn the craft properly. You do not need prior BDR or SDR experience. You will be the first person at Medius that an interested buyer talks to: someone who filled out a form, started a chat on our website, met us at an event, or came to us through a partner. Your job is to respond quickly, understand what they need, and connect the right ones with an Account Executive.

This is a quality-first team. We care more about how well you qualify and how many of your meetings turn into real pipeline than about raw activity counts. You will be measured on the meetings that get accepted and progress, not on activity for its own sake.

We will teach you the rest. You start with a structured 90-day onboarding covering our product, our buyers, our tools, and how to run a good qualification conversation, with regular call coaching from your manager from week one.

The role is also a genuine first step on a path. BDR I is where we develop people into BDR II and Senior BDR roles, and from there into Account Executive, Business Development Manager, and other go-to-market roles. We will tell you plainly what must be true for you to get there.

Responsibilities and Duties -

Respond to inbound interest, fast

  • Respond to inbound leads within our service level: demo requests, content downloads, event follow-up, and partner referrals.

  • Staff live website chat during your scheduled coverage hours and turn real-time conversations into booked meetings.

  • Research the person and the company before you reach out, using Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and 6sense, so your first message is relevant to them.

  • Follow up by phone, email, and LinkedIn until you reach the person or have a clear reason to stop.

Qualify with care

  • Run intro conversations with Controllers, AP Directors and Managers, Accounting leaders, and IT decisionmakers.

  • Ask good questions and listen how they process and pay invoices today, where the process breaks, what it is costing them, and why they came to us now.

  • Qualify every lead against our criteria. Say no to poor fits and route existing customers to the right team.

  • Learn to handle common questions and objections around timing, budget, current tools, and ERP changes without pitching past the prospect.

Partner with Account Executives

  • Convert qualified leads into meetings for Account Executives, with notes complete enough that the AE can walk in prepared.

  • Run clean handoffs: confirmed time, confirmed attendees, agreed agenda, and context transferred before the call.

  • Take feedback on meeting quality directly and act on it.

  • Follow up on no-shows and on meetings that did not convert and keep those contacts in a deliberate nurture rather than dropping them.

Operate with Rigor

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and current: leads, contacts, activity, disposition reasons, and next steps. Pipeline decisions get made on this data.

  • Work your follow-up sequences in Outreach every day so no inbound lead sits untouched.

  • Know your own numbers. Come to your one-to-one able to say where leads are dropping off and what you are trying next.

  • Use AI tools in your workflow with judgment, as a drafting and research accelerator you edit, not as a send-button.

Learn and grow

  • Complete onboarding and certifications on Medius products, our buyers, and our qualification framework.

  • Take part in call reviews, role plays, and team training, and apply the coaching on your next call.

  • Build a working understanding of accounts payable, spend management, and the ERP systems our customers run.

Qualifications

  • No prior BDR, SDR, or tech sales experience required. We are hiring for drive, curiosity, and coachability, and we will teach you the role.

  • A track record of working hard at something and getting results: customer-facing work in hospitality, retail, or service, competitive athletics, military service, leadership roles, or putting yourself through school.

  • Comfort talking with people you do not know, on the phone and over chat, and the confidence to ask a senior finance leader a direct question.

  • Strong written communication. You can write a short, clear, professional message without relying on a template.

  • Genuine curiosity about how businesses operate. You do not need an accounting background, but you do need to want to understand what an AP team does.

  • Evidence of coachability. You can describe critical feedback you have received and what you changed as a result.

  • Resilience. Not every lead is a fit and not every call goes well, and we want to know how you reset after a tough day or week.

  • Organization and urgency. Inbound leads go cold quickly, and you can manage your day so the right ones get a fast response.

  • Comfort learning new software quickly.

Preferred -

  • Experience in a customer-facing, service, or sales role of any kind, including internships and part-time work.

  • Exposure to a CRM (Salesforce preferred) or a sales engagement platform (Outreach, Salesloft, or similar).

  • Coursework or experience in business, finance, or accounting.

  • Familiarity with B2B software, fintech, or ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle.

  • Experience using AI tools for research and writing.

Medius is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The estimated On-Target Earnings for this role is $80,000 USD, which represents a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position. Base salary is $55,000 and variable is $25,000, with monthly and quarterly accelerators.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, experience, qualifications, certifications, internal equity, and the geographic location in which the role is performed. Compensation may vary for roles performed in different locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for variable compensation (such as a performance bonus or commission), benefits, and/or participation in other incentive or benefit plans, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and retirement benefits, subject to eligibility requirements.

Equal opportunity

Medius is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability (physical or mental), genetic information, medical condition, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

If you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability or for religious reasons during the application or interview process, please review our accommodations process.

About Zaden Technologies, Inc.

Join Zaden Technologies on our mission to simplify the delivery and improve the utility of software products for our customers. At Zaden, we believe that our employees are our greatest assets. We hire the right candidates with the right skill sets who fit our culture of customer obsession, innovation, and continuous learning. We are our customer’s biggest advocate and we are looking for like-minded individuals who encompass these same ideals. It is important to us to offer you competitive pay and comprehensive benefits with opportunities that match your life and propel your career!

The Mechanical Integration Engineer is responsible for defining factory level mechanical and thermal solutions that enable the setup, expansion, and optimization of greenfield and brownfield Jabil owned manufacturing facilities in addition to product support. This role leads early phase factory design by scoping, specifying, and integrating mechanical and cooling systems, mimicking data center infrastructure functionality where required, and translating product and process requirements into scalable factory architectures that support efficient facility setup, equipment deployment and long term manufacturing readiness. The position also includes leading test process implementation and equipment selection to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and reliability.

India - Remote

  • Lead the design of factory level mechanical and cooling architectures, leveraging hyperscale data center design principles to define scalable, resilient infrastructure for Jabil manufacturing facilities

Welcome to Motorola Solutions. You'll join the CC Insights team as the product moves from pilot to general availability. The team is remote and spread across the US, South Africa, Brazil and India. We build a unified reporting application that combines several analytics products into one AI-assisted experience. It runs on an Angular and .NET web application, an internal Data Platform (Databricks and Azure Synapse), embedded Power BI and an AI Chat that turns natural-language questions into SQL.

As the product matures, more of our backlog is about reliability, data quality, AI answer accuracy and security. This is a new, dedicated quality role. You'll be the first engineer working full-time on our testing foundation across the application, the data pipelines and the AI Chat.


Job Description

We're looking for a Senior SDET to design and build our test automation strategy and tooling across the full stack: the Angular/.NET application, the Databricks/Synapse data pipelines and the AI Chat system. You'll work closely with Full Stack and Data Engineers to catch problems before customers see them, whether that's a broken UI flow, a data load that fails silently or an inaccurate AI-generated answer.

Where You'll Start

You won't be expected to cover everything on day one. In your first 90 days, the priorities are:

  • Foundation: CI quality gates, and automated API and UI tests for our most critical user flows.
  • Data quality: automated checks on the Gold-layer data that feeds customer reports.

After that, you'll extend into AI Chat evaluation, performance and security verification, working with the engineers who own those areas.

Key Responsibilities

  • Testing foundation: Define the team's test strategy and build test frameworks and tooling that the whole team can extend, running as quality gates in our GitHub Actions pipelines.
  • UI and API automation: Modernise end-to-end UI testing and build API test suites for our .NET REST services.
  • Data quality: Implement automated checks across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers: schema drift, null-rate thresholds, duplicates, volume anomalies and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • AI Chat validation: Work with the engineers building the AI Chat to create a "golden question" evaluation set and regression suite that measures whether generated queries return the correct results and catches quality regressions when prompts or models change.
  • Performance: Establish performance baselines and automated load tests for high-volume customers (for example, p95 query latency targets).
  • Pipeline reliability: Test retry, checkpoint/watermark recovery and alerting paths so that failures are detected and recoverable, not silent.
  • Security verification: Validate fixes for findings from our scanning tools (e.g. OWASP ZAP, SonarQube) and confirm them by re-scanning before sign-off.
  • Definition of Done: Help define and enforce automated test coverage across critical user flows, APIs and data pipelines, and sign-off criteria for UI, pipeline and AI work.
  • Mentorship: Encourage a test-first mindset and help engineers write testable, observable code.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years in software quality or software engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on test automation in code (not primarily manual testing).
  • Proven experience building or scaling automated test frameworks for web UIs and/or APIs (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, xUnit/NUnit, REST API test tooling) and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C#/.NET, TypeScript or Python for writing test code.
  • Strong SQL, with experience validating data correctness (reconciliation queries, data quality checks, testing reports or analytics data).
  • Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your workflow.

Position: Editor, FP Comment Position Type: Full time, Permanent Reports to: Editor in Chief, Financial Post Division: The Financial Post Location:Toronto (Remote)

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it.This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

The Financial Post is hiring an editor to lead FP Comment, Canada's leading home for sharp, insightful and colourful commentary on economics, business and public policy from a free-market perspective. For decades, FP Comment has made the case for open markets, free trade, limited government and the prosperity they create. It is frequently the lone voice standing for those first principles, against changing fashions, but it always proves in the end to be the most sensible voice. Our principles don’t change but our platform needs someone to keep it fresh and modern. We are seeking the editor who is passionate about our ideals. We also want one to bring new energy to the section by adding to our already powerful roster of columnists and contributors with new voices, reaching younger and broader audiences. That means taking FP Comment's arguments beyond the written page by incorporating video, social platforms and more.

What you'll do:

Set the editorial direction for FP Comment and own its daily file, commissioning, editing and publishing commentary. Find and develop new contributors, including economists, entrepreneurs, investors, policy thinkers, industry practitioners and emerging writers who can make the case for economic freedom in new and compelling ways, while working with the section's established columnists. Build FP Comment's video and multimedia presence, developing and producing (or working with producers on) short-form explainers, debates, interviews and recurring series for financialpost.com, YouTube and social platforms. Help develop new products such as newsletters, podcasts and live or virtual events that deepen reader engagement and grow subscriptions. Respond quickly to news, so that FP Comment offers a timely, rigorous free-market take on federal budgets, Bank of Canada decisions, trade disputes, major policy announcements and market events. Edit to a high standard for clarity, accuracy, argument and readability, and make sure every piece is grounded in evidence and data. Work with Financial Post editors, the audience and video teams, and colleagues across Postmedia to extend the section's reach. Use audience data to understand what resonates, and experiment with formats, headlines, packaging and distribution.

Who you are:

5+ years of experience in editing, opinion journalism, policy communications or a related field, with a record of commissioning and shaping strong commentary. A deep understanding of, and real commitment to, free-market economics and the editorial values of the Financial Post. A strong grasp of Canadian economic and fiscal policy, financial markets and business, and the ability to judge an economic argument on its merits. Experience with, or a clear vision for, video and digital-first content. Comfort with platforms such as YouTube, podcasts, newsletters and social media is important. On-camera or on-air skills are a strong asset. Excellent news judgment, sharp editing skills and the ability to work quickly on deadline. A writer in your own right, comfortable contributing columns and editorials.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location.

Pay Rate: $90,000 - $100,000

The Opportunity

The St. Jude Leadership Academy is building the systems, experiences and capabilities that help leaders across St. Jude grow their impact. We’re looking for a Director of Academy Operations who can help turn that vision into an enterprise-scale reality.

This is a role for a builder.


As the Academy’s primary operational leader and integrator, you’ll translate strategy into an integrated portfolio of work and create the infrastructure needed to move ideas from concept through implementation, evaluation and scale. You’ll work across Leadership Development, Culture Strategy and institutional partners to connect priorities, clarify ownership and turn complex, cross-functional work into coordinated action.


You’ll also serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership, bringing visibility to priorities, tradeoffs, resources and execution risks while helping shape how the Academy delivers its work across St. Jude.


Because the Leadership Academy operates as a small, highly collaborative team, this isn’t a role where strategy gets handed off once the plan is built. You’ll move comfortably between enterprise-level thinking and hands-on execution, building the systems that allow a small team to have an outsized impact across St. Jude.


What You’ll Do


As Director of Academy Operations, you will:


  • Turn strategy into execution. Translate Leadership Academy priorities into an integrated portfolio, implementation roadmap and operating plan.
  • Lead complex work from idea to impact. Guide cross-functional initiatives from concept and design through implementation, evaluation and scale.
  • Build the Academy’s operating infrastructure. Establish governance, decision points, roles, handoffs, planning processes and operating rhythms that create clarity and accountability.
  • Connect work across St. Jude. Build strong partnerships across Leadership Development, Culture Strategy and other institutional functions, bringing people and priorities together while maintaining clear roles and ownership.
  • See around corners. Identify dependencies, duplication, capacity constraints, gaps and execution risks across the Academy’s portfolio and drive solutions.

  • Communicate with influence. Develop executive-level materials and clearly communicate progress, decisions, risks and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Stay close to the work. Remain directly involved in execution when needed, reflecting the hands-on, highly collaborative nature of the Academy team.
  • Develop people and teams. Create clarity around goals and expectations while supporting performance, engagement, professional growth and meaningful career experiences.

What You Bring


You are an experienced operations and program leader who knows how to take an ambitious vision and build the structure required to make it real. You are comfortable navigating complexity, influencing across organizational boundaries and leading work when accountability is shared across multiple teams.


You bring:


  • A bachelor’s degree; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • 10+ years of related professional experience.
  • Significant experience leading complex enterprise programs, operations, transformation initiatives or similar work within a large organization.
  • Demonstrated experience building operating models, processes or organizational capabilities, not simply administering established programs.
  • A track record of translating strategic objectives into operational plans and driving those plans through execution.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional work in environments where accountability and authority are distributed.
  • Strong strategic program management, operational, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • The ability to move comfortably between enterprise-level strategy and detailed execution.
  • Strong consulting, stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including experience partnering with senior leaders.
  • Experience with budget planning, resource management, vendor relationships and contract negotiations.
  • Experience with human-centered design, agile methods, continuous improvement or related approaches.
  • Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills.
  • Experience in leadership development, organizational development, talent, culture or another people-related function is preferred, but not required.

The Kind of Leader Who Will Thrive Here


This role may be especially compelling if you:


  • See complexity and instinctively begin creating clarity and structure.
  • Get energy from building something, not simply maintaining what already exists.
  • Can zoom out to see the enterprise picture and then zoom back in to make sure the details work.
  • Know how to lead through influence when the people needed to accomplish the work don’t necessarily report to you.
  • Are comfortable asking difficult questions about priorities, capacity, tradeoffs and risk.
  • Enjoy turning promising ideas into repeatable, sustainable ways of working.
  • Believe measurement should help people make better decisions, not simply create more reporting.
  • Approach problems with curiosity and are willing to challenge established ways of working when there is a better path forward.
  • Can advise senior leaders one moment and roll up your sleeves to solve an execution problem the next.
  • Want to build systems that make it possible for other people to do exceptional work.

Key Capabilities


Enterprise program leadership • Operational strategy • Portfolio management • Cross-functional integration • Systems thinking • Execution • Consultative problem solving • Stakeholder influence • Human-centered problem solving • Measurement and analytics • Continuous improvement • Organizational change


Why St. Jude


At St. Jude, operational excellence ultimately serves a larger purpose. The work of the Leadership Academy helps equip leaders across the institution to lead people, navigate change and advance a mission unlike any other.


As Director of Academy Operations, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape not only what the Leadership Academy delivers, but how it works: building the infrastructure, partnerships and operating practices that allow a small team to create meaningful impact across St. Jude.

About DTIQ Technologies, Inc

DTiQ is a global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.

We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.

For more information on DTiQ visit our website () or our LinkedIn page ().

Role Overview

The Sales Operations & Deal Desk Specialist is responsible for managing the end-to-end sales administration process, ensuring customer quotes, pricing, contracts, order documentation and billing workflows are completed accurately, efficiently and within agreed timeframes.

Working closely with Sales, Account Management, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Finance, Customer Success and Operations, this role provides essential commercial and administrative support across DTiQ’s customer base and product portfolio.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the quoting and deal administration process, ensuring sales opportunities progress smoothly from initial requirements through to quote preparation, customer acceptance, contract execution and billing handover.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role requiring strong attention to detail, commercial awareness, initiative and the ability to work autonomously. The individual must be comfortable managing multiple requests, following established processes, identifying gaps and proactively driving tasks through to completion without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Quoting & Commercial Administration

  • Prepare, review and issue accurate customer quotes for hardware, software subscriptions, SaaS products, services, installations and ongoing support.
  • Work with Sales, Account Managers and SMEs to understand customer requirements, product configurations, quantities, pricing and deployment needs.
  • Apply approved pricing structures, discount schedules, commercial terms and pricing rules.
  • Validate quote accuracy, including hardware, recurring revenue, one-off charges, subscription terms, contract duration and payment arrangements.
  • Identify pricing discrepancies, non-standard requests or margin concerns and escalate them for approval before issuing quotes.
  • Manage quote revisions, renewals, amendments and customer requests for updated pricing.
  • Ensure quotes are delivered within agreed turnaround times and proactively follow up on outstanding information or approvals.
  • Maintain consistent quoting standards across products, customers and regions.

2. Salesforce CRM & Deal Desk Management

  • Manage quoting and sales administration activities within Salesforce, ensuring opportunities, quotes, products, pricing and associated records are accurate.
  • Support Sales and Account Management teams with opportunity updates, quote generation, amendments and administrative requirements.
  • Ensure customer records, account details, product selections and commercial information are complete and up to date.
  • Track quote status, pending approvals, contract progression and outstanding actions.
  • Maintain clear documentation and an audit trail for pricing decisions, approvals and customer commitments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Salesforce workflows, templates, data quality and sales administration processes.

3. DocuSign & Contract Administration

  • Prepare and issue customer agreements, statements of work (SOWs), order forms, renewals and related documentation through DocuSign.
  • Ensure the correct documents, pricing, customer details, authorised signatories and commercial terms are included before sending.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Legal and relevant internal stakeholders to resolve documentation gaps.
  • Monitor signature progress, follow up on outstanding agreements and escalate delays where required.
  • Maintain accurate records of executed contracts and ensure final documents are stored in the appropriate systems.
  • Support contract amendments, renewals and other customer documentation requirements.

4. Billing & Order Administration

  • Coordinate billing setup and administration following quote acceptance, contract execution and order confirmation.
  • Work with Finance to ensure customer billing details, purchase orders, subscription fees, hardware charges, payment terms and invoicing requirements are accurate.
  • Verify that commercial agreements and executed SOWs align with the information provided for billing.
  • Support recurring revenue setup, subscription changes, renewals, billing amendments and customer account updates.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between quotes, contracts, orders and billing records.
  • Ensure relevant information is handed over to Finance, Logistics, Operations and Customer Success to support delivery and customer onboarding.

5. Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as a central point of coordination between Sales, Account Management, SMEs, Finance and Operations for quoting and deal administration.
  • Gather technical and commercial inputs required to prepare accurate quotes and customer documentation.
  • Proactively chase outstanding information, approvals and actions rather than allowing requests to stall.
  • Ensure stakeholders have visibility of quote status, contract progress, billing requirements and outstanding dependencies.
  • Support customer renewals, upsell opportunities, hardware deployments and changes to existing customer agreements.
  • Maintain clear communication and ownership from initial request through to completion and handover.

6. Process Improvement & Operational Execution

  • Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and recurring errors across quoting, contracting and billing workflows.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to templates, processes, documentation and system usage.
  • Maintain trackers and reporting to provide visibility of quote volumes, turnaround times, outstanding approvals and contract execution.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures to support consistency and scalability.
  • Take ownership of issues and drive them to resolution, escalating only when necessary.
  • Ensure commercial and customer documentation is accurate, complete and managed in accordance with internal controls.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Sales Administration, Commercial Operations or a similar role.
  • Practical experience using Salesforce CRM, particularly opportunities, quoting, product records and commercial data.
  • Experience managing DocuSign workflows, including preparing, issuing, tracking and completing customer agreements.
  • Strong understanding of customer quoting, pricing structures, discounts, approvals and commercial documentation.
  • Experience supporting billing administration, purchase orders, order processing or finance handovers.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work across multiple departments.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability and the ability to work independently.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, follow-up and process improvement.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and general business systems capability.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in a technology, SaaS, hardware or managed services business.
  • Familiarity with recurring revenue models, subscription billing, annual renewals and multi-year contracts.
  • Experience with product catalogues, pricing matrices, discount approval processes and sales quoting tools.
  • Understanding of Statements of Work, order forms, service agreements and deployment requirements.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed Sales and Operations teams.

Key Attributes

Ownership: Takes responsibility for requests from start to finish and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

Commercial awareness: Understands the importance of accurate pricing, discount controls, contract terms and revenue integrity.

Execution-focused: Prioritises completing work accurately and on time, rather than simply passing tasks between teams.

Proactive communication: Follows up with stakeholders, identifies missing information early and communicates potential delays.

Attention to detail: Ensures quotes, contracts, billing information and CRM records are accurate before completion.

Continuous improvement: Looks for ways to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.

Autonomy: Can manage a workload independently, make decisions within established guidelines and escalate exceptions appropriately.

Measures of Success

Performance in this role will be measured against:

  • Quote turnaround time: Quotes prepared and issued within agreed service levels.
  • Quote accuracy: Minimal errors in pricing, product configuration, discounts and commercial terms.
  • Contract execution: Timely preparation, distribution and completion of DocuSign agreements.
  • Billing accuracy: Complete and accurate handover of commercial information to Finance.
  • Salesforce data quality: Accurate and current opportunity, quote and customer records.
  • Workflow ownership: Outstanding requests, approvals and documentation actively managed through to completion.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction: Positive feedback from Sales, SMEs, Finance and Operations regarding responsiveness and support.
  • Process improvement: Measurable reduction in delays, errors and administrative bottlenecks.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will become a reliable operational partner to the Sales and Account Management teams, enabling them to focus on customer engagement, revenue growth and new business opportunities.

Quotes will be accurate and delivered on time, contracts will move efficiently through DocuSign, billing handovers will be complete, and Salesforce will provide reliable commercial visibility.

Most importantly, the individual will take ownership of the process, anticipate what needs to happen next and drive the work forward with minimal supervision.

Wir suchen engagierte Psychologie-Studierende, die bei Lucoyo Praxiserfahrung in den Bereichen Patient:innenanfragen und Research sammeln möchten.

Darüber hinaus bringst du dich in spannende Research-Projekte ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst und erhältst so vielseitige Einblicke in unser Arbeitsfeld. Dabei kannst du flexibel von zu Hause aus arbeiten und wertvolle Erfahrungen in der Schnittstelle von Psychologie und digitaler Gesundheitsversorgung sammeln.
Das Praktikum wird von einem M.Sc. Psychologen betreut.

Start: ab März 2027

Umfang: mindestens 300 Stunden

20 Std./ Woche bevorzugt

Hinweis zum Bewerbungsprozess: Wir möchten alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig prüfen und melden uns voraussichtlich ab Dezember 2026 bei dir zurück.

Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung folgende Informationen hinzu:

  1. Deinen frühesten möglichen Startzeitpunkt.

  2. Das Datum, bis wann das Praktikum abgeschlossen sein muss.

  3. Die Gesamtstundenzahl des Praktikums.

  4. Die Anzahl der möglichen Wochenstunden.

  5. Deine zeitliche Verfügbarkeit innerhalb der Woche, damit wir sehen können, ob es zu unseren aktuellen Telefonservice-Zeiten passt.

Aufgaben

Als Praktikant bei Lucoyo erwarten dich folgende Aufgaben:

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Patient:innenanfragen am Telefon (ca. 10 Std./Woche) und nimmst ihre Anliegen empathisch entgegen.

  • Mitarbeit in Research-Projekten (ca. 10 Std./Woche), die du flexibel mitgestalten kannst.

  • Wir wünschen uns, dass du eigene Akzente setzt und deine Erfahrungen aktiv mit einbringst.

  • Teilnahme an unseren digitalen Team-Meetings sowie an den Lucoyo-Teamtagen (alle 3 Monate, 3 Tage in einem schönen AirBnB in NRW).

Qualifikation

Du studierst Psychologie im Bachelor (in den letzten Semestern) oder bereits im Master und möchtest dein Pflichtpraktikum bei uns absolvieren.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen (z. B. durch Praktika, Nebenjobs oder ehrenamtliches Engagement im psychologischen Bereich) sind hilfreich, aber kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Freude am Telefonkontakt mit Patient:innen hast, eine klare und empathische Kommunikation mitbringst und neugierig darauf bist, dich in Research-Themen einzubringen und diese aktiv mitzugestalten.

Benefits

  • Impact: Arbeite an einer Lösung um den vielen Patient:innen während der Wartezeit besser zu helfen!

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung: Dich erwarten spannende Aufgaben, die du geleitet von uns meistern darfst. Damit bekommst du früh Verantwortung und wir garantieren eine steile Lernkurve.

  • Team-Kultur: Dich erwartet ein tolles Team auf Augenhöhe, mit Leidenschaft für Digital Health und den Antrieb, etwas zu bewegen. Wir pflegen eine offene und lockere Remote-Kultur (z. B. mit Hilfe von bNear) und sehen uns 1x pro Monat vor Ort z.B. in Köln, Bielefeld oder Münster, oder bei regelmäßigen Teamevents.

  • Weiterbildung: Wir fördern dich so gut es geht und das auch über den Tellerand hinaus! Gemeinsam schauen wir, dass du dich in den Bereichen verbesserst, die dir wichtig sind.

Bei Lucoyo Health setzen wir uns für die Verbesserung der psychotherapeutischen Gesundheitsversorgung ein, indem wir innovative und intelligente Lösungen bereitstellen, die sowohl Praxen als auch Patient:innen unterstützen.

Wir Gründer:innen (Maja, Bastian und Robin) haben alle einen persönlichen Bezug zu Menschen mit psychischen Problemen und wissen, wie schwierig es sein kann, eine:n passende:n Psychotherapeut:in zu finden.

Mit Lucoyo - inspiriert von "Let us connect you" setzen wir uns täglich dafür ein, Menschen, die auf der Suche nach Hilfe sind, mit dem passenden Hilfsangebot in Kontakt zu bringen.

NVIDIA is looking for an experienced Network Solutions Architect Engineer to help bring our next-generation AI networking platforms into production at customer data centers. Do you want to be part of a team that brings new AI hardware and software technologies to production in customer data centers? As part of the NVIDIA SA organization, you will be driving deployment of our end-to-end technology solutions integration at some of NVIDIA's most strategic technology customers, as well as offering recommendations to business and engineering teams on our product roadmap.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Partner with AI-labs customers on large data center GPU and networking deployments. Guide architecture decisions across network, compute, and storage, including fabric design. Support on-site bring-up of server, network, and cluster infrastructure in customer data centers.
  • Demonstrate expertise on advanced GPU and network systems (Spectrum-X, BlueField DPU, InfiniBand/RoCE, etc.) for key accounts. Run regular technical account reviews covering roadmap alignment, cluster issues, feature discussions, and new technology introductions. Capture customer-specific requirements and translate them into concrete feedback for product, architecture, and engineering teams.
  • Analyze and debug configuration and performance issues in RoCE and InfiniBand environments. Work across NICs, switches, Linux, and system software to deliver performant, reliable AI clusters.
  • Identify and shape new project opportunities for NVIDIA GPUs, networking, and software in AI and data center use cases. Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, Product Management, and Sales to align solutions with customer outcomes. Build targeted POCs that showcase the value of NVIDIA’s networking stack (e.g., Spectrum-X fabrics, BlueField DPUs) in real customer environments.

What We Need To See:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in data center or cloud environments.
  • Proven, expert-level troubleshooting of data center networks (packet-level, control plane, and fabric behavior).
  • Deep protocol knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and L2/L3 switching in large-scale data center or cloud networks (ECMP, Clos/leaf–spine). Experience with high-density switching at cloud or hyperscale is strongly preferred. Experience with InfiniBand or RoCE is a major plus.
  • Solid understanding of CPU/GPU server architecture, NICs, Linux, system software, and kernel drivers
  • Strong time management and ability to context-switch across multiple customers and projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design docs, customer presentations, and root-cause summaries.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Automation & tooling: Experience in Python, Bash, or C/C++ for automating network workflows, validation, and debug.
  • NVIDIA platform experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA GPUs, NICs, DPUs, or ARM-based CPU platforms.
  • Customer-facing background: Pre-sales, post-sales, field engineering, or consulting experience with external enterprise or cloud customers.
  • Large-scale deployments: Direct experience bringing up and operating large clusters or supercomputing environments.
  • Virtualization / cloud: Familiarity with virtualization, containers, and cloud networking concepts.

jobs.excerpt: Join our team as a BI Solutions Developer, where you will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting business intelligence and data solutions across the Firm.
jobs.description:
Join our team as a BI Solutions Developer, where you will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting business intelligence and data solutions across the Firm. This role works across the BI lifecycle, including data transformation, data modeling, reporting, visualization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

You will work closely with business departments and technical teams to transform trusted enterprise data into intuitive, visually compelling solutions that tell a story with the data and make information easier to understand and use. Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related technologies, you will support the Firm’s enterprise data strategy while promoting BI standards and enabling departments to develop effective solutions through citizen development.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Intelligence & Data Visualization
• Design and develop intuitive, visually compelling Power BI reports and dashboards that tell a story with the data, clearly communicate key insights, and support business decision-making.
• Translate business requirements and trusted enterprise data into practical BI solutions that make complex information easy to understand and use.
• Develop and maintain semantic models, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, and reusable reporting components.
• Apply strong visual design, user experience, and attention to detail to create polished, consistent, and professional BI solutions.
• Maintain, modernize, optimize, and support new and existing reports, dashboards, semantic models, refresh processes, and data connections.

Microsoft Fabric & Data Transformation

• Use Microsoft Fabric as the primary low-code platform for developing data transformation, integration, analytics, and BI solutions.
• Develop and maintain Dataflows Gen2 and related Fabric components to prepare, cleanse, combine, and transform enterprise data for reporting and analytics.
• Create downstream Fabric data solutions, including lakehouses and reusable transformations, using trusted data from the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model.
• Use Fabric pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related capabilities as appropriate to develop scalable and maintainable BI solutions. Apply data quality and validation practices and identify transformations or business rules that should be transitioned to Data Engineering for implementation within the enterprise data layer.

Enterprise Data & Integration
• Use the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model as a primary source of trusted, consistent data for BI, analytics, AI, and reporting solutions.
• Maintain a strong working understanding of enterprise data architecture, including Azure Data Lake, data pipelines, integration, transformation, dimensional modeling, and related data engineering concepts.
• Collaborate closely with Data Engineers and application developers to understand enterprise data structures and define data requirements for BI and analytical solutions.
• Recognize when data requirements extend beyond the BI and low-code layer and work with Data Engineering to develop appropriate enterprise-level solutions.
• Integrate data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, SharePoint, files, and other approved sources when required to support business solutions.

AI & Automation
• Develop and support AI-enabled BI and data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, Data Agents, and related technologies.
• Develop and support data agents that allow users and business solutions to interact with trusted enterprise data through intuitive, AI-enabled experiences.
• Collaborate with Data Engineers, developers, and business teams to identify and prepare the data required for AI and agent-based solutions.
• Develop workflow and data automation solutions using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Microsoft Fabric, and related low-code technologies.
• Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and Fabric capabilities and apply them where they can improve access to information, automate manual processes, or deliver greater business value.

BI Governance, Standards & Citizen Development
• Establish and promote standards and best practices for BI development, data modeling, visualization, transformation, security, performance, deployment, and support.
• Partner with Finance, Client Value, and other technically capable departments to enable effective citizen development of reports, dashboards, dataflows, automations, and other BI solutions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, visualization, data modeling, and other approved low-code technologies.
• Promote the use of trusted enterprise data, shared semantic models, reusable solutions, and consistent business definitions while reducing duplication of data and business logic.
• Review and support citizen-developed solutions to promote appropriate design, data quality, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
Proficiency in the following tools, technologies, and concepts:
• Microsoft Power BI, including report and dashboard development, semantic models, Power BI Service, security, deployment, and data refresh.
• Microsoft Fabric, including Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory, pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related analytics capabilities.
• Power Query/M and DAX for data transformation, business calculations, KPIs, and semantic model development.
• Data modeling and transformation, including dimensional modeling, data integration, cleansing, validation, and data quality.
• SQL and relational database concepts for querying, validating, and working with enterprise data.
• Power Platform and automation technologies, including Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps.
• AI-enabled data solutions, including familiarity with Fabric Data Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and related technologies.
• Working knowledge of Azure and data engineering concepts, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, data pipelines, REST APIs, enterprise data models, and modern data architectures.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience developing business intelligence, reporting, data, or related technology solutions.
• Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data transformation solutions.
• Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
• Experience supporting self-service BI, citizen development, or technically capable business teams is preferred; experience with legal industry data, terminology, or business processes is a plus.
REQUIRED INTERPERSONAL AND COMMUNICATION SKILLS
• Ability to build effective relationships and collaborate with business stakeholders, citizen developers, Data Engineers, application developers, and other technical teams.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences and translate business needs into practical solutions.
• Ability to guide and mentor technically capable business users and citizen developers while promoting appropriate BI standards and best practices.
• Ability to lead discussions, provide technical recommendations, solve complex problems, and build consensus across business and technical teams.
• Ability to work independently, take ownership of solutions, and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

OTHER DESIRED TRAITS
• Strong attention to detail with a professional, business-focused approach and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
• Proactive and able to identify opportunities to improve reporting, data processes, automation, and user experience.
• Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to balance business enablement with appropriate technology standards and governance.
• Curious and adaptable, with an interest in emerging BI, data, AI, and automation technologies and their practical application to business needs.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENT

Minimal.

OFF-HOURS SERVICE REQUIREMENT
Responsibility within a 24x7 Technology Services organization may require work outside standard business hours, including weekends, based on support emergencies, deployments, and other system responsibilities.

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Structural Steel Shop Detailer

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD - $2,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a Perth-based design and technical consultancy specialising in delivering practical design, drafting and engineering support across residential, commercial, industrial, civil and mechanical projects. The business works with a diverse range of construction and development requirements, providing detailed technical documentation, 3D modelling, quantity take-offs and coordinated design solutions. With a strong focus on innovation, accuracy and efficient project delivery, the team combines technical expertise with modern design technology to support projects from initial concepts through to detailed documentation and implementation.

Role Overview: The Structural Steel Shop Detailer / Draftsperson is responsible for preparing accurate workshop drawings, coordinating material supply and managing production scheduling for structural steel fabrication projects.

The role requires a strong understanding of the Australian residential construction industry, including structural steel requirements for new homes, multi-residential developments, extensions, renovations and associated building works.

The successful applicant will be responsible for coordinating projects from receipt of architectural and engineering documentation through to shop detailing, material procurement, fabrication scheduling and delivery to site.

The position requires someone who can work independently, communicate effectively with builders, engineers, suppliers and workshop personnel, and ensure projects are delivered accurately, efficiently and within agreed timeframes.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Structural Steel Detailing and Drafting

  • Prepare detailed structural steel shop drawings from architectural and structural engineering plans.
  • Interpret structural engineering drawings, specifications and construction documentation.
  • Produce fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, erection drawings and material take-offs.
  • Detail structural steel beams, columns, lintels, posts, brackets, base plates, cleats and connection components.
  • Ensure drawings accurately reflect engineering requirements and design specifications.
  • Identify discrepancies, omissions and potential construction issues before fabrication.
  • Liaise with structural engineers where clarification or additional information is required.
  • Ensure all shop drawings are issued for review and approval where required.

B. Material Supply and Procurement

  • Prepare comprehensive material take-offs and cutting lists from approved shop drawings.
  • Identify required steel sections, including universal beams, universal columns, PFCs, RHS, SHS, angles, flats and plates.
  • Coordinate material purchasing and supply with steel merchants and suppliers.
  • Obtain material pricing and availability to assist with project costing.
  • Monitor supplier lead times and ensure materials are available in accordance with production requirements.
  • Coordinate special-order materials, connection components, bolts, plates and associated fabrication items.
  • Track material orders, deliveries and outstanding supply requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to optimise material utilisation and reduce wastage.
  • Ensure material specifications, grades and dimensions comply with engineering documentation.

C. Workshop and Production Scheduling

  • Develop and maintain workshop production schedules.
  • Coordinate fabrication priorities based on project deadlines and site requirements.
  • Schedule jobs according to material availability, labour capacity and workshop workload.
  • Ensure workshop drawings and material are available before jobs are released for fabrication.
  • Coordinate fabrication sequences to minimise downtime and improve workshop efficiency.
  • Monitor job progress and identify potential delays.
  • Communicate revised production timelines to management and relevant stakeholders.
  • Coordinate completed steelwork for delivery in accordance with site installation requirements.
  • Maintain visibility of current, upcoming and completed projects.

D. Project and Builder Coordination

  • Liaise with residential builders, construction managers, engineers and subcontractors.
  • Review project documentation and identify detailing or supply requirements.
  • Coordinate project deadlines with builders and site supervisors.
  • Confirm site delivery requirements, access constraints and installation sequencing.
  • Manage drawing revisions and ensure the workshop is working from the latest approved documentation.
  • Provide regular project updates and communicate potential delays.
  • Assist with resolving technical and logistical issues throughout the project lifecycle.

E. Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Ensure detailing and fabrication documentation aligns with applicable Australian Standards and engineering specifications.
  • Maintain accurate records of drawings, revisions, material orders and production schedules.
  • Ensure material traceability and certification requirements are addressed where specified.
  • Identify errors or inconsistencies before fabrication commences.
  • Support workshop quality control and continuous improvement processes.

Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience in structural steel detailing, drafting or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience within the Australian residential construction industry.
  • Strong ability to interpret Australian architectural and structural engineering drawings.
  • Experience preparing structural steel shop drawings and material take-offs.
  • Understanding of common Australian structural steel sections and grades.
  • Experience coordinating material supply and procurement.
  • Experience managing workshop production schedules and delivery deadlines.
  • Strong organisational, communication and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience with residential steel fabrication companies.
  • Experience using AutoCAD, Tekla Structures, Advance Steel or equivalent drafting software.
  • Familiarity with Australian Standards, including AS 4100, AS/NZS 5131 and AS/NZS 1554, as applicable to the role.
  • Experience dealing directly with Australian steel merchants and suppliers.
  • Understanding of residential building construction sequences.
  • Experience coordinating steelwork for residential builders and construction companies.
  • Knowledge of fabrication processes, welding, cutting, drilling and workshop operations.

4. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)

The successful applicant will be assessed against the following performance measures:

  1. Drawing Accuracy: Accurate and complete shop drawings with minimal revisions resulting from detailing errors.
  2. Material Procurement: Materials ordered correctly and available before scheduled fabrication commencement.
  3. Production Scheduling: Effective scheduling of workshop jobs to meet agreed completion dates.
  4. Project Delivery: Projects completed and delivered within agreed timeframes.
  5. Material Efficiency: Effective material utilisation and minimisation of unnecessary wastage.
  6. Communication: Timely communication with builders, suppliers, engineers and workshop staff.
  7. Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining accurate records and documentation.
  8. Workshop Efficiency: Minimisation of production delays caused by incomplete drawings, missing materials or poor scheduling.

5. KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

The position will work closely with:

  • Company Directors and Management.
  • Workshop Supervisors and Fabricators.
  • Residential Builders and Project Managers.
  • Structural Engineers.
  • Steel Merchants and Material Suppliers.
  • Site Supervisors and Installation Teams.
  • External Drafting and Engineering Consultants.

6. EXPECTED OUTCOMES

The successful applicant will play an important role in establishing an efficient and coordinated workflow between project documentation, structural steel detailing, material procurement, workshop fabrication and site delivery.

The position is expected to improve:

  • Accuracy and consistency of shop drawings.
  • Material ordering and supply coordination.
  • Workshop production planning.
  • Project turnaround times.
  • Communication between the office and workshop.
  • Overall operational efficiency and project profitability.

7. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The ideal candidate will be proactive, organised and commercially minded, with the ability to understand both the technical and operational requirements of a structural steel fabrication business.

They should be comfortable taking ownership of projects, identifying potential problems before they arise and ensuring that drawings, materials and production schedules are coordinated effectively.

A strong understanding of Australian residential construction and the ability to manage a project from drawing through to material supply and workshop scheduling will be highly regarded.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.excerpt: American Avenue is a boutique property management company that owns & operates one of the nation’s largest portfolios of affordable single-family homes, a market segment which has proven to be as economically robust as it is socially good.
jobs.description:
American Avenue is a boutique property management company that owns & operates one of the nation’s largest portfolios of affordable single-family homes, a market segment which has proven to be as economically robust as it is socially good. We thrive as a business by offering what so many in our country need: an affordable, newly-renovated, well-maintained, dignified rental house to call home. Today we own 9,000+ homes in 20 states.

American Avenue|Lead Maintenance Operator
Overview

We take pride in the homes we offer to our residents. When maintenance fails, there is a real resident who we let down. We need an owner who takes that personally, makes a plan, and follows through without dropping the ball.

As a Lead Maintenance Operator, you will own complex maintenance escalations and vendor projects across an assigned portfolio. You'll manage the work from a central operations seat, partnering with residents, vendors, dispatchers, and Field teams. Expect a busy queue, hard conversations, and plenty of follow-up.

You love a shrinking backlog, a frustrated resident won back, and a job done right. You know construction, move without being chased, and make teammates better. Your work shows up directly in NOI - sensible spending, faster repairs, and residents who stay.

Your Mandate

  1. Own it until it's fixed: Get the facts, make the call, and put names and dates against the plan. Chase loose ends. If the first plan fails, bring a better one. Ask for help early with a recommendation, and stay on the case through resolution.
  1. Stay on top of vendors: Field teams scope the work. You own execution. A missed appointment or unanswered message gets a follow-up. Get firm commitments, keep residents informed, and verify that the work is done. Validate every dollar going out the door.
  1. An upset resident keeps you up at night: You care that someone is waiting on a repair in their home. Pick up the phone, listen, and stay calm when it gets tough. Give clear answers, make promises you can keep, and follow through to earn back their trust.
  1. Spend our money like it's yours: Know enough about construction to question a bid, spot unnecessary work, and push for a fair price. Hold the agreed scope and check completion evidence. If the repair falls short, get it fixed. Every dollar should buy work the home needs, done right.
  1. Make the people around you better: Help Field teams, dispatchers, and other partners get work unstuck. Share what you know and give direct, useful feedback. When the same problem keeps showing up, fix the process and write down the better way.

What excellent looks like

  • You OWN every outcome: Know the target and keep pushing. When a vendor goes quiet or a handoff breaks down, step in and get people moving. Stay accountable for the result.
  • No loose ends: Every day, work the queue, answer residents and vendors, and chase stalled jobs. Keep your inbox clear of unattended requests. Every open case has a next action, an owner, and a date.
  • Data is your best friend: Know what's open, what's late, and what's costing too much. Each week, dig into the dashboards and outliers, adjust your plan, and share results and blockers before anyone has to ask.
  • You leave the operation better: Each month, review results and needs with business partners. Turn recurring headaches into better processes, keep the playbook current, and coach teammates to raise their game.

How do we measure success?

We expect your effort to show up in the numbers. The headline measure is net operating income (NOI) versus goal. Know what's moving these measures and what you're doing about the gaps.

  1. NOI versus goal: Keep spending sensible, get projects finished faster, and prevent avoidable concessions and maintenance-driven move-outs. Own the effect your decisions have on your portfolio's economics.
  1. Open vendor workload: Know your backlog cold. Get jobs to verified completion and catch stalled work before someone else has to find it.
  1. Escalation throughput and graduation rate: Resolve tough cases and get homes out of escalation management. Fix recurring causes so the same issue stays fixed. Keep residents informed and hold the quality bar throughout.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, property management, vendor management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in maintenance operations, construction, facilities management, or property management, including complex repairs and vendor-led work.
  • Deep practical knowledge of residential building systems and construction, with the ability to evaluate repair plans, bids, workmanship, and cost tradeoffs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to de-escalate difficult situations while setting clear expectations and following through.
  • A record of owning complex cases or projects through resolution, exercising sound judgment under pressure, and working effectively without a complete playbook.
  • Experience holding vendors accountable for schedule, price, and quality; able to negotiate constructively and challenge unsupported changes.
  • You can work a large queue without dropping the ball. You prioritize, keep clear records, and follow up without being reminded.
  • You make teammates better through useful coaching, direct feedback, and practical improvements to how the work gets done.
  • You're comfortable running your day from a computer. You use dashboards to find problems and decide where to focus. Property management software experience is preferred.
  • Availability to support urgent maintenance escalations outside regular business hours as needed.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including salary, performance-based incentives, PTO, health and dental coverage, and a 401(k).
  • Comp will include a quarterly bonus (20%) and an annual NOI bonus tied to company performance
  • A team that cares as much as you do: We work hard and expect a lot from each other. If getting a difficult repair across the finish line makes your day, you'll have good company here.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we want to meet you.
