jobs.description:
Role: Senior Engineering Manager

Location: Remote, UK

Team: Development & AI

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent (37.5 hours)

Salary: Competitive, based on experience + benefits + package

Security Clearance Requirements

Please note that holding a current Security Clearance is not essential at the time of application, but eligibility is required.

This role requires the successful candidate to be eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. To meet this requirement, applicants must:

  • Have the right to work in the UK
  • Have lived in the UK continuously for the past 5 years
  • Not have spent more than 6 months outside the UK in total during that period
  • Be willing to undergo security vetting as part of the onboarding process

About Us

Come and be a part of The Investigo Group(TIG), a dynamic coalition of cutting-edge tech firms specialising in Platform, Software, Data, AI and other bleeding-edge technology solutions. Our innovative prowess spans the globe while proudly hailing from the United Kingdom.

The group is multi-functional with a large portfolio of B2B products and services.

Our ecosystem is made up of:

Voixtel, secure communications and voice platforms for regulated and critical environments.

IIS, Providing secure internet access in both the public and private sectors. Its mission? To deliver world-class secure internet capabilities enhancing productivity across diverse skillsets and organisations.

Vestigo Consulting is our training and consultancy company, tailored around specialist sector-specific knowledge, and provides regular courses and CPD for our community. The Consultancy side concentrates on expert support of our customers as well as specifically assigned individual deployments.

Collaboraite is a bleeding-edge company that provides our Data and AI capability. A collaborative partner for designing user-centred secure data solutions to overcome operational hurdles, delivered through design thinking and agile coaching.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are at the heart of The Investigo Group (TIG). We're dedicated to creating a workplace where people from all backgrounds are not only welcome but empowered to excel. We actively seek diverse talent, promote fairness, and foster an inclusive environment where every voice matters, driving innovation and progress in our dynamic tech community.

The group provides bespoke, secure, user-centric products fuelled by deep technical knowledge advanced data and analytical skills.

We proudly stand as a global leader in this space, partnering with esteemed entities that require these advanced forward-thinking capabilities. These partnerships have been forged from our understanding of customer challenges, as well as our expertise in developing world-leading enterprise product sets.

Join us at TIG, where innovation knows no bounds, and together, we'll shape the future of technology solutions for a safer, more efficient world.

About the Role

Are you an experienced Engineering Manager who genuinely enjoys developing people, building effective teams and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work?

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Development & AI organisation, taking a leading role in supporting our engineering people, strengthening management practices and helping our teams operate effectively as we continue to grow.

Our engineering organisation brings together a broad range of technical disciplines, each with different challenges, specialisms and development needs. As our teams evolve, we want to ensure our engineers have the leadership, support, career opportunities and working environment they need to succeed.

This is a senior, people-focused leadership position. You'll take ownership of day-to-day engineering management, working with both individual contributors and engineering managers to develop capability, improve collaboration and establish consistent, effective ways of working.

You'll also play an important role in engineering resource and capacity planning, recruitment, performance management and continuous improvement, helping ensure our teams have the right skills, structures and support to meet current and future priorities.

Importantly, this isn't a hands-on coding or technical architecture role. You'll need a strong understanding of software engineering and the challenges engineers face, but your real impact will come through developing people, improving organisational effectiveness and enabling great engineering work to happen.

Working closely with our Director of Development & AI, technical leadership and product stakeholders, you'll help shape a positive, collaborative and sustainable engineering environment.

If you're passionate about engineering leadership, enjoy solving organisational challenges and believe that great teams are built through trust, accountability and genuine investment in people, we'd love to hear from you.

About the team

You'll join our Development & AI organisation, working with talented engineers across frontend, backend, full-stack, desktop development, machine learning engineering (MLE) and quality assurance (QA).

Our teams work with a diverse technology stack, including:

  • Backend: Go (Golang), Java and Python
  • Frontend: React and TypeScript
  • Desktop: C#/.NET
  • Machine Learning Engineering: Python
  • Engineering practices: Cloud-native development, CI/CD, automated testing and modern software delivery

We work across a range of interesting technical challenges, from mobile emulation and streaming technologies to sovereign AI platforms and other specialist software solutions.

Our engineering structure includes dedicated technical leadership responsible for architecture, engineering standards and technical direction.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you'll work alongside these technical specialists, providing complementary leadership focused on people, management capability, engineering culture and team effectiveness.

We value technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, personal ownership and continuous improvement. We're looking for someone who can help us build on those foundations and create an environment where engineers feel supported, challenged and empowered to develop.

What You'll Be Doing

    • Providing visible, approachable and effective leadership to engineers and engineering managers, creating an environment built on trust, accountability and collaboration.
    • Coaching, mentoring and developing individual contributors, existing managers and emerging engineering leaders.
    • Establishing consistent people management practices, including regular one-to-ones, constructive feedback, performance reviews and personal development planning.
    • Supporting engineers with career development, progression opportunities and clear expectations across different engineering disciplines.
    • Managing performance and addressing people-related challenges fairly, proactively and constructively, working alongside our People team where appropriate.
    • Taking ownership of engineering resource and capacity planning, ensuring our teams have the right people and capabilities to support business and delivery priorities.
    • Working with the Director of Development & AI and recruitment teams on hiring priorities, workforce planning, onboarding, retention and future skills requirements.
    • Identifying organisational bottlenecks, inefficient processes and opportunities to improve how engineering teams collaborate and deliver.
    • Working closely with product, delivery and technical leadership to improve planning, communication, dependencies and delivery predictability.
    • Helping establish meaningful measures of team health, engineering effectiveness and continuous improvement.
    • Supporting positive engineering practices that balance delivery commitments with sustainable workloads, individual wellbeing and long-term development.
    • Providing clear visibility of engineering capacity, capability gaps, organisational risks and development needs to senior stakeholders.

About You

More than anything, we're looking for an experienced, approachable and people-focused engineering leader who genuinely enjoys helping others succeed.

You'll understand that successful engineering management is about much more than tracking delivery or managing workloads. It's about building trust, developing capability, supporting individuals through challenges and creating the conditions for teams to perform consistently well.

You'll be comfortable having difficult conversations, addressing performance concerns and making balanced decisions that combine empathy with accountability.

You'll also be someone who can recognise when engineering processes or organisational structures aren't working effectively, bring people together to understand the challenges and introduce practical improvements without adding unnecessary complexity.

We'd particularly welcome candidates who have progressed from a software engineering background into management and understand the different challenges faced by engineers working across multiple technical disciplines.

You don't need to be the most technically knowledgeable person in the room. What matters is having the credibility to engage with technical specialists, an appreciation of modern engineering practices and the confidence to lead through people rather than technical authority.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't simply about managing teams or introducing new processes. It's about building an engineering organisation where people have the leadership and support they need, teams work effectively together and delivery becomes increasingly predictable and sustainable.

Within your first three months, you'll have built trusted relationships across the engineering organisation, developed an understanding of our people, strengths and challenges, and identified the opportunities where your leadership can make the biggest difference.

Within six months, you'll be helping establish more consistent management and development practices, clearer expectations for engineers and managers, and practical improvements to planning, communication and collaboration across teams.

Within twelve months, we want to see an engineering organisation where people feel supported in their careers, managers are confident and effective, teams collaborate well, and leadership has greater visibility of engineering capacity and delivery risks.

Ultimately, you'll help us build an environment that can continue to grow and evolve without unnecessary bureaucracy, where engineers feel both supported and challenged to do their best work.

Requirements

Skills & Experience We Are Looking For

You don't need to tick every box. We're interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong engineering management experience, genuine leadership capability and a track record of helping individuals and teams succeed.

People Leadership & Development

  • Proven experience in software engineering management, with significant responsibility for people leadership, development and team effectiveness.
  • Experience managing individual contributors and engineering managers, or a demonstrable ability to lead through other managers.
  • A strong track record of coaching, mentoring and developing engineers at different stages of their careers.
  • Experience establishing effective performance management, feedback and career development practices.
  • Confidence managing complex people situations, including underperformance, interpersonal challenges and organisational change.
  • The ability to build positive, inclusive team environments that balance individual wellbeing with accountability and delivery expectations.

Engineering Management & Operations

  • Experience improving engineering working practices, team coordination, resource planning and delivery effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering environments and the challenges involved in multidisciplinary software delivery.
  • Experience working with product and delivery stakeholders to improve prioritisation, planning and delivery predictability.
  • Ability to identify organisational bottlenecks and introduce proportionate, practical improvements.
  • Experience developing or implementing career frameworks, competency expectations or structured progression pathways.
  • Experience managing remote or distributed engineering teams.
  • Strong organisational awareness, stakeholder management and communication skills.

Technical Understanding & Collaboration

  • A solid understanding of modern software development lifecycles, CI/CD, automated testing and software delivery practices.
  • Sufficient technical knowledge to understand engineering challenges, engage with specialists and contribute meaningfully to engineering planning discussions.
  • Ability to work effectively alongside dedicated technical leaders, respecting the distinction between technical direction and people management.
  • Confidence translating technical and delivery challenges into appropriate people, capability or organisational actions.

Expert-level knowledge of our specific programming languages or frameworks isn't required, and this position does not involve routine hands-on development.

We're more interested in your ability to understand the challenges facing engineering teams and demonstrate how your leadership has helped people and organisations improve.

Nice to Have

Experience or exposure to some of the following would be beneficial:

  • Managing multidisciplinary teams spanning frontend, backend, full-stack, desktop development, machine learning engineering or QA.
  • Experience within cloud-native, SaaS, desktop software or other modern product-led technology environments.
  • Supporting engineering organisations through growth, transformation or changes to team structures.
  • Developing engineering career ladders, management frameworks or leadership development programmes.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Lean practices, engineering delivery metrics and continuous improvement approaches.
  • Experience partnering with Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Technical Leads or other dedicated technical leadership roles.
  • Formal management, coaching or leadership development training.

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline may be beneficial, but isn't essential. We value demonstrable engineering management capability, relevant experience and proven leadership outcomes over formal qualifications.

Benefits

    • Private Medical & Health Cash Plan
    • 4x Life Assurance
    • Inclusive Culture: Enjoy an inclusive culture and environment.
    • Holiday: Generous holiday allowance.
    • Learning: Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
    • Bonus Potential: Bonus potential based on performance and business-related factors.
    • Pension: Pension scheme contributions.
    • EV Car Scheme
    • More Benefits: Explore additional benefits on our career site.

How to Apply

Please note that the talent acquisition team is managing this vacancy directly and we do not require agency support.

Candidates who are successful will be required to undergo relevant security checks.

Our Process

Our talent acquisition team will be in touch if you're successful, the team will arrange a short screening call (max 30 minutes) to learn more about you, and what you are looking for and answer any questions you may have. If all goes well, the team will share your profile with the hiring manager for review. Our interview process is tailored to each role.

As an inclusive employer, please inform us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Equal Opportunities

Here at TIG we are committed to equal opportunities and value diversity, equity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As a Group, we seek to ensure that individuals with disabilities receive reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process and ultimately within the job itself. Please contact us to request any accommodations.

Change Management Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Change Management Director is responsible for developing and leading the organization's change management strategy to ensure successful adoption of business transformation, organizational restructuring, digital initiatives, process improvements, and strategic transformation programmes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide change initiatives involving operating model redesign, technology implementation, regulatory changes, organizational culture, workforce transformation, and business process modernization.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to minimize resistance to change, strengthen organizational readiness, engage stakeholders, and ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate organizational transformation objectives into structured change management plans.
  • Lead change management activities across strategic programmes, projects, and business units.
  • Establish change governance structures, standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Advise executive leadership on organizational readiness, change impacts, and adoption strategies.

B. Organizational Transformation & Change Implementation

  • Lead organizational change initiatives involving restructuring, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
  • Assess the impact of strategic changes on employees, processes, systems, and organizational structures.
  • Develop change implementation roadmaps, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate change activities across business functions to ensure consistent implementation.
  • Ensure new processes, systems, and organizational structures are effectively embedded into daily operations.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Work closely with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners to build commitment to change.
  • Lead executive communication, employee engagement, and organizational awareness initiatives.
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage resistance to organizational changes.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to monitor employee sentiment and change readiness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Management

  • Lead change management activities associated with digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and new business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT and technology teams to assess the organizational impact of system implementations.
  • Develop training programmes, user adoption strategies, and technology transition plans.
  • Monitor technology adoption and ensure employees effectively transition to new digital working practices.

E. Culture, People & Workforce Transformation

  • Partner with HR leadership to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to promote cultural transformation, leadership alignment, and employee engagement.
  • Identify capability gaps and develop workforce training and development strategies.
  • Support leadership teams in managing organizational transitions and behavioral changes.
  • Promote a culture of adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify potential risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to minimize disruption.
  • Monitor change adoption, employee engagement, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure change initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Benefits Realization & Performance Monitoring

  • Define change management KPIs and adoption metrics.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of change communication, training, and implementation activities.
  • Measure employee adoption, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness.
  • Evaluate whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for executive leadership and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational transformation, business transformation, or organizational development.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide change initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and benefits realization.
  • Experience managing change associated with digital transformation, technology implementation, restructuring, and operating model redesign.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Professional certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of enterprise-wide change management strategies.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Effectiveness of change communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive feedback.
  • Compliance with change governance and reporting requirements.

Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Transformation Director is responsible for leading and driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business growth, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees strategic transformation programmes involving digital innovation, business process reengineering, operating model redesign, technology modernization, organizational restructuring, regulatory compliance, and cultural change.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, business unit heads, technology teams, and external partners to translate corporate strategy into actionable transformation initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes, sustainable change adoption, and improved organizational performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Translate corporate objectives into strategic transformation initiatives, programmes, and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, operational improvement, digitalization, and organizational growth.
  • Align transformation priorities with business strategy, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Process & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead business process reengineering initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Evaluate existing operating models and recommend organizational, structural, and operational improvements.
  • Drive simplification, standardization, and automation of business processes.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, cost inefficiencies, and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable improvements across business functions.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead digital transformation initiatives involving automation, cloud adoption, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise technology modernization.
  • Oversee the implementation of digital platforms, business applications, and technology-enabled operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT leadership to ensure technology investments support business priorities.
  • Promote digital innovation across insurance operations, investment management, customer services, and distribution channels.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives improve data quality, system integration, security, and operational resilience.

D. Programme & Portfolio Leadership

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio and major change programmes.
  • Establish transformation governance frameworks, delivery structures, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Monitor programme milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Coordinate programme directors, project managers, business leaders, and external consultants.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs, improve profitability, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial benefits, and return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to measure the financial and operational impact of transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Culture Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management strategies to support transformation adoption.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop change communication, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Build organizational readiness and address resistance to change.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure new processes, technologies, and operating models are effectively adopted across the organization.

G. Stakeholder, Risk & Regulatory Management

  • Engage executive leadership, board members, regulators, business partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Identify and manage strategic, operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Present transformation progress, performance metrics, challenges, and recommendations to executive committees and the board.
  • Ensure effective governance, transparency, and accountability throughout the transformation lifecycle.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in business transformation, corporate strategy, organizational development, consulting, or enterprise programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior transformation leadership or director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of digital transformation, business process reengineering, operating model design, and organizational change management.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale transformation portfolios, budgets, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong financial analysis, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation objectives and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation initiatives delivered within approved timelines and budgets.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost reduction, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in business process efficiency and productivity.
  • Digital adoption and technology implementation success rates.
  • Employee engagement, change readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational risks and process inefficiencies.
  • Executive stakeholder satisfaction and transformation governance effectiveness.

  3. Experience scaling financial platforms to process millions of dollars monthly across multiple countries.
  4. Familiarity with SOC 2, PCI DSS, or financial audit requirements.
  5. Experience with stablecoin or crypto-based payment infrastructure.
  6. Experience building internal finance tools, reconciliation dashboards, or payment operations platforms.
  7. Experience leveraging AI coding agents and AI-assisted development workflows in production engineering.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a HRIS Associate in our People Systems area in the United States! This is a Remote – US position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in based in the US and that candidates living in New York can work as hybrid.

Reporting within People Systems and partnering closely with People Operations, IT, Finance, and Payroll, this is a hands-on systems role helping power Wellhub’s international scale—configuring and maintaining Workday architectures as we expand into new European markets (such as France and Austria), automating employee lifecycle journeys (leaves, allowances, probation, offboarding), and streamlining processes to eliminate administrative friction.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Global Market Expansion & Country Setups: Partner with People Ops, Payroll, and Legal to configure, test, and deploy country-specific Workday foundational setups (e.g., statutory leaves, mandatory compliance fields, local onboarding/probation milestones) supporting Wellhub’s growth across EMEA and the Americas.
  • Workday Configuration & Module Ownership: Own day-to-day maintenance of 1–2 core Workday modules, business process framework (BPF) updates, calculated fields, condition rules, and security role assignments, becoming a primary go-to resource for the team.
  • Mass Data Uploads & Data Integrity: Prepare, validate, and execute bulk data loads (EIBs) and conduct systematic audits across worker records, compensation data, and leave balances to keep Workday as our single source of truth.
  • People Ops Automation & Process Redesign: Identify bottlenecks in recurring manual workflows (such as Jira-based tracking or spreadsheets) and help transition them into structured, automated Workday workflows, self-service features, and clear employee knowledge guides.
  • Cross-Functional Support & Ticket Management: Manage incoming JIRA service desk requests from HR, Finance, and Payroll, resolving workflow exceptions and providing responsive, customer-centric support across multiple concurrent priorities.
  • AI-Augmented Operational Efficiency: Utilize existing productivity and enterprise AI tools—including Workday’s AI Agent, Gemini for Workspace, and NotebookLM—to accelerate troubleshooting, validate data quality, and maintain internal documentation.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • HRIS & Workday Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on HRIS experience with system configuration/administrative access; hands-on Workday experience (Core HCM, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, or Business Process management) is strongly preferred.
  • Strong Data & Spreadsheet Skills: Solid proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, data reconciliation) with strong attention to detail for preparing and auditing mass data uploads (EIBs).
  • Multitasking & Customer-Service Mindset: Proven ability to manage multiple competing requests from stakeholders across HR, Finance, and Payroll while maintaining clear, empathetic communication.
  • Adaptability in Fast-Paced Environments: Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a rapidly scaling global organization, eager to learn new modules and propose practical system improvements.
  • AI Tool Fluency: Enthusiastic about applying built-in AI tools (such as Workday AI agents and Gemini) in day-to-day workflows to solve problems faster and improve accuracy.
  • Communication & Working Hours: Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English are required. Flexibility to work core business hours aligned to EST or CST.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in HRIS and Excel are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

In New York, California, Colorado, Massachusetts, and Washington, the annual base salary range for this role is $66534 - $70015. The base salary range for other locations may vary. Actual base salary will be dependent on geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications and/or other job-related factors.In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in either our annual bonus plan or a sales incentive plan, and our performance-based stock option program.

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold-level membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and vision insurance. Access to telehealth, care concierge, and an Employee Assistance Program.

FINANCIAL WELLNESS: Plan for your future with 401(k) match, short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

  • Our US HQ is in New York City. We are currently set up to hire in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Missouri, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Hampshire, New York, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days PTO per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer up to 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. For parents giving birth, we offer up to 18 weeks paid leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while you get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
Enterprise Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Enterprise Transformation Director is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy to improve business performance, operational efficiency, financial sustainability, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role drives large-scale transformation initiatives across business operations, technology, organizational structures, digital capabilities, governance, and customer-facing services.

The incumbent translates corporate strategy into an integrated transformation roadmap, oversees strategic programmes and transformation portfolios, and ensures initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role works closely with the CEO, executive leadership, business unit heads, and external partners to drive sustainable organizational change and achieve strategic objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy, vision, and execution roadmap.
  • Translate corporate strategy into transformation priorities, strategic initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, organizational improvement, operational modernization, and sustainable growth.
  • Align transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide operating model redesign and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing business structures, processes, capabilities, and operating models to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive business process reengineering, simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Oversee transformation of insurance operations, investment services, distribution channels, and customer service functions.
  • Improve organizational agility, productivity, cost efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Oversee enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and digital business solutions.
  • Lead modernization and integration of enterprise applications, core insurance systems, investment platforms, and customer management technologies.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership to ensure digital investments support business strategy.
  • Promote innovation, data-driven decision-making, and technology-enabled business growth.

D. Transformation Portfolio & Programme Governance

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio, programmes, and major initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise transformation governance frameworks, performance controls, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor transformation milestones, budgets, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate transformation directors, programme managers, project leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital and resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial performance, and expected return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to track financial and non-financial outcomes.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Cultural Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management and organizational development strategies.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to drive workforce transformation, leadership alignment, and cultural change.
  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

G. Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee transformation-related strategic, operational, financial, technology, and compliance risks.
  • Collaborate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen governance and controls.
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational resilience, data governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure transformation programmes maintain appropriate oversight, accountability, and auditability.

H. Executive Stakeholder & Board Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, board members, executive committees, and business unit leaders.
  • Present transformation strategies, performance reports, financial outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead enterprise transformation steering committees and executive review meetings.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, strategic partners, technology providers, and regulators.
  • Ensure executive alignment and accountability for transformation outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or executive programme leadership.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior director-level or enterprise transformation leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong expertise in operating model redesign, business process reengineering, digital transformation, and organizational change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large transformation portfolios, budgets, executive stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong financial management, strategic planning, governance, and benefits realization capabilities.
  • Certifications such as PgMP, PMP, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation strategy and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation programmes delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost savings, revenue growth, and productivity improvements.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.
  • Digital adoption and technology modernization success rates.
  • Employee engagement, organizational readiness, and change adoption.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Executive and board-level stakeholder satisfaction.

jobs.description:
Our mission is to become the financial and revenue operating system for primary care practices.

We help dental and veterinary clinics manage how money flows into the practice — from patient access and onboarding, to payments, memberships, financing, insurance, and reporting — in one coherent system.

Rather than treating payments, plans, and finance as separate tools, we combine them into a single operating layer that reflects how practices actually run their business.

There are three structural shifts reshaping primary care right now:

  1. Patient access is moving beyond opening hours. Clinics are under pressure to be available when patients want to engage, not just when the front desk is staffed. Voice and chat interfaces are becoming the new front door to care.

  2. Revenue is becoming structured, not ad-hoc. Memberships, financing, and insurance are increasingly used to smooth cashflow, improve access, and increase predictability — particularly as NHS capacity declines and private care expands.

  3. Practices need better financial insight, not more software. Owners and managers want to understand whether their pricing, plans, and utilisation make economic sense — without becoming analysts or relying on opaque tools.

Today, we support over 6,000 dental practices across the UK. 100 more join our platform every month. Tabeo is the dominant market leader for patient finance and seeks to dominate membership plans next. Beyond payments, we are launching a voice/chatAI solution that complements our existing products.

At Lucky 21, we're dedicated to reshaping online retail through innovative strategies, technology, and operational excellence. We partner with established brands to grow and manage their presence across Amazon and Walmart.com, focusing on sustainable growth, compliance, and profitability.

As an Amazon & Walmart Marketplace Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting and maintaining our brands' presence across Amazon and Walmart.com.

You will work closely with our US-based brand managers and internal teams to ensure listings are accurate, marketplace issues are resolved, compliance requirements are met, and day-to-day operations run smoothly.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Directory
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Inaccurate provider directory data is one of the most persistent and costly problems in U.
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Inaccurate provider directory data is one of the most persistent and costly problems in U.S. healthcare. Members cannot reliably tell which clinicians are in network and accepting new patients, health plans carry real regulatory exposure under the No Surprises Act and CMS directory accuracy requirements, and providers are asked to verify the same information for dozens of payers. DataSpring sits at the center of that problem. Provider Directory is one of our highest-growth product lines, and we are investing to take it from a data asset to the market-leading directory solution for health plans.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Product Manager to own the success and evolution of DataSpring's Provider Directory product and domain. It pairs deep expertise in provider directory data and health plan directory operations with accountability for domain outcomes — from market and customer need through strategy, solution, funded delivery, commercialization, adoption, and performance. Provider Directory is the primary focus of this role, with secondary accountability for how Directory extends the broader Provider Data portfolio and our Universal Provider Data asset. This role will identify and evaluate new market and adjacent opportunities, ensure product strategy is aligned with industry mandates and regulatory considerations, and partner closely with UX, Technology, Data Science, and delivery teams to shape ideation, roadmap formation, and solution design, then steer delivery against committed outcomes — going deep into execution detail when a release, dependency, or escalation calls for it.

The Principal Product Manager owns the roadmap, the commercial model, and the KPIs that measure adoption, revenue, margin, and directory data quality. This is a multi-team influence role, setting direction across Technology, UX, Marketing, Sales, and Account Management and leading matrixed and contracted resources without direct reporting authority. The role engages health plan executives and buyers, provider organizations, and industry stakeholders, bringing fluency in buyer needs, procurement cycles, and directory operations, including network management, data intake, maintenance, outreach, and data verification, to improve how provider information is collected, governed, validated, and used across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Principal Product Manager is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Senior Director, Product Strategy and Management – Provider Data.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Own the success and evolution of the Provider Directory product and domain end to end, including growth of the existing Directory offering with health plans and its connection to the Universal Provider Data.
  • Identify and prioritize new market opportunities through customer discovery, competitive analysis, and business cases to guide investment decisions. Translate market needs, user personas, workflows, and data use cases into solution concepts, roadmap priorities, and product requirements.
  • Ensure strategy and roadmap reflect industry mandates, data governance expectations, directory accuracy and data quality standards, and interoperability requirements.
  • Validate concepts with advisory groups, customers, and industry stakeholders, including proofs of concept that inform commercialization and roadmap decisions.
  • Own the full product lifecycle for Provider Directory — strategy, concept, build, launch, growth, maturity, and retirement — setting the roadmap and funding case, and holding delivery teams to committed scope, timing, and outcomes while managing day-to-day execution when required. Serve as a subject‑matter expert and external advocate for Provider Directory, articulating strategic value to drive adoption and industry engagement.
  • Secure funding and resourcing for the roadmap through annual planning, weighing priorities against business objectives and customer need, and confirm work is ready for delivery teams.
  • Partner with Technology and UX to translate the business case into solution direction and requirements, and stay close enough to delivery to arbitrate tradeoffs and unblock decisions, working in the detail when a release demands it.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and run market sizing and buyer analysis to identify differentiation and inform roadmap and go-to-market priorities.
  • Own packaging, and value proposition for Provider Directory offerings, with the business cases and ROI models behind them, to drive revenue growth, margin, and market expansion with health plans.
  • Influence go-to-market and commercialization for Provider Directory with Marketing, Sales, and Account Management — supporting positioning, value narratives, sales enablement, and reference use cases — and lead launch readiness across pilots, proofs of concept, and general availability.
  • Define, monitor, and report the KPIs tied to business cases and the annual plan, — adoption, revenue, margin, and directory data quality — and use them to guide ongoing investment.
  • Champion provider data accuracy, validation, and directory maintenance capabilities — source-of-truth reconciliation, continuous data quality monitoring, practitioner and primary source validation — as core differentiators of DataSpring's Directory solutions.

Skills

  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to lead market analysis, customer discovery, and competitive intelligence and translate complex market, business, and healthcare data insights into clear product strategy and investment recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing provider directory data at scale, including data quality management; source-of-truth reconciliation across multiple contributing systems; provider verification of accuracy and primary source validation workflows; and identification, measurement, and remediation of directory data defects.
  • Expertise in developing compelling business cases, including financial modeling, ROI analysis, and growth potential assessment, to support prioritization and funding decisions.
  • Ability to define user personas, data use cases, and end-to-end solution concepts that connect customer problems to business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated capability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders—including Product Management, UX, Technology, Data Science, Operations, Marketing, and external partners—without direct authority, in a high-growth, matrixed environment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate strategy, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, balancing strategic vision with pragmatic constraints in a fast‑paced, evolving market environment.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, including experience engaging customers, advisory groups, and industry stakeholders to validate strategy and inform product direction.
  • Proven ability to carry a roadmap through delivery — building the investment case that secures funding, framing scope, risk, and dependency tradeoffs, and holding teams to committed outcomes — with the technical fluency to engage in execution detail when needed.
  • Deep understanding of health plan buyer needs, procurement cycles, and provider directory operational workflows, including network management, provider data intake, directory maintenance, accuracy, and outreach.
  • Experience setting pricing, packaging, and positioning for data products and partnering with Marketing, Sales, and Account Management to drive adoption and expansion.

Experience & Education

  • 10+ years of product management, product strategy, data science, or healthcare data solutions experience, preferably within payer, provider, or health care information technology vendors.
  • Experience in supporting product development through engagement with a heavily vendor-driven development approach.
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance drivers behind provider directory accuracy — including No Surprises Act directory provisions, CMS Medicare Advantage and Medicaid directory accuracy requirements, and state network adequacy rules — and experience translating those requirements into data quality expectations and product decisions.
  • Domain experience in healthcare technology and data solutions, including privileging, data management, data governance, interoperability, and/or provider operations.
  • Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, business cases, and investment opportunities to executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with the provider directory and provider data vendor landscape.
  • Demonstrated success owning a product or domain end to end through a period of rapid growth, including launch and commercialization with health plan customers.
  • Experience managing network adequacy a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Degrees in healthcare administration, public health, or technology disciplines preferred.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. SUMMARY

The FP&A Manager owns Civia’s annual budget and monthly forecast processes and gives leadership the financial insight it needs to make decisions. This role performs variance analysis, maintains the company headcount model, supports cash flow forecasting, and builds financial models, scenarios and business cases. Partnering closely with business leaders, operations and accounting, the FP&A Manager makes sure budgets, headcount plans and revenue projections are realistic, aligned with operational outputs and consistent with US GAAP.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budget and monthly forecast processes.

  • Support cash flow forecasting.

  • Maintain the company headcount model.

Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform variance analysis of actual results against budget and forecast.

  • Prepare management and executive-level financial reporting and analysis.

Business Partnership

  • Partner with business leaders on budgets, headcount and financial performance.

  • Partner with operations and accounting to ensure revenue projections align with both operational outputs and US GAAP.

Financial Modeling & Decision Support

  • Develop financial models, scenarios and business cases to support decision-making.

REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of FP&A or corporate finance experience.

  • Proven experience owning annual budget and forecast processes.

  • Advanced financial modeling skills, including scenario analysis and business cases.

  • Working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition.

  • Ability to present financial results and insights clearly to business leaders and executives.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with ERP or planning systems.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • MBA or CPA.

  • Experience in clinical research, CRO, life sciences or healthcare.

  • Experience with NetSuite or a planning tool (e.g., Adaptive, Pigment).

  • Experience in a growth-stage or start-up environment.

jobs.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: HR/Benefits Coordinator

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The HR/Benefits Coordinator supports day-to-day HR operations, employee benefits administration, onboarding, compliance tracking, employee records, and general employee support. This role is a key point of contact for employees and managers, helping ensure HR and Talent processes are accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-friendly.

The HR/Benefits Coordinator is organized, responsive, discreet, and comfortable working with employee data, talent acquisition, HR systems, and benefits-related processes.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Serve as the point of contact for new hires after they accept their offers through Talent Acquisition through their onboarding date; onboarding facilitation backup
  • Coordinate, follow-up and enter employee onboarding, offboarding, and employment changes in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate employee records, I-9 verifications, E-Verify, I-9 processing, benefits documentation, and HR compliance materials
  • Support benefits administration, including enrollments, qualifying life events, employee questions, carrier coordination, and open enrollment preparation
  • Assist employees with benefits-related questions and escalate complex issues to HR leadership, brokers, carriers, or vendors as needed
  • Track required documentation, acknowledgments, policy forms, and compliance-related employee submissions; enter employee data into background check platforms
  • Support leave administration, reports, workers’ compensation coordination, and accommodation request tracking as directed
  • Help prepare HR reports related to headcount, benefits participation, onboarding, compliance, and employee data changes
  • Coordinate HR communications (HR Tickets, HR Inbox), reminders, and employee-facing materials
  • Partner with payroll to ensure benefit deductions, employment changes, and employee data updates are processed accurately
  • Support HR audits by gathering records, reconciling data, and identifying missing or inconsistent information
  • Coordinate and communicate company equipment, shipping/packaging logistics
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information with discretion
  • Assist with HR projects, process improvements, employee engagement efforts, and policy updates (HR Employee Hub)

Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time with strong attention to detail

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (INTERMEDIATE LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Prior experience in HR, benefits administration, payroll support, office administration, or employee operations preferred; Rippling HRIS experience a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
  • Comfortable handling confidential employee information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, payroll, benefits, or document management systems preferred.
  • Working knowledge of employee benefits, onboarding, compliance documentation, and HR processes is a plus.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and standard business software.
  • Accuracy and follow-through
  • Benefits administration support
  • Confidentiality and sound judgment
  • Process coordination
  • Vendor and carrier communication
  • Data entry and recordkeeping
  • HR compliance awareness
  • Employee-service mindset
  • Problem-solving and escalation judgment

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Department Overview

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution. We rely on our team's expertise to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology, and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.


Job Details

Salesforce Experience Design is a group of passionate designers who build transformational experiences by turning human insights into business impact at Salesforce scale.


We partner with our technical and solution competencies, to support our FInancial Services, Health and Life Sciences verticals, and help customers unleash the full power of Salesforce through a design-centric approach delivering useful, usable and desirable experiences.


Our work environment appeals to self-motivated, flexible team players that have great interpersonal skills and lots of curiosity. We believe in peer relationships rather than hierarchies; in teams rather than lone thinkers. Salesforce is all about an open collaborative approach and we think it is the key enabler for us to deliver innovative, ground-breaking work. Our designers follow a consultant mindset including working with different Salesforce colleagues across various engagements, willingness to travel when required and understanding the value of working on site.


We are looking for a passionate and pragmatic design thinker who is eager to join a fun, collaborative and innovative team. The focus of the role is interactive—web and mobile applications, interactive design and user experience. The Sr. Experience Architect serves as the project leader and main point person for Experience Design engagements. He/she is responsible for leading the experience strategy and establishing and maintaining the highest quality of execution across all work. He/She will be responsible for the vision for an engagement as well as being able to lead multidisciplinary project teams. The Experience Architect must always provide team leadership, build strong partnerships and foster collaboration with the customer.


We believe the best Sr. Experience Architects are those who obsess over the creation of customer and business value. They have a customer-centric and collaborative mentality, a willingness to commit to the customer, and the drive to break down barriers to ensure customer success.


Responsibilities

Success will be measured by your contribution and collaboration within the Experience Design group — leading, advising and aligning project teams and customers to create successful outcomes and ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction.   • Manage research initiatives and synthesize insights from complex data sets to inform strategic decisions

Client Engagement
