  • Collaborate with internal team members to structure project work, plan and execute client proposals
  • Identify new business opportunities and be able to connect appropriate people to support
  • Lead and drive key experience design activities throughout a project’s lifecycle including research, workshops, and conducting interviews and synthesizing
  • Multi-task and perform well under pressure in a constantly changing environment with key stakeholders and teams
  • Build close relationships with customers and key stakeholders and ensure project teams and client understand roles, responsibilities and vision of project

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coordinate and manage the work of a project team either independently or in conjunction with key project team members
  • Manage and maintain team motivation and morale
  • Identify and resolve or escalate issues and conflicts within the project team
  • Engage and partner with external clients and other partners when required
  • Manage a project team of Experience Design colleagues with multidisciplinary backgrounds including visual design, interaction design, information architecture, etc.

Minimum Requirements

  • At least 10-12 years of experience in experience design, interaction design, or related fields

  • Strong proficiency with AI tools (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms) for innovation, efficiency, and day-to-day design work
  • Expert visual design and prototyping capabilities; ability to translate complex concepts into actionable designs
  • Strong research and synthesis skills; ability to extract insights from qualitative and quantitative data
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams to create impactful customer solutions.

  • Proven experience designing applications that balance user needs, business requirements, commercial interests and technological constraints
  • Proficient in relevant software packages (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, UX-related, Prototyping (InVision, Flinto, Marvel, Proto.io), etc.)
  • Well-versed in technology and software development as it relates to design
  • Proactive, self-sufficient and professional, with strong organizational, time management and communication skills
  • Passionate and enthusiastic about delivering design and user experience excellence
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP or other enterprise software
  • Experience working across a variety of industries, including B2B and B2C
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g., extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant (Sandia Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

Are you a problem-solver who loves turning complexity into clarity? We’re looking for a Business Systems Consultant (BSC I, II, or III)—depending on your experience—to join our Annuity Modernization CAPSIL Administration team. In this role, you’ll keep our systems running smoothly, lead process improvements, develop test automation, and help coach and mentor newer BSAs. If you’re the kind of person who speaks up, drives results, and enjoys guiding others, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
    • Business Systems Consultant I: $75,500-97,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Consultant II: $86,000-$114,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Consultant III: $99,000-$133,500, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead requirements gathering, hypothesis development, and gap analysis while guiding and mentoring Business Systems Analysts (BSAs) to deliver high-quality outputs.
  • Direct cross-functional initiatives and process improvements, aligning workflows, compliance, and business objectives across teams.
  • Oversee test strategy development (manual and automated), including planning, prioritization, quality review, and execution.
  • Build business cases and drive change initiatives, including vendor management, stakeholder communication, and adoption of Agile and project management practices.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Solid business analysis skills with 5 + years of proven experience gathering requirements, analyzing workflows, and supporting system or process changes.
  • Strong attention to detail, communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to speak up, influence decisions, and build relationships across teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment—skilled at prioritizing, problem-solving, and driving results.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, or similar methodologies.
  • Strong skills in process mapping, event driven architecture and understanding complex system integrations.
  • You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Insurance industry knowledge (life, health, annuities, or pensions).

jobs.title: Manager, DevOps
jobs.excerpt: Supplier. io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on.
jobs.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Manager, DevOps is a hands-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down.

What You Will Do

  1. Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities.
  1. Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding.
  1. Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards.
  1. Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems.
  1. Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments.

o Conflict Resolution: Address interpersonal or team-level disagreements early through objective, empathetic mediation.

o Communication and Collaboration: Maintain open, two-way communication channels through regular one-on-ones and team updates.

o Empowerment and Delegation: Delegate meaningful responsibilities to encourage team ownership and avoid micromanagement.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

jobs.excerpt: About the role: Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations.
jobs.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience or an equivelant combination of education and experience

  • Demonstrate experience in leading enterprise leadership capability strategies, experience redesigning leadership models for AI, digital transformation and organizational change

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Job Description:

A DXC Technology ajuda empresas globais em seus sistemas e operações de missão crítica modernizando TI, otimizando arquiteturas de dados e garantindo segurança e escalabilidade em nuvem pública, privada e híbrida. As maiores empresas e organizações de setor público confiam na DXC para implantar serviços para impulsionar novos níveis de desempenho, competitividade e experiência do cliente em suas propriedades de TI. Saiba mais sobre como entregamos excelência para nossos clientes e colegas em DXC.com.

Na DXC, usamos o poder da tecnologia para oferecer serviços de TI essenciais que nossos clientes precisam para modernizar suas operações e impulsionar a inovação em todo o seu ambiente de TI. Fornecemos serviços em toda a Enterprise Technology Stack para terceirização de processos de negócios, seguros, análises e engenharia, aplicações, segurança, nuvem, terceirização de TI e ambiente de trabalho moderno.

Nossos serviços de aplicações DXC ajudam nossos clientes a otimizar e transformar operações, reduzir custos e aumentar a agilidade na abertura de novos canais de crescimento. Nossas pessoas, tecnologias e melhores práticas melhoram e automatizam processos de negócios altamente complexos – nos setores de Analytics, desenvolvimento de sistemas, sustentação de sistemas, enquanto promovem a transformação da experiência do cliente.

Funções Essenciais do Cargo:

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos de tecnologia de ponta a ponta, garantindo escopo, prazo, qualidade, orçamento e entregas.
  • Conduzir planejamento, acompanhamento de cronogramas, riscos, dependências e planos de ação.
  • Coordenar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Atuar diretamente com Account Managers, apoiando o entendimento das necessidades dos clientes e das oportunidades relacionadas aos projetos.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders, conduzindo reuniões de acompanhamento e apresentações executivas.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos e direcionamentos claros para as equipes técnicas.
  • Utilizar sua experiência técnica para compreender arquiteturas, soluções, integrações, infraestrutura, sistemas ou outros componentes tecnológicos envolvidos nos projetos.
  • Identificar riscos técnicos e de negócio e trabalhar junto às equipes responsáveis na definição de soluções.
  • Apoiar discussões relacionadas a escopo, solução, estimativas, mudanças e expectativas do cliente.
  • Elaborar e apresentar status reports, indicadores, riscos e evolução dos projetos para stakeholders internos e clientes.
  • Conduzir reuniões em português e inglês com equipes locais e internacionais.
  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos / Project Manager em ambientes de tecnologia.
  • Inglês fluente, com capacidade para conduzir reuniões, apresentações e discussões profissionais.
  • Background técnico anterior em TI, não sendo suficiente experiência exclusivamente em gestão de projetos.
  • Formação superior preferencialmente em Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em funções técnicas, como Analista de Cloud, Engenheiro, Analista/Consultor de Tecnologia ou posições similares.
  • Capacidade de compreender discussões técnicas e atuar como ponte entre times técnicos, clientes, Account Managers e áreas de negócio.
  • Experiência com gestão de escopo, cronograma, riscos, recursos e stakeholders.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento com clientes.

Qualificações Básicas

Buscamos um profissional com uma combinação equilibrada de visão técnica, gestão de projetos e orientação comercial. Deve ter facilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis da organização, compreender tanto as demandas do cliente quanto as limitações e possibilidades técnicas da solução.

É importante apresentar um perfil hands-on, organizado, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambiente remoto.

Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de infraestrutura, Cloud, aplicações, transformação digital ou serviços de TI.
  • Experiência em projetos com clientes corporativos.
  • Vivência em ambientes globais ou projetos internacionais.
  • Certificações como PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, PRINCE2 ou similares.
  • Experiência apoiando Account Managers em discussões de escopo, solução, estimativas e oportunidades comerciais.

O que estamos oferecendo?

Vários benefícios, salário competitivo e nossos valores fazem da DXC uma das mais importantes e atraentes empresas para se trabalhar no mundo. Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.   

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a Temporary Business Analyst to lead business analysis activities across enterprise digital experience initiatives within the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem.

In this role, you will serve as a key connection between client business stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams, translating business objectives and operational needs into clear, actionable requirements for Adobe-based solutions. You will work across platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Sites, AEM Assets, Edge Delivery Services, Adobe Workfront, and other Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities.

This is a client-facing role requiring someone who can independently lead discovery and requirements activities, facilitate complex stakeholder discussions, identify gaps and dependencies, and help shape solutions rather than simply document requests.

You will partner closely with client stakeholders, product owners, solution architects, UX teams, developers, QA teams, and delivery leadership throughout the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and solution definition through implementation, testing, and release.

The ideal candidate brings strong Business Analysis fundamentals, significant Agile delivery experience, and hands-on experience working within Adobe Experience Cloud implementations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead requirements discovery and analysis for Adobe Experience Cloud implementations and enhancement initiatives.
  • Plan and facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, requirements sessions, and solution-definition discussions.
  • Translate business objectives into capabilities, epics, features, user stories, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Independently own requirements for significant project workstreams from discovery through implementation.
  • Partner with Adobe solution architects and technical teams to evaluate business requirements against platform capabilities and technical constraints.
  • Help stakeholders distinguish between business needs, solution requirements, and implementation preferences.
  • Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and conflicting requirements and drive them toward resolution.
  • Recommend practical solutions when business requests conflict with Adobe platform capabilities, established implementation patterns, or project constraints.
  • Develop clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria that enable development and QA teams to execute effectively.
  • Own backlog quality and requirements readiness for assigned initiatives.
  • Lead and participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
  • Work closely with Product Owners to support backlog prioritization and sequencing.
  • Maintain requirements traceability from initial business objectives through implementation and validation.
  • Coordinate requirements across business, UX, content, development, integrations, analytics, and QA workstreams.
  • Lead functional support for QA and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario review, requirement validation, defect triage, and functional clarification.
  • Support release-readiness activities and validate that delivered functionality addresses the intended business need.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, workflows, governance models, business rules, and operating procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, translating between the two when necessary.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-3+ years of Business Analysis experience within digital experience, marketing technology, enterprise technology consulting, product delivery, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or delivering enterprise solutions within the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem.
  • Hands-on Business Analysis experience with Adobe Experience Manager, specifically AEM Sites and/or AEM Assets.
  • Experience gathering and defining requirements for AEM capabilities, workflows, content models, authoring experiences, asset management, or related platform functionality.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading requirements discovery and requirements-management activities.
  • Strong experience working within Agile delivery environments, including Scrum-based delivery.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, documentation, backlog activities, and delivery coordination.
  • Significant experience supporting Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Testing, including requirement validation, test scenario review, defect triage, and functional clarification.
  • Strong experience developing epics, features, user stories, functional requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and how Business Analysis supports discovery, design, development, testing, and release.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

jobs.excerpt: Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?
jobs.description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

AdmitYogi is a college admissions platform built by Crimson Education, the world's leading college admissions consultancy. Founded in 2013, Crimson has helped students secure over 1,330 Ivy League offers and 2,140 places at US Top 15 universities, with students 7x more likely to gain Ivy League admission than their peers.

The Role

Are you a current or incoming student at a Top 10 US university? Want flexible, remote work while helping high school students get into their dream schools?

AdmitYogi is looking for college admissions mentors to work one-on-one with students in grades 8–12. You’ll support students at every stage: from building a strong profile years before they apply, through to essays, activities lists and everything else in their final applications.

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

The role has two parts, and you may work with students in either or both:

  • Profile building (grades 8–11): regular 30-minute video sessions, every two weeks, helping younger students plan their academics and testing, explore majors and schools, and build their extracurriculars. You’ll guide each student through a personalised roadmap and keep in touch with them between sessions.

  • Application support (senior year): reviewing and giving feedback on application materials, including personal statements, supplemental essays, activities lists and recommendation letter memos. This work is mostly asynchronous, inside the AdmitYogi platform, with occasional live sessions such as interview practice.

The role fits around your own schedule. That said, students rely on timely feedback and consistent support, so reliability is essential. You should be able to return reviews within 24-48 hours and turn up to every scheduled session.

What skills and experience are required?

  • Current or incoming student at a Top 10 US university

  • Someone who has been through the US college admissions process and understands what it takes

  • Fast, reliable and disciplined. Students expect feedback within 24-48 hours, and you need to deliver consistently

  • Strong writer and communicator

  • Comfortable building rapport with younger students and their families over video calls

What you get

  • Competitive hourly pay

  • Fully remote work

  • Flexible schedule that fits around your studies

  • The opportunity to help students navigate one of the most stressful and important stages of their academic journey, and to see the difference you make over months and years, not just one application season

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

David Kennedy Recruitmentis working with a global customer experience and technology services company that is seeking to onboard a Japanese-speaking Trainer to support its Japanese-speaking Customer Service team in Malaysia.

As a Trainer, you will be responsible for delivering training and supporting the development of Japanese-speaking Customer Service Representatives. You will help new and existing team members develop the knowledge, skills and confidence required to provide excellent customer support across travel-related products and services, including hotels, flights and activities.

Position: Trainer (Japanese)

Location: Malaysia

Model: Remote

Employment type: Full time

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deliver onboarding and training programmes for new Japanese-speaking Customer Service Representatives

  • Train employees on the products and services supported by the team, including hotels, flights, activities and other travel-related services

  • Explain customer service workflows, systems, tools and procedures

  • Develop, update and maintain training materials, presentations and learning resources

  • Evaluate trainees' knowledge, performance and readiness to transition into live operations

  • Conduct knowledge assessments, practical exercises and training evaluations

  • Provide individual coaching and constructive feedback to support employee development

  • Collaborate with Team Leaders and Quality Analysts to address recurring performance and knowledge gaps

  • Monitor training effectiveness and recommend improvements to training programmes

  • Support ongoing refresher training and continuous learning initiatives

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Native Japanese and good command of English

  • Previous experience as a Trainer, Training Specialist or in a similar learning and development role

  • Experience delivering training within a customer service or contact centre environment

  • Strong understanding of customer service principles and operational processes

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills

  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and adapt training methods to different learning styles

  • Ability to assess learning progress and provide constructive feedback

  • Comfortable working with digital platforms, training tools and presentation software

  • Willingness to work shifts according to business requirements, including weekends and public holidays where applicable

BENEFITS:

  • Work-from-home arrangement in Malaysia

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Performance bonus opportunities

  • Employee benefits

  • Career and professional development opportunities

  • Access to thousands of free learning courses

  • Initial training and ongoing coaching

  • Inclusive and supportive working environment

  • Opportunity to work within a global team

  • Relocation support

  • And many more!

Compensation Range:

National University – San Diego, California

Part-time Faculty: Psychology & Dissertation Chair

Location: Remote, USA

National University is a veteran-founded, San Diego-based nonprofit. Since 1971, our mission has been to provide accessible higher education to adult learners. Today, we educate a diverse student body from across the U.S. and around the globe, with more than 230,000 alumni worldwide. Our three schools and three colleges offer more than 200 accredited and licensed graduate and undergraduate programs. National University holds accreditation through the Western Senior College and Universities Commission (WSCUC).

Position Summary

The Department of Psychology, in the JFK School of Psychology and Social Sciences at the National University, invites applications for part-time faculty in Psychology. The successful candidate will have a demonstrated record of or potential for excellence in teaching in their field and a commitment to serving the university’s diverse adult student body. The successful candidate will have the potential for a commitment to serving the university’s diverse adult student body. This position primarily works closely with the Academic Program Director and other faculty within the program and contributes to ensuring program quality, student engagement, and success.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Provide substantive, timely feedback to students on various assessment activities.
  • Maintain a positive, safe, inclusive student-centric learning environment.
  • Complete required tasks on deadlines (e.g., final grades, assessment, grading rubrics, input for grade appeals, etc.)
  • Maintain appropriate professional training and/or scholarly activities, when applicable.
  • Provide feedback to the course lead regarding the course content.
  • Identify at-risk students and collaborate with student services.

Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree with a focus in Psychology or related field required, PhD preferred.
  • Research-based, scholarly, peer-reviewed journal article publications, required.
  • Experience with the online delivery of education and the systems that support it, required.
  • Graduate level qualitative methods, quantitative methods, or statistics teaching experience preferred.
  • Experience as a member of a dissertation committee, preferably as the chair/advisor required.
  • Content expertise in one or more of the following areas preferred, but not required: trauma, substance use/addictions, the use and impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • All skills, abilities and education will be considered for minimum qualifications.

For full consideration, interested candidates should provide the following.

  • A cover letter.
  • A curriculum vita.
  • Statement of teaching experience online and/or onsite for a diverse student body.

Candidate receiving offers will be offered a salary/pay rate commensurate with experience that vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies. Absent exceptional circumstances, candidates will be offered a salary within this range for this position. jobs.title: Werkvoorbereider - Integrated Solutions
jobs.excerpt: Voor onze projecten binnen Integrale Oplossingen en Energy Hubs zoeken we een Werkvoorbereider die wil bijdragen aan het First Time Right opleveren van onze projecten.
jobs.description:
Voor onze projecten binnen Integrale Oplossingen en Energy Hubs zoeken we een Werkvoorbereider die wil bijdragen aan het First Time Right opleveren van onze projecten. In deze rol ben je de spil in het proces: je beoordeelt binnengekomen projecten, verzorgt de complete werkvoorbereiding en werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers, uitvoerders, leveranciers en netbeheerders. Een functie met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden, korte lijnen en ruimte om je rol zelf vorm te geven.

Dit is Joulz

Bij Joulz werken we elke dag aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige energieoplossingen voor organisaties die door móéten kunnen. In een sector die continu in beweging is, maken wij complexiteit helder en nemen we verantwoordelijkheid: voor onze klanten én voor elkaar. We willen elk bedrijf meenemen in de energietransitie, met oplossingen die van die transitie geen knelpunt maken maar een kans.

Wat werken bij Joulz typeert?
Een combinatie van vakmanschap, vertrouwen en ontwikkelkracht. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, mee te denken en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. We werken samen in een informele, professionele sfeer waar betrokkenheid vanzelfsprekend is en waar ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. We houden van een can-do-mentaliteit, we kijken naar elkaar om en we vieren successen.

Bij Joulz bouw je niet alleen aan slimme energie-infrastructuur, maar ook aan je eigen groei én aan die van het team. Zo brengen we samen Nederland vooruit. Vandaag én morgen.

Waar jij impact maakt

Wat jij straks mogelijk maakt voor collega’s, klanten en projecten.

In deze rol:

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de complete werkvoorbereiding van onze nieuwbouwprojecten binnen Integrale Oplossingen en Energy Hubs

  • Zorg je dat elk project First Time Right wordt opgeleverd, als steun en toeverlaat van onze projectmanagers en uitvoerders

  • Draag je zorg voor een goede projectadministratie, gestructureerd bijgehouden conform de gemaakte procesafspraken en werkinstructies

  • Draag je bij aan werkgroepen en werkoverleggen over (veiligheids)processen en werkafspraken, en toon je initiatief in het doen van verbetervoorstellen

Dit pak jij concreet op

De taken waar je écht je dag mee vult.

  • Je beoordeelt binnengekomen projecten op compleetheid conform het afgesproken proces en schakelt met de collega’s van sales als er knel- of verbeterpunten zijn

  • Je verzorgt de complete werkvoorbereiding voor nieuwbouwprojecten en werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers en uitvoerders om een goed eindresultaat te bereiken

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste producten op het juiste moment op de juiste plaats, door tijdig voorraden te checken en de juiste assets en materialen te reserveren of bestellen

  • Je houdt de projectplanning bij, signaleert afwijkingen en bespreekt die met het projectteam of collega’s in de keten, of escaleert tijdig richting management

  • Je werkt nauw samen met leveranciers, onderaannemers en netbeheerders en gaat op locatie schouwen als de situatie daarom vraagt

Met wie je schakelt (en waarom dat werkt)

Welke collega’s je om je heen hebt en hoe jullie samen resultaat maken.

Je werkt samen met projectmanagers, uitvoerders, collega’s van sales en collega’s in de keten, en daarbuiten met leveranciers, onderaannemers en netbeheerders. Binnen Joulz geloven we in samen doen, elkaar helpen en duidelijke communicatie.

Wat jij van ons mag verwachten

Voorwaarden, vrijheid en ontwikkelkansen.

Jij maakt impact, wij belonen jou met:

  • Elke maand € 3.535,77 – € 4.881,51 bruto te zien op je loonstrook (inschaling afhankelijk van ervaring en opleidingsniveau)

  • Een bedrijfswagen, met de optie tot privégebruik

  • 24% Persoonlijk Budget vrij te besteden (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld)! Wil jij elke maand een extra bedrag boven op jouw salaris? Dat haal je uit dit budget. Of koop je liever vrijheid door extra verlofuren van dit budget aan te schaffen? Of… wacht je tot einde van het jaar en geef je jezelf een eindejaarscadeau door alles uit te laten betalen in december? De keuze is aan jou!

  • Arbeidsmarkttoeslag: € 200,= Bruto per maand

  • 24,5 verlofdagen

  • Een flinke bijdrage aan jouw pensioenpremie bij ABP; Joulz betaalt 70%!

  • Je bent aangesloten bij de cao Energie Netwerkbedrijven (NWb)

  • Een laptop van de zaak

En dit hoort er ook nog bij!

  • Heb je een mobiele telefoon nodig voor jouw functie? Dan krijg je die van ons. Of kies je liever voor Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)? Je gebruikt dan je eigen telefoon en ontvangt € 30,- bruto per maand

  • Jaarlijks kun je € 700,- besteden aan jouw vitale en mentale gezondheid vanuit het duurzaam inzetbaarheidsbudget — bijvoorbeeld voor een sportabonnement, de aanschaf van fitnessapparatuur of een coach

  • Dagelijks vers fruit op kantoor

Zullen we kennismaken?

Solliciteren, contact en de volgende stap.

Enthousiast? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer via de onderstaande button. Heb je eerst nog een vraag over de functie of werken bij Joulz? Neem gerust contact op met Jesse Middleton – Recruiter via 06 – 15 00 13 75 of .

Requirements

Skills, mindset en hoe jij graag samenwerkt.

Je bent een organisatorisch talent met een assertieve houding en een can-do-mentaliteit. Je weet wat er nodig is om een project tot een goed resultaat te brengen, neemt initiatief en schakelt snel, ook onder tijdsdruk. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk, nauwkeurig en een teamspeler, en denk je graag mee over oplossingen waar onze klant écht iets aan heeft.

  • Aantoonbaar mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Kennis en ervaring van projectmanagement

  • Tenminste 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een technische of operationele omgeving

  • Kennis en ervaring met Microsoft Project

  • Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics is een pré

  • Affiniteit met duurzame energie en de energietransitie is een pré

  • Een proactieve en betrouwbare houding

  • De motivatie om samen te werken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen

jobs.title: Principal Consultant
jobs.excerpt: L'équipe Science s'agrandit !  AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇 Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
jobs.description:
L'équipe Science s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras

Tu incarnes l'expertise scientifique d'AssessFirst au contact de nos clients. Tu conçois et livres nos projets d'accompagnement les plus complexes — études ROI, projets 360, analyses prédictives, débriefings collectifs — et tu transmets la lecture scientifique de nos solutions aussi bien aux clients qu'aux équipes internes.

Tu es le trait d'union entre la rigueur scientifique et son application concrète : capable de conduire une analyse de fond et de la restituer avec clarté, aussi bien à un dirigeant qu'à un opérationnel. Tu transformes cette expertise de terrain en valeur pour nos clients, nos équipes et notre produit.

Tes missions

  • Piloter des projets clients complexes : études ROI, projets 360, analyses prédictives, études d'impact, débriefings collectifs, en mobilisant les méthodes statistiques et les outils d'IA appropriés pour transformer la donnée en enseignements clairs et orientés décision.

  • Former et transmettre : intervenir en alternance avec les Customer Success Managers lors des sessions de formation client, en apportant la perspective scientifique, et concevoir des formats de restitution qui rendent la science accessible sans sacrifier sa rigueur.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : intervenir aux côtés des équipes commerciales (AE/AM) sur les sujets à forte composante scientifique, au titre de l'expertise, et prendre en charge les échanges clients à forte technicité.

  • Contribuer au produit : apporter l'exigence scientifique et la connaissance du terrain aux projets produit (parcours d'onboarding in-app notamment), et faire remonter les enseignements clients vers les équipes Produit et Science.

  • Être référent·e scientifique en interne : garantir la rigueur de nos discours et de nos livrables, faire le lien entre l'équipe Science (modélisation, psychométrie) et les équipes terrain, et contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes CSM, AM et AE.

  • Faire évoluer notre catalogue conseil : transformer les projets sur-mesure les plus complexes en méthodologies réutilisables et industrialisables, et identifier de nouveaux livrables à forte valeur.

  • Exploiter l'IA de manière avancée : concevoir des processus de travail augmentés par l'IA pour accélérer et enrichir le travail conseil, et diffuser les bonnes pratiques en interne.

  • Porter la voix scientifique d'AssessFirst : webinars, contenus, prises de parole, et appui aux enjeux d'expansion, notamment à l'international.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de l'équipe Science.

Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Customer Success (CSM) et Sales (AM/AE).

Expérience souhaitée

🇬🇧 Anglais courant, car notre équipe et nos clients sont internationaux.

🎓 Formation en psychologie (du travail ou organisationnelle) ou équivalent, assortie d'une solide culture psychométrique.

📊 Maîtrise des méthodes d'analyse quantitative et capacité à conduire de manière autonome l'exploitation de jeux de données clients.

💼 Expérience confirmée du conseil ou de l'accompagnement client sur des sujets complexes.

🤖 Appétence forte et maîtrise avancée de l'IA appliquée.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale : 60K-70K fixe

Autonomie & flexibilité : tu t'organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote : travaille d'où tu veux en Europe !

Tickets resto : carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle : couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation : dispositif d'épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être : participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d'avantages.

Coworking : accès à des espaces partagés jusqu'à 5 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d'équipe : une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. 3 entretiens maximum : avec Emeric (ton futur manager), Jeanne (Talent Acquisition Manager) et Karla (CSM), et enfin Quentin (CRO) et David notre fondateur !

  4. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏

jobs.title: Lead, L&D Program Mgmt & Delivery Specialist
jobs.excerpt: At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future.

Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition

Job Purpose:

The Lead, L&D Program Mgmt & Delivery Specialist delivers and administers high quality and effective learning for participants and internal customers through our TruStage classes and learning programs. This individual will have the ability to develop and maintain productive relationships with the wider L&D team, internal organization clients, vendors, and key stakeholders across the enterprise while positively demonstrating TruStage’s core values.

The Lead, L&D Program Mgmt & Delivery Specialist will manage and facilitate various impactful enterprise L&D programs for the program management and delivery team within the L&D Center of Excellence (CoE). These learning offerings, including the facilitation of classes for people managers, skill development, business acumen, functional, process/procedural, and systems training, support the TruStage imperative of “prepare for the future”. This individual will help advance our learning culture by ensuring learning is valued, expected, and embedded into the business.

The Lead, L&D Program Mgmt & Delivery Specialist will contribute to the development of and adherence to governance for the programs assigned. This individual will also explore opportunities to drive consistency and efficiencies for their given programs by maintaining metrics and generating reports as directed by the Sr Manager of Learning and Delivery. This role will also be responsible for coordinating scheduling, event communication, vendor contracts, and other class/program logistics.

This role reports to the Sr Manager of Program Management and Delivery. The Lead, L&D Program Mgmt & Delivery Specialist will work closely with the Sr Manager of Program Management and Delivery to communicate effectively regarding relevant work and to provide procedural suggestions to achieve program success.

Job Responsibilities:

Program Management

  • Coordinate the implementation and delivery of enterprise learning programs, ensuring they are effectively rolled out to meet the needs of the organization and aligned to leadership expectations.
  • Understand L&D processes (scheduling, registration, evaluation, consultation, L&D request Intake, Governance, etc.) and leverage expertise from L&D Consultants, L&D Learning Technology professionals, and the L&D design and development team as needed
  • Assist Sr Manager of Program Management and Delivery with evaluation, measurement, and reporting of assigned programs providing updates on effectiveness and status.
  • Provide feedback on a consistent basis to L&D Design and Delivery in order to improve/revise content and enhance the participant experience for learning programs
  • Create productive relationships with preferred vendors for relevant learning programs.
  • Engage business stakeholders on L&D related efforts including the leveraging L&D Learning Consultants and L&D Leadership as appropriate
  • Create action/project plans, lead meetings, maintain records, and share updates with stakeholders for enterprise learning programs
  • Partner within L&D team to build and curate learning curricula for easy access and navigation.
  • Demonstrate a proactive approach with excellent organization skills and detail in the management of programs, especially regarding participant communication, follow-up activities, reporting to stakeholders, and learning delivery governance administration.

Facilitation

  • Model excellent facilitation skills by engaging learners and creating a safe environment to share.
  • Facilitate courses for various audiences (people leaders, individual contributors, new employees, etc).
  • Ability to effectively facilitate learning for, communicate with, and influence leadership audiences up to the senior level.
  • Organize and plan appropriately for a successful enterprise learning events.
  • Stay up-to-date on learning content and is well prepared to deliver an engaging learning experience in-person and virtually.
  • Highly competent in facilitating content virtually via Microsoft Teams (leveraging annotation tools, breakout sessions, etc.) to engage the audience.
  • Able to quickly troubleshoot technology issues as they arise during facilitation.
  • Coordinate with and prep guest speakers for successful delivery of content to ensure program objectives are met.
  • Provide ongoing feedback to adjunct facilitators and speakers to set them up for success.
  • Leverage learning sustainability and reinforcement approaches to ensure learning retention of participants during follow-up
  • Bring current business knowledge into the classroom to align on relevant course material.
  • Understand how adults learn best by contributing to learning sustainability and reinforcement approaches to ensure learning retention of participants.
  • Stay updated on learning and development trends, learning delivery best practices, tools/technology, etc. to bring excellence and credibility into the classroom.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in Education, Organizational Development, Human Resources or related field or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in learning and development with 5+ years of facilitation experience..
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, theory, and strategies.
  • Must have prior management experience.
  • Experience facilitating offerings effectively to various audience levels (face-to-face and virtually).
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Teams for virtual delivery.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal communication and relationship building skills.
  • Facilitation certification in the following, a plus (Blanchard Companies, Crucial Learning, DDI etc.)
  • Some travel may be required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • DDI Certification preferred

If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today.A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool.This tool automatically generates a screening score based on how well applicant information matches the requirements and qualifications for the position. TruStage recruiters use the screening score as a guide to further evaluate candidates; the score is one component of an application review and does not automatically determine whether a candidate moves forward.Candidates may choose to opt out of this process.

Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan and exemption status.

Base Salary Range:

$104,200.00 - $156,300.00

At TruStage, we believe a sound, inclusive benefits program is of vital importance, along with a flexible workplace that allows for work-life balance, career growth and retirement assistance. In addition to your base pay, your position may be eligible for an annual incentive (bonus) plan. Additional benefits available to eligible employees include medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability plans, parental leave, paid time off, 401k, and tuition reimbursement, just to name a few. Beyond pay and benefits, we also recognize that flexibility, including working in a place you prefer, is essential to caring for our employees. We will continue to strive to offer flexibility and invest in technology and other tools that will make hybrid working normal rather than an exception, so that when “life happens,” you can focus on what’s most important.

Accommodation request

TruStage is a place where everyone can bring their best self and thrive. If you need application or interview process accommodations, please contact the accessibility department.

PVcase is seeking a Product Marketing Manager with hands-on solar engineering expertise to drive the market strategy for PVcase Ground Mount, PVcase Roof Mount, and PVcase Yield. Rather than a traditional marketer, we need someone with direct experience as a solar design engineer, PV engineer, or technical consultant at an EPC, developer, or solar tech firm. You understand utility-scale workflows, are comfortable in CAD environments, and speak the language of technical buyers.

In this role, you will bridge Product, Sales, and Go-To-Market by translating complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, shaping product roadmaps based on real engineering workflows, and proving PVcase's unique advantage to the market. Deep solar industry and technical expertise are required, while formal product marketing experience is secondary.

  • Own positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, and adoption initiatives for PVcase Ground Mount, Roof Mount, and Yield.

  • Develop a deep understanding of utility-scale solar engineering workflows, customer needs, and technical pain points.

  • Partner closely with Product Management to bring customer, market, engineering, and competitive insights into roadmap decisions.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value and differentiated product narratives.

  • Lead technical go-to-market planning for new products, features, and workflows.

  • Own demo strategy and help create credible, real-world solar engineering use cases.

  • Support Sales and Solutions teams on strategic opportunities requiring deeper product or industry expertise.

  • Monitor competitors, market trends, and developments across solar design, engineering, yield, and adjacent software.

  • Develop technical sales enablement, training, presentations, webinars, and educational content.

  • Serve as a bridge between Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical customers.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand workflows, validate product direction, and strengthen the Voice of Customer.

  • Help commercial teams understand not only what PVcase does, but how and why solar professionals use it.

Requirements

jobs.description:
About the role:

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientistto lead the technical direction, scaling, and evolution of our core AI capabilities across two tightly connected domains:

  • Search, Ranking & Recommendations: advancing our multi-stage retrieval and ranking systems (Two-Tower networks, Vector Search/ANN, LTR) to optimize catalog discovery for raw physical products and designs, with a particular focus on multimodal and sequence embeddings.

  • Generative AI & Visual ML: scaling our image intelligence pipeline by combining multimodal generative models with classical and deep computer vision. You'll drive systems that generate rich features and embeddings for recommendation engines, as well as tools that help merchants with content creation, smart product delayering, and automated visual asset processing.

You'll lead the modeling strategy and collaborate across our data science and machine learning engineering teams, advancing our production systems from early successes to enterprise-grade AI infrastructure.

Your daily tasks will include:

Leading & scaling recommendation and search systems

  • Lead the architectural direction for candidate retrieval, multi-objective ranking, and learning-to-rank (LTR) models across raw product and design recommendations.

  • Advance our personalization engines, incorporating sequence embeddings of merchant history, niche trends, and sales performance signals to surface the best products and designs.

  • Connect downstream merchant sales and conversion data back into upstream design generation and candidate ranking models to continuously improve recommendation relevancy.

Driving AI design generation & vision pipelines

  • Oversee image generation pipelines that combine LLMs/multimodal models with deep learning architectures (e.g., diffusion models, UNets, Vision Transformers) to generate high-converting designs for merchants.

  • Deepen our classical computer vision capabilities (OpenCV) alongside deep learning vision models (e.g., ResNet, CNNs, YOLO/segmentation networks) for delayering, automated background separation, print-area quality analysis, and asset validation.

Driving end-to-end product innovation (maker focus)

  • Act as a product engineer with full technical autonomy across the stack — from foundational model selection (fine-tuning, prompt engineering, self-hosting) to serving pipelines and frontend workflows.

  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and ship complete agentic pipelines and ML features using AI-assisted development (Gemini for ideation and research; Claude Code and Claude Cowork for rapid implementation).

Technical leadership, governance & mentorship

  • Define and refine online/offline evaluation frameworks (NDCG, MRR, visual quality metrics, merchant conversion uplift) and oversee our continuous A/B testing strategy.

  • Guide strategic make-vs-buy decisions, API vs. self-hosted fine-tuning trade-offs (e.g., open vision models, LLMs/multimodal models), and inference optimization.

  • Set standards for applied ML across the organization, mentor senior ICs, run design reviews, and foster a culture of shipping measurable business impact.

Your qualifications:

  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience building, deploying, and scaling production ML systems, with a proven track record of staff-level technical leadership.

  • Search & RecSys expertise: deep expertise in modern search, candidate generation, and recommendation architectures (Two-Tower models, ANN vector indexing, Transformer rerankers, learning-to-rank algorithms).

  • Computer vision & generative AI expertise: hands-on experience with classical CV (OpenCV) and modern deep vision architectures (CNNs, Vision Transformers, diffusion models, multimodal LLMs/CLIP) for image processing and generative workflows.

  • Closed-loop ML: a proven ability to build systems that feed downstream business outcomes (clicks, conversions, sales) back into upstream model training and generation logic.

  • Technical stack: fluency in Python and the modern AI/ML stack, anchored in PyTorch for deep learning and vision models, alongside LLM orchestration and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph). Practical experience with production serving patterns (FastAPI, event-driven async processing), MLOps tools (CometML, Flyte), and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • AI-assisted workflow: comfort leveraging AI tools across the workflow — Gemini for ideation and research, alongside Claude Code and Claude Cowork for rapid prototyping, system design, and production code development.

  • Product maker mindset: a proven track record of taking full technical ownership of end-to-end features. You treat ML systems as products and are comfortable making architectural decisions across the whole stack, from model selection down to frontend API integration.

Nice to have: experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, or creator platforms.


Our Stack & Tooling:

  • Deep Learning & Computer Vision: PyTorch, OpenCV, Hugging Face Transformers, Diffusers

  • LLMs & Agentic Systems: LangChain, LangGraph; hosted APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) and open multimodal models (FLUX, Qwen); Claude Code and Claude Cowork for software engineering

  • Search & Retrieval: Vector databases (Qdrant / Pinecone / FAISS), Two-Tower ranking, Snowflake

  • Workflows, MLOps & Experimentation: Flyte for workflow orchestration; CometML for experiment tracking, model registry, and CI/CD artifact management; Amplitude for A/B testing and feature flags

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!
