jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation and ABM Manager, Americas
jobs.excerpt: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Demand Generation and ABM Manager, Americas, you will be tasked with owning pipeline performance across segments in AMER, from first signal of intent through acquisition, close and expansion, as a strategic builder who can read a funnel, find where it leaks and turn that insight into programs that convert. You will pair rigorous pipeline inspection and ICP discipline with a modular program architecture that Regional Marketing Leaders can pick up, adapt and activate in their markets at speed, while coordinating with Global Digital Marketing and Global Integrated Marketing so regional programs mirror global plays and receive the right amplification. You are the center of gravity for segment demand excellence in the region, working in close partnership with Sales, SDRs, Partner Marketing, Global Marketing and Regional Marketing Leaders, and keeping a structured feedback loop with the region so programs stay grounded in market reality.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Inspect the funnel with rigor from MQL through SAL and SQO to Closed Won, by segment and channel, identifying where leads stall, where conversion underperforms and where pipeline is leaking; distinguish sourced from influenced pipeline, and flag data-quality and attribution gaps before drawing conclusions or setting baselines.
  • Run a regular inspection cadence with Sales, SDRs and Regional Marketing Leaders, and translate findings into clear optimization and planning inputs; analyze performance across the full customer lifecycle, from net new acquisition through pipeline acceleration, close and expansion.
  • Run structured gap analysis on coverage, conversion, program mix and account engagement against pipeline targets, and prioritize the highest-impact gaps to close; design lifecycle and expansion plays that grow revenue in the existing customer base in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, using the right triggers, messages and motions for each segment.
  • Develop, maintain and regularly refresh the ICP and target account framework for the assigned segments, using firmographic, technographic, behavioral and intent data; measure ICP strength by testing how well program targeting, account selection and pipeline outcomes align to the ICP, and recommend changes where they diverge; scrutinize account selection for programs deployed in the region so targeting is intent-driven and ICP-aligned before execution begins.
  • Build and maintain a modular program library of repeatable, plug-and-play plays, including always-on automated engines, vertical activations, nurture sequences, pipeline acceleration and flagship programs; make the library visible and actively socialized so adoption is pull, not push, and so Regional Marketing Leaders can deploy proven plays without rebuilding from scratch; hand off logistics and execution to the Regional Marketing Manager once programs are ready to scale.
  • Run a structured cadence with Regional Marketing Leaders to present new programs, gather field intelligence on what is and is not working, and prioritize the next development cycle; build partner leverage into program design from the outset, working with Partner Marketing to integrate partner-led and partner-assisted motions rather than bolting them on later.
  • Partner with Global Digital Marketing and Global Campaigns so regional programs mirror global campaign frameworks and receive the right paid, digital and intent-driven amplification; coordinate regional input into global plans and ensure global assets, plays and timelines are translated into programs Regional Marketing Leaders can use; collaborate on always-on, automated demand engines, including marketing automation, personalization, content syndication and paid digital.
  • Join SDR briefing calls ahead of each program deployment to set expectations, monitor conversion against KPIs, and convene the team quickly to diagnose, adjust and capture learnings when execution falls short.
  • Feed program performance data into the consolidated reporting framework owned by the Marketing Program Manager, covering pipeline contribution, account engagement, funnel progression and ROI; champion a test-and-learn culture, running structured experiments across channels, messages and tactics and sharing insights with the wider team and global stakeholders.
  • Deliver a weekly report to the AVP and Americas Marketing leadership on program health, covering pipeline contribution, funnel conversion and performance against plan, with the specific actions needed, owners and timing for any program that is off track.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Proven experience in B2B demand generation, integrated marketing or lifecycle marketing, ideally in technology or cybersecurity, with a clear record of pipeline contribution and measurable ROI rather than activity metrics.
  • Strong analytical capability, including hands-on experience inspecting funnel data from MQL to closed won, diagnosing conversion gaps and turning findings into prioritized actions.
  • Deep understanding of ICP definition, account segmentation and prioritization, and how to apply firmographic, technographic, behavioral and intent data to guide targeting and personalization.
  • Experience building modular, repeatable campaign plays and program frameworks that can be scaled and localized across markets, with a demonstrated ability to drive adoption across distributed field teams.
  • Experience with always-on, automated demand programs and the supporting stack, including marketing automation, nurture, paid digital, retargeting and content syndication.
  • Experience coordinating with global digital and campaign teams to translate global frameworks into regional execution.
  • Experience working with partner ecosystems and integrating partner-led and partner-assisted motions into demand and expansion programs.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Sales, SDR, Customer Success, partner and global teams without direct authority and maintain effective feedback loops with the field.
  • Organization and an execution focus, with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities, and comfort working in agile, OKR-driven and matrixed organizations.
  • The ability to deliver the outcomes this role is measured on, including segment pipeline contribution that is on plan and growing with a data-backed view of where it comes from, what drives it and what is not working; a funnel that tells a coherent story about where leads convert and where SQO progression is healthy, with programs in motion to close the gaps; an ICP and target account framework that is sharp, current and reflected in every program; Regional Marketing Leaders deploying your programs into their market plans at pace; regional programs aligned to global campaigns with no duplicated or conflicting effort; full lifecycle plays, including expansion, that generate measurable revenue growth beyond acquisition; partner motions built into programs by design that contribute measurably to pipeline; a quarterly cadence with Regional Marketing Leaders in which field intelligence flows back into the program cycle and the library improves visibly each quarter; and weekly program health reporting that reaches the AVP and Americas Marketing leadership on schedule, with every flagged issue having an owner and a next step.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

Live Oak Bank is a digital bank for small business owners across the country. Our goal is to be America’s Small Business Bank, and we’re getting there by pairing exceptional service with smart technology. We support owners at every stage with products:

  • loans to buy, build, and expand
  • checking and merchant services to keep daily operations moving
  • high-yield savings and CDs to grow the money they’ve worked hard to earn

Our people are the heart of Live Oak. We take care of each other here, and that care carries over to how we serve our customers. If you want to help small business owners chase the American dream, we’d love to meet you.


How This Role Impacts Live Oak and its People

In accordance with established lending policies and procedures, assists business line general managers and Senior Loan Officers in examining, evaluating, and closing commercial extensions of credit. May request specified information for loan applications. Responsible for assembling information required by Live Oak and counsel to properly close loans. Assists loan officer by participating in conference calls with Senior Loan Officers and clients, and by populating the SF file with notes from these discussions. Develops understanding of commercial lending and the product they are promoting. Promotes Bank’s services to current and potential borrowers. Must be highly responsive to clients in deal negotiations, increasingly knowledgeable of various loan structures and how to apply them with the utmost safety and soundness. Travels for site visits and trade shows as needed.

What You’ll Do at Live Oak

  • While completing the application learns elements of underwriting to include the analysis of applicants’ financial status, credit, operational skill set and its applicability to the business being acquired

  • Runs cash flow spreads, evaluate materials sent in by prospective borrowers and quickly develop critical questions, summarize strengths and weaknesses of the opportunity

  • Helps prepare budgets for loans, as assigned, to be reviewed and validated by a Senior Lender

  • Assists with customer interaction for the purpose of compiling a full underwriting package as directed by LO/SLO

  • Learns bank policies and procedures as well as SBA, USDA, and Conventional standards. Becomes familiar with SBA 7(a) SOPs and USDA regulations. Reviews loans for SBA and USDA eligibility and verifies same

  • Serves as a first call liaison with Underwriter for questions after the deal formally enters the Underwriting department. Handles smaller internal questions with the larger issues being raised to include the LO/SLO in charge of the deal

  • Develops expertise in use of Bank loan systems. Ensures that all documents required for the credit approval of the loan transaction are uploaded to Salesforce, SharePoint, and third-party data rooms

  • Ensures a smooth transfer of the customer to the Loan Closing Specialist for the closing and funding of the loan in addition to the construction specialist if applicable

  • Keeps abreast of economic conditions, changes and trends in customers' businesses, the banking industry and the specific market niches targeted by the Bank

  • Functions as a team and realizes all members of the team are vital to its success

  • Stays current with products and services the Bank is offering

  • Performs other duties as required

  • Maintain a high standard of regulatory awareness including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • 0 - 2 years industry specific experience

  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

  • Manage constantly shifting priorities and timelines

  • Collaborative, able to work in team environment

  • In-depth knowledge of Bank lending policies, procedures and criteria

Preferred Experience

  • Underwriting experience

  • Additional lending experience

  • Sound judgment

  • Detail oriented

  • PC proficiency

  • Strong work ethic

  • Strong organizational skills

Our Values

  • Dedication: Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, exemplified through a strong work ethic, adaptability and pride in your work.

  • Ownership: Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively and creatively solving problems, while maintaining a high degree of quality.

  • Respect: Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness.

  • Innovation: Embrace fresh ideas and fearlessly contribute new solutions to emerging or existing problems.

  • Teamwork: Foster collaboration, accountability, and trust with others and understand that together, we do more

We consider applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status or disability. Equal access to programs, service and employment is available to all persons. jobs.title: Associate Account Executive, Ad Network (U.S.)
jobs.excerpt: beehiiv is where the world's best newsletters, podcasts, and digital products are built, grown, and distributed.
jobs.description:
beehiiv is where the world's best newsletters, podcasts, and digital products are built, grown, and distributed. The platform combines email, podcast hosting, websites, community, and digital products, connected to a single audience and a single set of tools to publish, grow, and monetize. As we approach $50M in annualized revenue and continue to grow almost 100% YoY, our rapidly growing product suite and incredibly strong brand position us for the next stage of hypergrowth.

We're hiring an Associate Account Executive (AE) to get brands live on the beehiiv Ad Network, which connects advertisers with thousands of newsletters and the audiences that trust them. You'll start by working the inbound advertisers who come to us across every industry, and as you ramp, you'll take on a focused category or segment where you build real expertise.

This is a quota-carrying role built for an early-career seller who wants to learn the full ad sales cycle, from first call to renewal. You'll run discovery, close deals the network can deliver, and hand off cleanly to Client Success, with coaching from senior sellers on deal strategy, negotiation and account growth. We look for hungry, coachable people who are AI-first: reaching for AI to research, prep and follow up faster.

Your North Star: Get new brands live fast, set up to succeed and book again.

To apply, you must complete our Values Assessment Quiz here. We will consider your responses alongside your qualifications and experience as part of our overall hiring process.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • 1-2 years in sales, business development or another client-facing role; SDR (sales development rep), BDR (business development rep) or account coordinator experience is a plus
  • Speed: you follow up on inbound leads the same day and keep deals moving
  • Curiosity in discovery: you ask good questions before you pitch, even on a smaller deal
  • Honest expectation-setting: you're clear about what we do and don't guarantee, so first campaigns don't end in surprises
  • Organization: you manage a high volume of deals with a clean pipeline, accurate CRM (customer relationship management) and reliable follow-up
  • Coachability: you ask for feedback, act on it fast and can show how you've improved
  • Range: you can talk with a B2B software founder in the morning and a consumer brand marketer in the afternoon
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Clay) for research, outreach or deal prep
  • Media, advertising, marketing or SaaS experience is a plus, but not required

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Owning your number: Carry and hit a quarterly revenue quota from the deals you close and the accounts you grow.
  • Working inbound: Respond to and qualify inbound leads across B2B, B2C, media companies and agencies, and turn qualified leads into booked discovery calls quickly.
  • Discovery and proposals: Capture each brand's goals, KPIs (key performance indicators), ICP (ideal customer profile), measurement, budget, timing and creative needs. Build proposals from standard packages and pricing, and confirm inventory with Marketplace & Yield before you commit.
  • Speed to launch: Move deals from first call to signed IO (insertion order) quickly, with complete HubSpot fields, so campaigns go live on schedule.
  • Clean handoff: Introduce the Client Success Manager with a clear summary of the brand's goals and what they bought, so KPIs and ICP map to the right products before launch.
  • Setting accounts up to renew: Stay on the thread after launch, check in with Client Success on early performance, and use those results to make the extension or renewal ask.
  • Building a specialty: As you ramp, own a focused category or segment, learn its buyers and benchmarks, and become the team's go-to seller for it.
  • Bringing back signal: Share what you hear from inbound brands so the team can improve packaging, pricing and the inbound process.
  • Building with AI: Use and improve AI workflows for research, follow-up and deal prep, and share what works with the team.

Why this role might be for you:

  • You want to learn sales from the ground up and grow into a full Ad Sales role.
  • You want reps: a high volume of real deals, fast.
  • You're competitive and want your name on the leaderboard.
  • You're deeply curious about media, advertising, the creator economy and newsletters.
  • You want a clear path to growth at a company growing almost 100% YoY.
  • You're hungry to earn.

Why this role might not be for you:

  • You want a traditional 9-to-5
  • You'd rather work a few big deals than many fast ones
  • You don't want coaching or direct feedback
  • You don't like rapid iteration and context switching
  • You'd trade quality for speed, or speed for quality

Why beehiiv?

Our values aren't a poster on the wall. They're the bar. It's how we operate, publicly and privately, and what we should return to when making decisions. That's how we keep our team's momentum. That's how we hire and keep A players.

beehiiv's core values

  • There's no room for B players ⭐: the best makes everyone better.
  • Maniacal sense of urgency ⚡: speed is our superpower.
  • Say what you think with positive intent 💬: disagree openly and give hard feedback directly, with the intent to help someone improve.
  • User-obsessed 🐝: every decision starts with one question: how does this add value for the user?
  • Ego comes second, winning comes first 🏆: we're here to create the best outcome; the team comes before the individual.

We'll take care of you:

  • Competitive salary
  • Stock options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) employer match
  • Unlimited PTO (mandatory 10 days per year minimum)
  • Annual in-person team offsite
  • Unlimited book budget
  • Monthly Wellness Days (every third Friday of the month)

To apply, you must complete our Values Assessment Quiz here.

Salary: USD 90,000-105,000 OTE / annual

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Overview: As a Senior Account Manager, you will own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of Qolo's most strategic customers: large commercial banks that use Qolo to power virtual account management, connected deposits, embedded payments, and commercial card programs, and high-growth fintechs running payouts, B2B virtual card, and gift and incentive card programs on our platform.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Overview:

As a Senior Account Manager, you will own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of Qolo's most strategic customers: large commercial banks that use Qolo to power virtual account management, connected deposits, embedded payments, and commercial card programs, and high-growth fintechs running payouts, B2B virtual card, and gift and incentive card programs on our platform. You will be accountable for recurring revenue, renewals, expansion bookings, and forecast accuracy across a multi-million-dollar book of business.


You will know each customer's business well enough to sit on their side of the ledger, and you will move every relationship from vendor toward strategic partner. You will be the person our customers call first, and the person our internal teams look to for a clear view of what each customer needs, what it is worth, and what happens next and you will own a strategic portfolio of strategic bank partners and fintech platform customers. Reporting to the SVP of Customer Success, you will partner closely with Product,Engineering, Production Support, Onboarding, Solutions Architecture, Finance, and Qolo leadership.

Responsibilities:

Customer intelligence and account strategy

  • Know each customer's core business, market size, go-to-market thesis, competitive position, and whether payments are critical, essential, or ancillary to their model.
  • Track the metrics that matter to each customer, including revenue, growth rate, budgets, and internal goals, longside their usage and growth on Qolo.
  • Understand each customer's top initiatives, how they fund and prioritize projects, and which teams carry weight, and position Qolo inside that story.
  • Identify where Qolo can help unlock a customer's addressable market, and act as an advisor where Qolo is not the direct solution.


Commercial ownership and revenue growth

  • Own Total Recurring Revenue for your assigned portfolio and track actuals against forecast every month.
  • Identify, scope, and close expansion opportunities (new products, payment rails, card programs, ledger services, fraud, tokenization, and customer portal) that contribute to the Account Management team bookings target.
  • Lead renewals, amendments, and pricing negotiations with a clear strategy and defined levers, including volume commitments and monthly minimums.
  • Monitor contractual minimums and invoicing accuracy with Accounting, and raise revenue gaps early with a quantified recovery plan.

Strategic bank partnership management

  • Serve as the primary commercial lead for bank partners, coordinating across their product, operations, technology, procurement, and legal teams.
  • Manage DaaS and development hour economics: track hour allocations, reconcile delivered versus billed work, and make sure scope, sizing, and cost are documented before work starts.
  • Align each bank's roadmap with Qolo's roadmap and delivery capacity, separate committed dates from aspirational ones, and keep release schedules and release notes flowing on time.
  • Help bank partners grow their own client pipelines on Qolo, from Quantum Ledger prospects to new commercial card launches.

Engagement model and executive relationships

  • Build a multi-threaded engagement model for every account, pairing Qolo and customer counterparts at each level (executive, product, business, and operations) with recurring touchpoints and clear ownership.
  • Run quarterly business reviews and roadmap sessions, and keep account plans and customer business profiles current every quarter.
  • Map each customer on how they view Qolo, from vendor to partner, and act on the gaps that hold the relationship back.
  • Develop referenceable customers and pursue testimonials, joint press releases, and co-marketing.
  • Represent Qolo in customer onsites and at industry events such as Money20/20.

Internal advocacy and cross-functional leadership

  • Be the voice of the customer with Product, Engineering, Production Support, Partner and Network Operations, and Risk and Compliance.
  • Manage enhancement requests and issues, capturing the customer problem statement, revenue impact, scalability, and priority so the right work gets built.
  • Participate in product prioritization and drive clear DRI and RACI ownership on cross-functional initiatives and escalations.
  • Partner with Onboarding Project Managers, Client Services, and Solutions Architects to launch expansions smoothly.

Operating rhythm and forecasting

  • Maintain a clean HubSpot pipeline with defined milestones, risks, and recovery plans for every account.
  • Deliver monthly scorecards and forecast updates with actionable insight, using data to anticipate customer needs before they impact results.
  • Share customer trends and data that shape Qolo's product and business direction.

How You Will Operate

  • Trusted advisor. You understand each customer's business model, strategy, and revenue drivers well enough to be seen as a strategic partner, not just a vendor contact, and you build partnerships where growth benefits both companies.
  • Proactive owner. You shift from reactive account management to proactive leadership, anticipating needs and risks before they escalate.
  • Commercially disciplined. You bring a revenue-first mindset to every conversation, put pricing, scope, and timelines
  • in writing, protect Qolo's economics, and still find the path to yes for the customer.
  • Clear communicator. You communicate clearly to bank executives, fintech founders, and engineers alike, and you choose clarity over comfort when the news is hard.
  • Accountable. You follow and improve the processes that keep the team accountable, and you deliver accurate, professional work on or ahead of schedule.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in account management, client partnership, or enterprise sales in payments, banking, or fintech SaaS, including direct ownership of a multi-million-dollar book of business.
  • Experience managing relationships with large financial institutions and navigating their procurement, risk, and governance processes.
  • Working knowledge of card issuing, payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow), and ledger or virtual account concepts.
  • A track record of growing accounts through upsell, cross-sell, and renewals, including complex negotiations.
  • The ability to analyze a customer's business, market, and competitive position and turn it into an account strategy.
  • Comfort with MSAs, SOWs, amendments, minimum revenue commitments, and hours-based development pricing.
  • Enough technical fluency to engage credibly on APIs, webhooks, reporting files, and release management.
  • Strong forecasting skills, plus experience with HubSpot (or a similar CRM), Jira, ClickUp, Confluence, and Slack.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a bank, issuer processor, or card program manager.
  • Background in treasury management or commercial banking products such as virtual accounts and connected deposits.
  • Training in a value-based selling methodology such as GAP Selling.
  • Experience with digital wallets, tokenization, or fraud solutions.
  • Experience in a high-growth or post-acquisition environment.

Why Qolo

  • Help shape the future of banking and fintech by solving problems created by legacy infrastructure and complex core banking needs.
  • Own high-impact, visible relationships with leading financial institutions, fintechs, and payments companies.
  • Join a mission-driven team with deep payments experience, backed by the scale of CSI.
  • Competitive compensation with comprehensive benefits.
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility in how and where

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. jobs.description:
Customer Support Specialist (3-Month Contract)

Vetster (vetster.com) is the world’s fastest-growing veterinary telehealth and pet care marketplace. Since our launch in 2020, we have established ourselves as a leader in the rapidly growing pet care industry. Named Pet App of the Year, Vetster makes it easier for pet owners to connect with the veterinary care they need — anytime, anywhere.

We know that by empowering pet owners with easy-to-use, convenient services and an open marketplace, we can move the industry forward, create professional opportunities in the veterinary community, and fundamentally improve animal well-being and access to care. The work we are doing is groundbreaking and is changing lives.

We work in cross-functional teams and believe ownership and accountability—along with trust, respect, and inclusion—are core tenets of success in our new working paradigm. At all levels, successful Vetster team members seek to advance their careers and share our ambition to build a global, high-growth brand. Please note that this role is remote, with evening, weekend, and holiday availability required.

About the role

As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for pet parents and veterinarians using our platform. You'll give friendly, professional, solution-focused support that keeps appointments, prescriptions, and the platform running smoothly. Most of your work will be live chat, with some phone, SMS, and email.

This is a 3-month remote contract. Our support hours are 7 am to 11 pm ET, 7 days a week, and you'll need to be available evenings and weekends.

What you'll do

  • Become a Vetster product expert and learn what both pet parents and veterinary partners need from support
  • Manage appointments, including support, transfers, and rescheduling
  • Help with account issues such as logins, profile updates, and subscription questions
  • Help veterinarians with account setup, the appointment flow, and finding their way around the platform
  • Answer pharmacy order questions, including order status, shipping updates, and Autoship changes
  • Escalate clinical, technical, regulatory, or complex cases to the right internal team, including our Registered Veterinary Technicians
  • Keep accurate case notes and follow up on time with pet parents and vets
  • Work with teams across Vetster, such as Veterinary Success and Pharmacy Operations, to improve the pet parent and vet experience
  • Solve problems and make decisions in real time, within clear guidelines
  • Take on other projects and tasks as assigned

What you bring

  • 3+ years of front-line customer support experience, ideally on live chat in a high-volume or fast-paced environment
  • Hands-on experience with Intercom (or a similar help desk such as Zendesk or HubSpot) and Slack
  • Excellent written communication: clear, warm, and concise, with strong judgment about tone
  • Experience handling several conversations at once while meeting response-time and quality goals
  • Comfort de-escalating frustrated or upset customers with empathy and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate case notes
  • Good with technology: you pick up new tools and processes quickly and need little ramp-up time
  • Self-sufficient: able to work independently and remotely, and to know when to escalate
  • Available to work evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Most importantly, a passion for Vetster's mission!

Nice to have

  • Experience in pet care, veterinary, healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce support

Why Join Us?

  • The expected hourly rate for this position is $26/hr
  • Unlimited access to Vetster for your pets.
  • 6% in lieu of vacation
  • Opportunities for career growth and international assignments.
  • A culture of inclusivity, equity, and team engagement.

Interview process:

  • 45-minute Google Meet video call with Christine Novakovic, Support Manager and a member of our Customer Experience team
  • References and background checks
  • Offer

Ready to Make a Difference?

Embark on a fulfilling journey with us to shape the future of pet healthcare. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, apply now to join our mission-driven team.

Accommodations

Vetster welcomes and encourages applications from everyone! We are committed to accommodating candidates in ways that will make them comfortable and successful throughout the hiring process — both physically and mentally. These accommodations are available at every stage of the application process upon request.

AI Use Statement

For this role, we will use AI screening in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to identify keywords and minimum qualifications, as well as note-taking in interviews. These tools will help us identify qualified candidates and move the recruitment process along at a steady pace. If you have any questions about our use of AI, please reach out to us.

Salary: $26/hr

jobs.description:
AirStrip is adding a Clinical Software Engineer to our Engineering team. The Clinical Software Engineer bridges clinical domain judgment and systems engineering, driving technical execution across our Insight healthcare platform. Because healthcare software demands flexibility and deep context, this role is designed for a versatile engineer who can float across multiple disciplines as project needs evolve: serving as a point person for DevOps and cloud delivery, architecting robust backend microservices, configuring hospital/client deployments, and driving end-to-end clinical validation and testing. You will champion modern developer practices—actively leveraging AI tooling to accelerate development, streamline test harness generation, and maintain safety in regulated healthcare environments. This is a remote position requiring up to 10% travel to company office locations.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

DevOps & Deployment Infrastructure: Act as the point person for CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and automated environment provisioning across Linux VM and cloud environments. Implement and manage infrastructure-as-code and configuration automation using tools like Ansible and Docker/Docker Compose. Maintain and monitor staging/production deployment pipelines, ensuring zero-downtime, secure, and reproducible deployments (New Relic monitoring/alerting, Ansible-based deployment script creation). Backend Architecture & Distributed Systems: Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput backend services and asynchronous APIs within our Python microservices ecosystem. Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and service layers integrating with PostgreSQL, Redis queues, and message buses. Adopt and evaluate modern systems languages such as Rust to optimize performance critical paths, data processing pipelines, and system reliability over time. Hospital Client Implementations & Configurations: Lead technical configuration and environment orchestration for health systems and hospital partner deployments. Translate complex hospital EMR, HL7, and near real-time clinical telemetry integration requirements into reliable system configurations. Debug and resolve deployment-level configuration issues across client installations and multi-tenant environments. Clinical Software Testing & Quality Verification: Design comprehensive automated testing scaffolding, emulators, and integration suites to validate platform behavior across complex clinical scenarios. Implement multi-gate verification processes to catch subtle data mapping and clinical logic defects prior to production rollout. Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA compliance, data privacy, and clinical safety standards. AI-Leveraged Engineering & Adaptability: Actively utilize frontier AI/LLM tools and agentic workflows to accelerate code delivery, generate test fixtures, analyze requirements, and maintain system documentation. "Float" fluidly across the engineering stack—shifting focus between DevOps infrastructure, backend logic, assurance as platform priorities pivot

Education & Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or related field, or a related technical discipline. Minimum of 7 years' Hands-on experience in software engineering, backend systems, and DevOps/Linux environments, or related disciplines. We’re Auros—the leader in human insight. Our mission is to help organizations craft exceptional customer experiences through fast, actionable feedback.

With the world’s strongest participant network, AI-powered analysis, expert services, and seamless integrations, we help companies eliminate guesswork, align stakeholders, and bring customer needs into sharp focus.


Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100— Auros delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.


Let’s build experiences people love—together.

The Opportunity

As a Digital Scaled Customer Success Manager, you own the health and success of a broad portfolio of UserTesting and User Interviews customers through a combination of digital engagement, data-driven intervention, automation, and targeted human touch.


This is not a traditional one-to-one Customer Success role, nor is it a support role. Your job is to determine how we deliver the right Customer Success experience to the right customer at the right moment — whether that means an automated journey reaching hundreds of customers or a personal intervention with one account showing meaningful risk or opportunity.


You will operate with a commercial mindset and a bias toward scale. You will use customer data, technology, experimentation, and AI to identify patterns across your portfolio and turn those insights into programs that improve adoption, retention, and growth. Success in this role isn't measured by how many meetings you hold. It's measured by the customer outcomes you create at scale.


Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Health & Retention: Own the health of a broad portfolio of customers and proactively identify the signals that matter most. Use product adoption, engagement, sentiment, lifecycle, and commercial data to identify risk early and create interventions that improve retention and customer outcomes.
  • Scaled Customer Engagement: Design and execute one-to-many customer experiences across the lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, education, value reinforcement, renewal readiness, and re-engagement. Determine when automation is the right answer and when a targeted human interaction will create greater impact.
  • Adoption & Value Realisation: Help customers move from access to adoption to measurable value. Identify common barriers across your portfolio and build repeatable programs, resources, campaigns, and interventions that help customers get more from UserTesting without requiring every customer to have a dedicated CSM.
  • Retention & Growth: Partner with Sales and Account Executives to support the commercial outcomes of your portfolio. Surface churn risk, expansion signals, and customer intent early enough for the broader account team to act. Create scalable motions that improve renewal readiness and uncover opportunities for deeper adoption and growth.
  • Data-Driven Prioritisation: Use customer data to determine where your time will have the greatest impact. Build and refine segmentation, triggers, health signals, and engagement strategies rather than treating every account the same. Continuously evaluate which interventions are working and adjust based on measurable outcomes.
  • Digital Journey Ownership: Help build and continuously improve the digital Customer Success experience within tools such as Planhat, Salesforce, Marketo, in-app engagement, webinars, email, and other customer channels. Look for opportunities to replace repetitive manual work with scalable, thoughtful customer experiences.
  • AI & Automation: Actively experiment with AI and automation to make Customer Success more proactive, personalised, and efficient. Identify repetitive workflows, customer signals, and engagement opportunities that can be automated while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.
  • Targeted Human Engagement: Know when scale should stop. Step directly into customer relationships when data indicates meaningful risk, opportunity, or complexity. Lead targeted conversations, office hours, workshops, or other engagements where human intervention can materially change the customer outcome.
  • Customer Advocacy: Identify advocates across the portfolio and create scalable ways to generate references, testimonials, case studies, community participation, and customer feedback. Represent the patterns you see across hundreds of customers internally so Product and Go-to-Market teams understand not just individual requests, but broader customer trends.
  • Experimentation & Continuous Improvement: Treat Digital Customer Success as a system that can always be improved. Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, measure results, and scale what works. Share learnings with the wider Customer Success organisation so successful digital motions can influence how we serve customers across every segment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Professional Services, Support, Operations, and the wider Customer Success organisation. Digital Customer Success sits at the intersection of these teams, and you will help connect customer signals to the teams best positioned to act on them.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Experience, Digital Customer Success, or a related SaaS discipline.
  • A commercial mindset and an understanding of how adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion connect to one another.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of customers or working within a scaled, pooled, digital, or one-to-many Customer Success model.
  • Strong analytical instincts. You are comfortable using customer and product data to identify patterns, prioritise action, and measure whether an intervention actually worked.
  • An automation-first mindset. When you encounter a repetitive problem, your instinct is to ask how it could be solved systematically rather than simply adding another manual task.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make digital customer engagement feel relevant and personal rather than generic or transactional.
  • The judgement to know when a customer needs a scalable resource, when they need a targeted intervention, and when an issue should be escalated to another member of the account team.
  • Comfort experimenting. You can form a hypothesis, launch a program, measure the outcome, learn from what didn't work, and iterate quickly.
  • Familiarity with customer success and CRM platforms such as Planhat and Salesforce, as well as digital engagement, marketing automation, analytics, or similar tooling.
  • A strong curiosity and excitement toward AI adoption, with an interest in using AI to identify customer signals, personalise engagement, automate workflows, and dramatically increase the scale at which Customer Success can operate.
  • Experience with UX research, customer experience, or the UserTesting platform is an advantage, but a willingness to become deeply knowledgeable about our customers and their work is essential.

Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications—but you may be exactly who we’re looking for. jobs.description:
PRIMARY FUNCTION

The Content & Digital Marketing Specialist creates and runs Pediatric Associates Family of Companies’ (PAFC) enterprise social media, from short-form video and copy to the organic content calendar and paid social campaigns, helping families find, trust, and choose PAFC practices. Content comes first in this role. The Content & Digital Marketing Specialist writes, storyboards, and produces social content and short-form video, and writes the creative briefs that guide designed assets. The role owns PAFC’s enterprise organic social calendar and paid social campaigns, using a deep understanding of what performs organically to shape paid social, and supports other paid channels as needed. Reporting is central to the role: turning performance data into clear insights about what it means for the business, and building those learnings into the next content calendars and campaigns. Because PAFC serves families across many locations and markets, this role calls for an experienced marketer with sharp attention to detail and a nuanced understanding of multi-location social. This role reports to the Content and Digital Strategy Manager.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This list may not include all of the duties that may be assigned.

Lead enterprise social content creation, concepting, writing, and producing posts, carousels, stories, and short-form video in a warm, family-friendly voice that is consistent across PAFC brands and markets. Plan and produce short-form video for organic and paid social, including storyboarding, scripting, and light editing. Write short-form marketing copy, including social captions, ad copy, headlines, and calls to action that are clear, persuasive, and patient-friendly. Write clear creative briefs through marketing intake, covering the objective, audience, key message, call to action, specs, and deadlines. Own the enterprise organic social content calendar and publishing across PAFC’s consumer social channels (e.g., Facebook, Instagram), knowing it deeply so organic and paid social work together. Coordinate with the community marketing team on local priorities, geographic targeting, and market-specific content. Review content submitted by the community marketing team to ensure it meets enterprise standards and compliance requirements (e.g., not showing any protected patient information). Monitor and respond to social comments and messages in a timely, caring, on-brand way, escalating reputation issues, and sending anything involving the media or a potential crisis to the appropriate parties. Promote community events, partnerships, and classes through organic and paid social. Own paid social, planning, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and other social ad platforms, including audiences, geographic targeting by market, creative, and budget pacing, in line with the strategy and budget set by the Senior Director of Consumer Marketing, and partnering with the paid media agency where it supports execution. Use what performs on the organic calendar to shape paid social, such as promoting top-performing content and aligning paid campaigns with upcoming content themes. Optimize paid social toward CAC, cost per lead, and appointment bookings, running ongoing tests on creative, copy, and audiences. Support other paid channels outside of search, such as display and online video, as assigned. Coordinate so messaging and creative are consistent across channels. Report on organic and paid social performance in a way that goes beyond the numbers: explain what results mean for the business, such as which content and campaigns drive bookings in which markets, and recommend next steps. Build insights into the next content calendars and paid social campaigns, using a clear test-and-learn approach. Ensure every campaign is set up for accurate measurement, including call tracking, UTMs, landing pages and conversion tracking. Ensure all organic and paid social content, including agency and community marketing work, follows HIPAA, healthcare advertising platform policies, and brand standards, including privacy-safe tracking and audience targeting. Use approved AI tools to brainstorm concepts, draft copy and scripts, and speed up editing and reporting, always reviewing output for accuracy, tone, and compliance and never entering patient information into unapproved tools. Stay current on platform changes, social and video trends, ad products, and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team. Work closely with other consumer marketing team members to ensure cohesive, omnichannel strategies that support patient acquisition, engagement, and retention.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE:

4–6 years of experience in social media marketing, including hands-on ownership of both organic and paid social for a brand. Hands-on experience planning, building, and optimizing paid social campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and other social ad platforms. Experience writing short-form marketing and advertising copy, such as social captions, ad copy, and calls to action. Experience with video for social, including storyboarding, scripting, and light editing. Experience writing creative briefs for designers, video producers, or agencies. Multi-location or multi-brand social media experience strongly preferred. Experience with social media management tools (e.g., Birdeye, Sprout Social, Hootsuite) preferred. Healthcare or other regulated industry experience a plus.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Strong understanding of marketing copywriting and what makes short-form advertising clear, persuasive, and on brand. Strong reporting and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, explain what it means for the business, and turn insights into next steps. Critical thinking and sound judgment, especially when balancing enterprise standards with local market needs. Deep understanding of paid social, including audience and geographic targeting, creative testing, and budget pacing. Working knowledge of video and design tools (e.g., CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Canva). High attention to detail and comfort with nuanced, multi-location work. Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare advertising policies, including privacy-safe tracking and targeting. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

Join more than 6,000+ curious and diverse minds in connecting people, data, and technology to produce amazing experiences for some of the world's most influential companies. We explore the possibilities of sustainable digital technology by helping clients to rapidly innovate, modernize their systems, enable their teams, and optimize for continued growth.

The Opportunity in a Nutshell

As a Forward Deployed Product Manager at Valtech you embed inside a small, senior FDE pod and lead the redesign of how AI shows up in your client's business. You don't hand over strategy decks or shepherd long backlogs. You sit alongside your client, learn the real workflow, and build the experience that turns AI investment into outcomes that stick.

You're a T-shaped product leader: deep in product craft, dangerous in engineering and UX. You can read a system architecture and challenge a technical trade-off. You can sit with a designer and shape an interaction. You move fluidly between business outcomes, working code, and human experience. You're built for ambiguity, comfortable being wrong fast, and energized by the shortest possible path between a real problem and a working solution.

What You Can Expect

  • Embed inside a Forward Deployed Experience Pod, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client to learn the real workflow before you redesign it.
  • Own the workflow, KPIs, and alignment for your pod. Define success metrics with the executive sponsor at week one, then build until you hit them. Measure outcomes against KPIs, not features shipped.
  • Redesign the human experience around AI, not the other way around.
  • Break a complex business problem into composable, shippable work the pod can ship in days, not quarters. Production progress every day.
  • Work in your client's stack alongside the Forward Deployed Engineer and Forward Deployed Experience Designer in your pod.
  • Pair with the Valtech leadership and your client's executive sponsor(s) to clear the path in real time. Legal, compliance, architecture, risk, governance, internal politics.
  • Govern, secure, and measure outcomes from day one. AI in production demands real attention to evals, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design. You own the framework that proves the solution works and keeps working after the pod rolls off.
  • Transfer ownership cleanly. By the end of the engagement, the domain expert is set up to run the solution long-term without the pod. Documentation, conventions, and the team rituals that sustain the change are part of what you ship.
  • Surface the next opportunity from inside the work. Embedded pods see what's broken next before anyone else does. You bring that signal back, so the pod earns its way into the next problem rather than waiting for procurement.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Valtech's FDE practice. Every pod is a learning loop. Share what works, what didn't, and the patterns that should harden into how we deploy across clients.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience as a Forward Deployed Product Manager in a digital consultancy, product organization, or embedded-team environment, with a track record of shipping production software, not just running discovery.
  • T-shaped skill profile. Product is your deep specialty, but you have enough hands-on experience in engineering and UX design to be a contributor in these spaces, not just conversant. You can read and reason about code, prototype an interaction in Figma, and hold your own in technical and design trade-off conversations.
  • Proven experience taking AI or ML solutions from concept into production, not just pilot. You understand why most AI pilots never reach production, and you have direct experience navigating the people, process, and governance problems that cause it.
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling across the SDLC: AI-assisted requirements and synthesis, prototyping with tools like Figma Make or Claude, AI-accelerated development pairing with engineers, agent evaluation frameworks, and the practical judgment to know what's production-ready and what isn't.
  • Strong executive presence paired with hands-on credibility. Equally effective in a working session with two engineers and an executive sponsor review. You earn trust quickly inside client teams and operate as a partner, not a vendor.
  • Proven ability to break ambiguous business problems into composable, shippable units of work and sequence them for daily progress. Comfort pressure to demonstrate value continuously, not at the end of a long cycle.
  • Solid commercial awareness. Comfortable with milestone-based engagements where the pod is accountable to deliverables, not hours.
  • Experience in modern delivery environments, with the ability to adapt the operating model to the engagement rather than apply a framework rigidly. Equally comfortable when there is no backlog, no rituals, and no playbook yet.
  • A track record of leaving teams stronger than you found them. The FDE model is built on capability transfer, so the ability to coach a domain expert into ownership is part of the job, not a bonus.

The Type of Person We'd Love to Meet

  • Built for ambiguity. You head into the unknown without waiting for a brief, a backlog, or permission. The first week of a new engagement, where nothing is defined yet, is the part of the job you're most excited about.
  • T-shaped by instinct, not just resume. You actively pick up the skills around your specialty because being narrow slows the team down. You're the PM who has built a working prototype, written a SQL query, and run a usability test in the same week, and you don't think of any of it as out of role.
  • A polyglot communicator. You can hold the architecture conversation with the engineer, the interaction conversation with the designer, the workflow conversation with the domain expert, and the outcome conversation with the executive sponsor, often in the same morning.
  • Deeply curious about AI as a craft, not as a buzzword. You experiment with new models, tools, and agent patterns on your own time. You have informed opinions on where AI is genuinely useful and where it's smoke, and you can defend either position.
  • Outcome-obsessed. You measure your work by what changed for the user and the business, not by what got shipped or how many tickets closed. You'd rather invalidate an assumption in a week than spend a quarter validating it.
  • Boundless initiative and a bias toward action, balanced with the judgment to know when the right move is to stop, learn, and align before building more.

Commitmenttoreachingallkindsofpeople

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

Thebenefits

This is a full-time position based in Montreal/Toronto. The offered salary range is 120,000 - 160,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location.

Valtech offers a comprehensive benefits package effective after three months of continuous service:

  • A comprehensive insurance plan, where you can choose the module that best suits your needs—Gold, Silver, or Bronze. The employer may contribute up to 80% of your coverage depending on the selected module. This plan includes short- and long-term disability coverage.
  • Dialogue via Sun Life provides virtual healthcare services, allowing you to consult with a healthcare professional for emergencies, prescription renewals, and more. You also have access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program, as well as a complete mental health support program.
  • A $500 Personal Spending Account, which can be used for healthcare reimbursements, gym memberships, public transit passes, office supplies, or contributions to your RRSP through Valtech.
  • A retirement plan where Valtech will match 100% of your RRSP contributions through a Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), up to a maximum of 4%. You can start contributing to your RRSP immediately, and to the DPSP after 3 months. The vesting of the DPSP will be after a 24 months of service.
  • Access to a flexible vacation under Valtech's policy to support your work-life balance, with 5 days available during your probation period and a prorated amount calculated for the remainder of the year.
  • Personal Technology Reimbursement – $30/month for every employee-offered on day 1.
  • We close during the winter holidays and offer flexible scheduling throughout the year, so you can enjoy those sunny Friday afternoons—provided your weekly hours are completed.

Yourapplicationprocess

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

AboutValtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.description:
Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Digital Transformation Director is responsible for defining and leading the organization's digital transformation strategy to modernize business operations, enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation through technology.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide digital initiatives involving technology modernization, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud adoption, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and system integration.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, IT teams, business unit heads, and external technology partners to translate business objectives into digital transformation roadmaps, manage strategic technology investments, and ensure successful implementation of digital solutions that deliver measurable business value.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.

About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

We’re looking for a high agency IT Specialist, AV & Workplace Technology ready to make an immediate impact. This role is vital for delivering polished Town Halls and major company events, keeping Zoom and our meeting tools running smoothly, and making sure our offices have the technology our team needs to connect and collaborate, both in-office and remotely.

This role is fully remote within the US but requires about 25% travel to visit Engine offices, manage hardware logistics, and support onsites, Town Halls, and other company events.

Your Mission

As part of the Engine team, you’ll play a vital role in an environment where innovation meets collaboration. Here’s what you’ll take charge of:

  • Town Halls and Company Events: Own the AV for Town Halls, all-hands, leadership offsites and other major company events. This includes setup, run-of-show, rehearsals, live streaming and hybrid production, mics, cameras and switching, and attendee support before, during and after each event.
  • Zoom Administration: Own and maintain Engine’s Zoom environment, including Zoom Meetings, Webinars/Events and Zoom Rooms. Manage licenses, account settings, security policies and integrations, and stay current on new features that can help our team.
  • Meeting and Collaboration Tools: Go-to resource for Google Meet, Slack huddles and our conference room systems. Administer settings and licenses, troubleshoot issues, and make it easy for colleagues to run great meetings from anywhere.
  • Office Hardware and Conference Rooms: Facilitate hardware across our company offices, including conference room AV, displays and peripherals. Deploy, maintain and troubleshoot room systems so every space is meeting ready.
  • Device Inventory and Deployment: Maintain accurate inventory of office devices and AV equipment, coordinate deployments and refreshes, and partner with the IT team on device management through Iru (formerly Kandji). Travel to Engine offices to run asset audits and keep hardware accounted for.
  • Vendor Coordination and Onsite Support: Manage relationships with AV and hardware vendors, coordinate installs, repairs and venue requirements, and provide hands-on onsite support for our offices.
  • Incident and Request Fulfillment: Manage AV, meeting and hardware tickets in Jira according to target SLAs and KPIs, ensuring the best possible service for our business partners while maximizing uptime on systems.
  • Documentation: Build and maintain run-of-show templates, event checklists, room guides and self-service documentation in Engine’s Knowledge Base so events and rooms are repeatable and easy to use.

What You’ll Bring to Engine

We are much more interested in the mindset than years of experience, but ideally, we’re looking for:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in AV, event production or IT support within an enterprise setting. Hands-on experience running live and hybrid events, including mics, cameras, switchers and streaming. Strong working knowledge of Zoom administration, including Meetings, Webinars/Events and Rooms.
  • Workplace Technology: Familiarity with conference room systems, displays and peripherals, and with Google Workspace, Okta, Slack and macOS. Ideally someone that has used Jira Service Management effectively before.
  • Service Oriented: Focused on providing exceptional support, empowering colleagues through technology, and building strong partnerships to drive shared success. Calm and steady when an event is live and the pressure is on.
  • Highly Organized: You plan ahead, run tight rehearsals and sweat the details. You are an excellent written and verbal communicator who can work with executives, event organizers and vendors alike.
  • Tech Stack Extra Credit: Bonus points if you have experience with Iru (formerly Kandji), Zoom Rooms deployments, OBS, vMix or ATEM switchers, and Zoom or other AV certifications.
  • Flexibility: Able to lift and move AV equipment, and available for occasional early mornings or evenings to support major events.
  • Travel: Able and willing to travel about 25% of the time to visit Engine offices, complete hardware audits so equipment is accounted for, and support onsites, Town Halls and similar company events.
  • Mindset: You’re ready to roll up your sleeves, collaborate, and deliver results that matter.

Applications for this role will be accepted through January 10th or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Eligibility for medical, dental, and vision benefits for full‑time employees.
Access to retirement or savings options, if eligible under company plans.
