Lead Platform Strategy and Architecture

  • Architect and evolve the platform's core data, application, and agentic layers on Azure AI Foundry, establishing the reference architecture and technical standards that govern how every solution from intelligent tax preparation to agentic audit workflows gets built.

  • Codify AI and data governance (NIST AI RMF, PCAOB, Section 7216, and emerging requirements including the EU AI Act) into enforceable platform-level controls and automated compliance checks, in partnership with the firm's existing AI governance function.

  • Lead AI performance engineering across the firm's LLM ecosystem, benchmarking models for accuracy, latency, cost, and quality, and directing routing and optimization strategy to continuously lower cost-per-agent without sacrificing output quality.

Build and Operate Cross-Cutting Capability Enablement

  • Build and operate the platform's real-time performance monitoring layer, hallucination rates, retrieval precision, adoption, and cost-per-interaction, as a shared capability every service line draws on rather than one each team rebuilds independently.

  • Data Platforms: ADLS Gen2, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse/Databricks for analytics and data engineering

Position Summary

The Clinical Data Associate (CDA) supports and manages clinical data management activities across study start-up, conduct, maintenance, data review, database lock, and regulatory submission support for multiple Phase I-IV clinical trials. The role applies approved plans, procedures, system controls, and quality documentation to help ensure clinical data are complete, accurate, traceable, secure, and inspection-ready.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Study Database Design and Specification

  • Support the Clinical Data Manager in CRF/eCRF design and maintenance of the global library.
  • Create and maintain CRF completion guidelines and annotated CRFs, and coordinate appropriate team review and approval.
  • Assist with development, approval, maintenance, and execution of the study-specific Data Management Plan (DMP).
  • Assist with user requirements for edit checks, query logic, manual review rules, and data validations in the electronic data capture (EDC) system.

User Acceptance Testing

  • Assist with development of test scripts, expected results, execution logs, issue logs, and traceability for user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Execute and facilitate UAT of eCRF builds, edit checks, integrations, reports, roles and permissions, and supporting validation documentation.
  • Confirm that issues are documented, resolved, retested, and summarized before approval for production use.

Data Validation and Cleaning

  • Produce reports and listings for data review, DSMB or medical monitor review, CRA monitoring support, and data inspection in accordance with the DMP.
  • Assist with specifications for data listings, summary table validation, data transfers, and datasets prepared for statistical review or data management audit.
  • Monitor clinical data quality and readiness for freeze, unfreeze, lock, unlock, interim analysis, and final database lock.
  • Perform AE/SAE reconciliation, external data reconciliation, medical coding review support, and follow-up of discrepancies to documented resolution.

Quality Control and Study Closeout

  • Perform closeout quality-control review for study closure in EDC and coordinate archiving of study databases and related data management documentation.
  • Maintain and periodically review EDC user access, site setup, role assignments, training completion, and account activation or deactivation.
  • Follow approved SOPs, work instructions, the DMP, applicable regulatory requirements, and validated system procedures.
  • Maintain complete, contemporaneous, attributable, and traceable records, including approvals, version history, issue resolution, and audit trails.
  • Clinical Operations Support
  • Develop and maintain trackers for project activities, site and IRB/IEC information, clinical trial materials, site payments, vendor invoices, and trial finances, as assigned.

Team Engagement

  • Act as lead Clinical Data Associate for one or more clinical trials when assigned, providing day-to-day coordination and escalation under Clinical Data Manager oversight.
  • Serve as backup for Clinical Data Management team members to support continuity and coverage.
  • Participate in internal and external study team meetings, communicate data risks and status clearly, and maintain action-item follow-through.
  • Provide clinical data management support to Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams.

Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to apply the Quality Management System (QMS) by using current approved SOPs, work instructions, templates, and forms; identify procedural gaps; document quality issues; support CAPA or document updates; and complete required training.
  • Ability to support the development, review, maintain, and follow study-specific Data Management Plans (DMPs), including approvals, version control, roles, data flows, reconciliation activities, metrics, freeze/lock requirements, and archival expectations.
  • Ability to comprehend clinical study protocols, schedules of events, and data standards into eCRF requirements to support the development of: annotated CRFs, CRF completion guidelines, field definitions, code lists, visit structures, and traceable design decisions.
  • Ability to support risk-based UAT activities for eCRFs, edit checks, user roles, integrations, reports, and system changes by assisting with test preparation and execution, documenting expected and actual results, tracking and retesting defects, maintaining traceability, and contributing to release readiness and approval processes.
  • Ability to support the development and review of edit-checks and data-validation specifications using unique identifiers, source fields, conditions, query text, expected behavior, test scenarios, and revision history.
  • Ability to support the execution of controlled database changes through documented impact assessment, approvals, updated specifications, testing, release communication, production verification, and contingency planning.
  • Ability to assist with external-data receipt, quality control, loading, and reconciliation, including format, transfer security, record counts, identifiers, visits, timepoints, units, duplicates, discrepancies, and final completeness.
  • Ability to assist with AE/SAE reconciliation between clinical and safety systems, track mismatches, confirm resolution in the authoritative system, and promptly escalate overdue or potentially reportable issues.
  • Ability to apply approved medical coding conventions and dictionary versions, review uncoded or ambiguous terms, issue clarification queries, document coding decisions, assess version-change impact, and support final coding approval.
  • Ability to conduct systematic data review using programmed checks, listings, dashboards, trends, and manual criteria; write clear non-leading queries; and manage discrepancy ownership, aging, escalation, re-query, and documented closure.
  • Ability to coordinate database freeze, lock, unlock, and relock using approved checklists and authorization controls, with verification of data review, reconciliation, coding, deviations, approvals, final extracts, and audit trails.
  • Ability to produce and quality-check study-health reports and data-cleaning metrics for missing data, query aging, data-entry timeliness, coding, reconciliation, external data, protocol deviations, and lock readiness; investigate trends and document actions.
  • Ability to maintain role-based training and certification records and verify protocol, system, procedure, privacy, security, vendor, and task-specific training before access or regulated work is assigned.
  • Ability to maintain and reconcile protocol-deviation records, support cross-functional classification, identify recurring trends, escalate significant findings, and prepare approved outputs for analysis and reporting.
  • Ability to execute study closeout and archival activities and verify that required records are final, readable, attributable, indexed, version-controlled, secure, retained, and retrievable.
  • Working knowledge of applicable clinical data and regulatory expectations, including FDA requirements, ICH E6(R3), GCDMP, CDISC/CDASH, data-integrity principles, electronic records and signatures, privacy, security, and record retention.
  • Working knowledge of clinical data systems and connected platforms, including EDC, ePRO/eCOA, CTMS, eTMF, RTSM/IWRS, safety databases, medical coding tools, and secure data-transfer solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical reasoning, inspection readiness, organization, problem solving, written and verbal communication, cross-functional collaboration, and timely risk escalation.
  • Ability to manage multiple studies and priorities independently within approved procedures, assigned authority, documented timelines, and required review or approval pathways.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in clinical research, clinical operations, clinical data management, or a related clinical research environment.
  • Working knowledge of clinical trial data processes, including data collection, review, query management, and data quality activities.
  • Working knowledge of clinical research systems and applications, including Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems. Experience with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) or other clinical technology platforms is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), applicable regulatory requirements, and clinical research documentation standards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to identify, track, and resolve data discrepancies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting clinical data review, data cleaning, or database-related activities within clinical studies.
  • Experience collaborating with Clinical Operations, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, or other clinical study functions.

LA OPORTUNIDAD

Desde Spanish Engineers estamos colaborando con una empresa estadounidense de ámbito internacional, especializada en soluciones avanzadas de tratamiento de agua, desalación, tecnologías de membranas y valorización de salmueras, para incorporar un Head of Engineering / Senior Engineering Manager en España.

La compañía cuenta con una presencia consolidada en Estados Unidos y la región del Golfo (GCC), y está impulsando actualmente el desarrollo de su futuro hub europeo de ingeniería desde España. Esto representa una oportunidad para un profesional con experiencia el sector que quiera participar activamente en esta nueva etapa de expansión internacional.

En estrecha colaboración con la dirección de la compañía, la persona seleccionada liderará la actividad de ingeniería desde España, contribuirá al desarrollo de la organización europea y participará en proyectos industriales internacionales en Europa, GCC y Estados Unidos.

Se trata de una oportunidad para incorporarse a una empresa internacional en una fase temprana de su expansión europea, combinando responsabilidad técnica, autonomía y contacto directo con la dirección general.

El equipo inicial será relativamente reducido, con posibilidad de asumir progresivamente mayores responsabilidades a medida que la organización crezca.

FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Liderar y coordinar la actividad de ingeniería en España.
  • Gestionar y desarrollar el equipo técnico actual y participar en futuras incorporaciones.
  • Supervisar las actividades de ingeniería durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos, desde el diseño conceptual y de detalle hasta la puesta en marcha y entrega.
  • Coordinar equipos multidisciplinares de ingeniería, incluyendo procesos, mecánica, electricidad, instrumentación y obra civil.
  • Garantizar la calidad técnica, el cumplimiento de plazos y el control de costes de los proyectos.
  • Aportar experiencia técnica en tecnologías de membranas, especialmente ósmosis inversa (RO).
  • Participar en el diseño, optimización y mejora del rendimiento de instalaciones industriales de tratamiento de agua y plantas desaladoras.
  • Identificar y resolver incidencias técnicas e impulsar la mejora continua.
  • Colaborar con los equipos internacionales de I+D, operaciones, compras e ingeniería.
  • Actuar como interlocutor técnico con clientes, socios, contratistas y otros interlocutores del proyecto.
  • Participar en la elaboración de propuestas técnicas, estudios de viabilidad y actividades de desarrollo de negocio.
  • Contribuir a establecer estándares, procedimientos y buenas prácticas de ingeniería.

  • Titulación en Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Ambiental o similar.
  • Al menos 10-15 años de experiencia profesional relevante en tratamiento de agua, desalación o ingeniería de procesos industriales.

  • Experiencia demostrable en gestión de ingeniería, gestión de diseño o liderazgo de ingeniería de procesos en entornos EPC o proyectos industriales.

  • Experiencia en la gestión de proyectos industriales internacionales complejos y en la interlocución con clientes, contratistas y proveedores tecnológicos.
  • Capacidad para combinar conocimientos técnicos con coordinación de proyectos, toma de decisiones y liderazgo de equipos.

  • Nivel fluido de inglés.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar internacionalmente.

La posición está basada en España y ofrece un modelo de trabajo remoto, permitiendo trabajar desde cualquier ciudad española.

jobs.title: Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior
jobs.excerpt: At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future.
jobs.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew!

EQT runs AI agents in production on Microsoft Foundry, working inside Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. Demand is compounding as domain experts across the business bring new agent ideas forward, and the platform underneath has to scale with it.

We need an Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior to own that platform: secure, observable, affordable, and easy to build on.

The Role:

You own the foundation every agent runs on. Our AI Engineers build agents and the tools they use; you build and operate the layer beneath them: the Azure environment, the AI gateway, the tool registry, and the observability, evaluation, and guardrail systems that keep the fleet healthy.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You write the infrastructure as code, own the AI platform in production, and partner with Infrastructure to align to standards and deploy. You won't spend most of your time building agents, but you'll understand them well enough to make the platform fast and safe to build on.

Who Thrives Here:

  • You treat the platform as a product. Your customers are engineers and business builders, and the best paved road is the one they choose to take.
  • You automate the toil. If you did it twice by hand, it's in code the third time.
  • You think in least privilege. Identity, secrets, and network boundaries are design inputs, not cleanup.
  • You know what it costs. You can say where the tokens and dollars go, and you tune before anyone asks.
  • You're excited about where AI is going. You want to build the platform that lets an organization run many agents well, not just one.

The Azure AI Platform Engineer III/Senior responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own our Azure infrastructure as code: author, review, and deploy modular templates across dev and production.
  • Operate Microsoft Foundry environments, model deployments, and our private Azure subscription as production infrastructure, including onboarding, upgrading, and retiring models.
  • Own the AI gateway on Azure API Management: routing and transformation policies, per-consumer keys, rate limits, and onboarding new models and consumers.
  • Run the centralized tool registry: identity and authentication patterns, versioning, and reuse standards, so a tool built once serves every agent.
  • Build fleet-wide observability: logging, compliance log collection, monitoring, alerting, and usage telemetry attributed by agent and user.
  • Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure that gates releases and continuously scores agents in production.
  • Own identity and access: Entra ID group-based, least-privilege RBAC, managed identities, just-in-time elevation, and drift detection against the code.
  • Own cost and performance: budgets and alerts, tagging, recurring cost reviews, and latency and token tuning across the fleet.
  • Set the guardrails and paved roads (spend limits, standard build patterns, templates) that let builders move fast without breaking things, and bring manually deployed services under code.
  • Own platform production support, partnering closely with Cyber, Infrastructure, Network, Salesforce, and data teams, and keep runbooks and documentation current.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 6+ years in cloud platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or site reliability engineering, including 3+ years running production workloads on Microsoft Azure.
  • Production infrastructure as code on Azure with Bicep, ARM, or Terraform: modular templates, parameterization, and multi-scope deployments.
  • Azure identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and least-privilege design.
  • Azure networking and security fundamentals: VNets, private endpoints, TLS, and locking down public endpoints.
  • CI/CD and software fundamentals: git, code review, deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
  • Observability on Azure: Log Analytics, Application Insights, and writing KQL.
  • Working knowledge of how LLM applications and agents work (model endpoints, tool calling, tokens, evaluation), enough to design a platform for them.
  • Clear communicator who documents well and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to engineers and business leaders.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI in production: model deployments, agents, evaluations, and the control plane.
  • Azure API Management policy authoring, including request and response transformation between model APIs.
  • Azure Container Apps and Container Registry, including hosting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar services.
  • Agent evaluation and monitoring tooling, and responsible AI guardrails such as PII handling, content filtering, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Governance at scale with Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and FinOps practices.
  • Integrating Azure services with Salesforce or Databricks

Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

Summary of Role:

GlobalFoundries is seeking a new college graduate with strong artificial intelligence and machine-learning skills to develop AI-enabled methods for semiconductor device modeling. The engineer will combine device physics, measured silicon data, simulation data, and modern AI/ML techniques to accelerate model extraction, improve predictive accuracy, and create scalable modeling workflows for CMOS, cryogenic, photonic, superconducting, and other emerging devices.


Essential Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and evaluate machine-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, and prediction of device characteristics.
  • Build reproducible data pipelines that combine measured device data, compact-model simulations, TCAD results, and relevant process or test metadata.
  • Train, validate, and compare AI/ML models using appropriate baselines, holdout datasets, error metrics, uncertainty analysis, and physics-based constraints.
  • Apply methods such as neural networks, Gaussian processes, optimization, sensitivity analysis, and physics-informed machine learning to device-modeling problems.
  • Automate model fitting, feature extraction, hyperparameter optimization, regression testing, visualization, and reporting using Python-based workflows.
  • Work with device, characterization, compact-modeling, PDK, EDA, and circuit-design teams to translate technical requirements into usable AI-enabled modeling solutions.
  • Document datasets, assumptions, model architecture, training methods, validation results, limitations, and recommended usage to support traceability and knowledge transfer.
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations and transition successful methods into maintainable device-modeling and design-enablement workflows.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Physics, Physicss or related field from an accredited degree program.
  • Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing.
  • Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)
  • Academic or project experience in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, optimization, or scientific data analysis.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with common scientific and machine-learning libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Understanding of supervised learning, regression, neural networks, model validation, overfitting, uncertainty, and quantitative performance evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding of semiconductor device physics and transistor electrical behavior, with interest in applying AI methods to device modeling.
  • Experience working with structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, and reproducible analysis.
  • Ability to communicate technical results clearly and collaborate across AI, device, modeling, characterization, and design teams.
  • Travel - Up to 10%

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior related internship or co-op experience.
  • Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.
  • Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.
  • Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning & organizational skills
  • Graduate coursework, thesis research, internship, co-op, or substantial project work in AI/ML for semiconductor devices, electronic design automation, scientific machine learning, or computational physics.
  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks, differentiable programming, Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or uncertainty quantification.
  • Exposure to compact transistor models, SPICE simulation, parameter extraction, TCAD, cryogenic device behavior, photonic devices, superconducting devices, or quantum hardware.
  • Experience using experiment tracking, version control, testing, or reproducibility tools such as Git, MLflow, Weights & Biases, containers, or automated workflows.

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at .

About the Team

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Engineer focused on Actor Analysis, you will investigate the cyber adversaries relevant to CoreWeave’s global cloud infrastructure, AI platform, and corporate environment. You will develop a detailed understanding of their objectives, capabilities, targeting patterns, infrastructure, and operational behavior, and assess how their activities could affect CoreWeave.

You will be part of CoreWeave’s defensive security operations team, working alongside threat hunters, detection engineers, incident responders, and other security engineers. You will conduct original research using external intelligence, technical artifacts, and internal telemetry, and apply your findings to active investigations, hunt hypotheses, deception capabilities, vulnerability prioritization, and detection improvements. Your research priorities will be driven by operational needs and gaps in our understanding of adversaries. Success means helping the security team identify threats, make better defensive decisions, and respond effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain sustained coverage of priority cyber threat actors, including state-sponsored groups and cybercriminal organizations, tracking changes in their objectives, capabilities, targeting, and tradecraft relevant to CoreWeave.
  • Investigate adversary campaigns and intrusion activity to reconstruct operational timelines, identify attacker objectives, and assess implications for CoreWeave’s infrastructure, technologies, and business.
  • Research adversary infrastructure, tooling, malware, and operational patterns. Correlate technical artifacts and behaviors across external reporting, internal investigations, and telemetry to identify relationships between activity clusters and campaigns.
  • Develop and test hypotheses about actor relationships and attribution, accounting for shared infrastructure, commonly used tools, and alternative explanations. Clearly communicate supporting evidence, uncertainty, and confidence.
  • Produce actor profiles, campaign assessments, and intrusion analyses that help security teams make specific defensive decisions. Explain likely adversary actions, relevant attack paths, and opportunities to improve defenses.
  • Define intelligence requirements and collection gaps for priority actors in partnership with security teams. Pursue relevant information through open sources, commercial intelligence, research communities, and internal telemetry.
  • Support active investigations with Incident Response and Detection and Response, providing adversary context, investigative pivots, and assessments of campaign connections to inform triage, incident scope, and response decisions.
  • Develop actor-specific hunt hypotheses and participate in hunts with security partners. Translate observed behaviors into detection requirements and help detection engineers validate coverage against relevant adversary techniques.
  • Partner with security engineers to develop deception capabilities informed by actor targeting and tradecraft. Analyze activity from honeypots, canaries, decoys, and other instrumentation to refine actor assessments and identify new collection opportunities.
  • Assess observed exploitation and actor capabilities against CoreWeave’s technologies and exposure. Support vulnerability management by identifying adversary-relevant vulnerabilities and attack paths that warrant remediation priority.
  • Develop scripts and analytical workflows to enrich artifacts, track infrastructure, and correlate activity. Maintain actor relationships and supporting evidence in the threat intelligence platform, incorporating findings from defensive operations into ongoing research.

Qualifications:

  • 8–10 years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, security research, incident investigation, threat hunting, or related disciplines, with substantial experience conducting threat actor and campaign analysis.
  • Deep expertise in at least one cyber threat actor set, such as Chinese, Russian, Iranian, North Korean, or cybercriminal actors, demonstrated through sustained analysis of their campaigns, targeting, tradecraft, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce original adversary research from technical evidence and multiple intelligence sources.
  • Deep understanding of adversary tradecraft, including initial access, credential theft, persistence, lateral movement, command and control, and infrastructure use.
  • Experience correlating intrusion activity, infrastructure, tooling, and targeting patterns to evaluate campaign relationships and attribution hypotheses.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing endpoint, network, identity, or cloud telemetry to investigate adversary activity.
  • Demonstrated experience applying actor research to threat hunting, deception, vulnerability prioritization, detection engineering, or incident response, with concrete examples of resulting defensive improvements.
  • Strong analytical judgment, including source evaluation, consideration of competing hypotheses, and clear expression of uncertainty and confidence. Ability to explain technical findings and their operational implications to security teams and leadership.
  • Ability to independently manage actor research while adjusting priorities to support investigations, emerging threats, and other defensive requirements.

Preferred Skills:

  • Deep experience investigating state-sponsored actors or cybercriminal groups targeting cloud providers, technology companies, or the AI ecosystem.
  • Experience analyzing threats involving Linux, Kubernetes, cloud control planes, identity systems, or software supply chains.
  • Background in malware analysis, digital forensics, network analysis, or incident response.
  • Experience researching adversary infrastructure using passive DNS, certificate data, domain registration records, or other technical datasets.
  • Proficiency with Python, SQL, APIs, or graph analysis to support research and correlation.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, intrusion analysis frameworks, and intelligence platforms used to maintain actor and campaign relationships.
  • Relevant certifications, such as GCTI, GCIH, or CTIA, are a plus.

jobs.description:
About Us:
Headquartered in Ottawa, BTA Design serves the electronic design community in Canada, specializing in ASIC and FPGA design and verification, and embedded software development services. We augment and enhance our clients’ teams and accelerate the development of complete designs.

We’re adaptable and efficient, with a brilliant staff at our core. We aim to be the best at what we do.

Our success continues to fuel growth. We are currently searching globally for a number of key technical resources, including an Analog Layout Designer with exceptional technical skills and significant experience.

About the Position:
As an Analog Layout Designer you will play a key role in creating and verifying full-custom analog and mixed-signal IC layouts in close collaboration with circuit designers. The role emphasizes layout quality, matching, parasitic control and physical verification through block integration and tape-out readiness. You will work within a strong and very experienced team and play an integral role in delivering world-class ASICs for our clients.

This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Translate schematics and circuit constraints into device placement, floorplans and detailed layout.
  • Apply matching, symmetry, shielding, guard rings and appropriate routing to protect sensitive signals.
  • Resolve DRC, LVS, electrical-rule and antenna findings using foundry-approved verification flows.
  • Generate parasitic extraction and work with circuit designers to address post-layout performance issues.
  • Address electromigration, IR drop, ESD and latch-up requirements with circuit designers and reliability teams.
  • Manage layout revisions, ECOs and integration handoffs; document sign-off results and approved exceptions.

Key Qualifications:
  • Hands-on full-custom analog or mixed-signal layout experience, with completed block-level deliverables.
  • Proficiency in Cadence Virtuoso or an equivalent custom-layout environment.
  • Practical DRC, LVS, ERC and parasitic extraction experience with foundry PDKs and sign-off tools.
  • Understanding of device matching, parasitic effects, noise coupling and layout-dependent effects.
  • Ability to work closely with circuit designers and explain the performance impact of layout decisions.
  • Ability to collaborate with client teams, communicate clearly and take ownership of assigned deliverables.

Additional Qualifications:
  • Layout of data converters, clocking, power management, RF or communication circuits; relevant process technologies; reliability verification, layout automation and mentoring.

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Why Work Here?
We offer interesting work in challenging, stimulating technical environments with companies that lead the world in technology and innovation.

We recognize that our strength is in the individuals who join our team, so at BTA Design Services, we foster an environment where everyone is appreciated, trusted and engaged. We recognize that work-life balance is important and we strive to provide our employees with challenging roles that also allow them to enjoy family, friends and life outside of work.

Role - Video Editor

Work Location - Work From Home

About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)

Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)

Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)

Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)

Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)

Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. Job Description: French Language Expert (France)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: France, Remote

About the Role

We are seeking French Language Experts based in France to support a specialized AI training project focused on French audio annotation. You will use your linguistic expertise and understanding of regional dialects, accents, and language conventions to improve the accuracy and quality of AI systems.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with experience in language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or related fields.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio recordings featuring various French dialects and accents from France.
  2. Annotate audio and speaker metadata, including audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.
  3. Review and correct Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcripts using French spelling, vocabulary, and conventions as used in France.
  4. Identify and annotate regional linguistic features, idioms, slang, and pronunciation patterns, including informal expressions such as t'as and ouais.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in French as spoken in France, with a strong understanding of its regional varieties.
  2. Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related field.
  3. Ability to distinguish between French dialects, accents, and regional pronunciation patterns.
  4. Familiarity with French vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions, including verlan, regional expressions, and English influences.
  5. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle linguistic differences.

  7. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an advantage but not required.

jobs.excerpt: Welcome systems thinkers.  System builds software to help the world see and solve anything as a system, starting in healthcare.
jobs.description:
Welcome systems thinkers. System builds software to help the world see and solve anything as a system, starting in healthcare. We are a Public Benefit Corporation driven by purpose and shaped by values. We hire systems thinkers who are motivated by our purpose, share our values, and have the skills to advance our mission.

We believe in the power of autonomous, interdisciplinary, and diverse teams; in agile development; and in leading with our values, first principles, and clear high-level priorities backed by data. We believe in cultivating a growth mindset for our team: always learning, improving, being challenged, and having opportunities for professional and personal development.

About this role

As Senior Research Engineer, you will lead the definition, implementation, and scaling of our LLM evaluation architecture and algorithmic benchmarking systems. You will also contribute to research and development in support of System’s core platform and product suite. This role reports to the Head of AI & Engineering.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain automated, reproducible evaluation frameworks to grade LLM reasoning, retrieval accuracy, and structured outputs across our CDS applications.
  • Create both general and domain-specific evaluation benchmarks, synthetic test-case generators, and golden datasets.
  • Quantify and mitigate edge cases, hallucinations, model drift, and safety regressions.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Research Scientists, ML Infrastructure Engineers, and Product teams to establish standardized offline and online evaluation loops integrated into CI/CD workflows.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or AI research, with a strong statistical foundation and scientific rigor.
  • Demonstrated track record of designing eval harnesses or benchmarking suites for LLMs and complex reasoning systems (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, reference-based metrics, human-in-the-loop review).
  • Advanced Python proficiency, experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face), frontier model APIs, RAG pipelines, and experiment tracking/observability tooling.
  • Strong written communication skills (journal article writing, blog posts, position papers, etc.)

Nice to Have

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or other scientific field
  • Contributions to peer-reviewed research or presentations to machine learning conferences (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.)
  • Experience with knowledge graphs

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $240,000, alongside equity and a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health and wellness coverage designed to support employee well-being
  • Generous paid time off to rest and recharge
  • A flexible workplace policy with a hub in Lower Manhattan and full support for remote work

About System

We aspire to help the world see itself differently and build a more responsible and values-driven model of a tech company. We are backed by top-tier VCs in Silicon Valley and New York and leading angel investors, and founded by the former VP Data at Spotify. To learn more about what motivates our social mission, we invite you to read our blog and our charter.

System Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace, in person and online, free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Job applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States of America and must maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.

jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity Behavioral and Mental Health (BMH) is Riverside's integrated system of care for student behavioral and mental health across Tiers 1-3.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Behavioral and Mental Health (BMH) is Riverside's integrated system of care for student behavioral and mental health across Tiers 1-3. Districts rely on DESSA, a strength-based assessment of students' social-emotional and behavioral competencies, and Move This World, video-based social-emotional learning for the classroom, to identify needs, personalize supports, and measure student growth in the skills that matter for life and learning.

The next chapter is significant. You will reposition two established, well-loved products and evolve them into one assessment-led system that connects assessment, targeted support, progress monitoring, and reassessment, in a category that is maturing from SEL toward life skills and whole-learner support. Few product roles offer this much room to shape a market while helping every student be seen, understood, and supported.

We are looking for a product leader who operates like a true general manager: someone with sharp product intuition, strong commercial instincts, and deep respect for the educators, counselors, and district leaders who support student well-being. Ideally, you have sat in their seat, as a school psychologist, counselor, social worker, MTSS coordinator, or student services leader, and have since become a hands-on product leader.

This is a high-visibility role with general-manager accountability for the vertical, but it is not a distance-from-the-work role. Most of your time goes to product leadership, go-to-market planning, and the operational needs of the business, while partner teams own execution. You will lead a remote team in a focused, resource-constrained environment where choosing what not to do matters as much as choosing what to do.

This role reports to the Chief Product Officer.

What You'll Do

  • Set the BMH strategy. Build and own one strategy and operating plan that repositions DESSA and Move This World, with clear calls on what to cut and where to put people and budget.
  • Deliver the roadmap. Own an integrated roadmap toward a comprehensive, assessment-led solution, with emphasis on Tier 2 targeted and Tier 3 intensive support capabilities.
  • Resolve technical and content tradeoffs. Serve as a real sounding board for Engineering and Content, making informed, market-driven decisions and settling conflicts quickly.
  • Protect the Evidence Base. Partner with Research to safeguard the validity, reliability, and evidence base of DESSA, Move this World and new BMH Capabilities as the systems evolve.
  • Own Businesss performance. Lead the cross-functional work with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Experience to deliver billings, retention, and expansion goals through influence.
  • Build go-to-market plans. Personally develop positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch plans, and shape the partnerships that extend BMH's capability and reach.
  • Build the team. Lead, coach, and develop product and content leaders, define the roles the vertical needs next, and set an operating cadence that raises the quality of decisions.
  • Strengthen customer value. Track the usage and implementation signals that predict renewal, learn directly from district practitioners, and develop advocates and case studies.
  • Be the voice of BMH. Represent the portfolio at conferences, with district leaders, and in the press, while protecting district and family trust through strong student data privacy and responsible use of AI.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Experience scaling software products or platforms, with enough technical and content depth to make sound, market-driven decisions alongside Engineering and Content teams.
  • A track record of repositioning an established product for its next chapter, with a clear commercial result.
  • Hands-on experience building go-to-market plans, including positioning, pricing, packaging, and launch.
  • Experience managing and developing product, content, or adjacent teams.
  • Accountability for business results such as billings, retention, and expansion, achieved by influencing cross-functional partners.

What You'll Bring

  • Firsthand experience in an MTSS, student services, or behavioral health seat, or deep practitioner and market knowledge gained another way, along with real curiosity about the day-to-day job of district and school teams.
  • Credibility as an external voice with district leaders, at conferences, and with the press, plus sound judgment on the political and regional nuances of SEL and student mental health, student data privacy (FERPA, COPPA, PPRA, and state laws), and the responsible use of AI in education.
  • A discerning, systems-thinking, and scrappy approach: you see the full size of an opportunity, choose a few moves to win first, and design for how assessment, action, implementation, and outcomes connect.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; master's degree preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Remote
  • Travel up to 15% for off-site team meetings or conferences.
  • May require stationary positions (sitting or standing) for extended periods.

Disclaimer

The above statements describe the general nature and level of the work performed by people assigned to this work. This list does not cover all possible duties, tasks, or responsibilities. Riverside Insights may amend or change responsibilities to meet the needs of the business and organization as necessary.

Benefits

Why Join Our Team?

At Riverside Insights, achieving real results for students and educators is more than talk, it is what we do. As we grow, so will you, offering the chance to expand your skills on an ambitious, solution-focused team. Join us in making great work possible, where your well-being and dedication to making an impact go hand in hand. If you are ready for an ambitious, collaborative environment, Riverside is the place for you.

Benefits

  • Company paid basic life and AD&D insurance

  • Company paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement plan with discretionary company matching

Compensation

A reasonable estimate of the range for this position is $175-220K USD. This role also includes an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE: A21 is a nonprofit organization fueled by radical hope that human beings everywhere will be rescued from bondage and completely restored.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

A21 is a nonprofit organization fueled by radical hope that human beings everywhere will be rescued from bondage and completely restored. We are the Abolitionists of the 21st century (A21), and we work to free people in slavery and disrupt the demand.

For 18 years now, we've rolled up our sleeves and set our feet to action. Why? Because in a single moment a number can turn into a name, a tragedy into a victory, and a belief into an action.
Freedom. That's our goal for every human being on the planet.

OUR MISSION:Abolish slavery everywhere, forever.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: International Finance Assistant

JOB PURPOSE

Support the Global Finance Manager with accurate and timely routine bookkeeping, finance administration, and record-keeping across A21’s international entities. This is an entry-level role designed for a recent graduate, with training, supervision, and progressively increasing responsibility. The role helps maintain reliable financial information and supports efficient month-end processes.

Primary coverage: Australia (AUS), United Kingdom (UK), and Greece (GRC) - assist with assigned day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration, initially with close guidance and review.

Secondary coverage: Cambodia (KHM), Thailand (THA), and South Africa (SA) - provide specific support as assigned and as capacity allows, in coordination with local finance contacts. The Global Finance Manager sets priorities and deadlines within the agreed 20 working hours per week and retains financial oversight, technical decisions, and approval authority.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES/ KEY DUTIES

Bookkeeping and payment preparation

  • With training and review, enter approved invoices, expenses, income, donations, receipts, and routine journals in Sage Intacct and other designated systems, using the correct entity, account, currency, department, project, and fund coding.
  • Assist with accounts payable and receivable records, monitor due dates and outstanding items, request missing documentation, and refer non-routine questions to the Global Finance Manager.
  • Help prepare payment schedules and supporting documentation for review and approval. Record completed payments and prepare remittance advice as directed; do not independently authorize or release payments.
  • Assist with routine bank, card, cash, and payment-platform reconciliations using established procedures; identify differences and escalate unresolved or unusual items.

Month end and financial reporting

  • Support month-end reconciliations and prepare assigned supporting schedules under supervision. Assist with gathering information for trial balances, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, payroll balances, and other general ledger accounts; accounting judgments and final entries remain subject to review.
  • Update intercompany schedules and help match due-to and due-from balances across entities. Use documented procedures and seek guidance before preparing or posting unfamiliar or uncertain entries.
  • Help compile data and draft schedules for financial reports, budget-versus-actual analysis, cash summaries, forecasts, grant reporting, and year-end accounts, for review by the Global Finance Manager.
  • Work toward agreed month-end deadlines, with tasks prioritized by the Global Finance Manager. For assigned field operations work, assist with trial balance and bank statement submissions by the 5th or next working day, follow-up through the 15th, and Friday cash and payment reporting as directed.

Country coordination and secondary support

  • For AUS, UK, and GRC, help gather and organize routine finance information from country teams, external accountants, and payroll providers. Assist with approved payroll inputs, payroll journal preparation, and balance reconciliations as training permits.
  • Help gather documents and maintain deadline trackers for local tax, statutory reporting, and audits, under the guidance of the Global Finance Manager and relevant local advisers.
  • For KHM, THA, and SA, provide specific data-entry, reconciliation, document-collection, or reporting support when assigned, subject to primary responsibilities and available working hours.

General administration and accounting support

  • Maintain organized and secure digital records of invoices, receipts, approvals, bank statements, contracts, and accounting correspondence, following documented filing and access procedures.
  • Provide routine finance correspondence, meeting coordination, action tracking, document preparation, spreadsheet updates, contact-list maintenance, and related administration as assigned.
  • Maintain finance calendars and request trackers; follow up on missing information, assist with audit requests and policy documentation, and identify opportunities to make recurring administrative processes more efficient.
  • Build proficiency in Sage Intacct, A21 financial procedures, internal controls, and multi-currency bookkeeping through training and feedback. Undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the entry-level nature and part-time hours of the position.

Controls and confidentiality

  • Follow A21 accounting policies, approval limits, and separation-of-duties requirements. Prepare or initiate payments only with assigned access and instruction; a separate authorized person must approve and release all payments.
  • Protect confidential financial, payroll, donor, staff, and beneficiary information. Promptly report suspected errors, fraud, missing approvals, control weaknesses, and risks to deadlines. Final financial review, accounting judgments, and statutory sign-off remain with designated responsible persons.

PERSONAL SPECIFICATIONS - Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge & Skills

Essential Qualifications and Skills

Recently completed or nearing completion of a degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant training; foundational knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping; good numerical accuracy, organization, and attention to detail; working knowledge of Excel and office applications; good written and spoken Greek and English; discretion, dependability, curiosity, and willingness to learn across countries and time zones.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

Any internship, volunteer, or academic experience involving bookkeeping, accounting, or administration; familiarity with Sage Intacct or other accounting software; exposure to nonprofit finance, multiple currencies, or payroll processes. Prior professional experience is not required. Training, feedback, and close supervision will be provided, with duties expanding as competence develops.

Values

Commitment to A21’s mission to abolish slavery everywhere, forever, and to integrity, responsible stewardship, equality, and respect for vulnerable people.

jobs.title: Director/Principal, Real-world Data and Healthcare Analytics Lead
jobs.excerpt: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting.
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Purpose:

The demand for high-quality health economic and outcomes research (HEOR), health services research (HSR) and real-world evidence (RWE) to support drug development, health technology assessment/access decisions, product differentiation, clinical decision making, and shape the health policy environment continues to increase. The Lilly Research and Evidence Capabilities team within the Health Outcomes and Medical Engagement (HOME) function is looking for talented, energetic, creative, diverse, influential, and collaborative team members to join team.

The real-world data and healthcare analytics lead will be an integral leader of our evidence generation strategy within the Research and Evidence Capabilities team. Using their deep knowledge and expertise in real-world data, analytics, and outcomes research, this leader will transform real world data into actionable insights. This role will serve as the senior technical authority for generating real world evidence from administrative claims data. The lead will use their extensive experience to design and oversee rapid-cycle analyses and study specifications to match business and strategic research questions.

The lead is both the team’s technical expert and the senior reviewer of junior analysts’ work. The lead must be forward-thinking and innovative, working collaboratively with technology teams to advance RWD platforms and maximize the value of AI and emerging technologies to improve analytic outputs. This is a critical role requiring strong internal partnership, scientific credibility, and the ability to balance adherence to standards and best practices with a need for urgency and rapid innovation.

Primary Responsibilities: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervision regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.

Health Economics and Outcomes Research Analysis

  • Lead the design of RWE analyses using administrative claims, pharmacy and medical data, including cohort definitions, enrollment, index-date and lookback logic, code sets, and fit-for-purpose assessment of data sources.
  • Serve as hands-on technical leader, lead specification development and validate complex analyses and results, and set the program standards the team follows.
  • Own analytic quality: set and apply standards for code, QC, validation, documentation, and reproducibility, and peer-review analyses across the team.
  • Provide expert input on the fit-for-purpose assessment of real-world data (RWD), use of artificial intelligence, and RWD infrastructure needs,
  • Support rapid-cycle analytic process efficiency, including prioritization, templates, and triage across teams.
  • Develop AI-enabled workflows - LLM-assisted programming, agentic AI, automated QC of analyses and evidence summaries.
  • Transform RWD sources to analysis ready data sets to enable rapid generation of RWE.
  • Partner with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory so analyses are designed to support the evidence communications they are intended for.
  • Ensure analyses meet privacy and data governance requirements (HIPAA, de-identification, small-cell suppression, data use agreements).
  • Mentor and coach research scientists on methods and analytic best practice.

Strategy

  • Applies disease state knowledge, US healthcare industry expertise, and research methods to develop REC team analytics strategy to accelerate insights to US payers and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serves as a strategic partner on lead/core teams across medical, tech and various commercial teams.

Information Dissemination

  • Collaborate with team members, including field medical team and researchers, to write reports, draft abstracts/posters/manuscripts, create data visualizations, and communicate study/analysis results.
  • Communicate study results via dashboards, final reports, manuscripts, or oral presentations in group settings, as well as for communicating with key population-based decision makers (PBDMs) and internal leaders.

Healthcare Industry Domain Knowledge

  • Understand Lilly relevant disease states and the broader healthcare environment in order to contextualize analytic requests and analytic capability needs.
  • Working knowledge of how claims data are generated, from care delivery and pharmacy dispensing through claims adjudication, and how that shapes data strengths and limitations.

Project Management ​

  • Ensures projects and RWD tools meet timelines, budget, and scope by coordinating analytics efforts with cross-functional Lilly business partners and external collaborators as appropriate.​

Minimum Qualification Requirements:

  • Advanced degree (PharmD, MD, PhD, MS, MPH) in a quantitative or health related field (e.g. economics, epidemiology, statistics, actuarial) with significant experience (8+ years with masters or 5+ years with doctorate) with highly relevant experience in RWE analytics.
  • Demonstrated 5+ years of hands-on experience working with US and administrative medical and pharmacy claims data (e.g. Marketscan, Optum, Komodo, IQVIA)
  • Advanced proficiency in the use of statistical language and programming software (i.e. SQL and R or Python) to efficiently harmonize and analyze real world data and translate research questions into program specifications.

Other Information/Additional Preferences:

  • Extensive prior data and analytics experience in pharma, managed care or similar healthcare industry.
  • Understanding of medical and pharmacy taxonomy (e.g. NDC, ICD, CPT, HCPCS).
  • Clinical training or experience
  • Proficient with data visualization and dashboard creation.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate within and across cross-functional teams primarily residing in US time zones.
  • Location: US Remote or Indianapolis, IN

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment

This is a hands-on build role, and acts as the connective tissue to our cross-functional GTM team. You will work daily with Sales and Partnerships, because the programs you build feed their pipeline across mid-market brands, enterprise order management, and 3PL.

About the role

Pipe17’s Order Operations Platform is the connected OMS that unifies orders, inventory, products and fulfillment across selling channels (DTC, B2B, retail and agentic), ERPs and fulfillment locations. We sell a technical product to operators, their bosses and the rest of the enterprise buying group, and generic marketing does not work on them.

We need someone who can build the systems that put the right message in front of the right account at the right moment, then run those systems without babysitting. You are part engineer, part marketer: comfortable in APIs, automation platforms, and LLM tooling, and equally comfortable judging whether a play will actually grow qualified pipeline. You will be the only person in this function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, with the latitude to build what does not exist yet.

What you'll do

Run account-based marketing execution.

  • Build the named account lists for our enterprise and 3PL programs, and map the people inside each account.
  • Keep account evidence current, built with agents rather than by hand: what each account runs, who runs it, what it costs them, and what changed.
  • Run the mechanics: multi-touch sequences, executive outreach, dinner and event invitations, gifting, and follow-up.
  • Own event and conference follow-up as a system. Target list and meetings booked before anyone travels, follow-up inside 72 hours.
  • Give Sales and Partnerships what they need to work each account, when they need it.

Build custom nurtures. Replace the single nurture track with custom paths, where treatment rises with intent and decays with time. High-intent visitors get a human fast, light engagement gets agent-drafted outreach keyed to what they did, and stalled or previously-too-small accounts get re-scored and re-contacted on a schedule.

Own HubSpot. Own the roadmap and the admin. Fix the data model so it matches how we actually sell across three segments, clean up source attribution so we can say what produced pipeline, and build reporting the business trusts. Keep the stack small. We are not looking for someone who adds tools.

Build the outbound engine.

  • Build automated outbound end to end: signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, reply handling, and CRM sync, using the tools we have in house today (HubSpot, Clay, Propensity, Artisan, Gong).
  • Detect the events that mean an account is in play: a replatform, an ERP migration, a 3PL change, a new channel, a second warehouse, a bad peak season, a new operations or technology leader.

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

We are seeking an experienced, true full stack Developer/Tester who can own an application end to end: Angular front-end, .NET API and backend services, SQL Server data layer, and automated testing. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a UI component, designing an API contract, writing a performant stored procedure, and authoring the test suite that validates all three. This role also integrates agentic AI workflows into the application stack, orchestrating existing AI/LLM services rather than training or fine-tuning models. Candidates should expect to move fluidly across the full stack on any given day, not specialize in a single layer.

Frontend Development (Angular)

  • Design and build responsive, maintainable Angular applications and components, including state management, routing, and reusable component libraries.
  • Consume and integrate REST APIs into the UI, handling loading states, error handling, and data validation.
  • Build UI components that surface agentic AI features (chat interfaces, recommendation panels, agent status/monitoring dashboards, etc.) within existing or new applications.
  • Collaborate with design/UX to translate requirements into polished, accessible interfaces.

API & Backend Development (.NET)

  • Design and develop backend services and APIs in .NET (C#), following REST/gRPC best practices for consumption by the Angular front-end and downstream systems.
  • Architect and implement integration layers connecting Python-based agentic services with .NET applications (via APIs, message queues, or SDKs).
  • Apply solid software design principles (SOLID, dependency injection, clean architecture) to keep backend services maintainable and testable.
  • Ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable integration patterns across all application layers.

Database Engineering (SQL Server)

  • Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases supporting transactional application data and agentic workflow data (logging, agent state, audit trails, metadata).
  • Write and tune complex stored procedures, queries, indexes, and ETL processes for both application and agentic workflow needs.
  • Own data model design decisions in partnership with backend and API development.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright for UI and end-to-end testing across the full application stack.
  • Write unit and integration tests for .NET services and APIs as part of the standard development workflow, not as a separate hand-off.
  • Develop testing strategies specific to agentic systems (prompt regression testing, output validation, agent behavior testing, edge-case/adversarial testing).
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and release quality gates.

Agentic AI Integration

  • Integrate with third-party or internally hosted AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) to power agentic capabilities within applications.
  • Write Python-based scripts/services for agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar, and wire them into the .NET/Angular application stack.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deploy, monitor, and manage application services and supporting infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP (e.g., Lambda/Cloud Functions, container services, storage, IAM).
  • Collaborate with DevOps to ensure scalable, cost-efficient, and secure cloud deployments across the full stack.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in .NET / C# development (API and backend services).
  • 7+ years of experience with SQL Server (database design, optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning).
  • 3+ years of hands-on Angular UI development experience, including component architecture, state management, and consuming REST APIs.
  • Demonstrated true full stack ownership: comfortable working across Angular, API design, .NET backend, SQL Server, and test automation without needing to hand off between specialists.

  • Practical experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration).
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and AI service integration.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms for deploying and managing application workloads.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design and service-to-service integration patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work across the full stack, from UI to database, without silos.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Grow alongside strong A-players who share their expertise and are always ready to boost each other.

Working at NLR

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Resilient Infrastructure and Security Center (RISC) advances energy security, infrastructure, and resilience technologies that can withstand and recover from disruptions—empowering secure, competitive economies and resilient, thriving communities. Within the RISC center, the Strategic Energy Security (SES) Group leads projects and initiatives to ensure our nation’s energy security, assists in disaster planning and recovery, enables resilient infrastructure assessment, and implementation, and works with national security partners to ensure that critical infrastructure remains resilient and operational during disruptive events.


SES is hiring a researcher to support and lead various analysis efforts that are central to the Threat to Consequences demonstrations, a critically important capability and growing area of work for the lab. This role requires someone with a keen attention to detail, versatility, excellent analytical capabilities, and a willingness to work with a variety of teams to accomplish tasks in a timely manner. In this role, the successful candidate will both work to deepen and enhance consequence analysis capabilities and develop customized demonstrations for important visitors, VIPs, and other stakeholders that showcase these capabilities and how they might be leveraged to better understand and manage the consequences posed by various threats and hazards that threaten these complex, interconnected systems. This role requires the ability to work in collaboration with many matrixed contributors, be a contributing team member, but also lead the development of the demonstration projects independently at times. This work often operates in difficult circumstances with tight timelines, high stakes, and continuously changing requests; therefore, the successful candidate needs to be comfortable with uncertainty and innovating novel ways to tackle new challenges as they arise.


Job Responsibilities


  • Conduct data assessments and analyses
  • Write SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze large datasets, combining disparate sources to generate synthetic datasets as needed
  • Identify potential threats, vulnerabilities, interruptions, and areas of weakness in grid-related energy distribution use cases
  • Develop clear documentation that others can understand, replicate, and build upon
  • Develop and maintain backend logic and pipelines using Python (or other software languages), providing clear documentation that others can understand, replicate, and build upon
  • Effectively use geospatial tools and platforms, including ArcGIS, QGIS, and Google Earth, to identify, analyze, and visually display geospatial information and phenomena
  • Clearly define and identify project requirements, adjusting these requirements and outputs as project objectives and circumstances may change
  • Track deliverables and milestones as projects progress, clearly communicating how the work product meets project requirements
  • Collaborate with team members, including members from different parts of the lab with different areas of expertise


.
