Relevant PhD . Or, relevant Master's Degree and 3 or more years of experience . Or, relevant Bachelor's Degree and 5 or more years of experience . Demonstrates broad understanding and wide application of engineering technical procedures, principles, theories and concepts in the field. General knowledge of other related disciplines. Demonstrates leadership in one or more areas of team, task or project lead responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in management of projects. Very good writing, interpersonal and communication skills.

* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

Additional Required Qualifications

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance at the DOE (Q) and SCI access or DoD (TS). Eligibility requirements:To obtain a clearance, an individual must be at least 18 years of age; U.S. Citizenship is required except in very limited circumstances. See DOE O 472.2A for additionalinformation.

  • Training and experience in geographic information sciences and data analysis, including proficiency in SQL, Python, and JavaScript

  • Experience with assessing risks and vulnerabilities within different infrastructure, potential consequences associated with infrastructure disruptions, and resilience and/or disaster planning
  • Broad and in-depth knowledge of the issues and best practices in the applicable field of expertise
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Proven problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Ability to collaborate with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work independently and achieve milestones in a timely manner

Preferred Qualifications

  • Some exposure and interest in growing into a role where you are leading projects and teams
  • Experience with geospatial analysis and remote sensing
  • Experience with assessing risk and/or disaster planning and recovery
  • Direct experience with military operations, installations, and infrastructure
  • Understanding of military and national security concerns
  • Some exposure with budgetary experience including planning and overseeing project budgets
  • Strong communications experience representing organization to internal and external audiences, including at an executive level

.

jobs.description:
Head of Change Management – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Change Management is responsible for developing, leading, and implementing the organization's change management framework to support business transformation, organizational development, digital adoption, and operational improvement initiatives.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role manages organizational change activities associated with technology implementation, business process redesign, operating model changes, regulatory initiatives, restructuring, and cultural transformation.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to assess organizational impacts, improve change readiness, manage resistance, and ensure employees successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the organization's change management strategy, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate transformation objectives into structured change management plans and implementation roadmaps.
  • Establish change management standards, governance structures, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential challenges associated with planned changes.
  • Align change management activities with corporate strategy and transformation priorities.

B. Organizational Change & Transformation

  • Lead change initiatives involving organizational restructuring, operating model redesign, business process improvement, and operational transformation.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify effects on employees, departments, workflows, and systems.
  • Develop implementation plans to support smooth transitions across business functions.
  • Coordinate change activities across multiple projects and transformation programmes.
  • Ensure new organizational structures, processes, and procedures are effectively adopted.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational development, business transformation, or programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or organizational transformation leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide or business-unit change initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of change management frameworks, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and organizational readiness.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, technology adoption, business process redesign, and organizational restructuring.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of the organization's change management strategy.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Effectiveness of stakeholder communication and engagement.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and management feedback.
  • Compliance with change management governance and reporting standards.

jobs.title: Creative Lead | UK hours
jobs.excerpt: Our client in the UK is looking for a Creative Lead.
jobs.description:
Our client in the UK is looking for a Creative Lead. You will own the creative vision and quality bar for every client account. You decide what we make and why, write the angles and scripts, storyboard the ads and sign off the finished work before it goes live. This is a hands-on leadership role.

You will think like a strategist, write like a copywriter and open CapCut to build a quick cut or a set of test variations yourself. Final creative sign-off sits with you. You will have the authority to approve work, reject it or send it back for changes.

Key responsibilities

The role covers four areas, and you will spend time in all of them every week.

Creative vision and quality

  • Own the creative direction for each client account, in line with their brand and goals.
  • Set and protect the quality bar for all paid social creative.
  • Review and sign off all ad creative before it goes live.
  • Build creative guidelines, brief templates and review checklists the team can work from without you.

Creative strategy

  • Research each client's audience, customer reviews, competitors and ad libraries to find angles worth testing.
  • Turn research into clear angles: pain points, desires, objections, social proof, offers and founder stories.
  • Plan creative testing roadmaps with the paid ads team so every account has fresh concepts in the pipeline.
  • Read creative performance data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and decide what to iterate, scale or retire.

Concepts, scripts and storyboards

  • Write hooks, scripts and on-screen copy for video and static ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.
  • Storyboard concepts so the video editor, designer and any UGC creators know exactly what to produce.
  • Write clear creative briefs for internal production, UGC creators and client shoots.
  • Present creative concepts and the thinking behind them to clients when needed.

Hands-on production

  • Build quick edits in CapCut to prove a concept or get a test live fast.
  • Create test variations of winning ads: new hooks, openings, captions, CTAs and formats.
  • Adapt assets for different placements and platforms.
  • Brief and direct the video editor and designer on polished production.

Who you will work with

You report to the Operations Director. Day to day, you plan tests with the paid ads team and brief the video editor and creative designer, who produce polished work from your storyboards.

What success looks like

By day 90 you own creative on every account, with a testing roadmap and a sign-off process the team runs without you.

1. First 30 days: Learn every client account, including their brand, audience and current ad performance. Audit the existing creative and agree a sign-off process with the Operations Director and paid ads team.

2. First 60 days: Take over creative strategy and sign-off on all accounts. Put a creative testing roadmap in place for each client, with new concepts in production from your briefs and storyboards.

3. First 90 days: Show measurable improvement in creative performance on key accounts. Document creative guidelines, brief templates and a review checklist the team uses day to day.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

  • Creative performance against each account's targets, such as hook rate, CTR, CPA and ROAS.
  • The number of new concepts tested each month.
  • How often new concepts beat the current best performers.
  • Quality and consistency of creative across all accounts.
  • Client feedback on creative.

Requirements

What we are looking for

Strategy and production carry equal weight in this role, so we need you to be strong at both.

Strategy and leadership

  • Three or more years in creative strategy, creative direction or copywriting for paid social, ideally in an agency or a fast growing DTC brand.
  • A portfolio of paid social ads you conceived, with the results they drove.
  • A deep understanding of what makes ads work on Meta, TikTok and YouTube, including hooks, pacing, native formats and direct response principles.
  • Comfortable reading ad performance data and turning it into creative decisions.
  • Strong copywriting and scriptwriting skills in English.
  • Confident giving clear, direct feedback and making sign-off calls.
  • Experience presenting creative ideas to clients.

Production

  • Able to storyboard concepts clearly, whether sketched, illustrated or built digitally.
  • Confident editing short form video in CapCut.
  • Able to produce quick test variations to a good standard without waiting on the editor.
  • A sharp eye for design, typography and brand consistency.
  • Organised enough to manage several client accounts and deadlines at once.

Working remotely

  • Self managed and reliable as part of a remote team.
  • Clear, concise written communication.
  • Working hours that overlap with UK business hours.

Nice to have

  • None of these are required, but they will help you stand out.
  • Experience briefing and directing UGC creators.
  • Experience with AI creative tools for images, video or voiceover.
  • Knowledge of Google Ads creative, including YouTube and Performance Max assets.
  • Experience with ecommerce or DTC brands.
  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager.
  • Editing skills beyond CapCut, such as Premiere Pro or After Effects.
  • Experience leading or mentoring a small creative team.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect, Pre-Sales (Bulgaria - Remote, World Wide, BG)
jobs.excerpt: Wiser Technology is a leading software development company.
jobs.description:
Wiser Technology is a leading software development company. Our team of 600 engineers across Europe excels in web and mobile software development, video streaming, defense, machine learning, automotive, e-commerce, and AI. We leverage top-tier technologies and expertise driven by a passion for innovation to drive progress.

We're seeking a Senior Solution Architect, Pre-Sales, for our GCC Business Unit, which covers the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman.

  • Location: Preferred: based in the GCC region (Dubai or Riyadh). Considered: based in Bulgaria, Serbia or elsewhere in Europe, with regular travel to the region.
  • Travel: Essential in either case. If you are based in Europe, expect up to 40 per cent of working time in the region in the first year; if you are based in the GCC, expect frequent in-country client work.
  • Employment: Full-time, permanent. Employing entity, level and remuneration confirmed at offer, according to your country of residence.

Key Responsibilities:

Discovery and Pre-Sales Leadership

  • Lead client discovery workshops in the region, in person: elicit business objectives, current landscape, constraints, security and data-residency requirements, and success criteria.
  • Qualify opportunities with the Head of the Business Unit on technical feasibility, delivery risk and fit with Wiser's capabilities, and say early when an opportunity should not be pursued.
  • Own the technical content of proposals, responses to requests for proposal, and statements of work: architecture, scope, assumptions, phasing, team shape and effort estimate.
  • Present and defend solutions to client technology and information leadership, enterprise architecture boards and procurement, and run technical due-diligence sessions.
  • Build and run demonstrations and proofs of concept, including artificial-intelligence prototypes, to shorten the sales cycle.


Solution Design and Delivery Validation

  • Design end-to-end target architectures across cloud, integration, data and application layers, with particular depth in artificial-intelligence solution patterns.
  • Produce effort estimates using Wiser's estimation standard and own the assumptions behind them.
  • Have every proposal validated by Wiser's delivery organisation and engineering practices before it goes to the client — confirming it can be delivered as designed, with the team and timeline proposed, within the financial parameters set by the Business Unit — and release no proposal that has not passed that validation.
  • Hand each won opportunity over to the delivery organisation with a documented architecture, risk register and open decisions, and stay engaged through mobilisation and the first delivery increment to confirm that what was sold is what is being built.


Artificial-Intelligence Leadership for the Region

  • Become the region's reference point on applied artificial intelligence, supported by Wiser's enablement lead and engineering practice: large language model application design, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, and the data foundations beneath them.
  • Advise clients on responsible deployment, data residency and sovereign-cloud options available in the region, and on the regulatory expectations of the markets served.
  • Work with Wiser's artificial-intelligence enablement lead and engineering practice so that regional proposals reuse Wiser's accelerators, reference architectures and partner certifications.


Market and Relationship Development

  • Build trusted relationships with client technical leaders and with the regional teams of hyperscale cloud and artificial-intelligence partners.
  • Represent Wiser at regional industry events, partner forums and client executive briefings.
  • Feed market intelligence — demand patterns, competitor positioning, pricing expectations, emerging regulation — back to the Business Unit and the engineering practices.


Capability Building

  • Contribute reusable pre-sales assets: reference architectures, demonstration environments, estimation baselines and proposal components.
  • Coach engineers assigned to GCC opportunities on discovery technique, proposal writing and client-facing conduct.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Ten or more years in software engineering or technology consulting, of which at least four in a solution-architecture or pre-sales role with direct client ownership.
  • A documented record of leading discoveries and winning proposals for enterprise or public-sector clients, with deal values and outcomes that can be discussed openly in interview.
  • Hands-on depth in at least one major cloud platform (Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud) at the architecture level, including security, identity, networking and data-residency design.
  • A record of mastering new technology domains quickly. Artificial-intelligence solution design is central to the region's demand; if you do not have that background, you are expected to reach credible solution-design depth within the first months, with Wiser's enablement support.
  • Experience with modernisation and integration programmes: application re-platforming, application programming interface strategy, event-driven architecture, enterprise integration.
  • Fluent written and spoken English at the level required to author proposals and present to executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to and work in the GCC region as a core part of the role, and eligibility to obtain the necessary visas and work permissions.
  • Willingness to undergo the background checks that specific clients and opportunities in the region require as a condition of participating in them.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct, recent experience delivering artificial-intelligence solutions in production — large language model applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems or machine-learning platforms — as the designer or technical lead. Supporting data engineering alone does not meet this. A strong advantage.
  • Prior work in the GCC markets, with an understanding of government and semi-government procurement, local-content expectations and the role of in-country partners.
  • Professional certifications: cloud architecture at professional level; artificial-intelligence or machine-learning specialisations; The Open Group Architecture Framework or equivalent.
  • Experience with sovereign-cloud and data-residency arrangements in the region, and with sector regulation in financial services, healthcare, energy or government.
  • Experience in a services firm operating a delivery model across several countries.

Working Culture & Personal Attributes

Wiser operates on openness. Pre-sales at Wiser is not a closed practice: discoveries, estimates, risks and client feedback are shared with the engineering practices and the delivery organisation so that what is sold can be built, and the people who build it have a voice before commitment. You are expected to:

  • Share the full picture of each opportunity — commercial context, client politics, risks and assumptions — with the delivery colleagues who validate it and will inherit it, and accept challenge from them.
  • Be candid with the Head of the Business Unit and with clients when a requirement is unrealistic, an estimate is thin, or a commitment should not be made.
  • Work comfortably across cultures, time zones and seniority levels, and represent Wiser with the formality and patience that business in the region requires.
  • Combine commercial judgement with engineering integrity: win work that Wiser can deliver well, at a margin that holds.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, often as the senior Wiser representative in the room, and keep the Business Unit informed without being asked.

Measures of Success

First Six Months

  • Every GCC opportunity reaching the client-proposal stage has a named technical owner, a documented architecture and an estimate validated by the delivery organisation and the engineering practices.
  • At least three client discoveries led in person in the region, each resulting in a qualified proposal or a documented decision not to pursue.
  • A regional demonstration environment for Wiser's artificial-intelligence offerings is available and has been used with clients.

First Twelve Months

  • Measurable improvement in proposal win rate and in the ratio of pre-sales effort to won revenue for the Business Unit, against the baseline agreed at appointment.
  • No material scope, estimate or margin dispute at handover on work you designed.
  • Established relationships with the regional teams of at least two hyperscale cloud or artificial-intelligence partners, evidenced by joint opportunities.
  • Reusable regional pre-sales assets contributed and in use.


Background Checks for Specific Opportunities

Wiser does not require a background check for appointment to this position. Clients and opportunities in the region may, however, require checks on named individuals as a condition of participation: identity verification, employment and qualification history, security clearance, non-disclosure undertakings or in-country registration. You must be willing to complete such checks when an opportunity requires them. Each check is conducted lawfully, with your informed consent, and the data is handled in accordance with Wiser's data protection obligations.


Selection Process

  • Stage one: screening conversation with the GCC Business Unit's commercial and delivery leadership on regional experience, travel and location.
  • Stage two: technical and architecture assessment with Wiser's engineering and delivery leadership — a case-based discovery exercise and an artificial-intelligence solution design review, including estimate and financial-parameter validation.
  • Offer: terms confirmed according to country of residence.


What's in it for you

Culture & Development:

  • Friendly Environment: We take pride in our culture, and we love spending time together.

  • Team Spirit: Be part of a supportive team that uplifts each other.

  • Mentorship and coaching. Our colleagues are experts in their field, and you can expect to have a strong team to rely on.

  • Personalized Development Program: We realize one size doesn’t fit all, so you get an individual development plan tailored specifically to your career aspirations.

Social Benefits:

  • A Suite of Perks: Additional health insurance, referral bonus, and more.

  • Work Flexibility: Embrace flexible working hours and a hybrid work model.

  • Multiple Office Locations: in Sofia, Plovdiv, Stara Zagora, and Nis, you choose where you would like to work.

  • Community and Connections: Engage in exciting social events and team initiatives.

  • Empowerment: At Wiser, every role is instrumental. You will have the power to make a difference!

jobs.excerpt: With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life.
jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:


Please submit your CV and Cover Letter in English.

This is a remote/homeworking opportunity open to candidates internationally. To facilitate collaboration across our international team, we have a preference for candidates located within approximately ±4 to 5 hours of the United Kingdom's time zone (GMT/BST). We nevertheless welcome applications from qualified candidates in other eligible locations. Final appointment will be subject to the selected candidate residing in a country where World Vision International (WVI) is registered and able to employ staff.


JOB PURPOSE

The Senior Advisor, Children, Digital and AI strengthens World Vision International's (WVI) external influence and positioning on children's digital rights, Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance and digital participation. The role develops evidence-informed policy positions, thought leadership and coalition engagement, working across Child-led and Digital Advocacy (CLAD) and through a matrix relationship with Global Partnerships and Influence (GP&I) to connect children's voices and rights in the digital environment and systems-influencing opportunities under the global strategy “Our Promise” (OP3), shift 3.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

External Thought Leadership and Policy Influencing — Children, Digital and AI:

  • Develop and position World Vision's agenda on children in digital environments and AI, going beyond online safety to address digital rights, data governance, AI systems affecting children, and children's participation in digital futures.
  • Track and analyse global policy, regulatory and multilateral developments relevant to children and AI/digital environments, providing timely intelligence and positioning advice to CLAD, GP&I and Advocacy & External Engagement (A&EE) leadership.
  • Develop high-quality thought leadership content — papers, briefs, op-eds, speaking notes and external statements — that positions WVI as a credible and distinctive voice in digital rights and AI policy for children.
  • Represent WVI in relevant external policy forums, multi-stakeholder consultations, regulatory processes and events, coordinating closely with GP&I to ensure coherence with wider WVI policy positions.
  • Work with the matrix line into GP&I to align WVI's positioning on children and digital/AI with broader systems-influencing and multilateral engagement priorities.

Coalition, Partnership and Multi-stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead or coordinate WVI engagement in a small number of priority external coalitions or multi-stakeholder networks focused on children's digital rights, AI governance, online safety or children in digital environments.
  • Develop and maintain an external stakeholder map of priority actors, coalitions, regulatory bodies and thought leaders in the children, digital and AI space, using it to identify entry points and influence opportunities.
  • Negotiate and operationalise engagement plans with key external partners, brokering opportunities to amplify children's voices and WVI's positions in relevant global debates.
  • In coordination with the matrix relationship into GP&I, ensure WVI's coalition engagement on children and digital/AI is aligned with wider systems-influencing strategies and avoids duplication.
  • Work with the Senior Advisor, Child-led and Digital Advocacy to identify joint coalition opportunities and ensure internal complementarity.

Policy, Evidence and Positioning Development

  • Commission, synthesise and produce evidence and analysis on the impact of digital environments and AI on children's rights, wellbeing and participation, translating emerging research into actionable policy asks and advocacy content.
  • Develop and maintain WVI's policy positions on priority children and digital/AI issues, including processes for updating positions in response to fast-moving regulatory and policy developments.

La personne sélectionnée devra mener les activités suivantes :

  • Réaliser un diagnostic des modules et outils pédagogiques existants.
  • Réviser et moderniser les contenus de formation en intégrant les tendances entrepreneuriales actuelles, les besoins du marché et les approches inclusives.
  • Développer des curricula, outils pédagogiques, fiches techniques et outils d'évaluation des apprentissages.
  • Concevoir des guides d'animation destinés aux formateurs communautaires.
  • Accompagner l'équipe dans l'adoption et l'utilisation des nouveaux contenus et outils de formation.

Compétences académiques essentielles:

  • Diplôme universitaire en entrepreneuriat, développement ou gestion des entreprises, ou domaine connexe.

Expérience / Compétences professionnelles essentiels:

  • Minimum de cinq ans d'expérience en conception, révision ou amélioration de programmes de formation en entrepreneuriat.
  • Expérience dans le développement de formations destinées aux jeunes entrepreneurs.
  • Expérience en formation des formateurs et en accompagnement d'équipes pédagogiques.
  • Bonne connaissance des enjeux liés à l'égalité des genres et à l'inclusion sociale et économique (GESI).

À propos du coopérant-volontaire

Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. Contribuer ses compétences à une communauté, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, et de faire de nouvelles connexions sont les avantages communs du volontariat virtuel, et pour Cuso International c’est aussi une grande opportunité pour engager plus de personnes dans sa mission.

Certains de nos partenaires se trouvent dans des zones reculées avec une connexion Internet peu fiable. Par conséquent, lorsque vous travaillez avec les partenaires, il est raisonnable de supposer que les réponses à vos courriels ne seront pas envoyées immédiatement (structure change in this sentence). De plus, pour certains de nos partenaires, il s'agit de leur première expérience de travail avec des volontaires virtuel, de sorte que la flexibilité et la patience sont une caractéristique précieuse du volontariat virtuel.

À propos de nous

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Safety Core, you’ll build software that helps customers identify and reduce risk across vehicles, equipment, workers, and customer sites. You’ll develop the systems and product capabilities that turn signals from connected devices and operational workflows into timely, trustworthy safety insights. Initial opportunities may support Safety Operated Equipment or Safety Installations, with the flexibility to contribute to other Safety Core initiatives as priorities evolve. You’ll take ambiguous customer and operational problems from discovery through technical design, production delivery, and measurement. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys defining both the problem and the approach, making sound trade-offs, and connecting engineering work to customer outcomes.

This is a position open to candidates based in or close to Toronto, Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Unlock new customer-facing Safety product capabilities, not just maintain existing systems. Pursue the best solution to the problem - even when that means working beyond a single service or discipline and partnering across application, platform, data, and ML.
  • Translate customer and operational needs into useful, maintainable capabilities, initially supporting Safety Operated Equipment or Safety Installations, with the flexibility to contribute to other Safety Core priorities.
  • Own outcomes, not just project delivery: start from the real-world safety or customer problem, help define how success will be measured, and stay accountable for whether the product meaningfully improves that measure. Frame ambiguous problems, identify what is needed, align partners, deliver, measure impact in production, and iterate until the intended outcome is achieved. Be resourceful and move quickly while maintaining sound engineering judgment.
  • Build and operate reliable software across the parts of the stack needed to deliver the outcome, making pragmatic trade-offs across customer value, reliability, scalability, delivery speed, and long-term maintainability.
  • Use AI tools as a core part of the engineering workflow to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, and iteration; validate outputs and remain accountable for the quality of what ships.
  • Partner closely across functions - including product, design, platform, data, and ML—to turn customer needs and real-world feedback into clear technical plans and shipped improvements.
  • Use production data, customer feedback, and operational signals to understand whether the real-world problem is improving - not just whether the engineering solution shipped—and use that evidence to guide iteration.
  • Raise the engineering bar through strong technical designs, thoughtful reviews, clear communication, mentoring, and improvements to how the team builds and operates software.
  • Automatically included - do not run through Bias Decoder:
    • All Roles: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
    • People Manager Roles: Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience shipping and supporting production software that solves customer problems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems in at least one modern programming language.
  • Experience designing or operating backend, distributed, data-intensive, or full-stack systems, with depth in at least one of these areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer or real-world problem, define a practical approach and meaningful measure of success, and work with cross-functional partners to deliver and validate an outcome—not just complete a scoped engineering project.
  • Demonstrated, regular use of AI tools across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering speed and quality, with the judgment to validate AI-generated work and maintain ownership of correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Ability to connect engineering decisions to customer or operational outcomes and use data and customer feedback to determine whether the underlying problem is getting better.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions, explain trade-offs, and align partners across functions.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building products involving connected devices, physical operations, safety, or other real-world workflows.
  • Experience owning product or engineering work through discovery, delivery, rollout, and iteration, with a focus on achieving measurable customer or operational impact rather than shipping to scope alone.
  • Experience developing customer-facing product capabilities across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Experience working with event-driven, distributed, or workflow-orchestration systems.
  • Experience partnering with data, AI, or ML teams, or building products that use data-driven or model-powered capabilities. This is useful context, not a requirement for every Safety Core project.
  • A track record of improving engineering quality, mentoring teammates, and helping a team navigate ambiguity.
  • Curiosity about how software can make complex real-world operations safer and more effective.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$126,225—$163,350 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks

Job Description

We are engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required — your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter.

Scope of Work

  1. Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors.
  2. Identify edge cases the rubrics don’t currently cover and recommend how they should be handled.
  3. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved.
  4. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems.
  5. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions.
  6. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently.
  7. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate.
  2. Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role.
  3. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.
  4. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction.
  5. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work.

We're hiring a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) to join Realm Lab and drive research initiatives focused on evaluating and improving frontier AI systems.

This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of machine learning, data research, and evaluation engineering. You'll work closely with researchers and domain experts to develop benchmarks, reinforcement learning environments, and high-quality datasets that advance model capabilities and performance.

  6. Build reproducible evaluation pipelines and feedback loops to support iterative model development.
  7. Contribute to benchmarks, research papers, technical reports, and open research artifacts.

  2. Hands-on experience designing ML evaluations, benchmark suites, research datasets, or experimental frameworks.

  4. Understanding of LLMs, foundation models, post-training techniques, and evaluation methodologies.

In addition to its representation business, Range has a fully-fledged independent studio that develops, packages, and produces projects for film, scripted and unscripted television, digital content, and more. Range is a solution-oriented, collaborative environment which prioritizes candor, resourcefulness, learning, and creativity.

Job Summary

Superfly is seeking an experienced, self-starting marketing lead to oversee the development and execution of the marketing strategy for a new event launching in Arizona, California, Nashville or New York in Fall 2027.

This individual will be responsible for building the event’s brand identity and marketing presence from the ground up, including brand positioning, website development, social media management, radio advertising, outdoor advertising, content strategy, digital advertising, and influencer partnerships.

The ideal candidate is an experienced marketer who sets strategic direction and exercises independent judgment over brand positioning, campaign priorities, and marketing investments. They should be comfortable working under general supervision, evaluating performance and adjusting tactics and strategy, allocating resources within approved budgets, and directing external creative and digital partners to achieve the festival’s business objectives.

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in launching a new entertainment property and help establish its identity.

Who You Are

Self-directed, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities.

It would be music to our ears if you have:

  • Previous experience launching or marketing a music festival, concert series, golf event, or other live entertainment property.
  • Existing industry relationships or demonstrated familiarity with country music, golf, or both.
  • Experience developing and managing influencer or creator marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with artist marketing, talent management, and music industry promotional practices.
  • Experience developing marketing campaigns specifically designed to drive ticket sales.
  • Knowledge of the Arizona market and regional entertainment audiences.
  • Experience working with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, WordPress, Webflow, or comparable marketing tools.
  • Experience coordinating public relations, earned media, or external PR agencies.

Expected Responsibilities

Brand Development & Marketing Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of the festival’s overarching marketing strategy, from initial brand development through the inaugural event.
  • Establish the festival’s brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, messaging, and target audience profiles.
  • Work with festival leadership and external creative partners to develop a cohesive visual identity, brand guidelines, and marketing assets.
  • Create a comprehensive marketing roadmap outlining campaign objectives, promotional milestones, and key deliverables leading up to Fall 2027.
  • Research comparable festivals and relevant consumer brands to identify market opportunities and competitive positioning.

Website Development & Digital Infrastructure

  • Lead the creation, launch, and ongoing management of the festival’s website, including coordinating with external developers and designers as needed.
  • Determine website content strategy, user experience priorities, and integration requirements; direct developers and other resources responsible for implementation.
  • Evaluate and select digital marketing platforms within approved spending authority, establish audience acquisition and segmentation strategies, and oversee implementation by assigned resources.
  • Define the marketing measurement framework, determine reporting requirements, and use performance analysis to make campaign and investment decisions.
  • Ensure consistency in branding, messaging, and user experience across all digital platforms.

Social Media & Content Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy across relevant platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels.
  • Set channel priorities, editorial standards, and audience engagement strategy; oversee publishing and community management performed by designated internal or external resources.
  • Determine editorial priorities and campaign sequencing across festival milestones, artist announcements, ticket launches, and sponsorship activations; development and maintenance of the supporting content calendar.
  • Develop content concepts and set creative direction, evaluate proposed approaches, and approve digital assets, including social graphics, short-form video, photography, and promotional materials.

Influencer, Artist & Partnership Marketing

  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.

jobs.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

Are you passionate about computer science, education, and AI? Do you want to help teachers in the U.S. and around the world learn with and about AI?

Every day, teachers use CodeAI to introduce students to computer science and AI. As a Software Engineer on our Teacher Experience team, you'll make that experience faster, clearer, and more reliable for the educators who rely on it.

You'll work alongside product managers, designers, and curriculum writers to take features from ambiguous classroom needs to production, using agentic AI tools to accelerate the work without sacrificing maintainability.

Want to learn more about our engineering organization as a whole? Great news! We’re fully open source, and our products are free to use, so in addition to checking out our company and engineering team pages, you can check out our GitHub, review our architectural tenets, and check out our course catalog.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role you will:

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and curriculum writers to develop end-to-end features that are accessible, usable, and engaging in real classrooms.
  • Write and maintain production-ready code in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Ruby on Rails, and SQL, working with AWS services like S3 and CloudWatch for asset storage, logging, and infrastructure.
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-focused products for students, including evaluating, selecting, and incorporating generative AI models with an eye toward safety, bias mitigation, and effectiveness.
  • Take ownership of complex projects, driving technical decisions and collaborating across teams to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Support site and user needs, including monitoring production issues, deploying updates, triaging user-submitted issues, and responding to teacher and student inquiries.
  • Help foster a collaborative, encouraging team culture through knowledge shares, code reviews, and helping teammates succeed.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • A passion for expanding access to computer science and AI education and building tools that help students and teachers succeed.
  • 10+ years developing and maintaining consumer-grade full-stack web applications, preferably using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Ruby on Rails, and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic AI tools to build software, with a track record of continuously learning new tools and workflows as the space evolves.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and supporting high-scale, production applications.
  • Technical leadership experience, whether through leading architectural changes, setting technical direction, or mentoring teammates.
  • The ability to drive projects independently, including breaking down work into smaller features, making informed tradeoffs, and communicating progress effectively.
  • A collaborative mindset, with a strong belief in supporting teammates, sharing knowledge, and contributing to an inclusive engineering culture.

We prefer candidates who also have:

  • Experience working on AI-powered products or educational technology, particularly in building tools that help students learn to use and learn with LLMs.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $145,800 - $162,000. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, and skillset.

Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Transformation Director is responsible for leading and driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business growth, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees strategic transformation programmes involving digital innovation, business process reengineering, operating model redesign, technology modernization, organizational restructuring, regulatory compliance, and cultural change.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, business unit heads, technology teams, and external partners to translate corporate strategy into actionable transformation initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes, sustainable change adoption, and improved organizational performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Translate corporate objectives into strategic transformation initiatives, programmes, and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, operational improvement, digitalization, and organizational growth.
  • Align transformation priorities with business strategy, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Process & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead business process reengineering initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Evaluate existing operating models and recommend organizational, structural, and operational improvements.
  • Drive simplification, standardization, and automation of business processes.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, cost inefficiencies, and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable improvements across business functions.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead digital transformation initiatives involving automation, cloud adoption, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise technology modernization.
  • Oversee the implementation of digital platforms, business applications, and technology-enabled operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT leadership to ensure technology investments support business priorities.
  • Promote digital innovation across insurance operations, investment management, customer services, and distribution channels.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives improve data quality, system integration, security, and operational resilience.

D. Programme & Portfolio Leadership

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio and major change programmes.
  • Establish transformation governance frameworks, delivery structures, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Monitor programme milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Coordinate programme directors, project managers, business leaders, and external consultants.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs, improve profitability, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial benefits, and return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to measure the financial and operational impact of transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Culture Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management strategies to support transformation adoption.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop change communication, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Build organizational readiness and address resistance to change.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure new processes, technologies, and operating models are effectively adopted across the organization.

G. Stakeholder, Risk & Regulatory Management

  • Engage executive leadership, board members, regulators, business partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Identify and manage strategic, operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Present transformation progress, performance metrics, challenges, and recommendations to executive committees and the board.
  • Ensure effective governance, transparency, and accountability throughout the transformation lifecycle.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong financial analysis, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and executive communication capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Join Fyfe and help strengthen the document control behind successful engineering and resources project delivery.

jobs.excerpt: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Digital Transformation Director is responsible for defining and leading the organization's digital transformation strategy to modernize business operations, enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation through technology.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide digital initiatives involving technology modernization, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud adoption, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and system integration.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, IT teams, business unit heads, and external technology partners to translate business objectives into digital transformation roadmaps, manage strategic technology investments, and ensure successful implementation of digital solutions that deliver measurable business value.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.
