jobs.title: Robotics Simulation and Navigation Engineer — Real-to-Sim
jobs.excerpt: Job Purpose About the Role You own the loop between the real venues our robots work in and their simulated twins.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

About the Role

You own the loop between the real venues our robots work in and their simulated twins.

Our humanoids interact with people in real venues: hotels, clinics, museums, offices. Today the robot stands still and gives directions from a tagged map. The next step is for it to move with people, and before a humanoid walks among strangers we want to have tested that behavior in a faithful simulation of the exact venue. The step after that is to use those twins to evaluate robot policies and behaviors at a scale no number of live sessions can reach, and to offer venue twins and sim-based evaluation to the robot makers we work with alongside the real data we collect there.

You build that capability: capture real environments, turn them into simulation-ready twins using the real-to-sim tooling that now exists rather than writing your own, make the robot navigate in the twin and then in the real venue, and close the gap between the two. This is a long-term role that starts with one venue and one robot and grows into a capture-to-twin-to-evaluation pipeline used across our physical AI work.

What this role is not: you will not develop a physics engine or a simulator core, and you will not build general simulation infrastructure. We adopt Isaac Sim-class platforms and the open real-to-sim pipelines around them; your job is to make them work for our venues and our robots

About Train AI

RWS TrainAI is the AI data and evaluation business of RWS Group, working with leading AI developers worldwide. We are building a physical AI practice: multilingual, culturally localized interaction for service robots, human evaluation of how robots behave around people, and the data pipelines behind both. Our advantage is a global, multilingual human network and a focus on behavior that is culturally appropriate, measured and auditable.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

Capture and reconstruct real environments

  • Stand up and adapt existing real-to-sim tooling (Isaac Sim with NuRec, Genie Sim, Gaussian-splat and photogrammetry pipelines, handheld LiDAR scanners) into a venue capture pipeline, aligned to the tagged point-of-interest map our deployments already use.
  • Turn reconstructions into simulation-ready scenes: mesh extraction, collision and material setup, semantic labels, USD export, with the venue’s furniture and lighting represented well enough to matter.
  • Populate twins with pedestrian agents (crowd simulation) matched to the venue’s traffic, so social navigation can be tested against people, not empty corridors.
  • Define what “faithful enough” means for each use (navigation testing, perception testing, policy evaluation) and measure it.

Navigation on the real robot

  • Build localization and navigation for our humanoid in human environments: LiDAR-inertial SLAM (Livox-class sensors, FAST-LIO2 / Point-LIO or equivalent), Nav2 or equivalent planning, dynamic obstacle avoidance among pedestrians, and the social rules (keep distance, give way, slow near groups) our HRI scientist specifies.
  • Test every navigation change in the venue twin before it runs in the venue, with the systems integration engineer who owns the robot and its safety envelope.
  • Integrate with the application layer so a walk through the venue is a sequence of points of interest the dialogue can narrate, and build the recovery behaviors for when navigation fails in front of people. The robot runs in production; you share the on-call rotation for it.

Sim-to-real and evaluation

  • Emulate our robot’s sensors in the twin (RGB, depth, LiDAR, microphones where it matters) closely enough that perception results transfer, and calibrate dynamics between twin and robot.
  • Close the gap: domain randomization, the measurements that tell us when a result in simulation predicts a result in the venue, and a tracked sim-to-real gap for navigation.
  • Build closed-loop and log-replay evaluation of robot behaviors and policies in the twin, replaying our real interaction and demonstration data, so that behavior changes and third-party policies can be tested at scale before live sessions.
  • Work with our data and research engineers so the twins, the real recordings and the evaluation results share one schema and can be delivered together to robot makers.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • Degree in robotics, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of robot simulation: operating and extending an Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo or Genesis-class platform for training or evaluation, including building scenes and assets (USD or equivalent) and a real-to-sim pipeline of some kind.
  • 3+ years of navigation on real mobile robots in human environments: indoor localization and mapping, 3D sensors for world modeling, planning and avoidance around people.
  • Strong Python and C++; ROS 2; LiDAR and IMU fusion; comfortable with GPU workflows.
  • Experience taking something from simulation onto a real robot and dealing with what broke, and with closed-loop or log-replay evaluation.
  • Professional working English; Mandarin a strong plus for working with venues and the China team.

Preferred

  • Hands-on neural scene reconstruction (3D Gaussian splatting, NeRF) or photogrammetry, and turning it into simulator assets.
  • Navigation or locomotion on a legged or humanoid platform.
  • Sensor emulation, domain randomization, and numerical optimization for calibration or motion planning.
  • Social navigation research or deployment in retail, hospitality, healthcare or museums.
  • Semantic or open-vocabulary mapping (scene graphs) for linking the navigation map to a knowledge base.
  • Experience with closed-loop or log-replay evaluation of robot policies at scale, or with VLA / world-model training data.

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: a live demo in front of an audience. Not polished: the first venue captured and reconstructed into a navigable simulation twin, the humanoid localizing and navigating in it with pedestrian agents, shown side by side with the real venue; capture protocol documented so a second venue takes a week.
  • By 6 months: the humanoid navigating in the real venue with the social rules in place, every change tested in the twin first; a measured sim-to-real gap for navigation with a plan to close it.
  • By 12 months: three venues captured and simulated; sim-based evaluation running on our real data; a first venue twin plus evaluation report delivered to a robot maker.

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Job Description Summary

‎

At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Data Engineer who lives and breathes healthcare data end-to-end, understands how to make BigQuery purr across ML and Looker, and champions data as the fundamental lifeblood of our product. Operating on Google Cloud Platform, you will build unified models from multi-source data while informing leadership of emerging trends and breathing the "art of the possible" into our products and processes. If you are a high-agency builder who can elevate data from "something we look at" to the core engine driving consumer experiences for millions, we want to talk to you.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Who You Are:

  • A Healthcare Data Native: You breathe healthcare data end-to-end. You understand the nuances, complexities, and operational realities of acquiring, ingesting, and transforming fragmented multi-source data—from raw claims and clinical feeds to benefit designs and user telemetry.
  • A Value-Obsessed BigQuery Virtuoso: To you, BigQuery isn't just a passive storage warehouse—it’s your ML engine, your clean room, and your business catalyst. You know data is only as valuable as its downstream impact, and you know how to make BigQuery purr to directly power ML models, advanced analytics, Looker dashboards, and real-time consumer experiences. You bridge the gap between raw bytes and real utility.
  • A Cultural Evangelist & Advocate: You advocate fiercely for the organization to see data not as a static byproduct or "a thing we look at," but as the foundational lifeblood of our product.
  • A Multi-Source Data Architect: You excel at taking disparate, messy inputs from dozens of health plans and employers and unifying them into clean, highly structured, production-grade data models that drive actual decisions and actions.
  • An End-to-End Pipeline Operator: You design, orchestrate, and maintain bulletproof data pipelines using Python, Apache Airflow, and GCP native tools. You take total ownership of data quality, latency, and uptime from raw ingestion to active consumption.
  • High-Agency & Execution-Driven: You maintain a ship-first, high-impact mindset. You eliminate operational drag, build resilient pipelines, and serve as the technical authority who ensures data isn't just sitting in a database, but actively moving the business forward.

Who We Are:

At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives.


What You'll Do:

Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Staff Individual Contributor driving the architecture, scale, and actionable value of Castlight's core data ecosystem on Google Cloud Platform. You will take ownership of multi-source healthcare data processing, building the foundational engine that powers personalized care navigation, predictive analytics, and enterprise intelligence for millions of users.


In this role, you will:

  • Inform Strategy & Trends: Continuously analyze and inform engineering and executive leadership of emerging data trends, operational patterns, and architectural opportunities across our entire data surface.
  • Inspire Innovation: Breathe the "art of the possible" directly into our products, engineering processes, and user journeys by uncovering new ways to leverage modern data tools and AI/ML capabilities.
  • Champion Data as Lifeblood: Advocate relentlessly across the entire organization so that data is treated not as a report we look at, but as the core, real-time lifeblood that fuels our consumer product experience.
  • Architect & Scale Data Engines: Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines using BigQuery, Python, and Airflow on GCP to process high-volume healthcare data streams.
  • Unify Multi-Source Data: Transform complex, heterogeneous healthcare data feeds (claims, eligibility, clinical, engagement) into normalized, highly performant data models designed for immediate operational use.
  • Bridge the Value Gap: Unlock BigQuery as an all-in-one execution engine—connecting backend data architectures seamlessly to downstream consumers like Looker, machine learning models, and consumer-facing application APIs.
  • Partner with Product & AI/ML Teams: Collaborate directly with engineering, analytics, and product leaders to ensure clean, low-latency data actively fuels predictive models, reporting suites, and intelligent user touchpoints.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Technical Experience: 8+ years of data engineering experience with a focus on building distributed data platforms and pipelines at enterprise scale.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep hands-on experience working with complex, multi-source healthcare data domains (claims, clinical, eligibility, benefit structures, or HL7/FHIR formats).
  • GCP & BigQuery Value-Centric Mastery: Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform, specifically using BigQuery as a high-performance engine to power ML workflows, analytics, and BI tools like Looker.
  • Pipeline Orchestration: Expert-level capability in Python and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer) for orchestrating complex batch and event-driven data workflows.
  • Data Modeling for Utility: Proven track record of designing scalable schemas, entity-resolution pipelines, and semantic layers that bridge raw database tables to active consumption.
  • Communication & Evangelism: Exceptional ability to translate complex data architectures into clear business strategy, inform leadership of key trends, and advocate for data-driven product transformation across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You'll Get:

  • Competitive Compensation: A highly competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Technical Autonomy & Vision: Full ownership over the architecture and direction of core healthcare data engines on GCP, with the mandate to shape how our product uses data.
  • High-Visibility Scale: Direct impact on data systems that process massive healthcare workloads for millions of active users.
  • Work That Matters: Build data systems where every pipeline directly enables personalized, actionable health insights for real people.

1. Role Summary

The Enterprise Transformation Director is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy to improve business performance, operational efficiency, financial sustainability, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role drives large-scale transformation initiatives across business operations, technology, organizational structures, digital capabilities, governance, and customer-facing services.

The incumbent translates corporate strategy into an integrated transformation roadmap, oversees strategic programmes and transformation portfolios, and ensures initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role works closely with the CEO, executive leadership, business unit heads, and external partners to drive sustainable organizational change and achieve strategic objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy, vision, and execution roadmap.
  • Translate corporate strategy into transformation priorities, strategic initiatives, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, organizational improvement, operational modernization, and sustainable growth.
  • Align transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide operating model redesign and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing business structures, processes, capabilities, and operating models to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive business process reengineering, simplification, standardization, and automation.
  • Oversee transformation of insurance operations, investment services, distribution channels, and customer service functions.
  • Improve organizational agility, productivity, cost efficiency, and service delivery.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Oversee enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and digital business solutions.
  • Lead modernization and integration of enterprise applications, core insurance systems, investment platforms, and customer management technologies.
  • Collaborate with technology leadership to ensure digital investments support business strategy.
  • Promote innovation, data-driven decision-making, and technology-enabled business growth.

D. Transformation Portfolio & Programme Governance

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio, programmes, and major initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise transformation governance frameworks, performance controls, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Monitor transformation milestones, budgets, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate transformation directors, programme managers, project leaders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital and resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial performance, and expected return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to track financial and non-financial outcomes.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Cultural Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management and organizational development strategies.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to drive workforce transformation, leadership alignment, and cultural change.
  • Build organizational readiness and employee engagement for major transformation initiatives.
  • Oversee communication, training, capability development, and change adoption programmes.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

G. Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee transformation-related strategic, operational, financial, technology, and compliance risks.
  • Collaborate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen governance and controls.
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational resilience, data governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure transformation programmes maintain appropriate oversight, accountability, and auditability.

H. Executive Stakeholder & Board Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, board members, executive committees, and business unit leaders.
  • Present transformation strategies, performance reports, financial outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead enterprise transformation steering committees and executive review meetings.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, strategic partners, technology providers, and regulators.
  • Ensure executive alignment and accountability for transformation outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or executive programme leadership.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior director-level or enterprise transformation leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong expertise in operating model redesign, business process reengineering, digital transformation, and organizational change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large transformation portfolios, budgets, executive stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong financial management, strategic planning, governance, and benefits realization capabilities.
  • Certifications such as PgMP, PMP, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation strategy and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation programmes delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost savings, revenue growth, and productivity improvements.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and business performance.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.
  • Digital adoption and technology modernization success rates.
  • Employee engagement, organizational readiness, and change adoption.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Executive and board-level stakeholder satisfaction.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating potentially improper, excessive, unsupported, or medically unnecessary healthcare services.

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Quality Engineering

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage.

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity.

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development.

What You'll Do

  1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage.
  2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows.
  3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes.
  4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues.
  5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk.
  6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.
  7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality.
  8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture.
  2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks.
  3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows.
  4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies.
  5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure.
  6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases.
  7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows.
  8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work.
  9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers.
  10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on.

Nice to have

  1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments.
  2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation.
  3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team.
  4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows.
  5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery.
  6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

  • Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.

  • Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.

  • Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or

  • A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.

jobs.excerpt: Ready to make a real impact on global health and wellness care?
jobs.description:
Ready to make a real impact on global health and wellness care?

Practice Better is an all-in-one platform helping health and wellness practitioners run their businesses, care for their clients, and scale their impact. Founded by practitioners in 2016, we’re now the leading EHR and practice management platform in the wellness industry, trusted by tens of thousands of practitioners across 70+ countries.

In 2023, we expanded our whole-practice care offering through the acquisition of That Clean Life, bringing nutrition planning into our platform.

We’re a remote-first team headquartered in Toronto, made up of curious, driven, and empathetic people building tools that help practitioners create sustainable, independent practices; and do the most meaningful work of their careers. While most of our work happens remotely, we come together regularly for off-sites and team events to stay connected and build together.

Important notice to our applicants and job seekers:

We've become aware of fraudulent messages impersonating Practice Better's recruitment team.

Please note:

  • Practice Better will never ask for payment, banking details, or personal financial information at any stage of the hiring process
  • All official communication comes from @practicebetter.io email addresses
  • We will never ask you to purchase equipment, software, or gift cards
  • We will never conduct interviews solely via text message or WhatsApp

If something feels off, trust your instincts. Verify any suspicious outreach by contacting us directly at before taking any action.

Thank you for helping us keep our hiring process safe and transparent.

About Practice Better Payments

Launched in August 2023, Practice Better Payments is our fully integrated payment processing solution powered by Stripe. We provide practitioners with seamless payment processing including online and in-person transactions, automated payment plans, digital wallets, and comprehensive revenue reporting—all within a single HIPAA-compliant platform.

The Role

We're seeking a Payment Operations Manager to own the day-to-day operations of Practice Better Payments as a core member of our dedicated Payments squad. Embedded alongside Product, Design, and Engineering, you'll ensure payments run reliably for practitioners and their clients, with high transaction success rates, minimal disputes and chargebacks, and on-time payouts, and you'll use what you see in the data and the field to shape the experience we build.

You'll be the squad's operational expert, responsible for transaction monitoring, dispute resolution, fraud prevention, operational reporting, and continuous process improvement. You'll work closely with our payment processor Stripe, partner with Customer Success and Support, and manage a Payment Support Specialist who handles day-to-day merchant support, with your guidance and escalation support. You'll also turn what you learn into product decisions by identifying failure patterns, surfacing practitioner pain points, and helping determine what we build next in embedded fintech.

This is a hands-on role for someone with deep payments experience in SaaS, ideally vertical SaaS, who wants to move from running payments to shaping them. As the squad and our embedded fintech roadmap mature, it can grow into a Fintech Product Manager role.

Note: Practice Better is a remote-first company with team members across North America. However, this particular role is currently open to Canadian-based candidates only, and preference will be given to applicants legally authorized to work in Canada.

What You’ll Be Doing

Payment Operations & Transaction Management

  • Monitor daily payment transaction flow, identifying and resolving processing issues, failures, and anomalies
  • Oversee payout operations ensuring practitioners receive funds on schedule and reconciliation is accurate
  • Manage refund processing, ensuring timely execution and proper documentation
  • Track and report on key operational metrics including transaction success rates, failure rates, decline reasons, and processing times
  • Coordinate with Stripe support to resolve technical issues, escalate critical problems, and implement fixes
  • Maintain operational dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into payment health and performance
  • Identify patterns in payment failures and work with Engineering to implement systematic improvements

Dispute & Chargeback Management

  • Own end-to-end dispute and chargeback process from notification through resolution
  • Investigate disputed transactions, gather evidence, and submit compelling responses to maximize win rates
  • Communicate with practitioners about disputes, providing guidance on documentation requirements and best practices
  • Track dispute metrics including dispute rates, chargeback ratios, win/loss rates, and financial impact
  • Identify root causes of disputes and implement preventative measures to reduce future occurrences
  • Ensure compliance with card network rules and maintain chargeback ratios within acceptable thresholds
  • Build and maintain dispute response templates, playbooks, and practitioner education materials

Risk Management & Fraud Prevention

  • Monitor transactions for suspicious activity, potential fraud, and unusual patterns
  • Collaborate with Stripe's risk team on account reviews, fraud investigations, and merchant underwriting
  • Manage account holds, restrictions, and security reviews ensuring swift resolution with minimal practitioner impact
  • Review and approve high-risk transactions or merchants based on established criteria
  • Maintain and optimize fraud detection rules and risk tolerance thresholds
  • Track fraud metrics including fraud rates, false positives, and financial losses
  • Develop fraud prevention education materials for practitioners to reduce client-initiated fraud

Merchant Support & Enablement

  • Serve as escalation point for complex payment issues that Customer Success and Support teams cannot resolve
  • Troubleshoot practitioner payment configuration issues including payout settings, payment methods, and account setup
  • Guide practitioners through payment compliance requirements, documentation requests, and account verification
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, missing transactions, and reconciliation issues
  • Partner with Support team to create and maintain payment help documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides
  • Analyze support ticket trends to identify systemic issues and opportunities for product or process improvements
  • Conduct post-mortems on major payment incidents and implement preventative measures

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Design, document, and optimize payment operations workflows to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Build and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all payment operations processes
  • Implement automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
  • Conduct regular operational reviews identifying bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to prioritize operational pain points and feature requests
  • Establish operational quality standards and service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the practitioner payment experience

Reporting & Analytics

  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards tracking payment performance, issues, and trends
  • Provide regular reporting to the Payments squad and VP, Product on operational health, risks, and opportunities
  • Analyze payment data to identify patterns in transaction failures, disputes, fraud, and practitioner behavior
  • Conduct cohort analyses and segmentation to understand payment performance across practitioner types, geographies, and use cases
  • Prepare monthly operational reviews highlighting key metrics, incidents, wins, and action items
  • Use data insights to inform operational strategy and prioritize improvement initiatives

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in payment operations, transaction processing, or related fintech operations roles
  • Experience in payments at a SaaS company, ideally vertical SaaS
  • Strong understanding of payment processing fundamentals including authorization, settlement, refunds, and chargebacks
  • Hands-on experience with dispute management, chargeback processes, and card network rules
  • Proven track record managing day-to-day payment operations with high transaction volumes
  • Experience working with payment service providers such as Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Adyen, or similar platforms
  • Excellent analytical skills with ability to interpret data, identify trends, and draw actionable insights
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with demonstrated success troubleshooting complex payment issues
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, data visualization tools)
  • Outstanding attention to detail and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex payment concepts clearly
  • Customer-focused mindset with commitment to delivering exceptional support experiences
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote environment

Bonus Points

  • Experience in B2B or platform payment operations supporting merchants or business users
  • Background in healthcare technology, health and wellness, or SMB-focused platforms
  • Knowledge of payment compliance requirements including PCI DSS, AML/KYC, and regional regulations
  • Familiarity with fraud detection techniques, risk management, and security best practices
  • Experience with subscription billing, recurring payments, and payment plan operations
  • Understanding of payment APIs, webhooks, and technical integrations
  • Process improvement or Six Sigma training/certification
  • Stripe platform experience strongly preferred
  • Experience managing or mentoring team members

Key Success Metrics

  • Transaction Success Rate: Maintain >95% authorization success rate for valid transactions
  • Dispute Win Rate: Achieve >40% win rate on disputed transactions through effective evidence submission
  • Chargeback Ratio: Keep chargeback ratio below 0.65% to maintain good standing with card networks
  • Response Time: Resolve 90% of operational issues within 24 hours of identification
  • Practitioner Satisfaction: Maintain <1% support ticket rate for payment issues and high CSAT scores
  • Operational Efficiency: Reduce manual processing time by 20% through automation and process improvements

Compensation & Pay Transparency

At Practice Better, we believe in pay transparency, equity, and fairness. We benchmark compensation against similar-stage, high-growth SaaS companies in both Canada and the United States and review our salary bands regularly to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with market trends.

Each role has a defined pay range based on its level, scope, and geographic location. Final offers are determined by several factors, including experience, demonstrated skills, and location, to ensure consistency and equity across our team.

Anticipated Salary Range (Canada): $135,000 – $155,000 CAD

We take a holistic approach to compensation, combining salary, benefits, and flexibility. Our goal is to provide total rewards that support both your professional growth and personal well-being.

The range above reflects our expected compensation for this role, based on current market data. Final offers may vary depending on factors such as location, skills, depth of experience, and relevant certifications. All compensation ranges are reviewed regularly and may evolve over time to reflect changes in the market.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Benefits
We offer a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage from day 1, as well as RRSP matching, generous paid parental leave, and annual learning stipends.

Remote-First, Connected CultureOur remote-first model gives you autonomy and flexibility, with optional access to our downtown Toronto office for in-person collaboration. We also host regular off-sites and team gatherings across North America, because connection, creativity, and shared moments matter.

Wellness and Growth

  • Unlimited vacation, built on trust, clear expectations, and real support for taking time off
  • Company RRSP program with employer-matched contributions
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits from day 1
  • $750 annual Health & Wellness Allowance
  • $1,000 annual Learning & Development Allowance to support your growth
  • $500 annual Home Office Allowance to set up a productive remote workspace
  • Sprout Family: personalized support for family-building and fertility journeys
  • Inkblot: confidential, digital mental health support from licensed professionals
  • Company-wide holiday closure in December
  • Regular virtual company-wide events, lunches, and team socials to stay connected

Thriving at Practice Better

At Practice Better, you are not just an employee. You are part of a mission-driven community dedicated to helping others thrive. You will be trusted with autonomy, encouraged to take ownership, and supported by a team that values curiosity, compassion, and meaningful results.

We believe great culture and great performance go hand in hand. Delivering on our commitments is how we earn the trust of our practitioners and continue to expand our impact. Here, you will find the freedom to experiment, a focus on follow-through, and the opportunity to grow, along with the satisfaction of knowing your work directly improves lives every day.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Belonging

We know innovation happens when diverse perspectives come together. Practice Better is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered to contribute their best.

If you do not meet every requirement listed above, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows that underrepresented groups often hesitate unless they feel 100% qualified. We are far more interested in your potential, curiosity, and alignment with our values.

We are committed to building a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. Accommodations are available throughout the interview process upon request.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your next step, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of health and wellness for practitioners, their clients, and communities worldwide.

Apply Now →

jobs.description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

As a Senior Data Engineer reporting to the Data Engineering Manager in our Provider & Revenue data engineering team, part of DASA (Data and Strategic Analytics), your purpose will be to help:

  • Own data products end to end, from the pipelines that land data in BigQuery to the dbt models the business makes decisions with
  • Take on projects, not tickets: significant, ambiguous work you de-risk, sequence and land, including bringing in new tools and switching off the legacy ones they replace
  • Shape our move from a deliberately simple warehouse towards a lakehouse
  • Partner with business, operations, finance and product stakeholders, turning their needs into buildable work and pushing back when needed
  • Raise the team's bar through design, review and mentoring. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management
  • Lead by example in AI-assisted engineering, with reviewed and tested output

Requirements

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

  1. Experience in data engineering, owning systems end to end rather than contributing to someone else's design, ideally including a migration where you introduced the new and retired the old
  2. Expert SQL and data modelling, with production dbt on a cloud warehouse. Ours is BigQuery; Snowflake, Redshift or Databricks translate
  3. Hands-on GCP experience, especially running and tuning BigQuery itself

Job Title: Business Analyst, APAC Jurisdictions

Location: Singapore or Remote. Remote candidates need a minimum of four hours’ daily overlap with Singapore business hours

Workplace Type: Remote

Engangement: Full-time, permanent

About AsiaVerify

AsiaVerify delivers corporate verification and risk intelligence for global organisations operating across Asia. We deliver trusted company, ownership and risk insights, from real-time registry data through to decision-ready assessment.

Our mission is to help organisations verify businesses, understand ownership, assess risk and monitor relationships through trusted intelligence built for Asia. Global organisations rely on AsiaVerify across 14 Asia-Pacific jurisdictions to verify, understand, assess, onboard and monitor the businesses they work with, supported by direct registry access and solutions across the full lifecycle.

Built for Asia. Delivered as infrastructure. Operated as a partner.

About the Role

As Business Analyst, APAC Jurisdictions, you will be the data and requirements analyst behind AsiaVerify’s jurisdiction coverage. You will work out, on evidence, where we should deepen our existing coverage and where we should expand next, and then turn those decisions into requirements, data mappings and acceptance criteria our Engineering team can build against.

Your time will be split broadly equally between strengthening coverage in the markets we already serve and assessing new markets across the Asia-Pacific region. For each jurisdiction, you will look at registry access, data quality, regulation, data partner options and commercial demand, and present a clear recommendation.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Jurisdiction Assessment

Build and run a repeatable framework for assessing jurisdictions, with consistent criteria, scoring and evidence standards, so that markets can be compared side by side and prioritised on facts.

  • Existing Coverage

Review our current jurisdictions for opportunities to improve data sources, data depth and product availability. Build the case for each improvement and, once approved, define the requirements to deliver it.

  • New Market Expansion

Assess new APAC markets, both those requested by clients and those identified through a structured review of the region, and recommend which to pursue and in what order.

  • Registry and Data Source Analysis

Identify and evaluate official company registries and other data sources in each market: access model, entity coverage, available fields, ownership and officer data, update frequency, language, reliability and cost. Validate data quality through structured test calls, data profiling and sample reviews.

  • Regulatory Research

Research KYB, UBO, AML and data protection requirements in each jurisdiction, including beneficial ownership disclosure, data usage and cross-border transfer rules, and summarise findings with primary-source references.

  • Commercial Case

Build the commercial case for each market from client demand, Sales and Client Success input, marketing data, competitor coverage and expected cost to serve.

  • Data Partner Evaluation

Where direct registry access is not available, identify and evaluate data partners on coverage, freshness, terms, cost and dependency risk, and support partner negotiations through to agreement.

  • Business Requirements and Launch Readiness

Translate approved decisions into business requirements, field-level data mappings and acceptance criteria. Lead data testing and quality checks, and prepare the launch documentation that Product, Sales and Client Success need.

  • Decision-Ready Reporting

Present each assessment as a clear decision paper covering the recommendation, risks, cost and expected outcome, and maintain an up-to-date view of the jurisdiction pipeline.

Required Skills/Related Knowledge

  • Three to five years’ experience as a business analyst, data analyst or product analyst, ideally in RegTech, FinTech, data or information services.
  • Proven experience writing business requirements, field-level data mappings and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.
  • Working SQL and advanced Excel or Google Sheets for data profiling, coverage analysis and quality checks.
  • Comfortable testing APIs and reviewing structured data (for example JSON) to judge field coverage and quality.
  • Working knowledge of KYB, KYC, UBO and AML concepts and how company registry data is used in compliance.
  • Experience researching regulatory and legal frameworks from primary sources and summarising them clearly for non-specialists.
  • Ability to build a commercial case that connects demand, cost and risk to a clear recommendation.
  • Experience evaluating vendors or data suppliers, or supporting commercial negotiations, is an advantage.
  • Fluent written and spoken English is required. Additional Asian languages are an advantage.
  • Experience working across time zones with distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence is an advantage.

Expected Behaviour & Attitudes

  • Evidence-led: every finding is sourced, tested and traceable.
  • Commercially minded: connects analysis to revenue, cost and risk.
  • Decisive: makes clear recommendations, including recommending against a market.
  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, without losing sight of the decision required.
  • Honest about uncertainty and quick to flag gaps or risks.
  • Discreet with commercial terms, client data and test data.
  • Collaborative across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Marketing and Sales.
  • Self-directed and reliable, whether in the office or working remotely.

jobs.excerpt: HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond.
jobs.description:
HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading venture capital, we’ve built a team and a platform focused on real-world mass deployment of TFLN photonics technology.

At the core of our work is the TFLN Chiplet™ platform: a modular architecture designed for scalability, manufacturability, and integration into complex systems. We partner with our customers and suppliers from concept and prototyping through mass production. We believe in integrity, innovation, collaboration, and pragmatic solutions, and we take pride in tackling hard problems with curiosity, humility, and a deep sense of care for one another.

We’re hiring a Heterogeneous Integration Design Enablement Lead to head design enablement, physical verification, and layout for our heterogeneous integration program: TFLN chiplets die-bonded onto third-party silicon photonics platforms to provide higher-performance modulators. You will own design enablement for this platform end to end, including layout of initial development projects, developing composite signoff flows, and ultimately building a TFLN add-on PDK for end customers. You will also build the team that accomplishes this — we expect this team to grow quickly to include dedicated PDK, physical verification, and layout engineers. Expect to be hands-on from day one and to hire alongside the technical work.

As part of your responsibilities, you will:

  • Build and lead a heterogeneous integration design enablement team — defining the roles, hiring into them, and developing the people you hire.
  • Own physical verification for our multi-die TFLN-on-silicon-photonics stacks, including interface and assembly-level checks, deck architecture, partitioning, hierarchy and runtime, results triage, and waiver workflow.
  • Stand up and run composite DRC and LVS signoff in-house using tools such as Synopsys IC Validator and Siemens Calibre, initially hands-on and then through the team you build.
  • Own our TFLN add-on PDK end to end — architecture, model integration, release and qualification criteria, documentation, and support for internal and external users.
  • Own layout execution and tapeout readiness for these programs: set layout standards and review practices, and plan capacity across concurrent tapeouts.
  • Serve as HyperLight’s primary technical interface to foundry, OSAT, and customer verification teams on rule interpretation, PDK development, and scope boundaries between parties.
  • Partner with our component design, product, and process teams to align design enablement priorities with the heterogeneous integration roadmap
  • Shape HyperLight’s heterogeneous integration technical roadmap and act as the company’s go-to authority on design enablement.

Requirements

  • Either 8+ years of relevant work experience or equivalent experience through an advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
  • Experience with design enablement or physical verification of multi-die, 2.5D, or 3D integrated products, including interface and assembly-level checks across dies from different sources.
  • Experience leading engineers — as a manager, team lead, or technical lead — including hiring, mentoring, and setting technical direction for a group.
  • Hands-on experience authoring and debugging production DRC and LVS rule decks in IC Validator, Calibre, or Pegasus — not only running decks written by others.
  • Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys OptoCompiler, and Siemens Calibre or comparable commercial layout, verification, and PDK environments, including techfiles, PCells, compact models, and scripting (e.g., SKILL).
  • Experience owning layout or tapeout execution for a photonic IC program, including design review practices and schedule planning across concurrent tapeouts.
  • Strong track record serving as the technical point of contact for foundry, OSAT, and customer engineering teams, including holding a technical position under pressure.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building a team or function from a small starting point.
  • Experience developing, releasing, and supporting PDKs used by external customers.
  • Experience with chiplet integration flows — die bonding, interposers, redistribution layers, bump and pad interfaces, or die-to-die interconnect.
  • Experience with advanced-node or advanced-packaging foundry and OSAT flows, including scope splits between partners.

Benefits

  • Competitive market-based compensation (salary range $190,000 - $260,000 per year)
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, vision, and dental plans for individuals and families
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employee matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Commuter benefits and subsidies

experience supporting SharePoint migrations from on-premises or legacy file share environments (e.g., FSx) strongly preferred Familiarity with Microsoft Purview (or predecessor tools: Azure Information Protection, MIP) for sensitivity labeling and compliance management; willingness to develop deep proficiency required Automation-first orientation: evaluates AI/ML-assisted and platform-native automation options (e.g., Purview auto-labeling, SharePoint Syntex, Power Automate) before recommending manual processes Exposure to data catalog or metadata management tooling (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Informatica, or similar); willingness to develop proficiency in Security Benefit’s selected platform required Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with competing priorities Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to translate complex governance concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences Understanding of AI/ML governance concepts, including data readiness for RAG architectures, is a meaningful differentiator Experience in financial services or a regulated data environment preferred; familiarity with SQL, Python, or scripting for data profiling and quality validation a plus

jobs.excerpt: Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces.
jobs.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

The Commercial Counsel owns the review and negotiation of customer contracts for Case IQ’s growing SaaS business. This is a hands-on, business-facing role focused primarily on day-to-day commercial deal execution, helping Sales move agreements forward efficiently while managing legal, privacy, security, and AI-related risk. You will work closely with Sales, InfoSec, the Data Protection Officer (DPO), and other teams, strengthen contract standards and playbooks, and reduce reliance on outside counsel for routine commercial work. You will act as the business owner for commercial contracting decisions, consulting subject matter experts where necessary and making practical decisions within your authority. The role is accountable for the contract’s progress and outcome—not merely for providing legal advice.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we work. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to using AI responsibly to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making. Across all roles, we look for strong human judgment, problem-solving, collaboration, and the ability to thoughtfully apply AI tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy, context, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

Customer Contracts (Core Responsibility — ~70–80%)

  • Review, draft, and negotiate:
    • SaaS subscription agreements
    • MSAs, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, order forms, AI addenda, renewal agreements, and SOWs
  • Partner directly with Sales to support deal execution and timelines, owning matters from intake through completion and proactively following up with subject matter experts on outstanding actions and deadlines
  • Own cross-functional coordination with InfoSec and the DPO on data protection and privacy-related contract terms, including DPAs, data security requirements, and HIPAA-related obligations; obtain required input and approvals, follow up on open actions, and keep the contract moving
  • Review and negotiate AI-specific contract terms, including model governance, training data restrictions, output ownership, pass through warranties, and AI-related indemnification
  • Support contract-related issues arising from customer M&A activity, including spinoffs, divestitures, and assignment requests
  • Own the next step on each deal. Bring the right teams together, clarify who owns each decision, and communicate timelines, trade-offs, and your recommendation.
  • Represent Case IQ’s agreed position with customer legal and procurement teams. Escalate material exceptions to the appropriate decision-maker with a recommendation and a clear decision deadline.
  • Identify key risks and recommend and execute practical, proportionate solutions that support business objectives

Contract Efficiency & Consistency

  • Own contract intake, triage, and prioritization across a high-volume queue, balancing deal deadlines, complexity, and risk.
  • Own and improve templates, fallback language, and playbooks so teams can resolve recurring issues quickly and consistently.
  • Track turnaround times and recurring bottlenecks, and use what you learn to shorten contract cycles and make delivery more predictable.
  • Develop and maintain fallback positions and playbook guidance for recurring topics such as indemnification, limitation of liability, AI, data privacy, etc.

Internal Legal Support

  • Provide practical legal guidance on:
    • Customer-specific issues
    • Basic vendor agreements
    • Routine business questions
  • Triage when to involve outside counsel

Outside Counsel Coordination (Limited)

  • Interface with external attorneys for complex or specialized matters
  • Help ensure efficient use of external legal spend

What Success Looks Like

  • Material risks are effectively managed and identified early, with clear recommendations and timely approvals.
  • A high volume of contracts moves through review and negotiation with fast, predictable turnaround times.
  • Reduced spend on outside counsel for contract review
  • Sales and cross-functional partners involve Legal early and know who owns the next step and when to expect a decision.
  • Contracts become more standardized over time
  • Counsel becomes the leader of the contract process

Who You Are

  • JD and active bar membership
  • 5–10 years of legal experience
  • Strong experience with B2B SaaS/commercial contracts
  • Experience negotiating with procurement/legal teams at customers
  • Demonstrated ownership of a high-volume contract queue, with a track record of meeting tight turnaround expectations.
  • Clear, practical communicator who aligns internal teams and confidently represents agreed business positions with customers.
  • Operator mindset: takes ownership, makes sound decisions within authority, removes blockers, and is personally accountable for getting the work done in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating AI-related contract terms, including AI schedules, data use restrictions, and model governance provisions
  • Working knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, state privacy laws) and experience negotiating DPAs and BAAs.

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (We have employees spanning 7 countries!)
  • Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
  • Generous professional development budget
  • RRSP/ 401k matching program
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer

jobs.title: Especialista em People Operations
jobs.excerpt: Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.
jobs.description:
Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Esta vaga faz parte da filosofia da Kunumi de tratar a operação de pessoas como parte central do negócio, e não como área secundária ou somente de apoio. A pessoa vai garantir que tudo o que envolve o vínculo de cada pessoa com a Kunumi, da admissão ao desligamento, aconteça com precisão, conformidade e cuidado. Ela também vai ter autonomia para propor e melhorar processos para apoiar nosso crescimento, ganho de escala e cuidado com o time

Esse propósito se traduz, na prática, nos seguintes Jobs to Be Done:

  • Garantir uma folha de pagamento precisa e pontual: Conduzir o processamento mensal da folha, férias, 13º salário, rescisões e encargos (INSS, FGTS, IRRF) com rastreabilidade, incluindo conciliações e provisões.
  • Assegurar a conformidade trabalhista, previdenciária e sindical: Acompanhar, junto à Contabilidade terceirizada, o envio correto e tempestivo dos eventos ao eSocial, FGTS Digital, DCTFWeb e EFD-Reinf, interpretar convenções coletivas, mitigar passivos e conduzir o atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Cuidar do ciclo de vida da pessoa colaboradora: Conduzir admissões, movimentações, afastamentos e desligamentos com documentação completa, prazos legais cumpridos e uma experiência fluida para pessoas e lideranças.
  • Atuar como Business Partner da frente: Ser a ponte entre Departamento Pessoal, Financeiro/Controladoria, FP&A e lideranças do negócio, traduzindo dados de folha em impactos de custo e apoiando decisões com informação confiável.
  • Gerir benefícios, jornada e parceiros: Administrar benefícios, jornada e férias, e conduzir o relacionamento com fornecedores, sindicatos e contabilidade, garantindo nível de serviço e custo adequados.
  • Evoluir processos com tecnologia: Identificar gargalos nas rotinas de DP e propor melhorias e automações que tornem a operação mais simples, segura e escalável.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência em Departamento Pessoal, com vivência de ponta a ponta nas rotinas de folha de pagamento, admissão, férias, rescisão e encargos.
  • Conhecimento prático de eSocial, FGTS Digital e DCTFWeb, e da aplicação de convenções coletivas.
  • Capacidade analítica aliada a visão de negócio, com experiência em conciliações, provisões e interface com Contabilidade e Financeiro.
  • Google Sheets/Excel em nível avançado.
  • Formação em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Ciências Contábeis, Direito ou áreas correlatas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Vivência na implantação ou migração de sistemas de folha/HRIS e na gestão de BPO de folha.
  • Forte interesse por inovação, tecnologia e impacto social.

SOBRE A KUNUMI

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto;
  • Trabalho em ambiente remoto com horário flexível;
  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros);
  • Plano de saúde premium e dental para você e seus dependentes, sem mensalidade;
  • Alimentação (cartão flexível);
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Assistência a Filhos;
  • Auxílio para Filhos(as) com Deficiência;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programas de promoção à Saúde - mental, física e emocional
  • Parceria Wellhub - Plano Gold gratuito
  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano
  • Kunumi Day mensal - Toda segunda sexta-feira do mês ficamos off

SOBRE O PROCESSO

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação.
Acreditamos que a diversidade promove a criatividade e acelera resultados positivos, portanto, consideramos todos os candidatos não somente pela qualificação técnica, mas também como nos complementa como grupo.

  • Creativity

target markets, key accounts, and industry segments, aligning on outreach and engagement
strategies.

Experience or familiarity within the wellness/Salon space is a strong plus.
Sales & Communication Skills: Confident engaging with business owners and skilled at
uncovering pain points and presenting solutions.
CRM Proficiency: Experience using Salesforce, Outreach, or similar tools for tracking and
managing outreach a plus.
Motivated & Organized: Self-starter with excellent time-management skills and the ability to

growth, and team success.

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holidays

Life Insurance
Peace of mind for you and your loved ones! We provide Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D). What’s even better? Millennium Systems International fully covers the entire cost—100% on us!

Long-Term and Short-Term Disability Insurance
Stay secure no matter what life brings your way. Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance. And we’ve got your back—Millennium Systems International covers the full cost of Long-Term Disability at 100%.

401(k) Retirement Plan
Plan for your future with confidence! You’ll be eligible to enroll in our robust 401(k) plan. When you do, you’ll enjoy a 100% match on up to 4% of your contributions, thanks to our Safe Harbor plan. It’s our way of helping you build a brighter tomorrow.

Learning & Development Opportunities
We foster a culture of growth and professional excellence. As part of our benefits, we offer unlimited access to Udemy’s online courses, helping you refine your skills, explore new areas, and advance your career. Whether you're deepening your expertise or learning new technologies, we’re here to support your development every step of the way.
