jobs.title: North America Campaign & Events Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Role Purpose PebblePad is seeking a commercially focused, highly organised and energetic North America Campaign & Events Marketing Manager to lead integrated regional campaigns, events, webinars and field marketing execution across the USA and Canada.
jobs.companyName: PebblePad - The ePortfolio for Higher Education
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

PebblePad is seeking a commercially focused, highly organised and energetic North America Campaign & Events Marketing Manager to lead integrated regional campaigns, events, webinars and field marketing execution across the USA and Canada.

This is a highly visible role at the heart of our North American growth plans. Acting as the marketing lead on the ground for North America, the postholder will work alongside an ambitious Sales team to create momentum across campaigns, events, webinars and priority accounts, while bringing regional customer and market insight into wider Marketing and Commercial Leadership discussions.

The role owns and activates a programme of 30+ events and regional activities each year, including around 10 major conferences and approximately 20 smaller regional, sector and customer-focused activities. It is not a standalone event coordination position: every activity should connect to a clear audience, campaign, account opportunity and follow-up plan.

Success will be measured through campaign and event performance, lead progression, pipeline contribution, return on investment and strong alignment between Marketing and Sales.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated Campaigns & Regional Marketing

  • Lead the planning and execution of integrated campaign and field marketing activity across North America.
  • Act as the primary marketing partner to the North American Sales team and a confident marketing voice for the region.
  • Build campaigns around priority regional themes, audiences, accounts and commercial opportunities.
  • Localise and activate global campaigns for North American universities, colleges and other priority audiences.
  • Use events, webinars, customer stories, speaking opportunities and content as connected activation points within wider campaigns.
  • Coordinate email, digital, content and nurture activity to support regional campaigns.
  • Manage regional campaign and event budgets, balancing activity levels with expected commercial return.
    Identify new opportunities, share regional insight and recommend where Marketing should invest, adapt or stop.

Events, Conferences & Webinars

  • Own and activate a programme of 30+ events and regional activities annually, including around 10 major conferences and approximately 20 smaller regional, sector and customer-focused activities, with additional opportunities developing throughout the year.
  • Manage major conferences, exhibitions and sponsorships from planning through to delivery, including logistics, suppliers, booth requirements, collateral, speaking submissions, customer participation and on-site support where required.
  • Treat smaller activities as meaningful campaign opportunities, coordinating the required audience targeting, HubSpot campaign setup, email promotion, registration support, data management, lead imports, follow-up and reporting.
  • Develop integrated pre-event, event and post-event engagement plans, with clear objectives, audiences, Sales roles and follow-up expectations.
  • Own webinars end-to-end, including audience development, promotion, speaker and senior stakeholder coordination, rehearsals, live delivery, follow-up and performance reporting.
  • Manage multiple simultaneous activities while maintaining pace, accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Run structured post-event reviews and use results to improve future activity and event selection

Sales Partnership & Account-Based Marketing

  • Partner closely with the VP Sales (North America), Account Executives and SDR team to align Marketing activity with regional priorities and pipeline objectives.
  • Lead and activate Account-Based Marketing programmes around priority accounts, territories, campaigns and events.
  • Build engagement plans for target accounts and opportunities, using relevant messages, content, events and follow-up activity.
  • Brief Sales teams before campaigns and events, ensuring clarity on target audiences, messaging, assets, responsibilities and follow-up.
  • Work confidently with senior customers, prospects, speakers, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to identify appropriate customer participation, advocacy and regional engagement opportunities.

HubSpot, Lead Management & Reporting

  • Work hands-on in HubSpot to manage campaigns, lists, segmentation, data quality, lead imports, workflows, nurture and reporting.
  • Ensure event and campaign leads are accurately captured, uploaded, assigned and followed up, with clear ownership across Marketing, SDRs and Sales.
  • Create and coordinate invitation, reminder and post-event email activity for relevant programmes.
  • Track activity against agreed registration, attendance, engagement, lead, MQL, SQL, pipeline and revenue objectives.
  • Develop and maintain reporting that provides clear visibility of campaign and regional marketing performance.
  • Report on lead progression, conversion, cost per lead/MQL, pipeline contribution and Marketing and event ROI.
  • Meet with Sales and SDR stakeholders after campaigns and events to review lead quality, follow-up and progression.
  • Use performance data to support forecasting, budget optimisation and recommendations on future investment.

Market Intelligence & Commercial Insight

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, sector events and demand signals across North America.
  • Gather insight from customers, prospects, events and Sales conversations to improve campaigns and inform wider marketing strategy.
  • Bring customer and market insight into Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Commercial Leadership discussions.
  • Spot opportunities proactively and turn them into clear recommendations and action.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B campaign marketing, field marketing, regional marketing or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience, including campaign setup, segmentation, list management, lead imports, workflows and reporting.
  • Strong Account-Based Marketing experience, working directly with Sales on priority accounts, territories or opportunities.
  • Proven experience owning a busy programme of campaigns, events and webinars, with multiple activities live at the same time.
  • Demonstrable experience managing conferences or event programmes from planning and logistics through to promotion, lead follow-up and reporting.
  • Experience owning webinars end-to-end, including promotion, speakers, delivery, follow-up and performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical and commercial reporting skills, including experience tracking engagement, funnel progression, pipeline contribution and ROI.
  • Experience managing marketing and/or event budgets and making prioritisation decisions based on expected impact.
  • Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • A strong understanding of Marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly across North America for priority conferences, customer events and team meetings.

Highly Valuable

  • Experience within EdTech or Higher Education, particularly marketing to universities and colleges in North America.
  • Experience within a SaaS or subscription-based organisation.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or other paid channels to support integrated regional campaigns.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, high-energy marketer who is equally comfortable building an integrated campaign plan, running a major conference, owning a webinar, working hands-on in HubSpot, collaborating with Sales and presenting results back to senior stakeholders.

They will be proactive, curious and confident working at pace. They will bring ideas, spot opportunities and create momentum without waiting for every detail to be mapped out, while retaining the accuracy and discipline needed to manage complex campaign and event delivery.

They will enjoy working as part of a close, collaborative Marketing team and alongside an energetic North American Sales team. They will be comfortable sharing ideas, challenging thinking constructively and taking genuine ownership of North American marketing activity.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers a well-organised, energetic and commercially effective North American campaign and events programme.
  • Turns major conferences and smaller regional activities into connected campaigns with purposeful pre-event, event and post-event activity.
  • Owns webinars confidently from concept and audience development through to delivery, follow-up and reporting.
  • Builds strong ABM activity with Sales around priority accounts and commercial opportunities.
  • Ensures campaign and event data is accurately managed in HubSpot and leads are consistently captured, assigned, followed up and measured.
  • Provides clear, actionable reporting on engagement, lead progression, conversion, pipeline contribution and ROI.
  • Builds trusted relationships across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Commercial Leadership.
  • Brings valuable North American customer and market insight into wider marketing strategy and helps shape what the business does next.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss examples of campaigns, events, webinars and ABM programmes they have personally owned, including HubSpot use, Sales collaboration, lead follow-up, reporting and measurable commercial outcomes.

This is a new role with real room to make a difference. Some areas will give you the chance to build something new, while others will mean improving established practices and working through existing constraints. You’ll work closely with our leadership, Finance, and Employee Experience teams to develop a practical, consistent approach to compensation and benefits that supports our people and the company’s growth.

  • Design and evolve global job architecture, job leveling, and career framework structures to support consistent grading across geographies and functions.
  • Design competitive, market-appropriate benefits programs tailored to statutory requirements and market norms in each country.
  • Own the design and administration of short-term and long-term incentive plans, including sales incentive plans and equity or long-term incentive programs.
  • Lead participation in global and local compensation surveys and benchmark pay and benefits against relevant industry and geographic markets.
  • Deliver data-driven insights and modeling to inform executive and board-level decision-making.
  • Perform other duties as may be required consistent with the purpose of this role.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, including experience in a management or leadership role, ideally within an international organization.
  • Proven expertise in global compensation and benefits programs, including salary structures, job grading, market benchmarking, short- and long-term incentive plans (STIP/LTIP), and equity-based compensation.
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience in compensation surveys, pay equity analysis, budget impact assessments, and HRIS or compensation management systems.
  • Solid understanding of international compensation practices and regulatory requirements, including local labor laws, tax implications, pay transparency, and compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advise senior leadership, influence compensation decisions, and communicate complex reward matters effectively. Advanced English proficiency is required.
  • Experience in the technology or IT services industry is an advantage, as is a relevant university degree.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.

  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization, and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Financial Wellness bet inside New Ventures, based in Brazil.

Record numbers of Brazilian workers are in debt, carrying it in new, harder-to-see ways, including payroll-deducted credit that leaves their account before the salary does. There is no regulatory deadline forcing anyone to buy a solution: the pain is real, but the purchase is not compelled. That makes this a pull market, not a push one, and the product has to earn the right to be trusted by someone already carrying shame and fatigue around money. Beyond the core worker journey (diagnosis, a debt-exit plan, budgeting, a forward view of committed installments), the bet also has line of sight to three regulated profit pools: credit, group life insurance with a behavioral component, and pension, each gated by its own license path (BCB/correspondent rules for credit, SUSEP for insurance and pension).

You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Financial Wellness bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build in the earliest phase: discovery is underway, the demand drivers and candidate wedges are hypotheses, not yet validated with a single worker interview, and the taxonomy of what the product must cover is provisional by design. You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, legal and compliance, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from discovery through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own product for the Financial Wellness bet: turn the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and the discovery team's open questions into a testable product direction, and keep reshaping it as evidence comes in from interviews, not desk research alone.
  • Close the evidence gap before you build: this bet currently runs on desk research and inference, with zero worker interviews booked. Drive the interviews and validation work that turn "we think" into "we know" before committing engineering effort to a wedge.
  • Build inside the regulatory lines, not around them: work hand in hand with legal and compliance to pick a defensible vehicle (referral, correspondent, licensed broker, or embedded partner) for any credit, insurance, or pension offer, and make sure LGPD, Open Finance consent, and CDC credit-offer-conduct rules are built into the product, not bolted on after.
  • Make AI the core mechanic: work with engineering to use AI for debt diagnosis, plan generation, and the forward view of installments, so a lean squad can deliver something that feels like a personal financial advisor, not a static dashboard.
  • Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, oriented around learning speed and validated demand first, revenue metrics once a wedge is proven.
  • Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including time spent building a product from zero to one in close, daily partnership with a founder, GM, or general manager owning the P&L.

  • Experience in, or close proximity to, a regulated consumer-finance or insurance market (consumer credit, fintech lending, insurtech, pension, or personal finance management), and comfort making product calls where legal and compliance have a real seat at the table.

  • Comfortable building without a validated demand signal: you know how to run discovery rigorously, turn hypotheses into interview plans, and kill or pivot a wedge on evidence rather than sunk cost.

  • Genuinely AI-native: you reach for AI as the default way to do more with less, and you see AI as the core mechanic for a trustworthy, personal financial product, not a bolt-on feature.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills: able to use data and qualitative evidence together, prioritize ruthlessly, and know what to measure when the business itself is still being defined.

  • Judgment with sensitive, personal subject matter: debt carries shame; you design and communicate with the empathy that a worker in financial distress needs, not a growth-at-all-costs lens.

  • Entrepreneurial and self-driven, with a bias to ship and test as the way to learn, balanced with the discipline to not cut corners on data privacy, credit-offer conduct, or employer trust

  • Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

With almost 40 courses in a wide variety of subject areas, AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. The AP program is continuing to rapidly expand its development of instructional and assessment products under the leadership of the growing Assessment Production team. The Production Management team currently consists of 16 talented and collaborative professionals with expertise in a variety of domains that are integral to the assessment production process.

To support the continued production of high-quality teacher- and student-facing materials, the AP Program is looking to fill the role of Director, AP Assessment Production.

About the Opportunity

The Director, AP Assessment Production will oversee project and process management for assessment authoring and review for up to 3 AP courses, maintaining and communicating detailed reporting and status tracking across several interdependent workstreams. This is not a traditional project management role. Rather than running a single project from kickoff to close, you will run a production cycle that never stops, with several administration years in flight at different stages of authoring, review, and form development. Partnering with AP course teams, external consultant content creators, and various other stakeholders, the Director will ensure that all assessment items in their portfolio complete all required processes on needed timelines, with schedules accurate, handoffs clean, and risks surfaced early. You will have a high degree of ownership over your courses, supported by a leadership team you keep informed of risks and changes. This role will direct the work of several independent consultants but has no direct reports.

As Director, AP Assessment Production, you are an integral member of the cross-functional team building and delivering AP Exams and Instructional resources. You are a collaborative, insightful, and highly motivated professional, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for educational opportunity. You are not shy about digging into ambiguity; you bring steady discipline to a standardized process, and you are quick to propose more efficient ways of getting things done.

In this role, you will:

Lead assessment production cycle execution (40%)

  • Lead on-time, on-spec delivery of items, reviews, and forms for your assigned courses across overlapping exam administration years, accountable for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Move work through multiple levels of internal and external review, and manage the resulting resolution steps before advancing items to later review steps
  • Collaborate with relevant AP course teams, providing visibility into and accountability for current work status and upcoming deliverables through weekly production syncs and consistent communication
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, such as Editorial, Accessibility and Psychometrics, to keep shared handoffs clean
  • Direct the work of independent consultants (ICs) across your courses: match assignments to background and availability, track deliverables against schedule, and forecast IC capacity against upcoming item and form demand so gaps surface before they reach the critical path
  • Resolve IC-related delivery issues quickly by addressing access issues, reassigning work, and/or re-sequencing downstream dependencies, while keeping course teams informed of impacts

Maintain accurate schedules and shared tools (25%)

  • Build and maintain detailed, accurate schedules across multiple courses and exam administration years, reflecting actual progress, dependencies, and realistic timelines
  • Implement schedule and scope changes promptly and communicate them clearly to affected partners
  • Maintain shared tracking tools so teams across the organization have reliable, up-to-date information on the status of their work
  • Synthesize status across courses to give stakeholders a clear view of progress and upcoming deliverables
  • Keep course spend and forecasts accurate in shared financial tools to track costs against budget

Anticipate and resolve delivery risks (20%)

  • Identify potential delays, capacity constraints, and recurring issues early, before they affect key milestones
  • Resolve course-level problems directly, using sound judgment to adjust sequencing, scope, or timelines while maintaining quality
  • Bring significant risks to leadership with clear context and a recommended path forward
  • Maintain strong working relationships with course teams, consultants, and cross-functional partners to resolve issues quickly and collaboratively
  • Recommend efficient resourcing as demand and budget conditions shift

Lead process development, improvement, and integration (15%)

  • Integrate production schedules and tools for your course(s) with processes and artifacts managed by other key stakeholders in the Assessment Production value chain
  • Propose and pilot practical process and tool improvements grounded in what you see across production cycles, sharing recommendations on an ongoing basis
  • Collaborate with peer managers and the broader Assessment Production team to document current practices, share learning across courses, and keep standards consistent

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree is required
  • 5+ years of relevant product and/or project management experience is required, preferably in the education industry
  • High degree of personal ownership and accountability to consistently deliver results in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with a process-oriented mindset
  • Excellent interpersonal, collaborative and communication skills; demonstrated ability to establish positive working relationships at all levels of the organization
  • An ability to embrace ambiguity and a willingness to dig into unfamiliar tasks
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically 1-2 times per quarter
  • Ability to process and distill large volumes of data and draw insightful conclusions to drive decision-making

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$130,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.excerpt: Summary: The Bankruptcy Specialist III is a senior-level subject matter expert responsible for managing the most complex, escalated, and high-risk bankruptcy matters and ensuring cases are handled accurately, timely, and in accordance with applicable requirements.
jobs.description:
Summary:

The Bankruptcy Specialist III is a senior-level subject matter expert responsible for managing the most complex, escalated, and high-risk bankruptcy matters and ensuring cases are handled accurately, timely, and in accordance with applicable requirements. This position requires advanced bankruptcy knowledge and the ability to independently research, analyze, reconcile, and resolve complex case issues while identifying and mitigating potential financial, regulatory, legal, and operational risk. The Bankruptcy Specialist III handles specialized bankruptcy matters, including, but not limited to, cramdowns, total debt, lien strips and complex Proofs of Claim (POCs), adversary proceedings, payment disputes, Motions for Relief (MFR) related objections, Chapter 11 cases, complex reconciliations, and other contested or escalated matters. The position also supports complex borrower complaint research and responses, internal and external audits, and other matters requiring advanced bankruptcy expertise. Serving as a senior bankruptcy subject matter expert and escalation resource, the Bankruptcy Specialist III provides guidance on complex case matters, identifies and resolves discrepancies, and partners with leadership, Legal, Compliance, outside counsel, and other business partners to determine appropriate resolution and mitigate risk. The Bankruptcy Specialist III may also represent the company as a corporate witness and attend bankruptcy hearings, depositions, mediations, or trials as required. The position must be able to clearly and accurately explain account activity, payment histories, servicing actions, bankruptcy processes, and the basis for actions taken throughout the life of a bankruptcy case.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manages complex, escalated, and high-risk bankruptcy cases requiring advanced research, analysis, reconciliation, and independent judgment to determine appropriate case strategy and servicing actions.
  • Performs specialized bankruptcy functions, including cramdowns, Chapter 11 matters, complex or amended Proofs of Claim, contested matters, payment disputes, and complex pre- and post-petition reconciliations, exercising discretion in the interpretation and application of bankruptcy requirements.
  • Researches complex account discrepancies and determines appropriate corrective action to ensure accurate bankruptcy treatment and servicing, making recommendations based on analysis of account and case-specific circumstances.
  • Identifies potential financial, regulatory, legal, or operational risk and works with leadership, Legal, Compliance, outside counsel, and other business partners to facilitate appropriate resolution and mitigate business impact.
  • Reviews complex bankruptcy pleadings, court orders, plans, payment histories, servicing records, and other case documentation to determine required servicing actions and ensure compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Partners with outside counsel on complex or contested bankruptcy matters, providing account research, documentation, payment histories, reconciliations, and other information necessary to support case strategy, risk assessment, and resolution.
  • Serves as a bankruptcy subject matter expert and escalation resource for complex cases, exceptions, and process-related questions, providing guidance and recommendations on appropriate courses of action.
  • Conducts research and prepares detailed findings and responses related to borrower complaints, escalations, audits, regulatory inquiries, and other requests requiring advanced bankruptcy expertise, often involving complex analysis and judgment.
  • Supports internal and external audits by researching bankruptcy activity, validating servicing actions, providing documentation, and responding to findings or information requests, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of information provided.
  • May serve as a corporate witness and attend bankruptcy hearings, depositions, mediations, or trials. Prepares supporting documentation and provides accurate testimony regarding account activity, servicing actions, payment history, and bankruptcy processes, representing the organization in legal proceedings as required.
  • Ensures complex bankruptcy matters are handled accurately and timely in accordance with court requirements, applicable bankruptcy law, investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal policies and controls, exercising discretion in resolving non-routine issues.
  • Maintains advanced knowledge of bankruptcy laws, regulations, investor requirements, and servicing practices and provides guidance to other team members as needed on complex or sensitive matters.
  • Collaborates with Bankruptcy leadership and cross-functional business partners to identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to reduce risk and improve bankruptcy servicing, recommending process enhancements and corrective actions.

Other Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.

At BELAY, we're passionate about providing innovative financial solutions tailored for the Small and Medium-sized Business (SMB) market and accounting firms. We empower businesses to thrive by streamlining their financial operations and fostering strategic partnerships.

As a Financial Solutions Consultant, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth by selling our cutting-edge financial solutions to SMBs and accounting firms. You'll leverage your strong understanding of accounting principles and solutions to build strategic partnerships, effectively communicate the value of our offerings, and manage the entire sales cycle. This remote role offers flexibility and the opportunity to work from anywhere while contributing to the success of our clients and BELAY.

*This is a remote position with strong preference for candidates in the U.S. Eastern or Central Time Zones.*

Duties and responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Sr. Certification Engineer I

Job Summary

The Sr. Certification Engineer leads and coordinates global regulatory certification activities for wireless and IoT products. This role manages certification testing and approvals, including FCC, ISED, CE/RED, RF, EMC, safety, and carrier certifications while working closely with engineering teams, external laboratories, and certification bodies to ensure products meet regulatory requirements and maintain compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of wireless technologies and global regulatory requirements, while demonstrating the ability to manage multiple certification programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive timely product approvals that support successful product launches worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead and coordinate global regulatory certification activities for wireless and IoT products, including FCC, ISED, CE/RED, and other regional approvals.
  • Manage RF, EMC, safety, and wireless certification testing with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Support certification programs for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LTE, and 5G products.
  • Review certification requirements, test plans, technical documentation, and test reports to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Product Management, and external partners to resolve certification issues and maintain project schedules.
  • Track certification progress, maintain compliance records, and support product changes that may impact existing approvals.
  • Manage certification budgets, including laboratory quotes, actual versus forecast spending, and customer certification costs.
  • Coordinate certification activities across multiple projects and geographic regions.
  • Maintain regulatory documentation and support audits, compliance reviews, and certification renewals as required.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or equivalent technical discipline.
  • 3-5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, product certification, or a related engineering field.
  • Experience working with wireless and IoT technologies, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LTE, and/or 5G products.
  • Experience coordinating with external test laboratories, certification bodies, and internal engineering teams.
  • Experience managing certification testing programs and certification budgets.

Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or equivalent technical discipline.
  • Experience in regulatory compliance, product certification, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Experience managing certification budgets, including laboratory quotes, actual versus forecast tracking, and certification costs.
  • Familiarity with FCC, ISED, CE/RED, RF, and EMC regulatory standards.
  • Experience with wireless or IoT products, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LTE, and 5G technologies.
  • Experience coordinating with external test laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Strong communication, organization, coordination, and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple certification projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience with carrier certification programs such as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Telstra, or similar carriers.
  • Familiarity with PTCRB and GCF certification processes.
  • Experience with cellular IoT devices, gateways, routers, or embedded wireless products.
  • Understanding of RF and EMC test methods and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Hands-on experience conducting RF, EMC, or wireless testing in a laboratory environment.

Location

Taipei, Taiwan or Remote U.S. (Plymouth, MN or Irvine, CA preferred).

United States: $55,000 - $130,000 annually

Bonus Target: 15%

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager & Application Team Lead (Freelance kan)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilités Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead Une fonction qui combine le pilotage de la delivery IT, le leadership d'équipe et la gestion d'un portefeuille applicatif.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead

Une fonction qui combine le pilotage de la delivery IT, le leadership d'équipe et la gestion d'un portefeuille applicatif.

Votre rôle
Au sein du département ICT, vous pilotez les projets IT qui vous sont confiés tout en assurant le leadership de l'équipe applicative.

Vous contribuez à la livraison des projets, à l'organisation et au développement de l'équipe ainsi qu'à la gestion et à l'évolution du portefeuille applicatif. Vous veillez à fournir une visibilité claire et suffisamment anticipée sur l'avancement, les risques, la capacité disponible et les arbitrages nécessaires.

Piloter les projets et la delivery IT
Vous assumez la responsabilité de la delivery IT des projets qui vous sont confiés. Vous assurez la maîtrise du périmètre IT, du planning, des ressources, du budget IT, des risques, des dépendances et de la qualité.

Dans le cadre d'un projet Business, vous prenez en charge le volet IT et sa livraison, en collaboration avec le responsable du projet Business. Vous conservez une vue d'ensemble du projet afin d'identifier et de signaler à temps les risques ou dépendances susceptibles d'affecter la delivery IT. Le reporting global reste sous la responsabilité du responsable du projet Business.

Pour les projets exclusivement IT, vous assurez le pilotage complet du projet jusqu'à sa livraison, y compris le reporting.

Vous anticipez les écarts, analysez l'impact des changements et des nouvelles demandes, puis formulez des propositions pour permettre les décisions et arbitrages nécessaires. Vous assurez le reporting relatif au périmètre dont vous avez la charge.

Diriger et accompagner l'équipe
En tant que Team Lead, vous êtes responsable du fonctionnement opérationnel de l'équipe et du people management.

Vous organisez les activités, définissez les priorités, gérez la capacité et favorisez une collaboration efficace entre les profils impliqués dans l'analyse, le développement, les tests et la mise en production.

Vous accompagnez les collaborateurs dans leur fonctionnement quotidien et leur développement professionnel. Vous veillez à la qualité des activités réalisées, identifiez rapidement les difficultés et les risques, puis prenez les mesures nécessaires ou les escaladez lorsque la situation l'exige.

Gérer la capacité et le portefeuille applicatif
Vous participez activement à la gestion et à l'évolution du portefeuille applicatif de l'équipe.

Vous gardez une vue d'ensemble des besoins liés aux projets, à la maintenance, aux évolutions technologiques, aux risques et à la capacité nécessaire. En concertation avec le management, vous proposez les priorités et arbitrages requis et contribuez aux exercices périodiques de forecast et de planification.

Vous veillez à un équilibre dans l'affectation de la capacité entre les projets, la maintenance et les autres priorités du portefeuille.

Garantir la maîtrise de la delivery
Vous vous assurez que chaque étape de la delivery, de l'analyse à la mise en production, est correctement préparée, coordonnée et suivie.

Vous suivez le planning, le budget IT, le forecast, la capacité, les risques et les dépendances. Vous garantissez une visibilité suffisante sur les écarts et les difficultés.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Business, les équipes ICT et les autres parties prenantes afin d'assurer une livraison maîtrisée et de qualité.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience senior en gestion de projets et en leadership d'équipes IT.

  • IT Project Management : minimum 8 ans d'expérience;
  • Team Leadership et People Management : minimum 5 ans d'expérience;
  • Gestion du planning, du budget, de la capacité, des risques, des dépendances et des changements : minimum 8 ans d'expérience;
  • Expérience dans des environnements combinant projets et maintenance d'applications : minimum 5 ans;
  • Cycle de développement et de livraison d'applications : minimum 5 ans d'expérience;
  • Azure DevOps : minimum 3 ans d'expérience;
  • Bonne culture technique permettant de comprendre et de challenger les sujets IT sans devoir intervenir comme expert technique;
  • Forte capacité d'analyse, d'anticipation et de prise de décision;
  • Capacité à identifier rapidement les problèmes et à les escalader de manière appropriée;
  • Leadership et communication claire avec des interlocuteurs Business et IT.

Une connaissance de .NET/C#, SQL, des API, des architectures applicatives et des environnements CI/CD constitue un atout.

Langues
Vous avez une excellente maîtrise professionnelle du néerlandais ou du français, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance de l'autre langue nationale, le français ou le néerlandais.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead

Een rol waarin IT-delivery, teamleiding en het beheer van een applicatieportfolio samenkomen.

Jouw rol
Binnen de ICT-afdeling stuur je de toegewezen IT-projecten aan en neem je tegelijk de leiding over het applicatieteam op.

Je draagt bij aan de oplevering van projecten, de organisatie en ontwikkeling van het team en het beheer en de verdere evolutie van het applicatieportfolio. Je zorgt voor een duidelijke, tijdige en voldoende vooruitziende rapportering over de voortgang, risico's, beschikbare capaciteit en noodzakelijke beslissingen.

🛠️ Verantwoordelijkheden

IT-projecten en delivery aansturen
Je staat in voor de IT-delivery van de projecten die aan jou worden toegewezen. Je bewaakt de IT-scope, de planning, de middelen, het IT-budget, de risico's, de afhankelijkheden en de kwaliteit.

Binnen een Business-project neem je het IT-luik en de bijbehorende oplevering op, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke voor het Business-project. Je behoudt een globaal overzicht, zodat je risico's of afhankelijkheden die de IT-delivery kunnen beïnvloeden tijdig identificeert en meldt. De globale rapportering blijft de verantwoordelijkheid van de verantwoordelijke voor het Business-project.

Voor projecten die uitsluitend op IT betrekking hebben, neem je de volledige projectaansturing op tot en met de oplevering, inclusief de rapportering.

Je anticipeert op afwijkingen, analyseert de impact van wijzigingen en nieuwe aanvragen en formuleert voorstellen die de nodige beslissingen en afwegingen ondersteunen. Je rapporteert over het domein waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent.

Het team aansturen en begeleiden
Als Team Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor de operationele werking van het team en het people management.

Je organiseert de activiteiten, bepaalt de prioriteiten, beheert de capaciteit en bevordert een efficiënte samenwerking tussen de profielen die betrokken zijn bij analyse, ontwikkeling, testen en ingebruikname.

Je begeleidt medewerkers in hun dagelijkse werking en professionele ontwikkeling. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van het werk, signaleert moeilijkheden en risico's tijdig en neemt de nodige maatregelen of escaleert wanneer de situatie dat vereist.

De capaciteit en het applicatieportfolio beheren
Je werkt actief mee aan het beheer en de verdere ontwikkeling van het applicatieportfolio van het team.

Je houdt overzicht over de behoeften rond projecten, onderhoud, technologische evoluties, risico's en de vereiste capaciteit. In overleg met het management stel je prioriteiten en noodzakelijke afwegingen voor en draag je bij aan de periodieke forecast- en planningsactiviteiten.

Je zorgt voor een evenwichtige inzet van de beschikbare capaciteit over projecten, onderhoud en andere prioriteiten binnen het portfolio.

De beheersing van de delivery waarborgen
Je zorgt ervoor dat elke stap van het deliveryproces, van analyse tot ingebruikname, correct wordt voorbereid, gecoördineerd en opgevolgd.

Je volgt de planning, het IT-budget, de forecast, de capaciteit, de risico's en de afhankelijkheden op. Je zorgt voor voldoende transparantie over afwijkingen en moeilijkheden.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Business, de ICT-teams en andere stakeholders om een beheerste en kwalitatieve oplevering te verzekeren.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt ruime seniorervaring in projectmanagement en het aansturen van IT-teams.

  • IT Project Management: minstens 8 jaar ervaring;
  • Team Leadership en People Management: minstens 5 jaar ervaring;
  • Beheer van planning, budget, capaciteit, risico's, afhankelijkheden en wijzigingen: minstens 8 jaar ervaring;
  • Ervaring in omgevingen waarin projecten en applicatieonderhoud worden gecombineerd: minstens 5 jaar;
  • Levenscyclus van applicatieontwikkeling en -oplevering: minstens 5 jaar ervaring;
  • Azure DevOps: minstens 3 jaar ervaring;
  • Een goede technische achtergrond, zodat je IT-onderwerpen kunt begrijpen en kritisch kunt bevragen zonder zelf als technisch expert op te treden;
  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, anticipatievermogen en besluitvaardigheid;
  • Het vermogen om problemen tijdig te identificeren en op gepaste wijze te escaleren;
  • Leiderschap en duidelijke communicatie met Business- en IT-betrokkenen.

Kennis van .NET/C#, SQL, API's, applicatiearchitecturen en CI/CD-omgevingen is een pluspunt.

Talenkennis
Je hebt een uitstekende professionele kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans en een goede kennis van de andere landstaal, het Frans of het Nederlands.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.description:
Job Description:


The Senior Systems Engineer is the technical and team lead for Qolo's Production Support / Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team. The role is responsible for the stability, integrity and availability of the Qolo payments platform, including issuer authorization, settlement and funds movement, scheduled jobs, reports and file transfers, and client and internal portals.

This is a senior individual contributor who also leads the team day to day. The Systems Engineer III acts as Incident Commander for major incidents, serves as the L2 escalation point for team members and for machine-generated alerts, sets technical direction for monitoring, automation and runbooks, and mentors the team. The role works closely with Engineering, DevOps, Security, Product, Client Success, Onboarding, and external banks and vendors, and acts as the liaison between those teams and Infrastructure & Support leadership.

Production Support / SRE keeps detection, monitoring, incident triage and incident command. Day-to-day settlement and ACH subject-matter ownership sits with Payments Operations, and code-level remediation sits with Sustaining and Feature Engineering. This role works across those boundaries and drives the requirements that reduce manual work for the team.


Essential functions

Incident command and on-call

  • Serve as Incident Commander for Sev 1 and major Sev 2 incidents: open and run bridges, set severity and priority, manage SLA clocks, coordinate stakeholders, and send incident communications on a defined cadence until resolution.
  • Act as the L2 and high-level escalation point for triaging and resolving technical issues, including SQL and transaction diagnostics, manual interventions that require bank approval, and coordination with Engineering and external parties.
  • Lead root cause analysis: complete RCAs within the 48-hour target using blameless methods such as 5 Whys, and drive corrective actions into runbooks, alerts, automation or engineering work items.
  • Participate in the Production Support / SRE 24x7 on-call rotation. Help design and maintain the rotation, PagerDuty routing and escalation policies aligned to reliability domains (issuer, jobs and reports, portals, network and infrastructure), and the Engineering Areas of Responsibility (AOR) escalation model.
  • Own the quality of on-call handoffs, escalation criteria and incident documentation for the team.

Monitoring, alerting and observability

  • Design, tune and maintain alerts for the issuer path, scheduled jobs, reports, file transfers and portals using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights and Kusto Query Language (KQL).
  • Improve alert quality by reducing noise, tracking actionable versus non-actionable alerts, and retiring or refining alerts that do not drive action.
  • Define and track service level indicators and objectives (SLIs, SLOs) and error budgets for critical paths, including availability, latency and integrity of authorization, settlement and funds movement, reports and file delivery.
  • Run recurring audits, including the quarterly Azure alert action group review, to confirm recipients, routing, severity and on-call coverage.
  • Monitor and report on system performance, and recommend capacity and configuration changes.

Jobs, files, reports and funds movement operations

  • Oversee operation and recovery of scheduled jobs and file flows, including VisualCron jobs and Azure runbook jobs: diagnose failures, determine partial loads, back out and reprocess, and rerun safely.
  • Confirm that files are created, transmitted, received and posted, and follow up on file exceptions. Rerun, deduplicate, correct and re-deliver failed reports and malformed client files.
  • Maintain the jobs and file inventory (Qolo File Management Tracker) as the source of truth for job names, schedules, owners, dependencies and SLAs.
  • Support daily settlement and funds-movement operations for sponsor banks while ownership transitions to Payments Operations, and continue to own detection, triage and escalation for settlement failures.
  • Investigate payment incidents by building and running targeted SQL queries and by researching card network and payment portals to resolve issues.

Automation and engineering

  • Build and maintain SQL, PowerShell and Azure-based automation (Azure Automation, GitHub workflows and runners) for jobs, audits, reruns, diagnostics and other repeatable tasks.
  • Convert recurring manual work into documented, restartable and monitored automation, and write clear operational requirements (alerting, restartability, rollback) for work that Engineering or DevOps must implement.
  • Help the team protect engineering time by tagging and reporting work by category (incident, monitoring, automation, client support, configuration, audits) and by escalating when reactive work exceeds the target cap.
  • Identify and prioritize the team's top recurring pain points and turn them into an automation or tooling backlog, with measurable reduction in manual effort.
  • Install, configure, upgrade and enhance monitoring, operating system, database and utility software that supports production operations.
  • Prepare, test, evaluate and implement changes that support infrastructure and operations, following Qolo change controls.

Release and deployment support

  • Support production releases: send client and vendor deployment notices, monitor Application Insights and Azure Front Door during rollout, validate post-deployment health, and participate in rollback and hotfix steps per playbooks.
  • Define minimum observability, post-deployment validation and rollback requirements for services and releases, and confirm that a tested rollback or hotfix path is linked from each release record and service runbook.
  • Move production traffic and adjust scaling during releases as directed by the release plan.

Escalated client and internal support

  • Provide technical support for escalations from Client Services, Client Success and Onboarding when they cannot resolve an issue: reproduce the problem, pull logs, run targeted SQL and data checks, document the outcome, and escalate to Product or Engineering when needed.
  • Execute program, BIN and other non-financial configuration requests in line with Qolo change controls, and help define the requirements for self-service tools that remove Production Support as middleware.
  • Administer and review access for production platforms and tools, and support security investigations (for example phishing and suspicious activity) in partnership with Security.

Certificates, security and compliance

  • Maintain the inventory, renewal calendar, alerts and runbooks for certificates that affect production (TLS, mTLS, card network and bank certificates), in partnership with Security and Engineering.
  • Apply Azure security best practices to the resources the team administers, and support audit requests with evidence of controls, access reviews and incident records.
  • Operate within access-control and least-privilege policies for on-call and production changes. Policy and governance remain with the CISO.

Documentation and knowledge management

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation: runbooks, incident playbooks, SOPs, knowledge base articles (KBIs), deployment support procedures, client notification templates and diagnostic query libraries.
  • Make sure every frequent alert type has a linked runbook that defines first checks, mitigation and escalation paths, and that RCA findings feed back into runbooks and SOPs.
  • Document completed projects clearly for the next engineer and for stakeholders.

Team leadership and mentorship

  • Act as technical and team lead for the Production Support / SRE team: set day-to-day priorities, review work, coordinate coverage and handoffs, and keep intake disciplined.
  • Mentor and train team members and L1 resources, including alert triage, SQL and KQL diagnostics, runbook use and incident communication. Model "play your position" discipline and cross-training so team members are interchangeable.
  • Serve as liaison between the Production Support / SRE team, stakeholder teams and Infrastructure & Support leadership. Advise on current internal and external work, and report team health, workload and risks.
  • Proactively research and introduce new technology and best practices, and recommend the technical direction for operations and reliability projects.
  • Lead large or complex projects as assigned: define the plan, coordinate participants and make sure work is delivered accurately and on time.
  • Expand your own education, technical stack and relevant certifications.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS


Experience

  • Seven or more years of successful, extensive experience in systems engineering, production support, site reliability, infrastructure operations or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience as an incident commander or technical escalation lead for production systems.
  • Experience in payments, financial services or other regulated, high-availability environments is strongly preferred.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or training from an accredited university, college or trade school in a related technology field, or equivalent professional and technical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus.
  • Advanced certifications recommended, for example Microsoft Azure Administrator or Azure Security Engineer, ITIL, or equivalent.

Technical skills

  • Expert-level Azure operations and monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights and KQL.
  • Advanced SQL Server skills, including reading and writing diagnostic queries and working with stored procedures.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation. Experience with Azure Automation and GitHub workflows is preferred.
  • Windows and Linux server administration, and Azure networking and security fundamentals.
  • Experience with job scheduling and file-transfer tools (for example VisualCron and SFTP), and with incident and alerting platforms (for example PagerDuty).
  • Strong working knowledge of Qolo's solutions and service offerings, or the ability to build it quickly, including card issuing and authorization flows and money movement (ACH, settlement).
  • Familiarity with SRE practices: SLIs and SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems and progressive delivery.

Other requirements

  • Strong time management, organizational and communication skills, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to provide 24x7 monitoring and support through participation in an on-call rotation.

jobs.description:
TLDR; We build software for vacation rentals to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help them with more of their problems.

Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself!

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to work alongside our existing infrastructure lead, so the platform is no longer a single point of failure.

Your mission: make our Kubernetes and cloud platform safer, more reliable, and easier for product engineers to operate — and keep it that way as we grow. A large part of the job is keeping production healthy: incidents, upgrades, capacity, cost, and the unglamorous work that stops small problems becoming outages. You will also improve the platform itself, not only react to it.

This is a senior individual-contributor role at our E3–E4 level. You will report to Ivan, who leads infrastructure today.

"Working at Hospitable is both the most intense and the most rewarding professional experiences of my life. The momentum isn't for everyone, neither is the laser focus on shipping value, but the right person will flourish and grow here more so than just about anywhere else." - Nik, Principal Product Engineer.

The platform

Our platform runs across several Kubernetes clusters and 30+ managed database clusters.

Our main infrastructure stack includes:

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Terraform
  • DigitalOcean, with services in AWS and Cloudflare
  • GitLab CI/CD and container registries
  • MySQL, Redis, Beanstalk, and queue-heavy applications
  • VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Loki, Vector, Alertmanager, and PMM
  • Vault, cert-manager, external-dns, NGINX, KEDA, and Falco

We are an AI-forward engineering team. We use tools such as Cursor to work faster, but we expect engineers to understand and carefully review all changes before they reach production. That matters especially in infrastructure: you should be able to explain what a change will do, steer an agent when it goes wrong, and debug a system without relying on AI.

What you will be working on

  • Design, operate, and improve our Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
  • Maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm.
  • Improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of production systems.
  • Build safer and faster CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure changes.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, service-level objectives, logs, and operational dashboards.
  • Help engineering teams deploy and operate services without unnecessary infrastructure knowledge.
  • Improve database, queue, network, DNS, certificate, and secrets operations.
  • Lead infrastructure work during incidents and turn incident findings into lasting improvements.
  • Remove manual processes through clear automation and internal tools.
  • Working closely with Ivan, who's favourite fruit is nectarine.
  • Plan capacity and reduce single points of failure as the platform grows.
  • Write clear documentation and share operational knowledge across the engineering team.

You will spend most of your time on focused, steady execution, and some of it jumping into whatever is on fire. We need both: someone who finishes the work that keeps the lights on, and someone we can trust to step into a messy problem without fuss.

Requirements

Hospitable is a remote-only and distributed company. For this position, your location is not a requirement. We are looking for someone in the European and US-East timezones.

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. In the meantime, here's what we're paying attention to:

  • Strong production experience in infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or site reliability engineering. This usually means 5+ years in similar roles.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on knowledge of at least one major cloud provider, and ideally more than one.
  • Strong experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
  • Experience building and maintaining Helm charts.
  • Good knowledge of Linux, containers, networking, DNS, TLS, and cloud security.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems. GitLab CI experience is useful but not required.
  • Experience with metrics, logs, alerts, and incident investigation.
  • Ability to write maintainable automation in a language such as Go, Python, or shell.
  • A practical approach to reliability. You know when to automate, when to simplify, and when not to add a new system.
  • Strong written communication. Most of our work happens asynchronously through Slack, Notion, and code reviews.
  • The ability to make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete.
  • Empathy for product engineers and customers.
  • Comfort explaining technical work clearly, including to people who are not infrastructure engineers.

Useful additional experience

  • MySQL and Redis operations at scale
  • Vault and Kubernetes secrets management
  • VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Vector
  • Argo CD, KEDA, cert-manager, or external-dns
  • Runtime security tools such as Falco
  • High-volume queues and asynchronous workloads
  • SLO design, capacity planning, and cloud cost management
  • Remote incident response and on-call operations

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The total budget for this role is between USD$134,450.00 - USD $167,258.30 depending on the cost of living in your location. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For US employees, the gross compensation could be anywhere between USD$123,888.97 - USD$154,120.18.
  • We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a grant value of up to $76,026.50, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
  • Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD$268,000.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
  • For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
  • 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
  • Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
  • Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


The Experience

「戦略を、実行し、成果に変える。AIと共に」

顧客のDXパートナーとして、システム構想の策定から実際の導入・運用までを一気通貫でリードします。単なるツールの導入に留まらず、Salesforceを活用してお客様のビジネスを成功へ導くことが本ポジションの重要な役割となります。

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

In your first year, expect about 70% of your time on AI tooling and 30% on our core platform. Once the first tools are stable and adopted, the balance shifts toward core backend work on our Investing, Trading, Account Management and Funding services, while AI tooling expands to other teams.

We already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot, but mostly ad hoc. You'll turn that into something deliberate: shared infrastructure, proven workflows and clear standards for using AI safely in a regulated financial business.

In short, someone who wants to build the systems that let a small team operate like a much bigger one.

This might be a right fit if you

  • Have built and shipped LLM-powered tools or workflows that non-engineering teams used every day, and can show their adoption and impact.

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering, mostly backend, ideally in Python or Go, with solid fundamentals in databases, APIs, integrations and production systems.

  • Can sit with an operations or compliance team, learn their process in their language, and explain technical decisions clearly to them.

  • Make sound judgement calls: when AI is the right tool and when simple code is better, and how to balance simplicity, cost, performance and speed of delivery.

  • Experience in fintech or compliance, integrating SaaS tools through APIs, webhooks or MCP, and everyday use of AI coding agents is a strong plus.

Some of what you'll do

  • Spend time with the operations, compliance, KYC and marketing teams, map their most repetitive and error-prone processes, and decide where AI helps, where plain automation is better, and where neither is worth it.

  • Build assistants for document review, onboarding and KYC checks, and case summarisation, always with human review, clear audit trails and strict handling of client data.

  • Ship early wins quickly, then turn what works into durable, maintained tools rather than one-off scripts.

  • Build the shared foundation later work will reuse: secure access to LLM providers, connectors to internal data and tools, evaluations, guardrails, logging and cost tracking.

  • Measure impact in time saved, error rates and adoption, and retire tools that don't earn their keep.

  • Later, extend this work to customer support, engineering, sales and finance.

  • Develop and maintain our microservice architecture across Investing, Trading, Account Management and Funding.

  • Build services that scale to tens of thousands of clients, with strong data consistency, error handling and resilience.

  • Own projects end to end, working with product, operations and other teams to shape requirements and scope.

  • Test developed code with automated unit and integration tests.

  • Python and Django

Alongside your CV, tell us in a few paragraphs about one workflow you automated or improved with AI for a team you weren't part of. What was the problem, what did you build, how did you know it worked, and what would you do differently?
