jobs.title: Photonic Layout Engineer
jobs.excerpt: HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond.
jobs.description:
HyperLight is at the forefront of the commercialization of thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) integrated photonics — a material and process technology that is enabling high-performance, scalable optical components across AI/datacom infrastructure, hyperscale computing, quantum computing, sensing, and beyond. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading venture capital, we’ve built a team and a platform focused on real-world mass deployment of TFLN photonics technology.

At the core of our work is the TFLN Chiplet™ platform: a modular architecture designed for scalability, manufacturability, and integration into complex systems. We partner with our customers and suppliers from concept and prototyping through mass production. We believe in integrity, innovation, collaboration, and pragmatic solutions, and we take pride in tackling hard problems with curiosity, humility, and a deep sense of care for one another.

We’re hiring a Senior Photonic Layout Engineer to join our layout team and turn TFLN device and circuit designs into manufacturable, tapeout-ready masks. Your layouts will go straight to the fab and into products that ship to customers.

You’ll collaborate with device designers, process engineers, and our test team to design the layout of product chips and test structures. Our layout tools are code-driven and most of your time will be spent writing software: we automate everything we can by building parametric cells and full-chip layouts in Python with GDSFactory and other script-driven layout tools.

TFLN and electro-optic experience are not required – we have deep in-house expertise and will teach you. Experienced layout engineers from silicon photonics, III-V, MEMS, or electronic IC backgrounds are all welcome.

Why this role:

  • Fast iteration: We tape out frequently, so you’ll see your work fabricated and tested on a cadence most photonics companies can’t match.
  • Ownership: You’ll shape the layout libraries, automation, and best practices our whole design team builds on.
  • An emerging platform: TFLN is one of the most exciting technologies in integrated photonics, and you’ll be building it at the commercial frontier.
  • Software-first culture: We treat layout like code, with version control, review, and automation, not hours of manual polygon-pushing.

As part of your responsibilities, you will:

  • Lay out integrated photonic devices, circuits, and full masks, including transmitter PICs, waveguides, couplers, EO modulators, and test structures.
  • Build and maintain parametric cells, routing, and layout automation tools using tools like Python (GDSFactory, Klayout) and Cadence Virtuoso.
  • Run DRC and other verification checks, triage violations, and work with the foundry on rule interpretation and waivers.
  • Prepare and deliver tapeouts: floor planning, mask assembly, design reviews, and on-time GDS handoff.
  • Help shape our layout libraries, design rules, and best practices, and keep the shared codebase clean and reviewable.

Requirements

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Materials Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on layout experience for photonic or electronic ICs, through industry work, research, or university projects.
  • Working knowledge of semiconductor or photonics physical layout tools such as GDSFactory, IPKISS, KLayout, Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Optodesigner, or similar.
  • Comfort scripting in languages like Python, and enthusiasm for software-driven layout.
  • Understanding of semiconductor or photonic fabrication and DRC.
  • Clear communication with designers, process engineers, and external partners.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • None of these are required, and we don’t expect any one candidate to have them all. If you have some, tell us about them.
  • Experience owning or coordinating tapeouts: schedules, mask assembly, MPW or dedicated runs, and fab communication.
  • Project management experience tracking deliverables and managing tradeoffs against deadlines.
  • Test or characterization experience with photonic or electronic devices, and an eye for designing layouts that are easy to test.
  • Silicon photonics, TFLN, III-V, or other integrated photonics layout experience.
  • RF or high-speed electrode layout, or co-design of optical and electrical structures.
  • Authoring or maintaining DRC rule decks (KLayout, Calibre, etc.) or contributing to a PDK.
  • Software engineering skills, such as version control, code review, and test-driven development.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers

Benefits

  • Competitive market-based compensation (salary range $100,000–$180,000 per year)
  • New hire equity/option grant
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, vision, and dental plans for individuals and families
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employee matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Commuter benefits and subsidies
  • Professional growth and mentorship opportunities

This role can be performed remotely from within the US, with periodic travel to our Cambridge, MA office; candidates local to the Boston area are welcome to work onsite. Authorization to work in the US is required.

HyperLight is an equal opportunity employer.
